chapters.title: Chapter 101 - 90: New Expansion: [Blood Tide]_2
paragraphs: Noticing that Cheng Jianyong’s strike was quite damaging.
Shen Yun immediately cast a Holy Light Shield on himself and boldly faced Cheng Jianyong’s attack head-on.
Clang!
The purple Great Sword clashed with the earthy-yellow Shield, emitting a muffled sound.
Cheng Jianyong’s deadly move had no effect; instead, the powerful recoil forced him to take a step back.
At this moment, Shen Yun seized the opportunity and cast ’Wind’s Blessing’ on himself.
Under the ’Wind’s Blessing’ state, attack speed and movement speed both increase by 20%.
In an instant, Shen Yun’s speed surged.
Then he swung his Big Hammer, pressing forward aggressively.
Clang! Clang! Clang!
The Big Hammer continuously hammered at Cheng Jianyong, occasionally mixing in some Shield Strikes.
Cheng Jianyong was forced to retreat continually, just then, a Crystal Stone Hammer suddenly smashed down from above his head.
The strong wind gusted towards him, petrifying Cheng Jianyong, rendering him motionless.
The Big Hammer finally stopped less than five centimeters from Cheng Jianyong’s nose.
It was obvious from this spar that Shen Yun had gained the upper hand.
"Damn!"
Cheng Jianyong broke out in a cold sweat of shock, "I thought you were really going to swing that hammer at me!"
Shen Yun burst into laughter, "So, Xiaoyongzi, do you admit defeat?"
Cheng Jianyong rolled his eyes at him and complained, "You’re just relying on the equipment advantage, otherwise you wouldn’t be my match."
However, Shen Yun widened his eyes and retorted, "So what if I rely on equipment? Equipment is a part of strength too."
"Unconvinced? Want to fight another round?"
Seeing Cheng Jianyong soften, Shen Yun also burst into laughter.
Watching the two bickering, Zhang Lianmeng couldn’t help but smile from the side.
Just then, a series of system notifications rang in everyone’s ears simultaneously.
Announcement: "All survivors, please note! All survivors, please note!"
"Due to unknown reasons, a terrifying Blood Red Disaster will erupt in the Land of the Abandoned Gods!"
"Considering the current strength of the survivors is insufficient to cope with this disaster, we have made the following adjustments to the game content."
"1: The probability of obtaining Advanced Profession Scrolls from chests has been greatly increased."
"2: When survivors defeat Cloud Monsters, the experience value gained is increased by 20%."
"3: To cope with this disaster, regional restrictions have been further lifted, merging zones 1-100 and 101-200 into one large zone, and so on."
"These adjustments will take effect in 1 hour, please prepare all survivors.
"New expansion: ’Blood Tide’ is about to go online..."
"With a blood-red sky and distorted bodies, as the mutated monsters swarm out, the Land of the Abandoned Gods will face a Blood Red Disaster..."
A barrage of system notifications not only baffled Han Xing and the others.
The tens of billions of survivors on Blue Star were also in an unprecedented state of shock!
Every chat channel in all large zones was almost simultaneously flooded!
"Woah! Bros, did you see the announcement? They say a disaster is about to strike!"
"Saw it, this disaster sounds terrifying, it even forced the system to make adjustments, letting us increase in power faster!"
"Oh my god! There’s going to be a merger of zones, turning one hundred zones into one large zone, doesn’t that mean we’ll go from having thousands simultaneously to nearly a million in one channel?"
A million is indeed a huge number.
The sudden system announcement left everyone in a state of confusion.
The survivors in Zone 107 were also discussing fiercely.
Just then, Han Xing received an unexpected notification.
"Due to your early discovery of the Otherworldly Evil God’s plot, revealing an impending disaster, World Impact +53, Legendary Points +5."
Han Xing was stunned. He knew that this system reward was likely because of the monster bird quest from last time.
But why was it given out so late?
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng also looked tense; it seemed she had heard something too.
Zhang Lianmeng held her collar, bent slightly, and whispered into Han Xing’s ear: "Brother Xing, did you hear the notification?"
"The system just said that I discovered the Evil God’s plot, and it gave me 5 Legendary Points..."
Han Xing suddenly remembered that Zhang Lianmeng was with him when he was doing that quest. That meant the task was completed by a team of two.
So, it was perfectly normal for the system to reward both of them with Legendary Points.
Han Xing nodded and said, "I heard it, those Legendary Points will be useful later, save them for now."
Currently, the role of Legendary Points is to draw Hidden Profession’s Legendary Skills.
Although Zhang Lianmeng has already switched to the Mage Elemental Master, a pure DPS profession, and with the equipment crafted by Han Xing, Zhang Lianmeng’s damage is now quite impressive.
But if a better Mage-type Hidden Profession Scroll is found in the future, Han Xing still plans to let Zhang Lianmeng switch again.
But doing so will come at a certain cost.
That is, the level will drop to level 10, and she will have to start leveling up again.
But with Han Xing’s leveling speed, he’d quickly help her catch up.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun were just coming back to their senses from the shock.
Before they could open their mouths, Han Xing directly said: "You all heard it, right? A new expansion is about to be released.
"It seems what I told you before might be coming true."
The two nodded solemnly. Just a few days ago, Han Xing had warned them that a disaster might soon occur.
Now, the system notification had confirmed it.
Han Xing continued: "Our plan needs to change a bit too."
"We don’t know when Blood Tide will break out, but there’s an imminent danger we face."
"After the merge, our zone here will swell from nearly 10,000 people to nearly a million, and by then, this area will be unprecedentedly chaotic!"
"And your territories are still unguarded now!"
"To prevent any accidents, I suggest you immediately return to your territories, fortify them, and then everyone gather in one place."
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun nodded immediately after hearing this.
What Han Xing said made perfect sense.
Last time when the regional restrictions were lifted, Zone 107 only had over 9,000 people, yet many bloodshed incidents broke out.
This time, with the merge, the number will directly reach over 900,000!
The probability of encountering other survivors will soar.
Realizing the seriousness of the situation, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun were just about to teleport away.
Just then, the second system notification appeared.
[As most of the zone’s Level Rankings have ended, we are now introducing a new leaderboard, the Cloud Secret Realm Points List.]
[Cloud Secret Realm Points List]: Each time you clear a One-Star Secret Realm, you will receive 1 point. Each time you clear a Two-Star Secret Realm, you will receive 2 points, and so on.]
[The Cloud Secret Realm Points List will last for ten days, and after it ends, ranking rewards will be settled based on the points.]

"Please note: During the event, when survivors clear the Cloud Secret Realm, experience value gained will increase by 30%, and damage dealt to monsters in the Cloud Secret Realm will increase by 10%."

"The process of the Cloud Secret Realm will be modified, and once modifications are complete, there will no longer be cutscenes in all Cloud Secret Realms, and the difficulty will accordingly decrease."
"These modifications will take effect in one day!"
The three looked at each other.
At this moment, Shen Yun said: "Brother Xing, there’s a new leaderboard, should we go for a run at the Cloud Secret Realm Points List?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment before asking, "Have you two tried the Cloud Secret Realm before?"
Shen Yun nodded, "Yes, we did."
"Cheng Jianyong and I came across a One-Star Secret Realm before, the level requirement was 7-10, and we decided to challenge it. It took us over an hour."
"However, the reward for clearing it was indeed immense, especially the experience value reward, which was much richer than fighting monsters."
Shen Yun added, "But unfortunately, clearing the Cloud Secret Realm doesn’t increase the territory area."
Han Xing nodded and said, "That’s right, the experience rewards given inside the Cloud are abundant, and sometimes there are also special item rewards."
"Since this leaderboard has appeared, we might as well make a push for it!"

chapters.title: Chapter 102 - 91: The Second Server Merge
paragraphs: Han Xing proposed that Cheng and Shen return to their own territories.

After pausing for a moment, Han Xing continued, "Right, after you return, send a coordinate first, then our three Sky Islands will move closer together. If you encounter the Cloud Secret Realm on the way, pay attention to it."
"Okay." Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun nodded.
Then, the two left Han Xing’s territory in succession.
After the Teleportation Array’s one-hour cooldown, Shen Yun’s figure disappeared from the array.
All the Survivors felt a strange change.
This feeling was indescribable, as if at this moment, they felt their world had become a bit larger.
At the same time,
the system prompt appeared.
"The current update is complete. The 107 district you are in has now been merged into the 2 major districts."
Han Xing hadn’t opened the chat channel, but he could imagine how lively it would be now without needing to check.
Originally, most people from the 107 district were from Xinyang City.
This district merger essentially combined people from many different cities into one.
At this moment, in the chat channel.
There were countless people looking for others, recognizing relatives, seeking team-ups, and indiscriminately venting.
After the initial chaos, the recruitment information from some large teams began to flood the screen.
"111 district’s largest group, Cybertron is recruiting. We already have over three thousand members and are extensively recruiting from all major districts!"
"187 district’s top team, Peak of Ceasefire is recruiting. We only have over three hundred members, but all are elites, with a minimum of level ten Professionals!"
"Don’t compete with us! 199 district’s strongest group, Digital Celestial Team is recruiting. Our leader is the top-ranked dual leader, and we have over five thousand members!"
All the major districts’ teams began a frenzy of recruitment, understanding that now, right after the district merger, was the best time to recruit.
Seizing this opportunity could expand their team sizes severalfold, even tenfold!
These people were organized, with unified command.
Soon, the chaotic chat channel was dominated by those large teams from various districts.
Han Xing took a glance and directly closed it.
With more than ninety thousand people in the same channel, it was comparable to the population of a large city, bound to be incredibly chaotic, which was expected.
"Everyone is recruiting?"
Han Xing pondered, "It seems it’s going to be chaotic for a while."
At this time, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun sent over a string of numbers, which were the coordinates for their upcoming meeting.
Han Xing started maneuvering the Sky Island and continued moving towards the coordinates.
Half an hour later,
Zhang Lianmeng suddenly ran to Han Xing’s side, tugging at his clothes.
Seeing her nervous face, Han Xing followed her gaze to look ahead.
In the distance, several floating Sky Islands were vaguely approaching him.
These Sky Islands had no cloud coverage and were clearly other survivors’ territories.
"More Survivors."
Han Xing frowned, "Has the probability of encountering other Survivors increased so much after the district merger?
Less than half an hour after lifting the region restriction, Han Xing encountered the first wave of human Survivors.
At this moment, the gap between both sides was no more than five kilometers.
Han Xing could even vaguely see the layout of the opponent’s Sky Island.
Like other survivors’ Sky Islands, they were barren, with only some rudimentary camps and bonfires.
There were no large structures on these Sky Islands.
Compared to Han Xing’s territory, theirs seemed like an undeveloped wasteland.
The previous leaderboard rewards, though they issued a batch of Lord’s Cottage and Spiritual Shield Pyramid building blueprints,
but with most Survivors’ current resources, even if they had the blueprints, they couldn’t construct them.
At this moment, the huge castle on Han Xing’s territory and the hundreds of turret-like buildings appeared exceptionally eye-catching.
Han Xing guessed that these people probably got curious after seeing the buildings in his territory and wanted to approach for a closer look.
However, Han Xing had no intention of interacting with them much.
So, he directly turned around and maneuvered his Sky Island Territory to leave.
Aware of Han Xing’s intention to flee, the two Sky Islands behind seemed to begin to speed up as well.
Han Xing, now at level 12, had a Sky Island speed of 108 kilometers per hour, and with the territory castle’s bonus, this speed could increase by another 10%.
At this stage, few Survivors should be able to catch up with him.
The three Sky Islands pursued one after another.
Four minutes later, those two Sky Islands were left far behind by Han Xing.
At this point, seeing they couldn’t catch Han Xing, the survivors on those two Sky Islands had no choice but to stop their pursuit.
The two survivors seemed to know each other, one was a human knight (an advanced Holy Profession), the other an illusionist (an advanced Mage Profession).
Both of them had a "Tank" character printed on their chests.
This symbol indicated that they were both from the same team, Cybertron of District 111.
At the first opportunity after the district merger, Cybertron’s management released information on their team channel and united the nearby members.

At this time, the human knight was contacting someone, whispering, "Boss, we just discovered a strange sky island, and there’s actually a large castle on it! There are also many strange structures that look like turrets!"
The opposite side quickly responded, "Oh? Territory castle and turret buildings?"
He was very curious and asked, "Did you try to make contact with the people on the sky island?"
The human knight immediately replied, "No, the person seems uninterested in dealing with us."
"As soon as we got close, he directly controlled the sky island to leave, and his sky island is much faster than ours, we can’t catch up!"
At this time, a large sky island territory, a man in his thirties fell into deep thought.
He was wearing nearly a half set of purple equipment, well-refined.
On the territory, a lord’s cottage covering more than a hundred square meters had also been built halfway.

Not only that, but beside the lord’s cottage, a golden armored giant over ten meters tall was standing guard, indicating that this person was the one who secured the first-place reward in their district.
He was the leader of Cybertron of District 111, Optimus Prime.
Listening to his subordinate’s report, Optimus Prime fell into contemplation.
"A castle? It sounds like a building even higher level than the lord’s cottage, and at this current phase, someone actually managed to build such things before me?"
"Last time, building the lord’s cottage nearly depleted my resource reserves, causing me to have no time to build the Spiritual Shield Pyramid and Teleportation Array."
"The person built a large castle, consuming even more resources...
"Moreover, there are many turret-type buildings, building these territorial facilities alone must have cost a fortune."
"According to this description, the resources he possesses are probably even more terrifying than I imagined!"
Cybertron paused, then said to the two survivors, "You should come back, don’t follow them anymore!"

"This person is quite capable, might have a large team backing them with resources. Although we are number one in District 111, now that the districts just merged, we should be low-key given we don’t fully understand the strengths of other districts."
"With over 900,000 people in the same major district, there are bound to be many concealed talents, don’t provoke such major powers easily."
The human knight and human illusionist exchanged a glance, then nodded.
"Okay, boss."
"Received!"
After shaking off the entanglement of those two survivors,
Han Xing continued on his journey.
However, much to his frustration,
along the way, he encountered several other survivors’ sky islands.
These people, seeing the buildings on Han Xing’s territory, were intrigued and wanted to come over to take a look.
Han Xing didn’t want to get entangled with them, so he controlled the territory to take a detour.
After several times, although he shook off those people’s pursuit, it involuntarily made Han Xing feel a bit irritable inside.
Han Xing complained, "Damn, why does it feel like I’m a naked little wife right now, seeing everyone wants to come and take a sneak peek."
Beside him, Zhang Lianmeng was amused by his joke, laughing with flowers swaying.
Due to her large movements, Zhang Lianmeng’s full chest started to bounce again.
Seeing this, Han Xing suddenly said, "Lian’er, in a moment, you should go hide in the castle for a bit, don’t come out for now."
Zhang Lianmeng seemed a bit confused and asked, "Ah? Why, Brother Xing’er?"
Han Xing glanced at her, "Don’t you understand, your very presence is like an amplifier of desire for most men."
"I don’t want those lust-driven guys seeing you and then playing out some bad drama."
Upon hearing this, Zhang Lianmeng suddenly realized something, blushing, she said, "No... it’s not that exaggerated..."
"I only show myself to Brother Xing alone..."
After speaking, she turned around shyly and obediently trotted into the castle.
Watching her back, wrapped in a blue and purple patterned magic robe, swaying hips that awake deep desires unintentionally as she walked.
Especially when Han Xing had seen with his own eyes that under that magic robe lies a figure even more exaggerated than what meets the eye.
Thinking of that image made Han Xing’s mouth dry, even made him want to rush over and carry that beauty to savor carefully.
Han Xing quickly shook his head to keep himself alert.
He said somewhat sheepishly, "Oh come on, what a modern enchanting demon..."
At this moment, he suddenly thought, "If only there was some sort of item that could block outside probing, like those sky islands covered in clouds."
"This way, I wouldn’t always be surrounded and watched by these indiscreet fellows."
Then Han Xing continued to control the sky island forward.
Following his several evasions from the survivors’ pursuit,
the news of a peculiar sky island in this region gradually spread among some small groups of survivors.

The opposite side quickly responded, "Oh?
Territory castle and turret buildings?"
He was very curious and asked, "Did you try to make contact with the people on the sky island?"
The human knight immediately replied, "No, the person seems uninterested in dealing with us."
"As soon as we got close, he directly controlled the sky island to leave, and his sky island is much faster than ours, we can’t catch up!"
At this time, a large sky island territory, a man in his thirties fell into deep thought.
He was wearing nearly a half set of purple equipment, well-refined.
On the territory, a lord’s cottage covering more than a hundred square meters had also been built halfway.

Not only that, but beside the lord’s cottage, a golden armored giant over ten meters tall was standing guard, indicating that this person was the one who secured the first-place reward in their district.
He was the leader of Cybertron of District 111, Optimus Prime.
Listening to his subordinate’s report, Optimus Prime fell into contemplation.
"A castle?
It sounds like a building even higher level than the lord’s cottage, and at this current phase, someone actually managed to build such things before me?"
"Last time, building the lord’s cottage nearly depleted my resource reserves, causing me to have no time to build the Spiritual Shield Pyramid and Teleportation Array."
"The person built a large castle, consuming even more resources...
"Moreover, there are many turret-type buildings, building these territorial facilities alone must have cost a fortune."
"According to this description, the resources he possesses are probably even more terrifying than I imagined!"
Cybertron paused, then said to the two survivors, "You should come back, don’t follow them anymore!"
"This person is quite capable, might have a large team backing them with resources.
Although we are number one in District 111, now that the districts just merged, we should be low-key given we don’t fully understand the strengths of other districts."
"With over 900,000 people in the same major district, there are bound to be many concealed talents, don’t provoke such major powers easily."
The human knight and human illusionist exchanged a glance, then nodded.
"Okay, boss."
"Received!"
After shaking off the entanglement of those two survivors,
Han Xing continued on his journey.
However, much to his frustration,
along the way, he encountered several other survivors’ sky islands.
These people, seeing the buildings on Han Xing’s territory, were intrigued and wanted to come over to take a look.
Han Xing didn’t want to get entangled with them, so he controlled the territory to take a detour.
After several times, although he shook off those people’s pursuit, it involuntarily made Han Xing feel a bit irritable inside.
Han Xing complained, "Damn, why does it feel like I’m a naked little wife right now, seeing everyone wants to come and take a sneak peek."
Beside him, Zhang Lianmeng was amused by his joke, laughing with flowers swaying.
Due to her large movements, Zhang Lianmeng’s full chest started to bounce again.
Seeing this, Han Xing suddenly said, "Lian’er, in a moment, you should go hide in the castle for a bit, don’t come out for now."
Zhang Lianmeng seemed a bit confused and asked, "Ah?
Why, Brother Xing’er?"
Han Xing glanced at her, "Don’t you understand, your very presence is like an amplifier of desire for most men."
"I don’t want those lust-driven guys seeing you and then playing out some bad drama."
Upon hearing this, Zhang Lianmeng suddenly realized something, blushing, she said, "No... it’s not that exaggerated..."
"I only show myself to Brother Xing alone..."
After speaking, she turned around shyly and obediently trotted into the castle.
Watching her back, wrapped in a blue and purple patterned magic robe, swaying hips that awake deep desires unintentionally as she walked.
Especially when Han Xing had seen with his own eyes that under that magic robe lies a figure even more exaggerated than what meets the eye.
Thinking of that image made Han Xing’s mouth dry, even made him want to rush over and carry that beauty to savor carefully.
Han Xing quickly shook his head to keep himself alert.
He said somewhat sheepishly, "Oh come on, what a modern enchanting demon..."
At this moment, he suddenly thought, "If only there was some sort of item that could block outside probing, like those sky islands covered in clouds."
"This way, I wouldn’t always be surrounded and watched by these indiscreet fellows."
Then Han Xing continued to control the sky island forward.
Following his several evasions from the survivors’ pursuit,
the news of a peculiar sky island in this region gradually spread among some small groups of survivors.

chapters.title: Chapter 103 - 92: Slaughter
paragraphs: Han Xing’s territory maintained a steady pace, moving forward.
Just then, Han Xing suddenly saw many sky islands appear ahead.
Upon seeing Han Xing, they quickly dispersed and then closed in on him from different directions.
Han Xing counted, a total of six, all human survivor territories.
Moreover, these people seemed clearly premeditated and organized.
They appeared simultaneously and closed in from various directions, encircling Han Xing’s sky island.
Han Xing frowned, preparing to ascend into the sky and breakthrough by force.
Just then, another sky island appeared overhead, blocking Han Xing.
Han Xing’s gaze gradually turned cold. Seeing that he couldn’t shake off the encirclement, he simply stopped.
A moment later.
The seven sky islands were less than a kilometer away from Han Xing and still closing in.
At this moment, Han Xing said coldly, "Take one more step, and you’ll bear the consequences yourself."
His voice wasn’t loud, yet it was extraordinarily clear in this vast sky.
Hearing Han Xing’s warning, the seven sky islands stopped moving forward.
At that moment, several human survivors walked from the center to the edge of the territory.
They craned their necks, curiously observing the buildings on Han Xing’s territory.
It was evident that these individuals had good equipment, each with one or two pieces of blue equipment.
At least among ordinary players, their equipment strength was already considered good.
Directly in front of Han Xing.
A male Stalker (an advanced profession of Tracker) chuckled softly and said, "Friend, I am Luo Gai, the deputy leader of the Between the Clouds team in area 132. Our team..."
Han Xing interrupted directly, "No need to introduce yourself, just say what you want. I’m in a hurry."
Hearing Han Xing’s rather impolite response.
The other six human survivors’ expressions darkened.
At this moment, a young male Berserker (an advanced profession of Warrior) from the back shouted, "Kid, mind your manners when speaking to our deputy leader!"
"What if I’m not polite?"
Han Xing turned back to look, "You guys stopped me without any reason, and now you expect me to be polite?"
"You’re really like a monkey climbing a bamboo pole, jumping up and down in front of me, aren’t you?"
"You!"
"What you, look at your country bumpkin demeanor, coming to this world still thinking about being someone’s dog. Your master isn’t even in a hurry, but you are?"
That male Berserker was flustered and exasperated, his face turning red from Han Xing’s tirade?
He wanted to say more, but was interrupted by the Stalker named Luo Gai, "Little Tiger, shut up."
The male Berserker immediately closed his mouth.
Then, the Stalker named Luo Gai chuckled, "Friend, it was indeed presumptuous of us to stop you."
"But we did this to give this brother an opportunity to develop."
Han Xing, intrigued, said, "Give me an opportunity?"

Luo Gai, not angry, continued, "Indeed, you might not know, but our Between the Clouds is the largest team in area 132, with more than three thousand members. Our leader has won two consecutive top rewards on the leaderboard, making us a formidable force."
"I see this young brother does not bear a team insignia; achieving this scale alone must mean your skills are not lacking either."
"If you were to join us, you would surely receive exceptional treatment."
Han Xing immediately refused, "Not interested."
Hearing Han Xing’s refusal, the others’ expressions changed.
But this seemed to be within Luo Gai’s expectations, and he continued to smile, "Friend, meeting is fate. Since you don’t want to join us, I won’t force you."
"However, we are extremely curious about the buildings on your territory. Could this friend perhaps let us up to have a look?"
"Rest assured, we just want to look around, with absolutely no ulterior motives."
Luo Gai’s request was quite presumptuous; normally, no one would agree.
However, they had already surrounded Han Xing, and with their numerical advantage, they bet Han Xing wouldn’t dare refuse.
Under Luo Gai’s lead, the seven sky islands closed in again.
Seeing this move, Han Xing realized these people were finally ready to show their true colors.
He sneered, "Looks like you’ve finally shown your fox tails."
"Now, I’m warning you one last time, clear the way, or bear the consequences yourselves."
Han Xing still wore a sneer but now, his gaze carried a tinge of killing intent.
"Brother Gai, this kid is too ungrateful. Should we just take him out?" asked a human Divine Archer beside him.
Luo Gai still wore a smile, but he did not answer immediately?
The atmosphere instantly became somewhat serious.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng, hiding within the castle, seemed to sense something was wrong.
This group seemed intent on forcing their way onboard.
Worried about a potential fight breaking out, Zhang Lianmeng stepped out to help, holding a magic staff with a tense expression as she walked out of the castle.
Just then, Luo Gai and the other survivors seemed to also notice the graceful figure behind Han Xing.
In that instant, all the surrounding scenery, the sky, clouds, and sky islands.
Paled in comparison to Zhang Lianmeng’s angelic face and devilish figure.
Their attention was entirely captured by Zhang Lianmeng, their breaths involuntarily becoming rapid.
At that moment, including Luo Gai, a greedy look appeared in their eyes.
It was several seconds before they snapped back to reality.
Previously, Luo Gai had hesitated about dealing with Han Xing.
But now, he had made up his mind.
Kill this kid!
At this moment, Luo Gai exchanged glances with the others.
The others understood and prepared to encircle.
Han Xing sneered as he directly opened the territory building interface, slowly manipulating one hundred and twenty siege crossbow arrow launcher platforms to adjust the attack direction.
Realizing Han Xing’s attack intention, Luo Gai immediately ordered, "This kid wants to attack us, quickly rush onto his territory, don’t give him a chance!"
The other survivors heard this and quickly accelerated towards Han Xing!
"Courting death!" Han Xing said coldly.
More than two hundred siege crossbows were already loaded, with no need for charging.
Under Han Xing’s control,
Twenty siege crossbows instantly aimed at the approaching Sky Island, Luo Gai’s territory.
Seeing Han Xing’s crossbow launcher platforms targeting him, at this moment, Luo Gai seemed to have a bad premonition in his heart.
He suddenly turned around and fled into his Lord’s Cottage.
Inside, Luo Gai’s voice came: "Don’t mind me, this kid can’t break my Lord’s Cottage in a short time!"
"All of you forcefully land on his territory now, then take this kid out, by then, his woman, his castle, will all be ours!"
The other six survivors saw the crossbows aimed at them and paused, hesitating to enter the field.
At this moment, hearing Luo Gai’s instigation, their gazes instantly turned red.
Luo Gai wanted to use the Lord’s Cottage’s five hundred defense points to counter Han Xing’s attack.
It must be said, his decision was correct.
However, he misestimated the destructive power of the siege crossbows.
The next moment.
Twenty giant arrows shot out fiercely like arrows off the string.
Swish, swish, swish!
The tearing sound of breaking through the air followed.
The giant arrows instantly hit the walls of the Lord’s Cottage.
Boom!
Sounds like exploding cannonballs followed in succession.
Luo Gai watched as the 500 defense value on his Lord’s Cottage instantly cleared.
The calmness in his eyes disappeared, replaced by sheer horror!
"How is this possible?"
Luo Gai was full of disbelief.
The next moment, the Lord’s Cottage collapsed directly.
The remaining giant crossbow arrows pierced through the land, only one meter thick, of his territory.
This also included Luo Gai’s core territory.
As Luo Gai’s core territory was blown up by Han Xing,
he watched helplessly as the Sky Island, painstakingly built to a few thousand square meters, shattered into pieces at this moment.
Crash.
Sky Island fragments scattered.
The terrifying destructive power of the siege crossbows initially showed its edge!
After the Sky Island shattered, Luo Gai fell from ten thousand meters high.
He was horrified and a trace of regret rose in his heart.
However, at this time, Han Xing still had no intention of letting him go.
Controlling one of the crossbow launcher platforms, an arrow was shot fiercely.
Whoosh!
The sound of a crossbow arrow piercing flesh followed, and Luo Gai was pierced through the chest by the giant arrow.
"Ah!"
After a hair-raising scream, Luo Gai’s body began to fall, then disappeared from everyone’s sight.
At this time, the other six survivors between the clouds heard Luo Gai’s scream and suddenly trembled all over.
And when they saw Han Xing slowly adjusting the large crossbow launcher platform on the Sky Island, they were all scared witless, starting to flee madly.
"Damn, run!"
"His crossbow arrows are too powerful, can’t be resisted at all!"
Han Xing sneered, "Can you run?"
The next moment, a hundred giant crossbow launcher platforms fired in unison.
Han Xing did not need to aim, it was enough to directly carry out a fire coverage.
Crash!
Giant arrows fell like raindrops, with an overwhelming force, fiercely stabbing into the territories of these survivors.
Compared to Luo Gai, these survivors had not even built a Lord’s Cottage.
Their core territories were as fragile as paper.
A giant arrow could penetrate directly.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
As one core territory after another was destroyed by Han Xing, their Sky Islands shattered into pieces in the air one after another.
In the terrified eyes of those survivors, Han Xing fired another round of crossbow arrows to finish them off.
"No!"
"I was wrong... spare... spare me..."
"Let me go... ah!!"
Behind every scream, a survivor’s life was ended by a siege crossbow arrow.
Among them, there was an unlucky one who was hit in the head by a giant arrow before his territory shattered, ending up with a bowl-sized blood hole on his face, dying miserably.
With the last core of a Sky Island being blown up by Han Xing, the surrounding scene became empty again, as if nothing had ever happened here.

chapters.title: Chapter 104 - 93: Powerful Leaderboard Rewards!
paragraphs: After dealing with this batch of people who didn’t know better, the killing intent in Han Xing’s eyes gradually dissipated.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng was looking at Han Xing, her face pale.

It was her first time witnessing human conflict. Though she felt extremely uncomfortable, Zhang Lianmeng still held back her urge to vomit and walked to Han Xing’s side, saying, "Brother Xing, how are you?"
However, before she could finish speaking, Zhang Lianmeng suddenly doubled over, squatting on the ground and beginning to retch.
Han Xing walked over and gently patted her back.
Zhang Lianmeng looked up and then suddenly threw herself into Han Xing’s arms.
"Brother Xing, I’m sorry... I’m a little scared."
Han Xing hugged her and comforted, "Being scared is normal. These kinds of things will probably happen quite often later on, so you need to adapt quickly."
Zhang Lianmeng lightly bit her lip and nodded heavily.
Han Xing glanced around, and then continued to maneuver the Sky Island forward.
And just after Han Xing and the others left.
About seven or eight kilometers away from the site of their battle, a Survivor’s Sky Island quickly appeared.
On that Sky Island, a human Swordsman was staring in shock, saying, "Wow, what a sight to wake up to, actually witnessing a fight between humans!"
"What kind of monster is this, taking on seven alone and still ending the fight so quickly!"
"If I were to tell anyone about this, they simply wouldn’t believe it."
The human Warrior felt fortunate at this moment, saying, "But fortunately, I recorded the video."
"If I post this video on the forum, it will definitely cause a sensation!"
Thinking of this, he quickly pulled up the system interface.
Meanwhile, a post was uploaded to the Survivor’s Forum in District 2, and it rapidly garnered a huge amount of clicks.
The title was: "Mysterious Sky Island Player, Taking on Seven, Killed in Seconds!"
People were attracted by this concise yet powerful title, and upon clicking in, they were confronted by a video clip.
The video recorded the scene of Han Xing fighting with other Survivor teams.
However, it seemed the shooter’s perspective was from a great distance, only able to see seven Sky Islands encircling one Sky Island, preparing to close in.
And in the next moment, they saw a large Arrow suddenly shoot out from the encircled large Sky Island, directly blowing up a Survivor’s Lord’s Cottage, along with the core territory.
After this, the same fate befell the other six Sky Islands.
The clean and decisive battle, one-sidedly crushing the opponents, left people feeling profoundly shocked, unable to calm down for a long time.
Soon, the first reply appeared beneath the post.
"Oh my, what terrifying offensive power! Does anyone know what that thing is?"
"No idea, but it looks like some kind of Crossbow Arrow launching device!"
"A Crossbow Arrow launching device? The damage is truly frightening!"
Everyone was discussing fervently.
At this time, someone else left a message.
"Did you notice, that Sky Island is much larger than our territories, the thickness is even up to three meters, which is equivalent to three times the space, and I seem to have seen a castle on it!"
"A castle and Crossbow Arrow Launcher Platform, whose player in which major district is this?"
People began to speculate about the identity of this mysterious figure.
However, these Survivors from other districts couldn’t figure it out at all.

Before the districts merged, even those top-ranking strong individuals merely had territory areas just reaching ten thousand square meters, and on their territories, they hadn’t built such High Level buildings as castles.
Individuals like Han Xing, not only building a castle but also constructing a bunch of Attack facilities, were truly rare spectacles among all humankind.
Just at this time, a different reply appeared beneath this post.
The speaker was a Survivor called Bai Yunshu.
He left a message in the post: "Everyone, I am Bai Yunshu, the leader of the 132nd District’s first regiment, Between the Clouds."
"I am hereby releasing a request for assistance, hoping to find the individual in the video, with a handsome reward."
"Anyone who can provide information on this individual’s identity can come to Bai for a set of Blue Equipment."
"Anyone who can provide the individual’s location can come to Bai for a piece of Purple Equipment."
As a prominent figure in the 132nd District, Bai Yunshu had some recognition.
His message caught much attention.
Though Bai Yunshu did not disclose his purpose, others were left puzzled.
What they didn’t know was that the few people Han Xing killed were all group members of Between the Clouds, one of them even being their deputy leader.
And Bai Yunshu’s search for Han Xing was not for revenge.
For him, a few unrelated group members dying was of no concern.
He was only interested in the powerful Crossbow Arrow Launcher Platform on Han Xing’s territory.
Being a regiment leader of a major district, Bai Yunshu understood better than anyone what it meant to have a bunch of Attack facilities at this stage.
If he could recruit this person into his team and get hold of the blueprints for his Crossbow Arrow Launch Platforms, then Bai Yunshu’s strength would skyrocket!
However, when the Survivors of District 107 came across this post and saw Bai Yunshu’s message, their hearts were somewhat stirred.
They remembered the individual in their region.
But, they silently refrained from mentioning the name Star River.
After all, the shooting angle of this video was too far, and they couldn’t be sure if the person was indeed that individual.
After the previous transactions, Han Xing had established a mysterious and powerful image among the Survivors of District 107, and besides that, he had a reputation for being stingy...
Yes, stingy.
He would refuse trades with others just because of disputes over words.

I’m a little scared."
Han Xing hugged her and comforted, "Being scared is normal.
These kinds of things will probably happen quite often later on, so you need to adapt quickly."
Zhang Lianmeng lightly bit her lip and nodded heavily.
Han Xing glanced around, and then continued to maneuver the Sky Island forward.
And just after Han Xing and the others left.
About seven or eight kilometers away from the site of their battle, a Survivor’s Sky Island quickly appeared.
On that Sky Island, a human Swordsman was staring in shock, saying, "Wow, what a sight to wake up to, actually witnessing a fight between humans!"
"What kind of monster is this, taking on seven alone and still ending the fight so quickly!"
"If I were to tell anyone about this, they simply wouldn’t believe it."
The human Warrior felt fortunate at this moment, saying, "But fortunately, I recorded the video."
"If I post this video on the forum, it will definitely cause a sensation!"
Thinking of this, he quickly pulled up the system interface.
Meanwhile, a post was uploaded to the Survivor’s Forum in District 2, and it rapidly garnered a huge amount of clicks.
The title was: "Mysterious Sky Island Player, Taking on Seven, Killed in Seconds!"
People were attracted by this concise yet powerful title, and upon clicking in, they were confronted by a video clip.
The video recorded the scene of Han Xing fighting with other Survivor teams.
However, it seemed the shooter’s perspective was from a great distance, only able to see seven Sky Islands encircling one Sky Island, preparing to close in.
And in the next moment, they saw a large Arrow suddenly shoot out from the encircled large Sky Island, directly blowing up a Survivor’s Lord’s Cottage, along with the core territory.
After this, the same fate befell the other six Sky Islands.
The clean and decisive battle, one-sidedly crushing the opponents, left people feeling profoundly shocked, unable to calm down for a long time.
Soon, the first reply appeared beneath the post.
"Oh my, what terrifying offensive power!
Does anyone know what that thing is?"
"No idea, but it looks like some kind of Crossbow Arrow launching device!"
"A Crossbow Arrow launching device?
The damage is truly frightening!"
Everyone was discussing fervently.
At this time, someone else left a message.
"Did you notice, that Sky Island is much larger than our territories, the thickness is even up to three meters, which is equivalent to three times the space, and I seem to have seen a castle on it!"
"A castle and Crossbow Arrow Launcher Platform, whose player in which major district is this?"
People began to speculate about the identity of this mysterious figure.
However, these Survivors from other districts couldn’t figure it out at all.

Before the districts merged, even those top-ranking strong individuals merely had territory areas just reaching ten thousand square meters, and on their territories, they hadn’t built such High Level buildings as castles.
Individuals like Han Xing, not only building a castle but also constructing a bunch of Attack facilities, were truly rare spectacles among all humankind.
Just at this time, a different reply appeared beneath this post.
The speaker was a Survivor called Bai Yunshu.
He left a message in the post: "Everyone, I am Bai Yunshu, the leader of the 132nd District’s first regiment, Between the Clouds."
"I am hereby releasing a request for assistance, hoping to find the individual in the video, with a handsome reward."
"Anyone who can provide information on this individual’s identity can come to Bai for a set of Blue Equipment."
"Anyone who can provide the individual’s location can come to Bai for a piece of Purple Equipment."
As a prominent figure in the 132nd District, Bai Yunshu had some recognition.
His message caught much attention.
Though Bai Yunshu did not disclose his purpose, others were left puzzled.
What they didn’t know was that the few people Han Xing killed were all group members of Between the Clouds, one of them even being their deputy leader.
And Bai Yunshu’s search for Han Xing was not for revenge.
For him, a few unrelated group members dying was of no concern.
He was only interested in the powerful Crossbow Arrow Launcher Platform on Han Xing’s territory.
Being a regiment leader of a major district, Bai Yunshu understood better than anyone what it meant to have a bunch of Attack facilities at this stage.
If he could recruit this person into his team and get hold of the blueprints for his Crossbow Arrow Launch Platforms, then Bai Yunshu’s strength would skyrocket!
However, when the Survivors of District 107 came across this post and saw Bai Yunshu’s message, their hearts were somewhat stirred.
They remembered the individual in their region.
But, they silently refrained from mentioning the name Star River.
After all, the shooting angle of this video was too far, and they couldn’t be sure if the person was indeed that individual.
After the previous transactions, Han Xing had established a mysterious and powerful image among the Survivors of District 107, and besides that, he had a reputation for being stingy...
Yes, stingy.
He would refuse trades with others just because of disputes over words.

chapters.title: Chapter 105 - 93: Powerful Leaderboard Rewards! (Part 2)
paragraphs: It will also publish bounties for retaliation due to others’ sabotage, not stopping until the opponent is forced into a dead end.
If you offend this person based solely on some guesses, that would be a loss outweighing the gain.
At this moment, Han Xing continues to rush towards the coordinate area.
He hasn’t opened the chat channel and doesn’t know that the leader of Between the Clouds is looking for him.
However, even if he knew, he wouldn’t care.
To him, players now can’t pose any threat to him.
As long as they haven’t built a territorial construction comparable to the Siege Crossbow Arrow Launcher Platform, no matter how many come, they are dead.

In the past two days of free time, Han Xing did not forget to continue making Giant Crossbow Arrows, not only filling over two hundred launching platforms but also having an extra stock of over five thousand Giant Crossbow Arrows, which can be considered ample ammunition.
Just then, a system prompt appeared.
"Cloud Secret Realm Points Leaderboard update is complete, now, all survivors can go to the Points Leaderboard to view rewards."
"Note: Due to this region merger, the competition for the leaderboard has increased in number, and this time the number of places will be adjusted accordingly."
Upon hearing the system prompt, Han Xing opened the leaderboard.
Unlike before when there were only one hundred rewards, this time there are as many as ten thousand reward slots!
"Reward for ranks 10000-1000: Catapult Construction Blueprint*1, Wolf Cavalry Camp Map Blueprint*1, Moonlight Spring Construction Plan*1, Self-select Purple Weapon*1, Spirit Core*10000."

"Reward for ranks 999-100: Catapult Construction Blueprint*1, Wolf Cavalry Camp Map Blueprint*1, Moonlight Spring Construction Plan*1, Lord Contract Scroll*3, Self-select Purple Weapon*1, Spirit Core*20000."

"Reward for ranks 99 to 10: Catapult Construction Blueprint*1, Wolf Cavalry Camp Map Blueprint*1, Moonlight Spring Construction Plan*1, Lord Contract Scroll*5, Self-select Purple Weapon*1, Spirit Core*50000."

"Reward for ranks 9 to 4: Catapult Construction Blueprint*1, Minotaur Camp Map Blueprint*1, Moonlight Spring Construction Plan*1, Lord Contract Scroll*10, Self-select Purple Weapon*1, Spirit Core*100000."
Compared to the previous leaderboard rewards, this time the rewards are also generous.
Moreover, just like the last level leaderboard, this time also launched new types of territorial construction blueprints.
Han Xing opened these blueprints one by one for inspection.

[Catapult Construction Blueprint]: Territorial construction, can mass build catapults within the territory, catapults have 50 points of Defense Value, Attack Power of 700~780, with an additional 30% splash damage.

[Wolf Cavalry Camp Map Blueprint]: Territorial construction, a Wolf Cavalry Camp can be built within the territory, the lord can upgrade technology to enhance the wolf cavalry’s level, unlocking new skills for them, Wolf Cavalry Camp Defense Value is 200.

[Moonlight Spring Construction Plan]: Consume materials to build a Moonlight Holy Spring within the territory, within the coverage of the Moonlight Holy Spring, the recovery speed of injuries significantly accelerates, Moonlight Spring Defense Value is 300.

[Minotaur Camp]: Consume materials to build a camp within the territory that can recruit Minotaur Vanguards, with a chance to recruit Elite Level Minotaur Vanguards, by upgrading technology, enhance the Minotaurs’ level, unlocking new skills for them, camp Defense Value is 250.
"Another batch of new building blueprints!" Han Xing exclaimed.
The new building blueprints launched on the leaderboard are ones that Han Xing did not have.
And each has a unique function.
The first Catapult Construction Blueprint is clearly a type of offensive territorial construction.
Although Han Xing already has the Siege Crossbow Arrow Launcher Platform now, the crossbow arrows excel in individual damage without area damage.
If another row of catapults is built behind the Siege Crossbow Arrows, the lethality and deterrence will multiply!
Then there are the Wolf Cavalry and Minotaur Camps, these two blueprints are a type of recruitment building, to simply put, to recruit some cannon fodder.
Among them, in terms of individual combat capability, Minotaurs seem to be stronger than Wolf Cavalry by a notch, and most crucially, there’s a chance to recruit Elite Level Minotaurs.
When the number of cannon fodder reaches a certain level, a quantitative change can lead to a qualitative change.
Currently, although Han Xing’s territory is guarded by eight puppets, he does not have the blueprint to make Spiritual Cores, so he cannot produce them in bulk.
There’s also Moonlight Spring, once built on the territory, it can continuously help heal the creatures’ injuries within the territory.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng asked: "Brother Xing, don’t we still have many Life Secret Elixirs? What is the difference in recovery between Moonlight Spring and Life Secret Elixirs?"

Han Xing shook his head and said: "It’s different; Life Secret Elixir can only heal the severe injury state of One-star Creatures, we have now all completed Profession advancement to Two-star Professionals, the recovery effect of Life Secret Elixirs on us has greatly diminished."
"In a situation where the effect of Life Secret Elixir weakens, the Moonlight Spring Blueprint can be said to greatly enhance the survivors’ survival capabilities."
"I see." Zhang Lianmeng nodded in realization.
This time, every item in the leaderboard rewards is extremely important.
After examining the building class blueprints, Han Xing continued to check another special item in the leaderboard rewards, the Lord Contract Scroll.

[Lord Contract Scroll]: It can recruit the native inhabitants of the Holy Spirit Realm to become your territory residents through this contract, once the contract is signed, the other party will be loyal to you, executing your orders.
(Note that the creatures recruited via contract will have a related affinity level, be cautious of whether the other party might violate the contract when the affinity is too low).
"Oh? A scroll that allows signing contracts with the indigenous inhabitants of this world?" Han Xing was intrigued.
To date, he hasn’t really encountered many creatures with intelligence.
Aside from the Great Demon Monarch and that strange bird, the other monsters tend to be in an uninspired state, with only a desire to attack.
However, Han Xing also knows that this might be related to the area where Blue Star survivors are located.
This place is called the Land of the Abandoned Gods, which is an area most intelligent creatures in this world are unwilling to set foot in.
In the future, if given the chance, Han Xing indeed wants to recruit several indigenous inhabitants to his territory.
For example, Beast Eared Girls, Elf Maids, whatnot...
Um, don’t misunderstand, Han Xing doesn’t have any ulterior motives, he just needs a group of people to manage his increasingly booming territory.
So far, the rewards from this leaderboard have been extremely bountiful.
Just getting one of the ranks can significantly enhance the defense capability of the territory.
He continued to look further.

"3rd Place Reward: Catapult Construction Blueprint*1, Moonlight Spring Construction Plan*1, Minotaur Camp Map Blueprint*1, Wolf Cavalry Camp Map Blueprint*1, Lord Contract Scroll*10, Self-select Golden Weapon*1, Spirit Core*150000."

"2nd Place Reward: Flamethrower Catapult Construction Blueprint*1, Moonlight Spring Construction Plan*1, Minotaur Camp Map Blueprint*1, Wolf Cavalry Camp Map Blueprint*1, Lord Contract Scroll*10, Self-select Golden Weapon*1, Self-select Golden Accessories*1, Spirit Core*200000."

"1st Place Reward: Flamethrower Catapult Construction Blueprint*1, Moonlight Holy Spring Construction Plan*1, Minotaur Camp Map Blueprint*1, Wolf Cavalry Camp Map Blueprint*1, Lord Contract*10, Self-select Orange Weapon Blueprint*1, Vim Divine Power Horn (Gold)*1, Spirit Core*300000."
Compared to the previous rewards, the top three rewards have seen some changes again.
What interested Han Xing the most was that Flamethrower Catapult Construction Blueprint.

[Flamethrower Catapult Construction Blueprint]: Can construct a catapult that throws flame shells, causing massive splash damage upon hitting the target, additionally with a continuous burning effect, Flamethrower Catapult Defense Value is 100, Attack Power is 1000~1100, the maximum range is 4000 meters.
Compared to ordinary catapults, the Flamethrower Catapult has a significant improvement in both Defense Value and Attack Power, and it also has an added burning effect.
This thing, one shot might inflict more horrific damage than the Siege Crossbow Arrow.
Moreover, the Moonlight Spring has also changed from Moonlight Spring to Moonlight Holy Spring.

[Moonlight Holy Spring]: Consume materials to build a Moonlight Holy Spring in the territory, within the coverage of the Moonlight Holy Spring, injury recovery speed significantly increases, and every other day, it can consume the ability gathered by the Moonlight Holy Spring to instantly heal a fatal injury, Moonlight Holy Spring Defense Value is 500.
