chapters.title: Chapter 106 - 94: Team Invitation
paragraphs: [Moonlight Holy Spring]: Consumes materials to build a Moonlight Holy Spring in the territory. When within its coverage, the speed of wound recovery is significantly accelerated, and every other day, the ability gathered by the Moonlight Holy Spring can instantly restore a critical injury once. The defense value of the Moonlight Holy Spring is 500.
Han Xing noticed a new effect—instantly restore a critical injury.
Notice that it’s instant.
In other words, as long as you are not instantly killed on the spot, the Moonlight Holy Spring can pull you back from the edge of death and directly restore you to full health.
This is truly terrifying, as it greatly enhances survival ability within the territory.
Besides, this time the rankings indeed featured a blueprint for an Orange Weapon.
The Orange Weapon blueprint could be used to create Epic Quality items, and its attributes must be extremely powerful.
However, this time more than 900,000 people are competing for one Orange Weapon blueprint.
Compared to any previous ranking, the competition pressure is much greater.
Now, there is one last piece of equipment on the rankings that has not been checked for attributes, and Han Xing continued to click to see.

[Vim Divine Power Horn (Gold)]: Special equipment, where the Survivor can blow the horn every ten minutes to enhance the attack speed of all allied creatures by 30%, while recruited creatures gain an additional 50% attack speed and movement speed, lasting for 60s.
"Wow! Such strong attributes," Han Xing couldn’t help but exclaim.
The attributes of this equipment exceeded his expectations somewhat.
The Divine Power Horn is clearly designed to be used with building-type props like the Minotaur Camp.

When the number of recruited creatures is large enough, blowing a horn is equivalent to adding a layer of Bloodthirsty buff to all recruited creatures, enhancing both their mobility and destructive power qualitatively!
By then, everyone would truly enter a berserk state.
Han Xing felt a surge of determination to take the first place.
However, he also knew that securing first place among over 900,000 people is not a simple task.
It also requires continuously clearing Cloud Secret Realms.
Han Xing began to pay attention to the nearby clouds to see if any Cloud Secret Realms had formed.
However, as per the system announcement, the probability of Cloud Secret Realms forming won’t increase until the update tomorrow.
Currently, the likelihood of encountering a Cloud Secret Realm is quite small.
After another half hour, Han Xing saw that the message group lit up.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun simultaneously sent messages.
"Brother Xing, we discovered a Cloud Secret Realm here!"
Han Xing hurriedly asked, "What star level is the Secret Realm?"
Shen Yun replied, "Two-star, called ’Knight Judgment Arena’. "
"Knight Judgment Arena?" Han Xing was a bit puzzled. "Is it difficult?"
"It should be quite challenging. I saw that the entry level is 10-15, and it suggests five people to enter."
"Five people?"
Han Xing lowered his head to think.
Including Zhang Lianmeng, they currently had only four people,
"Are we still short of one person?"
Han Xing thought for a moment and opened his sparse friend list, seeing only two or three names.
Tang Mu, Hill Eagle, Su Xiaoyang.
The first two names were for Tangxin Mumu and Black Eagle, respectively.
Tangxin Mumu was added as a friend because of an agreement to interview Han Xing at his territory later.
As for Black Eagle, he added Han Xing as a friend because of a previous transaction, thinking they might have more cooperation in the future.
He wasn’t very familiar with either of them.
Now, only the last name, Su Xiaoyang, was left.
Han Xing noticed that Su Xiaoyang had already reached level 11 and advanced to the Hunter’s advanced profession, the Hunter.

This profession’s specialty is setting various traps, and just after advancing, one can learn two area skills: Explosive Rain Array and Bait Trap, greatly compensating for the Hunter’s weakness against group monsters.
With an additional survival skill, ’Tactical Retreat,’ it can be said to be both offensive and defensive.
Compared to the Hunter’s other profession: Divine Archer.
The ’Hunter’ is indeed much more versatile with stronger survival capabilities.
Seeing Han Xing not responding, Cheng Jianyong interjected, "Brother Xing, this Two-star Secret Realm seems quite difficult. How about we give up for now?"
Han Xing said, "No, the probability of Cloud Secret Realms appearing is relatively low right now. To climb the rankings, we shouldn’t miss any Secret Realm."
"You guys hold on first, I’ll call a friend over."
However, Cheng Jianyong was unexpectedly surprised and said, "What? Did I hear that right?"
"Besides us, does Brother Xing have other friends?"
"Even the sudden appearance of Sister Lian was surprising enough for us..."
Shen Yun was also very surprised, "Indeed, today the sun must have risen from the west."
"Get lost, you guys."
Han Xing replied helplessly, "Send me the coordinates, I’ll be there soon."
Cheng Jianyong sent a string of numbers.
Han Xing looked at their location and calculated that it would take about four to five hours to get there at full speed.
Then, Han Xing opened Su Xiaoyang’s chat interface, and straightforwardly said, "I’m preparing to challenge a Two-star Secret Realm here, and we need one more teammate. Are you available now?"
Soon after Han Xing sent the message, Su Xiaoyang quickly replied.
"Yes, Star God!"
Han Xing saw this and replied, "Okay, I’ll send you the coordinates. Check how long it might take you to get there."
Han Xing sent her some coordinates.
Su Xiaoyang looked at the map interface in surprise and said, "Huh, these coordinates... It seems I’m not too far. It should take about six hours."
Han Xing nodded, "It will take me about the same time, but I might arrive a bit earlier. I’ll wait for you at the secret realm entrance with my friends."
"Friends?" Su Xiaoyang keenly picked up on the key word in Han Xing’s words.
Han Xing replied, "Yes, this secret realm requires five people. Besides you, there are three more people who will go in with us. They’re all my friends."
Upon hearing this, Su Xiaoyang felt her heart sink, her expression changing instantly, "Um... Maybe I shouldn’t go?"
After saying this, Su Xiaoyang felt a bit regretful.
In her heart, she had imagined many times meeting Han Xing, but she never had the courage.
When she heard Han Xing mentioning it, Su Xiaoyang was very excited.
But when he mentioned there were three other strangers, the joy on Su Xiaoyang’s face gradually faded, replaced by fear.
It felt like meeting an online friend, only to find they’ve brought their own troupe of friends.
Noticing something was off in Su Xiaoyang’s tone, Han Xing asked, "What’s wrong?"
"Noth... nothing!" Su Xiaoyang quickly replied.
"I... it’s for my own reason. I’m not comfortable talking or interacting with strangers, I’m sorry..."
Han Xing suddenly realized and understood what Su Xiaoyang meant.
This girl, it turns out she’s a bit socially anxious.
Han Xing replied, "No worries, if you don’t want to go, I won’t force you. I’ll invite you next time when there’s a chance."
Hearing Han Xing’s comforting words, Su Xiaoyang clenched her small fists, showing a look of remorse.
She constantly blamed herself in her heart,
Xiaoyang, you’re so useless...
You finally had this rare opportunity to meet him, and you turned it down.
Being so useless, you might as well just... die...
Su Xiaoyang’s face was filled with sadness.
Just then, a trade request popped up in front of her, naturally from Han Xing.
Before Su Xiaoyang could say anything, Han Xing said directly, "I’m giving you some stuff that you might find useful."
Su Xiaoyang clicked accept in a daze.
A moment later, when she saw the trade window filled with purple equipment with astonishing attributes, her mouth dropped open in surprise.
However, this was just the beginning.
When she saw Han Xing place a golden weapon, the Soul Shattering Longbow, she was dumbfounded.
She spoke with a trembling voice, "Star... Star God, what’s wrong? Why are you giving me so much equipment..."
Han Xing said, "It’s nothing. When I was making equipment, I made a few extra sets of leather armor. You’re also of the Hunter profession, so you can use them. I’ll just give them to you."
"But..." Su Xiaoyang’s tone was a bit hesitant.
Han Xing then said, "Don’t worry about it. These purple items don’t mean much to me. If you don’t want them, I’ll just throw them in storage or dismantle them."
Knowing Han Xing’s strength, Su Xiaoyang understood that these items seemed as easy to give away for him as one might casually offer a gift.
After pondering for a while, Su Xiaoyang decided to accept them.
She sincerely said, "Thank you, Star God."
"You’re welcome." Han Xing replied, "If there’s nothing else, I’ll be off. Let’s keep in touch when there’s an opportunity."
Hearing this, Su Xiaoyang quickly said, "Star... Star God!"
Hearing Su Xiaoyang’s call, Han Xing asked, "What’s up?"
Su Xiaoyang hesitated on her end, while Han Xing patiently waited.
A moment later, as if mustering courage, she took a deep breath and said, "I... I’d like to join your team and explore the secret realm together. Is that okay?"
At this time, Su Xiaoyang clenched her small fists, her legs together, appearing very nervous.
She was worried that after refusing Han Xing’s invitation earlier, asking to join now might make him unhappy.
This worry made her heart race.
Su Xiaoyang didn’t notice that her eyes started to turn red due to blushing.
Meanwhile, at the territory center, a pale demon plant was trembling slightly, seemingly terrified of Su Xiaoyang’s current state.
Su Xiaoyang awaited Han Xing’s response.
Han Xing was momentarily stunned.
Even though he didn’t understand why she changed her mind, he smiled and said, "Of course, you’re always welcome."
Su Xiaoyang felt relieved, and the redness in her eyes faded.
In the territory center, the demon plant also stopped trembling.
"Thank you, Star God."
Su Xiaoyang softly said, "I’ll head to the coordinates now. If you get there first, please wait for me a bit."
"No problem, it’s fine."

sentences.text: [Moonlight Holy Spring]: Consumes materials to build a Moonlight Holy Spring in the territory.

When within its coverage, the speed of wound recovery is significantly accelerated, and every other day, the ability gathered by the Moonlight Holy Spring can instantly restore a critical injury once.
The defense value of the Moonlight Holy Spring is 500.
Han Xing noticed a new effect—instantly restore a critical injury.
Notice that it’s instant.
In other words, as long as you are not instantly killed on the spot, the Moonlight Holy Spring can pull you back from the edge of death and directly restore you to full health.
This is truly terrifying, as it greatly enhances survival ability within the territory.
Besides, this time the rankings indeed featured a blueprint for an Orange Weapon.
The Orange Weapon blueprint could be used to create Epic Quality items, and its attributes must be extremely powerful.
However, this time more than 900,000 people are competing for one Orange Weapon blueprint.
Compared to any previous ranking, the competition pressure is much greater.
Now, there is one last piece of equipment on the rankings that has not been checked for attributes, and Han Xing continued to click to see.

[Vim Divine Power Horn (Gold)]: Special equipment, where the Survivor can blow the horn every ten minutes to enhance the attack speed of all allied creatures by 30%, while recruited creatures gain an additional 50% attack speed and movement speed, lasting for 60s.
"Wow!
Such strong attributes," Han Xing couldn’t help but exclaim.
The attributes of this equipment exceeded his expectations somewhat.
The Divine Power Horn is clearly designed to be used with building-type props like the Minotaur Camp.

When the number of recruited creatures is large enough, blowing a horn is equivalent to adding a layer of Bloodthirsty buff to all recruited creatures, enhancing both their mobility and destructive power qualitatively!
By then, everyone would truly enter a berserk state.
Han Xing felt a surge of determination to take the first place.
However, he also knew that securing first place among over 900,000 people is not a simple task.
It also requires continuously clearing Cloud Secret Realms.
Han Xing began to pay attention to the nearby clouds to see if any Cloud Secret Realms had formed.
However, as per the system announcement, the probability of Cloud Secret Realms forming won’t increase until the update tomorrow.
Currently, the likelihood of encountering a Cloud Secret Realm is quite small.
After another half hour, Han Xing saw that the message group lit up.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun simultaneously sent messages.
"Brother Xing, we discovered a Cloud Secret Realm here!"
Han Xing hurriedly asked, "What star level is the Secret Realm?"
Shen Yun replied, "Two-star, called ’Knight Judgment Arena’.
"Knight Judgment Arena?" Han Xing was a bit puzzled.
"Is it difficult?"
"It should be quite challenging.
I saw that the entry level is 10-15, and it suggests five people to enter."
"Five people?"
Han Xing lowered his head to think.
Including Zhang Lianmeng, they currently had only four people,
"Are we still short of one person?"
Han Xing thought for a moment and opened his sparse friend list, seeing only two or three names.
Tang Mu, Hill Eagle, Su Xiaoyang.
The first two names were for Tangxin Mumu and Black Eagle, respectively.
Tangxin Mumu was added as a friend because of an agreement to interview Han Xing at his territory later.
As for Black Eagle, he added Han Xing as a friend because of a previous transaction, thinking they might have more cooperation in the future.
He wasn’t very familiar with either of them.
Now, only the last name, Su Xiaoyang, was left.
Han Xing noticed that Su Xiaoyang had already reached level 11 and advanced to the Hunter’s advanced profession, the Hunter.

This profession’s specialty is setting various traps, and just after advancing, one can learn two area skills: Explosive Rain Array and Bait Trap, greatly compensating for the Hunter’s weakness against group monsters.
With an additional survival skill, ’Tactical Retreat,’ it can be said to be both offensive and defensive.
Compared to the Hunter’s other profession: Divine Archer.
The ’Hunter’ is indeed much more versatile with stronger survival capabilities.
Seeing Han Xing not responding, Cheng Jianyong interjected, "Brother Xing, this Two-star Secret Realm seems quite difficult.
How about we give up for now?"
Han Xing said, "No, the probability of Cloud Secret Realms appearing is relatively low right now.
To climb the rankings, we shouldn’t miss any Secret Realm."
"You guys hold on first, I’ll call a friend over."
However, Cheng Jianyong was unexpectedly surprised and said, "What?
Did I hear that right?"
"Besides us, does Brother Xing have other friends?"
"Even the sudden appearance of Sister Lian was surprising enough for us..."
Shen Yun was also very surprised, "Indeed, today the sun must have risen from the west."
"Get lost, you guys."
Han Xing replied helplessly, "Send me the coordinates, I’ll be there soon."
Cheng Jianyong sent a string of numbers.
Han Xing looked at their location and calculated that it would take about four to five hours to get there at full speed.
Then, Han Xing opened Su Xiaoyang’s chat interface, and straightforwardly said, "I’m preparing to challenge a Two-star Secret Realm here, and we need one more teammate.
Are you available now?"
Soon after Han Xing sent the message, Su Xiaoyang quickly replied.
"Yes, Star God!"
Han Xing saw this and replied, "Okay, I’ll send you the coordinates.
Check how long it might take you to get there."
Han Xing sent her some coordinates.
Su Xiaoyang looked at the map interface in surprise and said, "Huh, these coordinates...
It seems I’m not too far.
It should take about six hours."
Han Xing nodded, "It will take me about the same time, but I might arrive a bit earlier.
I’ll wait for you at the secret realm entrance with my friends."
"Friends?" Su Xiaoyang keenly picked up on the key word in Han Xing’s words.
Han Xing replied, "Yes, this secret realm requires five people.
Besides you, there are three more people who will go in with us.
They’re all my friends."
Upon hearing this, Su Xiaoyang felt her heart sink, her expression changing instantly, "Um...
Maybe I shouldn’t go?"
After saying this, Su Xiaoyang felt a bit regretful.
In her heart, she had imagined many times meeting Han Xing, but she never had the courage.
When she heard Han Xing mentioning it, Su Xiaoyang was very excited.
But when he mentioned there were three other strangers, the joy on Su Xiaoyang’s face gradually faded, replaced by fear.
It felt like meeting an online friend, only to find they’ve brought their own troupe of friends.
Noticing something was off in Su Xiaoyang’s tone, Han Xing asked, "What’s wrong?"
"Noth... nothing!" Su Xiaoyang quickly replied.
"I... it’s for my own reason.
I’m not comfortable talking or interacting with strangers, I’m sorry..."
Han Xing suddenly realized and understood what Su Xiaoyang meant.
This girl, it turns out she’s a bit socially anxious.
Han Xing replied, "No worries, if you don’t want to go, I won’t force you.
I’ll invite you next time when there’s a chance."
Hearing Han Xing’s comforting words, Su Xiaoyang clenched her small fists, showing a look of remorse.
She constantly blamed herself in her heart,
Xiaoyang, you’re so useless...
You finally had this rare opportunity to meet him, and you turned it down.
Being so useless, you might as well just... die...
Su Xiaoyang’s face was filled with sadness.
Just then, a trade request popped up in front of her, naturally from Han Xing.
Before Su Xiaoyang could say anything, Han Xing said directly, "I’m giving you some stuff that you might find useful."
Su Xiaoyang clicked accept in a daze.
A moment later, when she saw the trade window filled with purple equipment with astonishing attributes, her mouth dropped open in surprise.
However, this was just the beginning.
When she saw Han Xing place a golden weapon, the Soul Shattering Longbow, she was dumbfounded.
She spoke with a trembling voice, "Star...
Star God, what’s wrong?
Why are you giving me so much equipment..."
Han Xing said, "It’s nothing.
When I was making equipment, I made a few extra sets of leather armor.
You’re also of the Hunter profession, so you can use them.
I’ll just give them to you."
"But..." Su Xiaoyang’s tone was a bit hesitant.
Han Xing then said, "Don’t worry about it.
These purple items don’t mean much to me.
If you don’t want them, I’ll just throw them in storage or dismantle them."
Knowing Han Xing’s strength, Su Xiaoyang understood that these items seemed as easy to give away for him as one might casually offer a gift.
After pondering for a while, Su Xiaoyang decided to accept them.
She sincerely said, "Thank you, Star God."
"You’re welcome." Han Xing replied, "If there’s nothing else, I’ll be off.
Let’s keep in touch when there’s an opportunity."
Hearing this, Su Xiaoyang quickly said, "Star...
Star God!"
Hearing Su Xiaoyang’s call, Han Xing asked, "What’s up?"
Su Xiaoyang hesitated on her end, while Han Xing patiently waited.
A moment later, as if mustering courage, she took a deep breath and said, "I...
I’d like to join your team and explore the secret realm together.
Is that okay?"
At this time, Su Xiaoyang clenched her small fists, her legs together, appearing very nervous.
She was worried that after refusing Han Xing’s invitation earlier, asking to join now might make him unhappy.
This worry made her heart race.
Su Xiaoyang didn’t notice that her eyes started to turn red due to blushing.
Meanwhile, at the territory center, a pale demon plant was trembling slightly, seemingly terrified of Su Xiaoyang’s current state.
Su Xiaoyang awaited Han Xing’s response.
Han Xing was momentarily stunned.
Even though he didn’t understand why she changed her mind, he smiled and said, "Of course, you’re always welcome."
Su Xiaoyang felt relieved, and the redness in her eyes faded.
In the territory center, the demon plant also stopped trembling.
"Thank you, Star God."
Su Xiaoyang softly said, "I’ll head to the coordinates now.
If you get there first, please wait for me a bit."
"No problem, it’s fine."

chapters.title: Chapter 107 - 95: Su Xiaoyang’s Transformation
paragraphs: After Su Xiaoyang agreed to form a team, Han Xing prepared to close the private chat window and continue on his way.
Just then, he seemed to have thought of something and sent a trade request to Su Xiaoyang again.
Then, on the trade window, Han Xing placed a black scroll.
Upon seeing the black scroll, Su Xiaoyang was stunned.
"A... a hidden profession?" Su Xiaoyang asked in disbelief.

Han Xing replied, "Yes, although you have already changed to the Hunter profession, the Elf Hunter is much stronger in comparison. Since you have not leveled up yet, the experience loss from changing professions again is not much."
"If you don’t like this profession, you don’t have to accept it."
Su Xiaoyang quickly said, "I... I didn’t mean it that way. What I meant was, the Hidden Profession Scroll is too valuable. I can’t take it... You should use it yourself, Star God."
Han Xing smiled, "Take it. I have already changed to another hidden hunter profession that suits me better than the Elf Hunter."

"No buts. If you intend to join my team, I hope the members’ abilities are strong enough. By changing to a hidden profession, you can help us better." Han Xing’s words carried a hint of uncompromising firmness.
After pondering for a moment, Su Xiaoyang finally clicked Accept.
But in her heart, she silently remembered Han Xing’s help.
After the transaction ended.
Su Xiaoyang gripped the scroll in her hand and then clicked Use.
A system prompt appeared.
[Do you want to use the Hidden Profession Scroll to change your profession to the hidden profession, Elf Hunter?]
"Yes."
Su Xiaoyang clicked Confirm, and the black scroll in her hand disappeared.
In the next moment, she suddenly felt numerous green light dots appearing around her.
These light dots appeared suddenly like fireflies, and their numbers increased rapidly.
In no time, she saw thousands of green light dots floating around her territory.
"So beautiful..." Su Xiaoyang extended her slender fingers, wanting to touch these floating light dots in the air.
However, when she touched one of the light dots.
In the next moment, thousands of green lights converged into her body.
Su Xiaoyang suddenly felt a cool power appearing in her body, continuously strengthening.
She realized that her body, which had stopped developing, was undergoing changes again at this moment.
First, her pair of artistically beautiful legs suddenly grew five more centimeters.
Su Xiaoyang’s legs were already quite long, and with this new growth, they seemed to slightly surpass the human limit.
This perfect leg proportion has rarely occurred in human history.
At this moment, Su Xiaoyang’s cheeks turned red as she noticed her already ample bosom becoming even more prominent, causing her beast hide top to stretch outward.
"How... how embarrassing..."
Su Xiaoyang quickly covered her chest.
Thankfully, no one else was around to see.
Moreover, the changes did not stop.
Su Xiaoyang felt her hair starting to grow, soon hanging down to her waist, and to her surprise, her ears became more pointed.
If Han Xing were here, he would definitely exclaim, Elf!
Yes, Su Xiaoyang’s body was transforming into that of the Elf Race.
Once all the green lights had entered Su Xiaoyang’s body.
Then, a system prompt appeared again.

[You have successfully transitioned to a Hunter’s hidden profession, Elf Shooter. Your all attributes have been increased by 150%, and your level limit is now increased to level 20. When leveling up, your agility attribute grows by 1.5 times.]
[You have automatically learned the Elf Shooter’s exclusive skills: Wind Perception, Elf Dance, and Low Altitude Flight.]
[Wind Perception]: When entering a battle state, attack speed increases by 100%. With the help of the wind, your arrow hit rate greatly increases, making it harder for enemies to resist your attacks.
[Elf Dance]: When the Elf Dance state is activated, your skill damage increases by 50%, and for 10 seconds, all basic Hunter skill cooldowns are reset to 0.

[Low Altitude Flight]: When the Low Altitude Flight skill is activated, the Survivor temporarily gains the ability to fly. In flight state, movement speed is increased by 100%, the effect lasts 120 seconds with a cooldown time of 200 seconds.
Su Xiaoyang’s mouth slightly open, exclaimed: "What... a powerful profession..."

Han Xing did not know about the changes that occurred after Su Xiaoyang transitioned to the Elf Hunter. At this time, he was rushing at full speed toward the area where Cheng Jianyong and others were located.
A few hours later.
He was finally nearing the coordinates where Cheng Jianyong and others were.
Along the way, Han Xing also encountered several groups of survivor teams.
But whether due to that post or other factors.
This time, those survivors surprisingly did not come forward to cause trouble when they saw Han Xing. Some even took the initiative to avoid him.
Han Xing didn’t know what had happened, but he was glad to avoid the hassle.
Soon, he was less than five kilometers from the coordinate position.
From a distance, Han Xing saw two huge Sky Islands ahead.
Both Sky Islands spanned over ten thousand square meters in territory.
At the current stage, only top experts possessed territories of this scale.
The owners of these two Sky Islands were naturally Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun.
At this time, they stood at the edge of their territories, excitedly waving their hands.
After moving his territory closer, Han Xing brought the three Sky Islands together.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong leaned forward and said, "Brother Xing, how do you think our territory is developing?"

Han Xing glanced at the layout of the two-person territory. A lord’s cottage of over a hundred square feet was situated at the center, with a spiritual shield pyramid and a teleportation array built on either side of the entrance.
On both sides of the territory, there were cultivated farmlands and ponds.
In Cheng Jianyong’s territory, there were also a few piglets with black spots leisurely strolling around.
Zhang Lianmeng stood behind, curiously observing the layout of the two people’s territory.
Han Xing chuckled lightly, "Not bad."
Compared to other survivors, the two of them had officially stepped from the primitive into the agricultural era. They no longer worried about having enough to eat.
Cheng Jianyong laughed heartily.
At this moment, Shen Yun pointed to the back and said, "Brother Xing, the secret realm we discovered is right over there."
Han Xing followed the direction of his finger.
Behind their territory, there was a strange-shaped cloud about thirty square feet, with a black vortex on top.
This vortex was the entrance to the secret realm.
Shen Yun continued to ask, "Brother Xing, should we enter now?"
Han Xing shook his head, "Let’s wait a bit; my friend is still on the way."
"Although four people can challenge the two-star secret realm, with five, it’s a bit more assured."
Zhang Lianmeng also softly agreed, "Indeed, five people are a bit safer."
However, Cheng Jianyong looked puzzled and asked, "Brother Xing, who is this friend of yours? Do we know them?"
Han Xing replied speechlessly, "You don’t know them. You’ll find out when they arrive."
Half an hour later.
The group saw a sky island rapidly approaching from the distance.
"Is it him, Brother Xing?" Shen Yun asked.
Upon receiving a reply from Su Xiaoyang, Han Xing nodded and said, "Yes."
The four of them watched eagerly, and the atmosphere suddenly became a bit silent.
Then, Cheng Jianyong suddenly said, "Xiaoyunzi, don’t you feel a little nervous?"
"Nervous? No, why should I be nervous?" Shen Yun said calmly.
Cheng Jianyong glanced at him and scoffed, "Tch, still acting tough. I can see beads of sweat on your forehead almost appearing."
Upon hearing this, Shen Yun quickly wiped his forehead.
Beside them, Han Xing glanced at the two.
Come to think of it, this was also his first meeting with Su Xiaoyang.
Previously, they had only exchanged messages in chat and didn’t know each other’s appearance.
Han Xing only knew that the other party should be a young girl with a pleasant voice.
Now that he was about to meet her in person, he also felt a bit nervous inside.
The distance between them was less than a kilometer.
However, what Han Xing didn’t know was that compared to his nervousness, Su Xiaoyang’s heart was pounding even more.
The closer she got, the more Su Xiaoyang felt her face turning red, with a rush of heat flooding her head, causing her eyes to redden slightly.
Su Xiaoyang quickly shook her head, dispelling the redness in her eyes.
She clenched her small fists, silently cheering herself on, "Come on, Xiaoyang, you can do it!"
"Star God is a very nice person, you don’t need to fear him."
Finally, the two sky islands approached.
On one side were four people, and on the other was a single person, finally meeting.
In front of Han Xing and his group, appeared a tall, long-legged young woman.
She was dressed in a hunter’s leather armor, with her long legs and a slender waistline showing no trace of extra fat.
Her exquisite features were like works of art finely carved by God.
A necklace with stars shimmering hung around her swan-like neck.
Because her hair was too long, Su Xiaoyang tied it into a single ponytail and carried a golden longbow identical to Han Xing’s on her back.
This outfit added a touch of spirit to her aura.
This peerlessly beautiful girl, whose aura was ethereal and unlike any human’s, captivated everyone’s attention.
Unlike Zhang Lianmeng’s beauty, Su Xiaoyang’s aura seemed more youthful and lively.
However, what caught even more attention were her slightly pointed ears.
Cheng Jianyong blurted out, "Whoa, elf race?"
Indeed, Su Xiaoyang’s current appearance really resembled that of an elf.
However, they also noticed the player symbol above her head.
Only then did they confirm that, like them, she was human.
At this moment, Su Xiaoyang stood in front of the four, not daring to say a word.
She immediately recognized Han Xing, who also carried a dark-gold longbow.
But besides the two men, she also saw that beside Han Xing stood a woman with an explosive figure, so exaggerated that she felt a bit envious.
Moreover, the woman seemed to be standing too close to Han Xing, indicating that their relationship might not be ordinary.
Thinking of this, Su Xiaoyang suddenly felt dejected.
She wasn’t good at communicating with others and suffered from severe social anxiety.
The situation made her almost want to flee.

She immediately recognized Han Xing, who also carried a dark-gold longbow.
But besides the two men, she also saw that beside Han Xing stood a woman with an explosive figure, so exaggerated that she felt a bit envious.
Moreover, the woman seemed to be standing too close to Han Xing, indicating that their relationship might not be ordinary.
Thinking of this, Su Xiaoyang suddenly felt dejected.
She wasn’t good at communicating with others and suffered from severe social anxiety.
The situation made her almost want to flee.

chapters.title: Chapter 108 - 96: Mutation—Raid of the Pale Demon Plant!
paragraphs: Just when she was extremely embarrassed.
Han Xing took the initiative to step forward, ready to talk to her.
However, before he could speak, Zhang Lianmeng quickly said, "Ah! What a beautiful girl!"
Her eyes lit up, as if she had discovered a treasure, she gracefully and swiftly walked to Su Xiaoyang’s side.
Then, under Su Xiaoyang’s confused gaze, she held Su Xiaoyang’s small hands with both of hers, and exclaimed excitedly, "Are you the friend Brother Xing mentioned?"
"So beautiful, ooh... How can there be such a lovely girl in the world?"
"I can’t believe Brother Xing didn’t introduce you to me sooner!"
Facing Zhang Lianmeng’s enthusiasm, Su Xiaoyang seemed a bit at a loss.
But she still replied, "No... nothing of the sort, sister you’re much prettier..."
Zhang Lianmeng quickly responded, "No way, sister is older than you, and doesn’t have legs as long as yours, can’t compare."
"Speaking of which, your legs are so long and fair, can I touch them?"
Before Su Xiaoyang could respond, Zhang Lianmeng reached out her hand.
Feeling a warm touch between her legs, Su Xiaoyang shuddered and her legs instantly tensed up.
Han Xing coughed twice, and Zhang Lianmeng seemed to realize she was a bit out of line, hurriedly stopping her creepy behavior.
Zhang Lianmeng also blushed and said, "Sorry, I got a little too excited seeing a beauty!"
Han Xing was also a bit speechless, this was the first time he had seen this other side of Zhang Lianmeng today.
Su Xiaoyang felt relieved.
At this point, Han Xing walked over and said, "Hello, I’m Han Xing."
Su Xiaoyang snapped out of her panic, and nervously said, "You... you hello."
Han Xing looked at the Soul Shattering Longbow in her hand, then at her ears, and asked, "Have you already changed profession to Elf Hunter?"
Su Xiaoyang quickly nodded, "Mm-hmm, yes."
Han Xing nodded, he knew the strength of the Elf Hunter profession.
Speaking of which, Su Xiaoyang was indeed quite suitable for this profession, not only in appearance, but also in that otherworldly aura that most people don’t possess.
She and Zhang Lianmeng were entirely different types.
Just when things were getting a bit awkward between them.
Suddenly, a white branch reached out from Su Xiaoyang’s territory.
With lightning speed, it swiftly attacked.
Whoosh!
This branch, filled with intense hostility, targeted none other than Zhang Lianmeng beside Su Xiaoyang!
Han Xing heard the sound of the air being cut, quickly turned to look.
Just as Zhang Lianmeng was about to be hit by the branch, Han Xing immediately entered ’Frenzy Burst’ state.
However, even so, he failed to stop the branch’s attack.
Thud!
Zhang Lianmeng’s shoulder was instantly pierced by the branch, a burst of blood splattered.
Everyone was bewildered seeing Zhang Lianmeng injured.
And at this moment, a surge of killing intent rose in Han Xing’s heart!
Suddenly attacked, everyone instantly entered combat mode!
Meanwhile, Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong quickly grabbed their weapons and rushed forward.
However, at this moment, a black light moved faster than anyone’s response.
Coal Ball flashed, appearing directly behind Zhang Lianmeng.
Swish! Swish!
Wolf claws extended, pale branch snapped immediately.
Meanwhile, more branches were attacking.
At this moment, Han Xing noticed that the attacker was actually a willow tree about seven to eight meters tall in Su Xiaoyang’s territory.
Previously, he thought it was just an ordinary territorial plant, apart from its somewhat strange color, he didn’t pay it any mind.
But now, he realized it was a rare demonic plant type monster, and a level 10 leader monster at that!
This guy actually seized the moment when he was unprepared to attack Zhang Lianmeng!
Han Xing’s eyes turned sharp, he immediately drew his bowstring.
Burst skill, Multi-Shot!
The Tree Demon Leader sensed the threat, countless branches waving, seemingly trying to counterattack.
Just then, Su Xiaoyang reacted, her expression turning extremely flustered, quickly shouted, "Xiaoqian, stop!"
The Tree Demon Leader, under Su Xiaoyang’s command, stopped its actions, bewildered.
However, Han Xing’s arrow was already shot.
Thunk! Thunk thunk!
All five arrows hit the Tree Demon’s trunk, firmly embedding it.
Feeling the intense pain, the Tree Demon instinctively wanted to retaliate.
Crash!
Numerous branches like pale poisonous snakes, prepared to launch the fiercest counterattack!
However, at this moment, Su Xiaoyang’s eyes suddenly turned blood red, she spoke in a strange, gloomy tone, "Xiaoqian, did you forget what I said?"
"Disobedient children will be burned and eaten..."
Hearing this, the Tree Demon Leader trembled, all its branches instantly withdrew.
Even though Coal Ball launched an attack on it, the Tree Demon Leader remained indifferent.
It seemed to be extremely fearful of Su Xiaoyang’s earlier state.
Seeing this, Han Xing furrowed his brows and called Coal Ball back, "Coal Ball, come back."
Without any hesitation upon hearing Han Xing’s command, Coal Ball flickered back to Han Xing’s feet.
The situation changed so quickly that everyone only reacted at this moment.
Cheng Jianyong raised his Great Sword, the Charge skill yet to be executed, and then halted in place.
Shen Yun also pulled out his Crystal Stone Hammer, ready to cast a Blessing skill.
"Humph..."
Zhang Lianmeng let out a muffled groan.
She stood to the side, her face pale, clutching the bloody hole on her shoulder as blood continued to flow.
Seeing this, Su Xiaoyang’s pupils lost their blood-red color in an instant. In panic, she walked over to Zhang Lianmeng and exclaimed, "Sister... are you, are you alright?"
"I’m sorry, I’m sorry, I’m sorry, I forgot to tell Xiaoqian that I wanted to meet new friends..."
"It will attack any strangers on my territory, it’s all my fault, I’m sorry, sob sob sob..."
Su Xiaoyang’s voice was already tinged with a sob, and her eyes began to cloud with mist.
Upon hearing this, Zhang Lianmeng realized that this might be a misunderstanding.

Seeing Su Xiaoyang crying like a pear blossom in the rain, Zhang Lianmeng felt a pang of distress and gently patted her, saying, "It’s... it’s okay, it’s just a small wound, a bottle of Life Secret Elixir will fix it."
Su Xiaoyang, hearing this, seemed to remember something and hurriedly exclaimed, "Life Secret Elixir... right, Life Secret Elixir!"
She fumbled hurriedly in her backpack, then pulled out a handful of Life Secret Elixirs from it, cradled them in her palms, and said excitedly, "Sis... Sister, quickly drink this!"
Seeing this, Zhang Lianmeng took a bottle from Su Xiaoyang’s hand and poured it into her mouth.
After changing her profession to Elemental Mage, Zhang Lianmeng was already a Two-star Survivor.
With the Survivors’ attributes greatly enhanced, the Life Secret Elixir could only heal minor injuries.
Fortunately, Zhang Lianmeng’s current injuries were not severe.
After only a few seconds, the bleeding from Zhang Lianmeng’s shoulder stopped.
At this moment, Shen Yun timely cast a ’Holy Light Healing’ skill on Zhang Lianmeng.
Shen Yun’s Spirit Attribute had reached an exaggerated level, and with the support of top-grade equipment, the healing amount was terrifyingly high!
Zhang Lianmeng’s injuries quickly healed, even better than the effect of using the Life Secret Elixir when she was One-star!
Han Xing glanced at Shen Yun, the role of a Priest profession showed itself in these moments.
Seeing Zhang Lianmeng’s injuries healed, Su Xiaoyang finally breathed a sigh of relief and continued crying, "I’m sorry, I didn’t mean it, sob sob sob..."
Zhang Lianmeng originally wanted to say it didn’t matter, but seeing Su Xiaoyang’s pitiful look, she was tempted to tease her a bit.
So, she deliberately took a cold breath and said, "Sister, it still hurts a bit here. Can you rub it for me?"
Su Xiaoyang didn’t realize Zhang Lianmeng was teasing her; without thinking, she gently placed her hands on Zhang Lianmeng’s shoulder.
Then, Zhang Lianmeng took the opportunity to embrace Su Xiaoyang into her arms.
"Ah!" Su Xiaoyang exclaimed with wide eyes.
Before she could stand up, her vision was covered by a pair of huge XX.
Originally wanting to stand, Su Xiaoyang suddenly found herself luxuriating in the realm of tenderness.
"Mm... so soft..."
Su Xiaoyang lay in Zhang Lianmeng’s arms, her head buried, with her fair legs extended.
The sight made even Han Xing break into a slight sweat.
As for Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, they had long tactically retreated to the side, pretending not to notice anything.
At this time, Han Xing awkwardly coughed twice.
Only then did Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang come to their senses, quickly sitting up from the ground.
At this moment, the two girls were slightly blushing.
However, after this playful interaction, Su Xiaoyang’s initial nervousness and anxiety were greatly alleviated.
Han Xing then walked over and said, "Hello, let me reintroduce myself, I’m Han Xing, nice to meet you."
"And thank you for the Life Secret Elixir blueprint you gave me before."
While Han Xing’s appearance was unfamiliar, his voice gave Su Xiaoyang an inexplicably familiar feeling.
Her face instantly turned red, she replied nervously, "Su... Su Xiaoyang, I’m also very happy to meet you!"
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng took Su Xiaoyang’s other hand and chuckled, "Hello, I’m Zhang Lianmeng, you can call me Sister Lianmeng, nice to meet you too."
Su Xiaoyang, although vaguely guessing that Zhang Lianmeng’s relationship with Han Xing was not ordinary, felt very good about this woman, showing a sincere smile, "Thank you, Sister Lianmeng."
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun also came over, scratching their heads.
Han Xing introduced them one by one, "The guy who looks honest is called Cheng Jianyong. The other one with the gloomy face is called Shen Yun; they’re both my friends and classmates."
"They’re also my teammates for this Two-star Secret Realm challenge."
Hearing Han Xing’s introduction of them, both Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun felt indignant.
"Oh come on, you’re the honest one!"
"Exactly, who are you calling gloomy!"
The two retorted.
Han Xing shrugged his shoulders.
In front of the beauties, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun scratched their heads in embarrassment and then chuckled.
Seeing how approachable they were, the tension in Su Xiaoyang’s heart eased by half again.
At this moment, Han Xing looked at the swirling teleportation gate behind them and said, "Alright, everyone is here. If there’s nothing else to handle, let’s get ready to enter the Secret Realm."

chapters.title: Chapter 109 - 97: Knight Judgment Arena (Bonus - )
paragraphs: "Well, everyone’s here. If there’s nothing else to handle, let’s prepare to enter the Secret Realm."
"Is everything okay?" Han Xing asked.
The crowd was silent for a moment.
Shen Yun then asked, "Brother Xing, speaking of which, once we enter the Secret Realm, won’t the territories remain unguarded? Could that be a problem?"

Han Xing shook his head and said, "Don’t worry about that. You can overlap your territories with mine, and I’ll modify the defensive instructions of the Spiritual Shield to cover your territories as well."
"Then set the attack program of the Siege Crossbow Arrow Launcher Platform. If anyone attacks the Defense Shield, it’ll automatically retaliate."
"Then, display the puppets from the last leaderboard rewards, and there should be no issues."
After hearing this, everyone nodded.
Han Xing’s Siege Crossbow Arrow Launcher Platform has proven its power, even capable of handling multiple attacks with ease and destroying them.
With so many Golden Armor and Silver Armor Puppets, it’s like an impenetrable fortress.
At this moment, Su Xiaoyang cautiously added, "If we encounter danger, Xiaoqian will help fight too..."
"It... it may look scary, but it’s obedient."
Everyone looked at Su Xiaoyang’s Leader-Level Tree Demon at level 10.
A Plant Series monster, and at Leader-Level, its combat capability even surpassed Han Xing’s Golden Armor Puppet.
Han Xing nodded, "Since there’s no problem, let’s enter now."
Then, Han Xing invited Su Xiaoyang to join the team.
This team of five had taken its initial form.
And Han Xing naturally became the team leader.
He approached the Cloud Secret Realm vortex, and at this moment, a system prompt appeared.
[Do you wish to enter the Two-star Cloud Secret Realm, ’Knight Judgment Arena’?]
"Yes."
The vortex began to rotate slowly, indicating the Teleportation Gate was open.
Han Xing stepped in first, followed by Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, and finally Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang.
With a flash, they found themselves in a massive plaza.
This plaza was extraordinarily vast, roughly estimated to be at least tens of thousands of square meters, with the floor paved with green-gray stones.
In the center of the plaza stood a gigantic statue about twenty meters tall, with a base diameter of more than five meters.
It depicted a human knight with a shield raised high in the left hand and a Holy Hammer in the right.
The simple pose displayed an extraordinary aura.
Beneath, a magnificent horse stood with head held high, highlighting the knight’s heroic stance even more.
However, at this time, the statue was toppled from the middle, lying in two pieces.
Thick dust covered the ground, and the knight’s former glory was no more.
At that moment, a system prompt appeared.
[With the neighing of horses and waving of flags, this was once the Judgment Arena of the Human Race Empire, where Knight King Grotar frequently judged the guilty.]
[Witnessed by the empire’s three thousand elite knights, the guilty would be beheaded here.]

[Until one day, the Knight Judgment Arena welcomed a different group of sinners. Today, they would publicly judge the Knight Commander of the previous empire, Lymes, along with his three hundred Azure Heaven Knight Order members.]
[As the right-hand man of the Knight King, Lymes contributed immensely to the empire’s rise, but recently, Grotar sought to sentence Lymes to death under the charge of betraying their faith.]
Everyone was momentarily puzzled.
Cheng Jianyong said, "What the heck? How is this Two-star Cloud Secret Realm different from what we played before?"
Han Xing nodded, "It is somewhat different; it even starts with an introduction."
Before they could digest this, they suddenly heard a resounding cheer.
The five instantly went on alert as the previously empty ground was suddenly filled with thousands of phantom figures.
They were all chanting one name,
"Grotar!"
"Grotar!"
Everyone glanced toward the spectator stands’ empty spot, which held a gigantic throne carved from a single stone block.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Whoa, does this thing have a cutscene?"
"By the way, is this Lu’erta so formidable that he wants to execute his own right-hand man?"
Shen Yun exasperatedly said, "It’s Grotar, Cheng Jianyong, be quiet and watch what’s happening."
Amidst the crowd of thousands of knights, a man clad in white armor with a resolute face sat upright on the throne.
He rested his face on his hand, his gaze sharp as he spoke loudly downward, "Lymes, do you admit your guilt?"
Below, the members of the Azure Heaven Knight Order, bound in shackles, were forced to kneel. They had been stripped of their glorious armor and dependable steeds.
These knights, once radiating brilliance, were now stripped of their radiance, showcasing sheer misery and despair.
Seeing no answer, Grotar spoke again, "Lymes, do you admit to violating the kingdom’s code and committing acts unfaithful to the God of Light?"
On the field, more than three thousand knights involuntarily turned their gaze.
They seemed unable to believe that Lymes, the most loyal and courageous knight commander to the kingdom in battles of the past, could betray the Knight King and the kingdom.
However, among the disgraced knights, a resolute-faced man in his forties raised his head and said, "Respected Knight King, Lymes, acknowledges his guilt..."
He seemed to have given up his last struggle, humbly lowering his head.
Hearing Lymes’ own admission, the other knights present looked at each other in disbelief.
On the throne, Grotar nodded slightly,
"Since you acknowledge your guilt, let us proceed according to protocol, strip Lymes of his rights as knight commander, and carry out the execution immediately."
Grotar’s pronouncement equated to a death sentence for Lymes.
Lymes’ expression showed no fear, but calmly asked, "Knight King, after this, can the evil god species eradication activity be ended?"
Grotar frowned upon hearing this, slightly angry, "Lymes, you are still so stubborn; I have already told you, those people are not our kin but a group of heretics who have joined the evil god!"
At this moment, Lymes asked in a trembling voice from below, "Your Majesty, you say they are heretical betrayers of faith, but they are just children!"
"I saw with my own eyes, the knights’ iron hooves ravaged their village, those children covered in blood searching for their family members’ corpses among countless dead bodies."
"Yet even so, those children’s eyes remained so clear, they asked me, would the God of Light take their relatives’ souls away?"
"How could these innocent children possibly be heretics? How could the God of Light fear a group of children?"
Lymes’ words were powerful enough to strike at the soul, leaving everyone stunned.
"Silence!" Grotar’s voice reverberated throughout the judgment arena.
"A new generation of evil god species has been born among humans; if allowed to grow, they will cause an unforeseen disaster, this is God’s warning to us!"
"Lymes, are you questioning the authenticity of the divine prophecy from the God of Light?"
Below, Lymes remained silent.
He dared not question the God of Light or Grotar in front of the crowd.
Grotar’s expression was unchanged as he continued, "Lymes, do not remain deluded."
"In view of the great contributions you have made in battle for the empire in the past, do you have any last words before the execution?"

Lymes looked around, clinging to a sliver of hope, he asked, "Majesty, it was my decision alone to let those children escape, it has nothing to do with the Azure Heaven Knight Order, could you execute only me and spare the other knights?"
Grotar thought for a moment and shook his head,
He firmly said, "No."
Lymes felt despair instantly, unable to believe as he looked at Grotar, asking, "Your Majesty, why?"
"They are innocent, they still wish to contribute to the kingdom again, to offer their faith to the God of Light!"
However, no matter how he pleaded, Grotar remained unmoved.
At this moment, sitting high on the throne, Grotar waved his hand and said, "Execute."
As he finished speaking, the edges of the judgment arena revealed several gigantic crossbow arrows.
Just as the crossbow arrows were about to be shot.
Lymes lifted his head, as if making some kind of decision.
Suddenly, a strong radiance burst from him.
This radiance shot straight into the skies, causing everyone to be unable to open their eyes.
The next moment, chains on Lymes shattered, along with the shackles on over three hundred humans.
He shouted loudly, "Brothers of the Azure Heaven Knight Order, you all still have a bright future, shouldn’t bear my mistakes, I will hold off here, all sins, shall be borne by me!"
Nonetheless, the over three hundred knights looked at each other, overcoming initial confusion, they realized what was happening.
Yet, not one of these knights retreated, instead, they stood resolutely behind Lymes.
Just as in every expedition, where Lymes would charge bravely at the forefront.
This time, the Azure Heaven Knight Order stood firmly behind Lymes, without anyone retreating.
In unison, they shouted, "Swear loyalty unto death to the knight commander, advancing and retreating together with the knight commander!"
The sudden change left thousands of knights across the judgment arena in a dazed state.
Including Han Xing and others who were watching the animation.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Whoa, are they gonna fight?"
"Hey, are we gonna get dragged into this?"
Cheng Jianyong’s worries were not unfounded.
At this moment.
On the throne, Grotar was not surprised; he methodically ordered, "Seal the judgment arena exit, crossbowmen prepare, shoot all criminals attempting to escape."
"Knights, suppress Lymes."
On the field, the thousands of knights quickly regained formation and drew their swords after the initial chaos upon receiving Grotar’s orders.
In perfect unison, they pulled out their swords!
Clang! Clang clang!
Longswords unsheathed, belonging to the kingdom’s most elite knights, advancing with unmatched momentum towards Lymes.

sentences.text: "Well, everyone’s here.
If there’s nothing else to handle, let’s prepare to enter the Secret Realm."
"Is everything okay?" Han Xing asked.
The crowd was silent for a moment.
Shen Yun then asked, "Brother Xing, speaking of which, once we enter the Secret Realm, won’t the territories remain unguarded?
Could that be a problem?"
Han Xing shook his head and said, "Don’t worry about that.
You can overlap your territories with mine, and I’ll modify the defensive instructions of the Spiritual Shield to cover your territories as well."
"Then set the attack program of the Siege Crossbow Arrow Launcher Platform.
If anyone attacks the Defense Shield, it’ll automatically retaliate."
"Then, display the puppets from the last leaderboard rewards, and there should be no issues."
After hearing this, everyone nodded.
Han Xing’s Siege Crossbow Arrow Launcher Platform has proven its power, even capable of handling multiple attacks with ease and destroying them.
With so many Golden Armor and Silver Armor Puppets, it’s like an impenetrable fortress.
At this moment, Su Xiaoyang cautiously added, "If we encounter danger, Xiaoqian will help fight too..."
"It... it may look scary, but it’s obedient."
Everyone looked at Su Xiaoyang’s Leader-Level Tree Demon at level 10.
A Plant Series monster, and at Leader-Level, its combat capability even surpassed Han Xing’s Golden Armor Puppet.
Han Xing nodded, "Since there’s no problem, let’s enter now."
Then, Han Xing invited Su Xiaoyang to join the team.
This team of five had taken its initial form.
And Han Xing naturally became the team leader.
He approached the Cloud Secret Realm vortex, and at this moment, a system prompt appeared.
[Do you wish to enter the Two-star Cloud Secret Realm, ’Knight Judgment Arena’?]
"Yes."
The vortex began to rotate slowly, indicating the Teleportation Gate was open.
Han Xing stepped in first, followed by Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, and finally Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang.
With a flash, they found themselves in a massive plaza.
This plaza was extraordinarily vast, roughly estimated to be at least tens of thousands of square meters, with the floor paved with green-gray stones.
In the center of the plaza stood a gigantic statue about twenty meters tall, with a base diameter of more than five meters.
It depicted a human knight with a shield raised high in the left hand and a Holy Hammer in the right.
The simple pose displayed an extraordinary aura.
Beneath, a magnificent horse stood with head held high, highlighting the knight’s heroic stance even more.
However, at this time, the statue was toppled from the middle, lying in two pieces.
Thick dust covered the ground, and the knight’s former glory was no more.
At that moment, a system prompt appeared.
[With the neighing of horses and waving of flags, this was once the Judgment Arena of the Human Race Empire, where Knight King Grotar frequently judged the guilty.]
[Witnessed by the empire’s three thousand elite knights, the guilty would be beheaded here.]
[Until one day, the Knight Judgment Arena welcomed a different group of sinners.
Today, they would publicly judge the Knight Commander of the previous empire, Lymes, along with his three hundred Azure Heaven Knight Order members.]
[As the right-hand man of the Knight King, Lymes contributed immensely to the empire’s rise, but recently, Grotar sought to sentence Lymes to death under the charge of betraying their faith.]
Everyone was momentarily puzzled.
Cheng Jianyong said, "What the heck?
How is this Two-star Cloud Secret Realm different from what we played before?"
Han Xing nodded, "It is somewhat different; it even starts with an introduction."
Before they could digest this, they suddenly heard a resounding cheer.
The five instantly went on alert as the previously empty ground was suddenly filled with thousands of phantom figures.
They were all chanting one name,
"Grotar!"
"Grotar!"
Everyone glanced toward the spectator stands’ empty spot, which held a gigantic throne carved from a single stone block.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Whoa, does this thing have a cutscene?"
"By the way, is this Lu’erta so formidable that he wants to execute his own right-hand man?"
Shen Yun exasperatedly said, "It’s Grotar, Cheng Jianyong, be quiet and watch what’s happening."
Amidst the crowd of thousands of knights, a man clad in white armor with a resolute face sat upright on the throne.
He rested his face on his hand, his gaze sharp as he spoke loudly downward, "Lymes, do you admit your guilt?"
Below, the members of the Azure Heaven Knight Order, bound in shackles, were forced to kneel.
They had been stripped of their glorious armor and dependable steeds.
These knights, once radiating brilliance, were now stripped of their radiance, showcasing sheer misery and despair.
Seeing no answer, Grotar spoke again, "Lymes, do you admit to violating the kingdom’s code and committing acts unfaithful to the God of Light?"
On the field, more than three thousand knights involuntarily turned their gaze.
They seemed unable to believe that Lymes, the most loyal and courageous knight commander to the kingdom in battles of the past, could betray the Knight King and the kingdom.
However, among the disgraced knights, a resolute-faced man in his forties raised his head and said, "Respected Knight King, Lymes, acknowledges his guilt..."
He seemed to have given up his last struggle, humbly lowering his head.
Hearing Lymes’ own admission, the other knights present looked at each other in disbelief.
On the throne, Grotar nodded slightly,
"Since you acknowledge your guilt, let us proceed according to protocol, strip Lymes of his rights as knight commander, and carry out the execution immediately."
Grotar’s pronouncement equated to a death sentence for Lymes.
Lymes’ expression showed no fear, but calmly asked, "Knight King, after this, can the evil god species eradication activity be ended?"
Grotar frowned upon hearing this, slightly angry, "Lymes, you are still so stubborn; I have already told you, those people are not our kin but a group of heretics who have joined the evil god!"
At this moment, Lymes asked in a trembling voice from below, "Your Majesty, you say they are heretical betrayers of faith, but they are just children!"
"I saw with my own eyes, the knights’ iron hooves ravaged their village, those children covered in blood searching for their family members’ corpses among countless dead bodies."
"Yet even so, those children’s eyes remained so clear, they asked me, would the God of Light take their relatives’ souls away?"
"How could these innocent children possibly be heretics?
How could the God of Light fear a group of children?"
Lymes’ words were powerful enough to strike at the soul, leaving everyone stunned.
"Silence!" Grotar’s voice reverberated throughout the judgment arena.
"A new generation of evil god species has been born among humans; if allowed to grow, they will cause an unforeseen disaster, this is God’s warning to us!"
"Lymes, are you questioning the authenticity of the divine prophecy from the God of Light?"
Below, Lymes remained silent.
He dared not question the God of Light or Grotar in front of the crowd.
Grotar’s expression was unchanged as he continued, "Lymes, do not remain deluded."
"In view of the great contributions you have made in battle for the empire in the past, do you have any last words before the execution?"

Lymes looked around, clinging to a sliver of hope, he asked, "Majesty, it was my decision alone to let those children escape, it has nothing to do with the Azure Heaven Knight Order, could you execute only me and spare the other knights?"

He firmly said, "No."
Lymes felt despair instantly, unable to believe as he looked at Grotar, asking, "Your Majesty, why?"
"They are innocent, they still wish to contribute to the kingdom again, to offer their faith to the God of Light!"
However, no matter how he pleaded, Grotar remained unmoved.

chapters.title: Chapter 110 - 98: Fierce Battle! Shadow Giant Dragon!
paragraphs: Under Grotar’s command, the kingdom’s most elite knights pressed towards Lymes and his companions.
Even though the Azure Heaven Knight Order stood united,
without weapons in hand, they were utterly incapable of resisting this group of well-equipped knights.
In terms of both numbers and equipment quality, the Azure Heaven Knight Order was completely crushed.
A barrage of attacks came upon them.
Lymes suddenly raised his head, seemingly making some decision, reaching out his hand, a mass of Holy Light gathered.
The next moment, a broken sword hilt appeared in his hand.
Just as they were about to be overwhelmed by attacks,
the broken sword hilt suddenly emitted an intense Holy Light, about a hundred meters high.
A strange scene unfolded as all the attacks from the knights, upon touching the Holy Light, either automatically veered off or lost their power, dissipating in mid-air.
Clatter! Clatter!
Various weapons and arrows dropped to the ground.
The concentrated fire of thousands of knights would even instantly kill a Legendary Creature if struck directly.
But now, it was easily neutralized by this broken sword hilt.
Everyone gazed bewilderedly at the item in his hand.
Lymes shouted loudly: "This is the personal sword of the First Knight King, according to the kingdom’s laws, no knight may attack the bearer of this sword!"
"Otherwise, it will be regarded as defying the will of the First Knight King, betraying the creed of the knights!"
When Lymes finished speaking, all the knights simultaneously looked at the broken sword hilt in his hand, their eyes showing reverence and worship!
The weight of the First Knight King was undoubtedly heavy, supposedly the first human to break through to demigod status.
Even though he has passed, his sword still possesses unimaginable power, as just demonstrated by the Holy Light blocking all attacks.
Watching from the side, Shen Yun’s eyes suddenly brightened, "This sword, a good thing indeed!"
The others also recognized the extraordinariness of the sword hilt in Lymes’s hand.
Han Xing analyzed, "It’s a good thing, I seem to see a bit of Rule Power on it."
"Rules?"
Everyone glanced at him in unison.
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, did you not notice?"
"Those attacks when touching the Holy Light, were not negated, they dispersed on their own."
"Considering what Lymes just said, this short sword likely possesses the Power of Rules, as long as it’s held, it equates to immunity from all Human Race attacks!"
Upon Han Xing’s words, everyone collectively took a deep breath.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Whoa, doesn’t this mean that as long as I hold this broken sword, I am invincible among the Human Race?"
Han Xing nodded, "Theoretically, it should be so."
At this moment, everyone stared intently at the broken sword raised high in Lymes’s hand.
At this time, even Grotar, sitting high on the throne, appeared slightly stunned, frowning and asking, "Lymes, do you intend to blatantly rebel and desecrate the God of Light?"
Lymes listened and responded firmly, "Your Majesty, please let us leave!"
However, this also seemed to be within Grotar’s expectations, a cold smile curled at the corner of his mouth.
"Leave? Dream on!"
"Have you forgotten, that while the knights cannot attack you, other race creatures can!"
He waved his hand, and the sky above the square was suddenly covered by a massive Black Shadow.
Lymes suddenly had a bad feeling.
It was a giant creature entirely covered in black scales, with wings on its back, and over fifty meters long.
Upon seeing the creature, everyone couldn’t help but look up in exclamation.
"Shadow Giant Dragon!"
As one of the Legendary Creatures, the Dragon Race is highly recognizable in appearance.
At this moment, the Shadow Giant Dragon was hovering in the air, its massive wings flapping, the resulting gusts making it hard for everyone to maintain their footing.
At this moment, the shadows of all knights in the square vanished, and system notifications appeared.
[Knight Judgment Arena Phase One challenge has commenced, the battle will begin in thirty seconds, challenge objective: Defeat the Shadow Giant Dragon (Phantom)]
"Damn, so after all this time, we’re not here to fight those knights, but to slay a dragon?" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in confusion.
Looking at the enormous creature before them, all five individuals in the arena tensed up.
At this moment, the dragon’s attributes also appeared before them.
[Shadow Giant Dragon Phantom (Two-star Leader, Legendary Creature)]
[Level: lv15]
[Attributes]: Power 333, Agility 333, Spirit 333, Constitution 333.
Skills:

[Shadow Flame Burst]: The Shadow Giant Dragon sprays a mass of Dark Flame forward, burning enemies and causing area damage, simultaneously reducing enemies’ Movement Speed and Attack Speed by 30%, and Defense by 20%.
[Shadow Devouring]: The Shadow Giant Dragon opens its massive mouth, absorbing Dark Energy to rapidly restore its injuries.
[Dark Wings]: The Shadow Giant Dragon unfolds its huge Dark Wings, soaring through the air, increasing its Movement Speed by 100% and Defense by 50%.

[Shadow Barrier]: The Shadow Giant Dragon drives Dark Power to form a layer of Dark Shield on its body with 200 Defense Value, blocking enemies’ attacks. When the shield is broken, it deals 200% blast damage to surrounding enemies!

[Shadow Roar (Legendary Skill)]: The Shadow Giant Dragon emits an ear-piercing roar, under its Dragon might, all enemies suffer a fear effect, falling into a ten-second immobilized state, and receiving psychic damage equal to the Shadow Giant Dragon’s attack power every second!
[Dark Dragon Soul]: Sealed state, cannot be used.
[Ultimate Skill - World-Ending Black Flame]: Sealed state, cannot be used.
[Ultimate Skill - Star of Annihilation]: Sealed state, cannot be used.
Seeing the formidable attributes and long skill list of this giant dragon, everyone fell into silence.
"Damn, is this really a Two-star Secret Realm?"
Cheng Jianyong said in disbelief, "Starting with such an invincible creature, does the system really want us to pass?"
When he and Shen Yun cleared that One-Star Secret Realm before, the strongest enemy they encountered was just a level 10 Elite Monster.
And in this Two-star Secret Realm, right at the start is a level 15 Leader, and it’s a Legendary Creature, the difference is more than just a level!
Facing the dragon’s intimidating force, everyone felt they could hardly breathe.
At this moment, Shen Yun asked, "Brother Xing, what should we do now?"
Everyone looked towards Han Xing in unison.
At this moment, Han Xing became their backbone.
Seeing that the battle countdown had only 10 seconds left.
Han Xing said seriously, "Get ready, form up, and prepare for battle!"
"Don’t worry, this dragon is just a phantom, its power has been greatly reduced, it can’t exert the strength of a Legendary Creature."
"Now, it’s just a level 15 Leader Monster, let’s go for it!"
Han Xing’s words were like a shot of adrenaline to the confused crowd.
Shen Yun took a deep breath, first raising the Shield of Immortality and charging forward.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang exchanged a glance, then each took a few steps back, standing about ten meters away on either side of Han Xing.
In the sky, the silhouette of the Shadow Giant Dragon became more and more solid, as if emerging from a phantom state into reality.
As the countdown ended.
The silhouette of the Shadow Giant Dragon also took its final form.
At this moment, beneath its jet-black scales, a pair of ghostly green eyes gazed at the small ants below.
The Shadow Giant Dragon swooped down.
Shen Yun immediately confronted it.
"Holy Light, protect me!" Shen Yun cast a shield on himself.
Faced with the dragon’s might, Shen Yun showed no fear; he knew he had the strongest defense among the five.
Raising the Shield of Immortality, Shen Yun boldly blocked the path of the Shadow Giant Dragon’s dive, preparing for direct contact.
"Unyielding Will!" Shen Yun activated the legendary effect of the Golden Shield.
For ten seconds, his damage taken was significantly reduced and he wouldn’t be pushed back by any attack!
Bang!
The enormous head of the Shadow Giant Dragon struck the Shield of Immortality, making a dull collision sound.
The next moment, the Shadow Giant Dragon shook its head, seemingly unable to believe that this human, who seemed like an ant, could withstand its impact without budging an inch.
The Shadow Giant Dragon’s pupils flickered, as if contemplating something.
Is this human wielding the Power of Rules?
Interesting...
At this moment, Coal Ball flashed over to the dragon’s phantom side.
Slash! Slash!
With two swipes, two scratches appeared on the thick scales of the Shadow Giant Dragon, emitting wisps of purple smoke.
The Shadow Giant Dragon’s pupils instantly widened; the aura of this little attacker felt eerily similar to a memory long buried.
Wasn’t this race supposed to be extinct?
This group’s combination is indeed quite peculiar...
At that moment, Han Xing also entered Frenzy State.
The Wild Ranger’s exclusive skill increased attack speed and hit rate significantly.
Wind Chasing Arrow shot forth, triggering the Longbow effect, ’Life-taking.’
Effect - Life-taking: There’s an 18% chance to deal 200% damage when attacking.
This strike triggered the double damage effect.
Supported by his powerful Attack Power, even the astonishing defense of the dragon was pierced by this arrow, deeply embedding into its flesh.
The sudden pain snapped the Shadow Giant Dragon back to reality.
It was completely enraged by Han Xing’s arrow, roaring towards the sky.
"Roar!"
The terrifying roar exploded in everyone’s ears, bringing a buzzing in their minds.
Two massive black wings unfurled, bringing a gale with them.
Cheng Jianyong saw this and instantly dashed forward with his sword.
However, he hadn’t gone far before the gust from the dragon’s wings sent him, along with the nearby Coal Ball, flying.
In the next moment, a human and a young wolf were simultaneously blown away.
"Damn!" Cheng Jianyong rolled a few times on the ground before quickly standing up.
Shen Yun held up the Shield of Immortality again, ready to charge forward once more.
The Shadow Giant Dragon’s eyes showed a hint of disdain, noticing that the special power of the human with the shield had disappeared.
It slightly opened its massive mouth, brewing a Dragon’s Breath.
"Be careful!" Cheng Jianyong shouted in alarm, rushing over without a second thought.
But Shen Yun yelled, "Don’t come over, I can block it!"
His eyes burning with determination and confidence!
He believed that, with his own strength combined with the full set of top-grade equipment Han Xing provided, he was more than capable of withstanding the dragon’s attack!
