"Damn!" Cheng Jianyong rolled a few times on the ground before quickly standing up.
Shen Yun held up the Shield of Immortality again, ready to charge forward once more.
The Shadow Giant Dragon’s eyes showed a hint of disdain, noticing that the special power of the human with the shield had disappeared.
It slightly opened its massive mouth, brewing a Dragon’s Breath.
"Be careful!" Cheng Jianyong shouted in alarm, rushing over without a second thought.
But Shen Yun yelled, "Don’t come over, I can block it!"
His eyes burning with determination and confidence!
He believed that, with his own strength combined with the full set of top-grade equipment Han Xing provided, he was more than capable of withstanding the dragon’s attack!

chapters.title: Chapter 111 - 99: The Mighty Void Ghost Wolf!
paragraphs: The Dragon’s Breath descended, carrying terrifying heat and corrosion.
However, at this moment, Shen Yun raised his shield high, enduring the terrifying attack.
A faint yellow light continued to emit from the Shield of Immortality, as the black Dragon Flame of the Shadow Giant Dragon raged on.
Even as Shen Yun was constantly driven back by the Dragon Flame’s breath, he stubbornly held his ground with the shield.
When the Dragon’s Breath dissipated.
At this moment, Shen Yun was fully equipped with purple armor, plus a golden shield, showcasing a powerful defense, astonishingly withstanding the attack of the Shadow Giant Dragon head-on!
Even in the eyes of the Shadow Giant Dragon, there was a hint of surprise.
Everyone was shaken, yet couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
"Attack!" Han Xing seized the opportunity, commanding.
Upon hearing this, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang quickly launched their attacks.
Several arrows, along with a fireball the size of a washbasin, bombarded the Shadow Giant Dragon.
Han Xing and Su Xiaoyang both wielded legendary golden equipment, dealing considerable damage. Coupled with their hidden professions, the damage they caused far exceeded that of other survivors.
Although Zhang Lianmeng did not have a golden weapon, she was an extremely fierce Elemental Mage, and a single large fireball directly burst the Shadow Giant Dragon’s scales!
"Roar!"
The Shadow Giant Dragon roared furiously, an enraged cry towards the heaven.
At the same time, Coal Ball and Cheng Jianyong advanced again.
Cheng Jianyong lifted his great sword and leaped high, slashing towards the belly of the Shadow Giant Dragon.
With a flicker, Coal Ball appeared on the back of the Shadow Giant Dragon.
Swish! Swish!
A sudden burst of killing intent!
Power of the Void!
The skills of a man and a wolf were unleashed simultaneously.
The Shadow Giant Dragon was corroded by Coal Ball’s Power of the Void, its defense plummeting significantly once again.
The damage dealt by Han Xing and the others became even more terrifying.
At this moment, a blast of eerie green energy suddenly rose from Han Xing’s body.
This energy even altered his attack form, with each arrow shot by Han Xing shimmering with a green glow.
Pop! Pop!
The arrows hit the scales of the Shadow Giant Dragon, emitting explosive popping sounds.
The eerie green glow followed the arrows and penetrated into the dragon’s body, suddenly making everyone feel as if its power had been partially weakened...
And this was the legendary effect of the Soul Shattering Longbow, Shattered Spirit!

In this state, all of Han Xing’s attacks were guaranteed to be critical hits, and each time an attack hit the enemy, it reduced the opponent’s attack power by 2%. The weakening effect lasted for two minutes and could stack up to 10 times!
The defensive reduction by Coal Ball, coupled with Han Xing’s attack power reduction, and Shen Yun holding the front with a golden shield.
The threat of the Shadow Giant Dragon was significantly diminished.
"Increase the attack!"
Upon hearing Han Xing’s command, everyone instantly focused their attention and began to unleash their powerful skills on the Shadow Giant Dragon.
Large Fireball!
Multi-Shot!
Eagle Fall Slash!
Counterattack Spike!
Numerous powerful burst skills inflicted massive damage on the Shadow Giant Dragon!
At this moment, everyone had a strange feeling in their hearts.
Even though it looked like an invincible Two-Star Legendary Monster, here they were managing to overpower it...
The scene before their eyes was somewhat surreal.
A group of insignificant humans was forcing the legendary dragon into retreat, causing it to wail incessantly.
No one would believe it if they told.
They also knew that a significant part of the reason lay in the powerful equipment Han Xing had prepared for them.
The entire team was in purple armor, and the quality of the equipment was at least rare. Such equipment strength was unmatched in the entire server before the merge.
But now, it was just standard gear for their team.
It could be said that Han Xing used equipment to utterly crush this dragon.
At this moment, the Shadow Giant Dragon was furious.
It couldn’t take down Shen Yun, and on the side, there were four or five pests constantly harming it.
Not only that, but these pests’ attacks made it feel a great sense of threat.
Just then, the Shadow Giant Dragon’s wings flapped.
Swoosh—Swoosh—
The speed of the Shadow Giant Dragon soared instantaneously, rushing into the sky with a fierce wind.
Han Xing quickly warned, "Everyone be careful, this is the Shadow Giant Dragon’s ’Dark Wings’ skill. In flying state, its defense and speed will increase significantly!"
Everyone’s expressions turned solemn.
The gigantic shadow swiftly circled above them, seemingly searching for a suitable target to attack.
At this point, everyone looked at Han Xing in confusion, seemingly awaiting his instruction.
Han Xing, staring at the dragon in the sky, said, "Cheng Jianyong, go guard Lian’Er. Shen Yun, you go protect Xiaoyang."
"All ranged attackers, full force, let’s bring it down!"
The next moment, he directly pulled back the bowstring and aimed at the sky, shooting the arrow.
Multi-Shot!
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang also assisted in the attack from the side.
The Shadow Giant Dragon continuously evaded the attacks from the three.
It seemed to realize then that the man holding the bow and arrow was the one giving orders.
Moreover, there was protection beside the other two ranged units, but only this person was alone.
Its eyeballs rolled a few times, then locked onto Han Xing.
The next instant, the Shadow Giant Dragon dived down fiercely.
At this time, there was no melee unit protecting Han Xing, meaning he had to face the Shadow Giant Dragon’s attack on his own.
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong exclaimed from the side, "Brother Xing, be careful!"
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang saw this scene, their hearts tightened simultaneously.
However, how could their speed possibly match the diving speed of the Shadow Giant Dragon?
The massive shadow, with the power to destroy everything, rushed towards Han Xing.
Han Xing didn’t panic. At the moment the Shadow Giant Dragon was about to crash in, Han Xing directly activated the Wild Ranger’s exclusive skill, Wild Instinct.
[Wild Instinct]: Movement speed increased by 500% for 10 seconds!
The Shadow Giant Dragon saw that this frail human suddenly flashed and instantly retreated.
The speed that erupted instantly even surprised it.
Rumble!
The dragon missed its target and crashed heavily onto the ground.
When the dust cleared, a figure appeared dozens of meters away, once again drawing the bow to shoot an arrow.
Seeing Han Xing was fine, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
At this point, they snapped back to reality and immediately launched another attack, causing more damage to the Shadow Giant Dragon.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun were preparing to close in again and suppress the dragon.
However, the Shadow Giant Dragon wasn’t foolish; it directly flapped its wings, ready to escape from this place.
And at this moment, a smile suddenly appeared at the corner of Han Xing’s mouth.
Because, above the Shadow Giant Dragon’s head, there was an entirely black creature that appeared out of nowhere.
Coal Ball’s silhouette was suspended in mid-air.
In the bewildered eyes of everyone, they suddenly saw countless black lines suddenly grow out from Coal Ball. These lines bloomed wildly in a short period.
Then, like fireworks, they blossomed fiercely!
At this moment, tens of thousands of black lines all pierced into the Shadow Giant Dragon’s body, penetrating its massive form!
These black lines seemed to attack from another dimension, completely ignoring the Shadow Giant Dragon’s flesh body defense.
At this point, the Shadow Giant Dragon’s ascent was abruptly halted, as if hung mid-air, unable to move.
Seeing this spectacle, question marks floated over everyone’s heads.
"What’s going on?" Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but ask.
They had never seen Coal Ball in this form; they only knew that it was Han Xing’s pet, with formidable attributes!
But Han Xing wasn’t surprised.
Because this was Coal Ball’s sixth skill, Void Frenzy, activated after reaching level 10.

[Void Frenzy]: The Void Ghost Wolf gathers the power of the void, unleashing 10,080 void line bodies, causing a large area of defense-ignoring damage to all enemies within 30 meters. If the void lines successfully hit targets, they inflict the Void Domain effect.

In the Void Domain state, enemies cannot move, and massive life force is drained per second until the enemy dies. (Note: Creatures trapped within the Void Domain can forcefully break free using their own power, the time to escape depends on the attributes and state of both sides.)
Cooldown time: 24 hours.
This Void Frenzy skill is the most powerful skill Han Xing has seen since entering Sky Island Paradise, bar none.
It delivers a wide area of defense-ignoring damage and can control the enemy if hit. Slightly weaker creatures cannot break free until they die.
However, the Shadow Giant Dragon is clearly outside the category of weak creatures.
"Roar!"
Suspended mid-air, the Shadow Giant Dragon let out an angry roar.
The tens of thousands of black lines from Coal Ball ruptured largely at this moment.
Han Xing realized that the Shadow Giant Dragon’s power clearly surpassed Coal Ball by a large margin, leading to the imminent collapse of the ’Void Domain’ control effect.
Han Xing quickly shouted, "All-out output, don’t give it the chance to escape!"
Upon hearing this, everyone instantly unleashed their most powerful attack skills on the Shadow Giant Dragon!
Thud! Thud!
Large fireballs, ice spears, multiple arrows, mid-air slashes...
All kinds of attacks fell heavily onto the Shadow Giant Dragon’s body.
Simultaneously, Su Xiaoyang triggered the legendary effect of the Soul Shattering Longbow, Shattered Spirit, increasing the damage dramatically!
Arrow after arrow plunged into the dragon’s body, the intense pain driving the dragon into a more violent struggle.
And at this moment, Han Xing saw another change in Coal Ball.
The remaining thousands of black lines suddenly began stirring, like human hair writhing madly.
A certain power within the Shadow Giant Dragon was rapidly diminishing, being absorbed into Coal Ball’s body.
This was a new skill awakened by Coal Ball after advancing to Two-star.

[Void Plunder (Passive)]: Creatures trapped within the Void Domain trigger the Void Plunder effect, where the Void Ghost Wolf continuously absorbs the strength of domain-dwelling creatures, replenishing its own life value. If there are Legendary Creatures within the domain, their origin power is absorbed, increasing the Void Ghost Wolf’s potential value.
Han Xing knew about this skill of Coal Ball, although the trigger conditions were a bit complex; he was giving it a try in this battle out of a sudden idea.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly noticed a change in the potential value section of Coal Ball’s pet information panel.

chapters.title: Chapter 112 - 100: "Stop Hitting Me, I Give Up!
paragraphs: Han Xing noticed that Coal Ball’s pet panel information was constantly changing.
The potential value column started to increase rapidly.
In less than three seconds, Coal Ball’s potential value increased by nearly 150 points!
"Wow, is this new activated skill really that abnormal?"
Han Xing was completely shocked. The potential value absorbed in three seconds even exceeded his harvest from feeding over the past three days.
Noticing the loss of power within, the Shadow Giant Dragon’s large eyes showed a peculiar expression.
This little Void Race creature, is it absorbing my power?
Hmm? It seems not just absorbing power, but absorbing my Power of Origin!
Damn!
"Roar!"
At that moment, the Shadow Giant Dragon let out a booming roar.
It began to struggle fiercely!
Bang! Boom!
The enormous body twisted wildly on the ground, like a raging beast.
The black lines appearing on Coal Ball also snapped quickly.
Everyone could see they were about to lose control over the dragon.
Just then, Han Xing noticed Coal Ball’s potential value,
points!
In just a few seconds, it increased by nearly 150 points again!
At that moment, Han Xing knew he had inadvertently given Coal Ball a tremendous opportunity!
The skill introduction for Void Raid stated that only legendary creatures could have their potential values absorbed.
And right in front of them, this Shadow Giant Dragon clearly met the criteria.
Following this trend for Coal Ball, in just a dozen seconds, it would match his hard-earned potential value from feeding over ten-plus days.
At that point, Coal Ball’s breakthrough to SS-level growth value would be just around the corner.
Han Xing would never allow this dragon to rise.
Seeing that the dragon was about to break free, Han Xing immediately drew the bowstring again.
This time, however, the arrow in his hand changed somewhat the moment it was set on the bow,
above it, the gentle Power of Moonlight began to overflow overflow.
Meanwhile, behind the Shadow Giant Dragon’s massive body, a bright moon gradually formed.
The Shadow Giant Dragon suddenly felt it couldn’t move, as if it were sealed.
The Shadow Giant Dragon realized that this human was very likely brewing a terrifying skill, within which it even felt a trace of legendary-level power.
If this human releases the skill, it might end up in a disadvantageous situation.
A huge sense of crisis made it struggle hard.
And just then, Han Xing’s arrow had already been shot.
This arrow, at a speed too fast for the naked eye to catch, instantly appeared on the surface of the Shadow Giant Dragon.
Buzz!
The round moon around the Shadow Giant Dragon’s body directly formed.
At this moment, it felt as if it were etched into the surface of the moon, its body firmly fixed within it.
This is precisely Han Xing’s legendary skill, Broken Moon!
It can seal an enemy for 5 seconds!
Under the double seal, no matter how fierce the Shadow Giant Dragon was, it couldn’t move an inch anymore.
The fear in the Shadow Giant Dragon’s eyes was even greater.
It wasn’t worried about being controlled, it was more concerned about the black little creature overhead.
If it were allowed to continue absorbing my Power of Origin, it could cause unimaginable consequences!
Damn!
The Shadow Giant Dragon was extremely anxious!
Seeing everyone else still in a dazed state, Han Xing quickly shouted: "Attack with all your might!"
"Press this dragon down firmly to the ground!"
Although everyone was still in shock at the giant moon.
Upon hearing Han Xing’s voice, they quickly reacted and launched attacks.
A whole lot of attacks fell on the Shadow Giant Dragon
After three seconds, cracks appeared on the surface of that massive round moon.
During this time, the dragon stopped struggling.
Coal Ball began to absorb its power recklessly.
Han Xing noticed that not only was Coal Ball’s potential value rising, but the Shadow Giant Dragon’s attribute panel was constantly changing too.
The Shadow Giant Dragon’s four-dimensional attributes were continuously declining.
Then, it directly dropped below three hundred.
At the same time, Coal Ball’s potential value began to soar, in less than three seconds, its potential value rose from 704, directly soaring to 1012! Officially surpassing four figures.
Five seconds later.
With a crisp cracking sound, the full moon suddenly exploded.
A 1200% attack burst directly severely damaged the Shadow Giant Dragon!
When the Shadow Giant Dragon regained consciousness, it found itself incredibly weak.
With successive heavy damage, coupled with Coal Ball’s constant absorption of its power...
In this situation, the Shadow Giant Dragon felt its body had been emptied...
It could no longer resist as fiercely as before.
At this moment, the Shadow Giant Dragon seemed to realize that if this continued, death was inevitable.
Being killed was fine, but now, it was being continually plundered for its Power of Origin by a strange little creature, a kind that wasn’t returned!
It thought of a terrifying consequence.
Fear appeared in the Shadow Giant Dragon’s eyes, it gathered its last strength and opened its mouth, seeming to be brewing some terrifying attack.
Realizing the Shadow Giant Dragon was preparing to explode.
Han Xing quickly shouted: "This creature wants to unleash a big move, interrupt it!"
The Shadow Giant Dragon has a legendary skill, ’Shadow Roar,’ not yet released.
And Han Xing’s legendary skill, Broken Moon, has been used, and entered a one-hour cooldown time, at this moment, there’s no sufficiently strong trump card.
At this point, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang simultaneously released their strongest burst skills.
Magma Eruption!
Elf Dance!
A large mass of magma suddenly erupted from the Shadow Giant Dragon’s abdomen, causing a fierce explosion.

Being killed was fine, but now, it was being continually plundered for its Power of Origin by a strange little creature, a kind that wasn’t returned!
It thought of a terrifying consequence.
Fear appeared in the Shadow Giant Dragon’s eyes, it gathered its last strength and opened its mouth, seeming to be brewing some terrifying attack.
Realizing the Shadow Giant Dragon was preparing to explode.
Han Xing quickly shouted: "This creature wants to unleash a big move, interrupt it!"
The Shadow Giant Dragon has a legendary skill, ’Shadow Roar,’ not yet released.
And Han Xing’s legendary skill, Broken Moon, has been used, and entered a one-hour cooldown time, at this moment, there’s no sufficiently strong trump card.
At this point, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang simultaneously released their strongest burst skills.
Magma Eruption!
Elf Dance!
A large mass of magma suddenly erupted from the Shadow Giant Dragon’s abdomen, causing a fierce explosion.

chapters.title: Chapter 113 - 100: "Stop Beating Me, I Yield!" (Part 2)
paragraphs: And Su Xiaoyang’s Elf Dance has no cooldown for all basic skills during the skill duration.
This is the exclusive skill of an Elf Shooter!
In other words, in this state, she can use Continuous Fire skills infinitely.
Combined with her terrifying attack speed, everyone witnessed what a true Elf Shooter is.
At this moment, Su Xiaoyang truly transformed into a nimble elf, walking while pulling the bowstring.
Everyone could only see the residual image of her hand strumming the bowstring rapidly.
Multi-Shot skills have turned into infinite Continuous Fire.
Pa pa pa pa!
In less than two seconds, at least thirty arrows were shot out.
On the side, Cheng Jianyong slashed his sword on the back of the Shadow Giant Dragon, "Damn it, is this a Machine Gun Shooter?"
Indeed, Su Xiaoyang’s terrifying attack speed at this moment was truly like a Machine Gun Shooter.
The Shadow Giant Dragon was directly pained by this burst.
"Awo ho!"
The Shadow Giant Dragon roared skyward, losing all resisting power.
Coal Ball continued to absorb Potential Value.
This scene made Han Xing extremely excited.
In just a few seconds! Coal Ball’s Potential Value had already reached nearly 1300, and if this trend continued, it might break through ten thousand today, becoming an SS-level pet!
In Han Xing’s eyes, this dragon was no longer a boss, but a huge chunk of meat that definitely couldn’t be let go!
And at this moment, seeing it couldn’t break free, the Shadow Giant Dragon actually stretched its neck, emitting a bizarre pitch.
Although Han Xing and others couldn’t understand it, they roughly comprehended the meaning through the system’s translation.
"Human Race! Release me!"
Everyone glanced at each other.
Cheng Jianyong asked blankly at this moment, "Damn, did you hear what this dragon said? It’s asking us to let it go?"
Everyone nodded.
Cheng Jianyong breathed a sigh of relief, "Looks like I didn’t hear wrong, I thought I was hallucinating."
Just then, the dragon emitted obscure syllables again.
"Human Race, quickly release me!"
Everyone didn’t stop fighting but still looked at Han Xing, seemingly waiting for his instruction.
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing said, "Ignore it, continue attacking!"
The Shadow Giant Dragon howled in pain as it was attacked, angry shouting, "Damn it, stop, don’t let that Void Creature keep absorbing my power, or the consequences will be unbearable!"
Cheng Jianyong glanced at the dragon, slashing again, "Damn, still acting so mad while begging for mercy, I’ll chop you to death!
Everyone launched another round of attacks, making the Shadow Giant Dragon howl incessantly!
"Roar! Roar!"
"Damnable! Damnable Human Race!"
"How dare you humiliate the great Dragon Race like this, you will pay for it!"
"Damn it, stop! Stop!"
"I surrender, isn’t surrendering enough?"
Everyone paid no heed, as long as Han Xing didn’t call a halt, they would keep attacking.
Even Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, were flushed with excitement.
It seemed crushing a legendary creature like this also thrilled them.
Another 15 seconds passed.
The Shadow Giant Dragon’s All Attributes had fallen below 200, and Coal Ball’s Potential Value soared by another 1000, reaching 2400 points!
The Potential Value needed for SS-level advancement had already completed one-fourth.
Panic appeared in the Shadow Giant Dragon’s eyes, and it hurriedly said.
"Human Race, get that Void Creature to stop, if you don’t stop now, when my power is drained, this Secret Realm will directly collapse!"
Hearing this, Han Xing’s heart stirred.
He waved his hand, "Stop!"
After hearing this, everyone instantly ceased their attacks.
However, the Shadow Giant Dragon, having been severely injured by the attacks, combined with its internal power being continually drained by Coal Ball.
Despite everyone no longer suppressing it, the Shadow Giant Dragon couldn’t rise anymore.
The Shadow Giant Dragon kept its mouth open, emitting unpleasant sounds.
"Quick, don’t let that Void Creature absorb my power anymore..."
Han Xing stepped forward, asking, "Explain clearly, no bargaining with us."
The Shadow Giant Dragon urgently said, "This Secret Realm is evolved from some rule, everything here is a fragment of the past, repeating continuously."

"I’ve stayed here for thousands of years and discovered that the dragon race body is merely a projection of my power. No matter how many times I’m defeated, the Power of Rules here will resurrect me!"
"And now, this Void Creature is absorbing the Origin Power I’ve left here. If it drains this body’s Origin Power, it’ll mean a part of the Secret Realm’s rules is missing."
"Then, not only will I be unable to resurrect, this Secret Realm will directly collapse."
"And you will be lost in unknown space, never able to leave!"
Upon hearing this, everyone’s expression suddenly turned serious.
This dragon revealed such hidden secrets, so the credibility of its words was indeed high.
However, Han Xing still didn’t let Coal Ball retract the Void Domain, instead asking, "Why does this place evolve into a Secret Realm and why did you leave a power projection here, explain clearly!"
The Shadow Giant Dragon replied, "I can’t say! If I tell, the Power of Rules here will directly erase me!"
Han Xing frowned.

The Shadow Giant Dragon grew more anxious, its tone even pleading, "I really don’t know why this place evolved into a Secret Realm. I can only tell you, my true body was guided by a certain sound back then, saying some day in the future..."
Before finishing its words, the Shadow Giant Dragon suddenly felt something amiss.
Inside its body, a force not belonging to it seemed to be erupting.
Suddenly, a strong Holy Light emerged from the Shadow Giant Dragon’s body, forcibly expelling Coal Ball’s Void Line Body.
This Holy Light grew more intense, everyone almost couldn’t see the scene ahead.
Amidst the light, Han Xing sensed a trace of danger and quickly shouted, "Retreat, quick!"
Upon hearing, everyone quickly started withdrawing.
As the light intensified, inside came the furious voice of the Shadow Giant Dragon.
"Who left this power in my body?"
"Damn it! God of Light?"
Boom!
After a loud explosion, the Shadow Giant Dragon suddenly self-destructed, leaving everyone bewildered.
However, Han Xing vaguely heard the last words of the Shadow Giant Dragon before its self-destruction,
God of Light!
As a kind of ancient deity frequently appearing in myths.
In this world, the God of Light seems to be the faith of the Human Race, even the First Knight King must worship him.
But here, Han Xing vaguely sensed something unusual.
System prompts appeared.

[Congratulations, you have successfully cleared the Two-Star Secret Realm ’Knight Judgment Arena’ Stage One challenge, earning Experience Value rewards: 200000+60000 (during the event period, an additional 30% Experience Value), item rewards: Strong Fragment*12, Rune Crystal*3400...]
At this moment, everyone was still bewildered.
A white light suddenly rose from Zhang Lianmeng’s body.
She leveled up, reaching Level 12.
Cheng Jianyong first exclaimed, "Wow, 260,000, this experience reward is truly rich!"
The Experience Value reward from the Cloud Secret Realm is very abundant, and during the event period, an extra 30% experience is also available.
Everyone immersed themselves in the sea of Experience Value rewards.
At this time, Shen Yun quietly walked over to Han Xing and said, "Brother Xing, don’t you think something’s off?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, that dragon died too strangely, like it was forcibly erased by some power."
"This Secret Realm... is not simple, there might be many things unknown to us hidden behind it."
"I don’t know if it’s just this one Secret Realm like this, or if every Secret Realm is the same way."
Shen Yun was also frowning.
This was their first challenge in a Two-Star Secret Realm, yet even in the first stage, it slightly exceeded everyone’s knowledge.
However, they did obtain some astonishing information from the Shadow Giant Dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 114 - 101: So This Is... the Truth!
paragraphs: Not long after the shadow giant dragon self-destructed, the second system prompt appeared.
[Survivors, due to your overachievement in completing the first-phase challenge, you are awarded with an additional 2 Legendary Points, and world influence +12.]
[Two-star secret realm ’Knight Judgment Arena’, the second-phase challenge is about to start, please be prepared, survivors...]
Upon hearing the system prompt, Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion: "Legendary Points? What are they used for?"
Zhang Lianmeng was the first to reply, "I know! Brother Xing said they can be used to draw out the legendary skills of hidden professions!"
"Legendary Skills?"
Han Xing nodded: "Yes, the skill I just used to control the shadow giant dragon is at the legendary level."
The scene where Han Xing summoned that circular moon came to everyone’s mind, directly controlling a creature like the shadow giant dragon for five seconds, with a terrifying effect.
The final shatter of the moon further severely injured the giant dragon, so strong it was frightening!
Han Xing added at this time: "However, I’m not sure if legendary skills are exclusive to hidden professions, if you have the opportunity, you should all keep an eye out."
Everyone enlightenedly nodded.
Then, the scene transformed again.
The view continued from before, with Knight Commander Lymes producing the broken sword hilt of the first Knight King, forbidding all knights, including all of the human race, from attacking him.
At this moment, the Knight King Grotar summoned the shadow giant dragon, starting an attack against Lymes and others.
This shadow giant dragon was not the phantom giant dragon Han Xing and his companions fought.
It was truly a creature with legendary power.
Even though Lymes fought valiantly, the power of humans was ultimately limited.
After a fierce battle.
In the center of the square, lay a pile of mangled human corpses.
On the field, only one blood-soaked man remained standing.
The next moment, a broken corpse fell from the sky, landing in front of him.
It was carelessly tossed by the shadow giant dragon, the corpse of his comrade.
Looking at the Azure Heaven Knight Order who once fought alongside him and was now reduced to such a state, Lymes felt a profound sadness rise within him.

He remembered when he first joined the Royal Knight Order, that man told him: "Lymes, you are my most trusted friend. With your help, I will certainly become the new Knight King, making all the kingdom’s people live happy lives!"
"I will let you form the strongest knight order, and your names shall forever be engraved on the stone of glory!"
At this time, Lymes wanted to question, "Grotar, were you deceiving me back then?"
Lymes knelt on the ground, the sword of the first Knight King in his hand also shattered during the battle with the giant dragon, just like his collapsed faith.
Outside the scene, those watching the cutscene couldn’t help but feel a sense of regret.
"It’s broken, such a powerful thing, what a pity..."
Without the sword, this meant others from the human race could now attack Lymes.
At this moment, Grotar, seated high on the throne, sighed, "Do it."
Around him, hundreds of crossbow arrows simultaneously aimed at Lymes.
The Azure Heaven Knight Order was left with only him, and Lymes had no more strength to resist.
The next moment, tens of thousands of arrows were fired.
Thud, thud, thud!
The sound of countless arrows penetrating flesh resounded.
Lymes looked at his body, filled with arrows, and then fell.
When all settled, Grotar stood up from the throne with a sorrowful face.
For executing his most trusted subordinate by his own hand, he seemed to also feel a great sorrow.
A knight beside him consoled: "Your Majesty the Knight King, Lymes deserved his fate; you need not mourn for someone who betrayed his faith."
Grotar sighed: "Dispose of their bodies."
Having said this, he staggered to his feet from the throne and turned to leave.
The knights all watched Grotar leave, including the deceased Lymes on the ground whose eyes could not close in peace.
However, what they failed to notice was that as Grotar turned away, a sly smile inadvertently crept upon his lips.
With the passing of time, the bodies of Lymes and his men were disposed of.
The Knight Judgment Arena returned to its tranquility.
Han Xing and the others looked at the empty and imposing judgment arena, somewhat perplexed.
Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion: "Huh? Is it over just like that?"
"So, does this mean that Lu’erta was problematic, right? Was it he who set up Lymes?"
Shen Yun nodded, "It seems so."
"From their conversation, given Lymes’ contributions, merely letting a group of children escape shouldn’t have been enough to warrant death, no matter the scenario."
"Yet Grotar not only executed him but refused to spare his knight order."
"Moreover, he seemed to know Lymes had the first Knight King’s sword, already having arranged for the shadow giant dragon to wait nearby."
"This Grotar clearly has issues."
Upon hearing this, everyone fell into a thoughtful silence.
At this moment, the scene altered once again.
In the placid square, a black shadow suddenly emerged.
This shadow looked like a woman.
She wore a hood, her black robe dragging on the ground, her figure graceful.
The woman slowly walked toward the center of the square, her gait distinctly peculiar, her waist swaying like a charming python.
She arrived at the spot where Lymes once died and sprinkled some sort of peculiar powder.
Simultaneously, a chilling wind began to blow through the long-silent Knight Judgment Arena.
Within the wind were the wails of the undead, seemingly echoing.
When the undead wind blew by, the next moment, a ghostly figure appeared, resembling Lymes in stature.
He looked bewilderedly at the hooded woman, asking, "Who... are you, and why have you awakened my spirit?"
The woman looked at him, lightly flicking her lan zhi, and laughed, "Oh dear... such a pitiful and wretched fellow."
"You don’t even know you’ve been betrayed by the one you trusted the most, and you still consider this your final resting place."
"Do you plan to continue guarding the Royal City even after death?"
Lymes’ stiff expression suddenly twitched.
Betrayal? Who betrayed me?
The woman continued, "Can’t you see it yet? You were framed by that guy and thus reduced to such a state."
Lymes’ eyes still carried a strong sense of vigilance.
"What’s wrong, don’t you believe it?" the woman continued to ask.
Lymes shook his head.
"Hehehe..." the woman giggled, then waved a single hand.
In front of Lymes, an image appeared.
The scene showed Grotar engaging in conversation with a darkly dispositioned person clad in all red from the Human Race.

Lymes recognized this person; it was the leader of the Evil God Cult whom the Azure Heaven Knight Order had paid a great price to pursue and who had been spreading the curse of the Evil God throughout the Human Kingdom.
But Grotar, actually conversing with such a person, and they were enjoying the conversation!
Then what was the true purpose of the so-called Evil God Species eradication operation they’ve always had, and was the so-called oracle of the God of Light even real?
Lymes fell into intense self-doubt.
The woman seemed to enjoy Lymes’ current expression, she stuck out a scarlet tongue, licking her lips.
Then, she continued in an alluring voice, "So, would you like me to show you what happened after you died?"
Lymes desperately wanted to refuse, knowing this woman was trying to manipulate him.
However, he was now just an undead spirit, with no right to refuse.
The woman waved a hand once more, and the image continued to unfold.
In the image, thin, frail humans were rudely awakened from their sleep, and a group of knights burst into their rooms, dragging them all out.
They were taken to a small hill outside the Royal City, faces filled with fear.
From the elderly in their seventies down to newborn infants, six or seven hundred people, all herded together by these knights.
Lymes’ soul body trembled violently; he recognized these people, they were all his blood relatives.
His uncles, brothers, siblings, sisters...
At this moment, they looked blankly toward the knights in the valley.
Lymes vaguely guessed what was about to happen next, not even daring to continue watching.
However, the inner struggle made him unwillingly open his eyes.
The next moment.
He saw crossbow arrows flying.
Thud thud thud!
Bodies were being pierced through.
Screams, wails, pleas for mercy, resounded through the night sky.
These sounds pierced into Lymes’ heart like sharp spikes.
His breath became increasingly hasty.
When the cruel massacre ended.
The ground lay scattered with hundreds of bodies, the soil stained red with blood.
Lymes’ kinsmen and friends were all shot dead in the pit.
Then, these Kingdom Knights raised swords that symbolized honor and integrity, delivering the final blow to these innocent human corpses.
Lymes’ soul body shook violently.
He spoke in a deranged tone, "This can’t be true, this can’t be true!"
"Grotar promised me he wouldn’t harm my kin."
"This can’t be true!"
The woman chuckled lightly, "Hehe..."
"Whether it’s true or not, you already have the answer in your heart, don’t you?"
"And, do you think this is all there is to it?" The hooded woman glanced at him with a sultry look, the seductive intent intensifying.
Lymes, on the brink of collapse, shivered all over upon hearing this.
His kin and friends were all killed, what else was Grotar planning?
The scene continued to play out.
At this time, Lymes saw two women.
Two young and beautiful women, one slightly innocent, the other a bit older, yet still showing her beautiful features.
Lymes recognized them, Ritana, Ali...
His wife and daughter.
However, at this moment, their faces bore tear stains, bodies naked, covered in bruises.
In the dim dungeon, terror exuded strongly from their eyes.
Then, a tall man appeared before them.
This man was Grotar.
Lymes’ heart wrenched, he reached out with his phantom-like fingers, desperately shouting, "No... no!"
In Grotar’s leering gaze, he subjected Lymes’ wife and daughter to countless humiliation and torment.
After an unknown period, unable to bear the disgrace, their spirits seemingly reached their limits.
In the endless darkness of the cellar, they took their own lives...

"From their conversation, given Lymes’ contributions, merely letting a group of children escape shouldn’t have been enough to warrant death, no matter the scenario."
"Yet Grotar not only executed him but refused to spare his knight order."
"Moreover, he seemed to know Lymes had the first Knight King’s sword, already having arranged for the shadow giant dragon to wait nearby."
"This Grotar clearly has issues."
Upon hearing this, everyone fell into a thoughtful silence.
At this moment, the scene altered once again.
In the placid square, a black shadow suddenly emerged.
This shadow looked like a woman.
She wore a hood, her black robe dragging on the ground, her figure graceful.
The woman slowly walked toward the center of the square, her gait distinctly peculiar, her waist swaying like a charming python.
She arrived at the spot where Lymes once died and sprinkled some sort of peculiar powder.
Simultaneously, a chilling wind began to blow through the long-silent Knight Judgment Arena.
Within the wind were the wails of the undead, seemingly echoing.
When the undead wind blew by, the next moment, a ghostly figure appeared, resembling Lymes in stature.
He looked bewilderedly at the hooded woman, asking, "Who... are you, and why have you awakened my spirit?"
The woman looked at him, lightly flicking her lan zhi, and laughed, "Oh dear... such a pitiful and wretched fellow."
"You don’t even know you’ve been betrayed by the one you trusted the most, and you still consider this your final resting place."
"Do you plan to continue guarding the Royal City even after death?"
Lymes’ stiff expression suddenly twitched.
Betrayal?
Who betrayed me?
The woman continued, "Can’t you see it yet?
You were framed by that guy and thus reduced to such a state."
Lymes’ eyes still carried a strong sense of vigilance.
"What’s wrong, don’t you believe it?" the woman continued to ask.
Lymes shook his head.
"Hehehe..." the woman giggled, then waved a single hand.
In front of Lymes, an image appeared.
The scene showed Grotar engaging in conversation with a darkly dispositioned person clad in all red from the Human Race.

Lymes recognized this person; it was the leader of the Evil God Cult whom the Azure Heaven Knight Order had paid a great price to pursue and who had been spreading the curse of the Evil God throughout the Human Kingdom.
But Grotar, actually conversing with such a person, and they were enjoying the conversation!
Then what was the true purpose of the so-called Evil God Species eradication operation they’ve always had, and was the so-called oracle of the God of Light even real?
Lymes fell into intense self-doubt.
The woman seemed to enjoy Lymes’ current expression, she stuck out a scarlet tongue, licking her lips.
Then, she continued in an alluring voice, "So, would you like me to show you what happened after you died?"
Lymes desperately wanted to refuse, knowing this woman was trying to manipulate him.
However, he was now just an undead spirit, with no right to refuse.
The woman waved a hand once more, and the image continued to unfold.
In the image, thin, frail humans were rudely awakened from their sleep, and a group of knights burst into their rooms, dragging them all out.
They were taken to a small hill outside the Royal City, faces filled with fear.
From the elderly in their seventies down to newborn infants, six or seven hundred people, all herded together by these knights.
Lymes’ soul body trembled violently; he recognized these people, they were all his blood relatives.
His uncles, brothers, siblings, sisters...
At this moment, they looked blankly toward the knights in the valley.
Lymes vaguely guessed what was about to happen next, not even daring to continue watching.
However, the inner struggle made him unwillingly open his eyes.
The next moment.
He saw crossbow arrows flying.
Thud thud thud!
Bodies were being pierced through.
Screams, wails, pleas for mercy, resounded through the night sky.
These sounds pierced into Lymes’ heart like sharp spikes.
His breath became increasingly hasty.
When the cruel massacre ended.
The ground lay scattered with hundreds of bodies, the soil stained red with blood.
Lymes’ kinsmen and friends were all shot dead in the pit.
Then, these Kingdom Knights raised swords that symbolized honor and integrity, delivering the final blow to these innocent human corpses.
Lymes’ soul body shook violently.
He spoke in a deranged tone, "This can’t be true, this can’t be true!"
"Grotar promised me he wouldn’t harm my kin."
"This can’t be true!"
The woman chuckled lightly, "Hehe..."
"Whether it’s true or not, you already have the answer in your heart, don’t you?"
"And, do you think this is all there is to it?" The hooded woman glanced at him with a sultry look, the seductive intent intensifying.
Lymes, on the brink of collapse, shivered all over upon hearing this.
His kin and friends were all killed, what else was Grotar planning?
The scene continued to play out.
At this time, Lymes saw two women.
Two young and beautiful women, one slightly innocent, the other a bit older, yet still showing her beautiful features.
Lymes recognized them, Ritana, Ali...
His wife and daughter.
However, at this moment, their faces bore tear stains, bodies naked, covered in bruises.
In the dim dungeon, terror exuded strongly from their eyes.
Then, a tall man appeared before them.
This man was Grotar.
Lymes’ heart wrenched, he reached out with his phantom-like fingers, desperately shouting, "No... no!"
In Grotar’s leering gaze, he subjected Lymes’ wife and daughter to countless humiliation and torment.
After an unknown period, unable to bear the disgrace, their spirits seemingly reached their limits.
In the endless darkness of the cellar, they took their own lives...

chapters.title: Chapter 115 - 102: Return! Undead Knight Order!
paragraphs: At this moment, Lymes’ eyes, like those of the undead, suddenly turned pitch black, as if he had seen the greatest despair in his life.
The soul fire kept flickering, seemingly about to dissipate.
The hooded woman beside him continued, "Lymes, do you see it?"
"The one you trusted is actually such a despicable person."
"He killed all your family members, even the newborns."
"Your wife and daughter were also toyed with to death by him. Now, do you still say he’s your most trusted partner, the hope that leads the Human Race to glory?"
Lymes, after hearing this, lifted his hollow eyes.
The soul fire on Lymes suddenly surged at this moment, soaring to the sky.
The sky over the entire kingdom seemed to darken at this moment.
The hooded woman’s eyes lit up, and she continued in that bewitching voice.
"Yes, Lymes, just like that."
"Look at yourself, with such a strong aura, which of the previous Knight Kings of the Human Race has reached your height?"
"Lymes, you possess the fate of a demigod. Actually, you are the Child of Destiny for the rise of the Human Race!"
"Grotar received the prophecy, so he recruited you when you were young. He used your fate to help him secure the title of Knight King."
"And you? What did you get?"
Lymes thought blankly,
"Yes? What about me?"
"I was betrayed by the person I trusted most, who killed all my family, and humiliated my wife and daughter to death!"
"And I can only become a wandering ghost, drifting in this world!"
Lymes felt as if a fury was devouring his heart.
Unchanging, changeable, trust, suspicion, reality, falseness!
At this moment, he deeply understood the ugliness in the depths of the human soul and felt disgusted by it!
He wanted to destroy this world!
Lymes suddenly raised his head, with an aura reaching for the sky, the Power of the Undead radiated across the entire plaza.
"Brothers who died unjustly, at this moment, in the name of the Azure Heaven Knight Order’s leader, I summon you again."
Buzz!
The cold wind howled, innumerable vengeful spirits roared in the air.
In the shocked eyes of Han Xing and others.
The phantoms of over three hundred souls of the Azure Heaven Knight Order, who perished with him, appeared all at once.
The Holy Light Knight Order, which had already disappeared in the long river of history, was actually reassembled at this moment.
However, they changed their identity and name.
The Undead Knight Order!
The ghastly green Power of the Undead shrouded the sky, appearing extraordinarily eerie in the supposedly holy Royal Capital.
The Royal Capital Knight Order was dispatched immediately, with thousands of knights charging into the Judgment Arena.
Meanwhile, the system prompt appeared.
[Knight Judgment Arena, Stage Two challenge task has been opened...]
"Note: This stage is a special challenge task, please survivors choose a camp and help them secure victory."
"1: Help Undead Knight Order (Lymes’ camp)"
"2: Help Royal Knight Order (Grotar’s camp)"
"Please make a choice within 30 seconds, failing to do so will be considered a forfeit, and you will be removed from the Cloud Secret Realm."
Another choice task!
Everyone was very surprised.
Han Xing knew that the upcoming choice must be very crucial.
"Brother Xing, who should we choose?" Cheng Jianyong asked gravely.
Han Xing was also thinking.
The current scene clearly appeared to be in Grotar’s favor.
The Royal City is Grotar’s main base, with tens of thousands of elite knights.
Compared to Lymes’ side, with merely three hundred undead knights, the strength gap was too vast.
If judged rationally, choosing to help the Royal Knight Order now would be a definite win.
By then, the rewards for clearing the Secret Realm should be more as well.
However.
Han Xing and others, having seen the cutscene, knew the story’s entirety.
If just for task rewards, choosing to help a despicable person like Grotar, Han Xing couldn’t bring himself to do it.
Such a guy is unworthy!
Han Xing lifted his head and said, "If I choose 1, to help the Undead Knight Order, does anyone have any objections?"
Everyone showed a smile of understanding.
"Alright, let’s choose 1, screw Lu’erta!"
"Screw Lu’erta!" Shen Yun was also full of enthusiasm.
Beside them, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, upon seeing Han Xing’s choice, their eyes revealed a look of approval and admiration.
As the saying goes.
I cannot tolerate heroes not being worshipped, nor can I tolerate villains occupying the high halls with dignity!
Han Xing unhesitatingly chose 1.
[You have made a choice, now, the Royal Knight Order will view you as an enemy and attack.]
"Please note, due to exceeding the Stage One challenge, the Secret Realm has made adjustments, and the Stage Two challenge is now set to the highest difficulty!"
Upon hearing the highest difficulty, everyone was briefly stunned.
However, before they could think further.
At this moment, among the Undead Knight Order, Lymes, riding a skeleton horse, unexpectedly turned to glance at Han Xing and the others, then nodded.
At this moment, Han Xing was stunned.
He remembered the giant dragon saying that this was just a scene from the past, everything here evolved from some rules, like fixed data.
But now, he actually saw an NPC inside nodding at him.

At this moment, Lymes spoke in that sharp voice like nails scraping glass: "Brothers of the Azure Heaven Knight Order, I am ashamed towards you, now, let’s pick up our weapons again and exterminate those despicable people!"
"Everyone, can you still fight?"
"Kill!"
"Kill!"
"Kill!"
The sky was filled with a murderous aura.
The Undead Knight Order stood before honest people, even in death, their murderous intent was sky-high!
At the same time, over three hundred knights each mounted an undead warhorse.
In the next moment, they charged into the ranks of the Kingdom Knight Order without hesitation.
The two knight orders immediately clashed fiercely.
Han Xing and his companions were also caught in the battle.
At that moment, an elite knight charged toward them.
"Traitors siding with the undead, die!" The knight launched a charge!
Han Xing shot an arrow, hitting the horse’s knee, causing the knight to fall off his mount.
Han Xing’s eyes lit up and he shouted, "Disable him!"
The next moment, Zhang Lianmeng and others unleashed various attacks on the knight.
Even a legendary creature like the Shadow Giant Dragon was trampled by them.
This Kingdom Knight, with only elite monster strength, was no match at all.
After a round of attacks, the elite knight died miserably under their concentrated fire.
A system notification appeared.
[Killed Kingdom Knight Ian (Elite Level), gained 30,000 experience points, and during the leaderboard period, gained an additional 30% experience.]
Everyone’s eyes lit up.
So much experience!
Defeating one elite monster compares to clearing a small Sky Island outside.
Zhang Lianmeng and her group had just advanced and reached level 11, their experience bars skyrocketing nearly 20%!
Even Han Xing, at level 12, gained nearly 10% experience.
A massive amount!
And this was just the experience reward from one elite monster.
How many more elite monsters were there on the battlefield now?
Han Xing scanned the area, and as part of the Kingdom’s Elite Knight Order, the proportion of elite monsters was over 50%, along with many leader-level knights.
Under normal circumstances, facing such a frightening number of elite monsters would mean instant annihilation.
However, now, the Undead Knight Order led by Lymes displayed terrifying strength, withstanding the pressure and even forcing the Kingdom Knights to retreat step by step!
At this moment, these Kingdom Knights looked like large experience bags in Han Xing and his group’s eyes!
"Brothers, charge!" Cheng Jianyong shouted, then charged into the battlefield first.
Yet in the next moment, he was flung back by a muscular brute wielding a Giant Hammer.
Landing on the ground, Cheng Jianyong spat out blood and, as if dazed, said, "Damn, there are leader-level monsters inside!"
Shen Yun quickly used Holy Light Healing on him and said helplessly, "Are you out of your mind running to the main battlefield to seek death?"
Cheng Jianyong, now recovered, felt guilty and didn’t dare retort even when Shen Yun scolded him.
Han Xing said, "Don’t stray from the team and don’t rush for quick successes. Right now, those Kingdom Knights are mostly focused on the Undead Knight Order."
"We only need to handle one or two knights at the edge of the battlefield."
The group nodded in agreement.
Five people and a wolf began to roam the battlefield edges.
They acted like guerrillas, targeting lone knights.
One by one, Kingdom Knights fell at their feet, turning into experience bags.
Their experience bars skyrocketed as if on a rocket.
Before long, Han Xing was the first to be enveloped in a beam of white light.
He reached level 13!
After completing the two-star transfer, Survivors require significantly more experience points to level up.
But correspondingly, the attribute increase per level is also substantial.
His Power increased by 4 points, and agility increased by 6 points.
Soon after Han Xing’s upgrade, Su Xiaoyang also reached level 11.
Then Coal Ball, Shen Yun, and Cheng Jianyong all reached level 12.
Zhang Lianmeng was used to this fast leveling pace having stayed with Han Xing for a while.
However, Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong had never experienced such rapid leveling and turned red with excitement.
"Damn! This feels amazing!"
"Just in these few minutes, this is almost equivalent to half a week’s worth of battle!"
"Incredible, at this pace, I can reach level 15 in a day!"
By this time, they had taken out over forty Kingdom Knights.
About twenty were regular knights, and the rest were elites.
Han Xing’s squad’s rampant slaughter had also caught the attention of the Kingdom Knight Order’s main battlefield.
At that moment, a brawny man riding a bull-like creature was charging towards them.
Han Xing saw this person’s attributes.
[Ockma: (Royal Knight Order Squad Leader, Two-star Leader Level).]
[Level]: lv15
[Attributes]: Power 310, agility 264, Spirit 250, Constitution 297.
Skills:
[Rock Shattering Strike]: The knight raises his giant hammer, delivering a heavy hit to the enemy with a 50% chance to cause them dizziness.
[Hammer of Thunder]: The knight summons the Power of Thunder, dealing area damage to enemies.
[Judgement Hammer]: Gathers the power of holy light to inflict a wide-range light attribute damage in front, with a 50% chance to reduce the enemy’s magic damage resistance by 20%.
Very strong attributes.
Moreover, everyone noticed.
Behind the leader-level attributes, there was unexpectedly another attribute panel.

chapters.title: Chapter 116 - 103: Soaring Levels!
paragraphs: Behind the leader level attribute, there is actually another attribute panel.
[Wild Horned Ox (Two-Star Elite Level Creature)]
[Level]: lv15
[Attributes]: Power 287, agility 247, Spirit 202, Constitution 253.
[Skills]: Wild Bull Charge, Trample, Earth-Splitting Strike.
Another knight of leader level, accompanied by a mount of elite monster level.
One man and one ox, this combination can be said to be quite formidable.
If it were usual times, facing such a powerful enemy, everyone would indeed feel a chill in their hearts.
But compared to the Shadow Giant Dragon, which is also leader level, this Ockma not only has inferior attributes but also possesses skills that are not on the same level at all.
Everyone has even dealt with creatures like the Shadow Giant Dragon, so how could they fear a mere human knight now!
It was still Han Xing who initiated the attack, followed closely by Su Xiaoyang’s arrow.
Thud! Thud!
The powerful equipment attributes brought unparalleled Attack Power,
directly penetrating the iron armor of the horned ox, deeply embedded into its flesh.
At this moment, Knight Captain Ockma raised the Holy Hammer high, and strands of Power of Thunder gathered in his hammer.
Coal Ball rushed over in an instant.
Swish! Swish!
Void Spike burst forth.
One of the spikes shot straight toward the face of the Knight Captain.
The damage of Void Spike is extremely formidable,
Ockma clearly felt the terror of this spike and had no choice but to interrupt the skill’s release, choosing to block Coal Ball’s Attack.
At this moment, the horned ox below glared with red eyes and charged fiercely at the group, sparks almost flying from its hooves.
This was precisely the elite monster’s skill, Wild Bull Charge.
If they couldn’t block it, the formation would be scattered by the horned ox.
And at this moment, Shen Yun suddenly shouted, holding a Golden Shield in front of the Wild Horned Ox.
Bang!
After a solid impact, Shen Yun staggered back more than a dozen steps.
Without the Legendary Effect, Shen Yun’s Power was not as great as the horned ox, so naturally, he was knocked flying.
However, he successfully interrupted the horned ox’s charge.
At that moment, Zhang Lianmeng’s Magma Eruption was completed.
"Flames, unleash your Anger!"
A hot magma suddenly surged from the belly of the horned ox and then exploded violently.
Boom!
This attack almost toppled the Knight Leader on its back.
At this time, the Knight Leader was busy blocking Coal Ball’s attack, with no time for anything else.
Han Xing and Su Xiaoyang also began to continue their output, with each arrow seriously injuring the horned ox.
The Knight Leader, furious, shouted, "Damn it, you traitors of the Holy Light! The God of Light will punish you!"
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong sneaked up behind him, then jumped high.
A sudden burst of killing intent followed by an Eagle Fall Slash.
With a swift motion, the Knight Leader had no time to react and was struck heavily from behind by Cheng Jianyong.
The Knight Leader cried out in pain and fell off the back of the horned ox.
"Haha, it seems your God of Light isn’t much use, is he?" Cheng Jianyong mocked arrogantly.
The fall of the knight was equivalent to losing half the combat strength.
Only Shen Yun was needed to hold off the elite-level horned ox.
As for Han Xing and the others, they began to bully the fallen enemy.
All kinds of Skills were fired one after another.
In the unwilling gaze of the Knight Leader, Han Xing shot an arrow that burst his head, triggering a system notification.
[Successfully killed Kingdom Knight Ockma (Two-Star Leader Creature), gaining 120,000 Experience Value,]
"Whoa, so much experience!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
Killing a Leader directly boosted everyone’s experience bar by a significant portion again.
As they took down this Leader Monster, they finally attracted the attention of the Royal Knight Order.
"Damn, they killed Ockma!"
"These traitors of the God of Light, send a squad to take them down!"
As the words fell, a commotion arose within the knight squad.
In the next moment.
A knight squad of more than thirty people charged towards Han Xing and his group, led by a Knight Leader.
Han Xing glanced at their Levels.
[Kingdom Knight Gene (Two-Star Ordinary Creature)]
[Kingdom Knight Zalhab (Two-Star Elite Creature)]
[Kingdom Knight Captain Corey (Two-Star Leader Creature)]
All over thirty knights were Level 15, with more than half being of elite level, and even the ordinary knights had Attributes not much worse than the elite creatures.
Han Xing knew that as the kingdom’s most elite knights, their Levels couldn’t be this low.
But because they were now in the Secret Realm, everything here evolved by certain rules, reducing the power of these knights.
At this moment, seeing the knights charging at them.
Han Xing suddenly asked, "Shen Yun, has the Legendary Effect’s cooldown time ended?"
Shen Yun glanced back and replied, "Yes, Brother Xing, what do you need me to do?"
Han Xing looked at the knights, his gaze serious, "I have an important task for you. Later, go hold this group of knights for me, delay them for a while, I need to prepare a skill."
"During this period, try to gather them together. This task is very dangerous, and if you’re not confident, you can refuse, and we’ll think of another way."
To single-handedly hold off more than thirty knights, with many elites and a Leader Monster among them.
This difficulty was not small, and it was very dangerous.
Shen Yun did not speak but raised his shield and charged forward without hesitation.
He believed in Han Xing, as this was their understanding garnered over many years together.
The Knight Leader, seeing Shen Yun charging alone, had a contemptuous look on his face.

[Wild Horned Ox (Two-Star Elite Level Creature)]
[Level]: lv15
[Attributes]: Power 287, agility 247, Spirit 202, Constitution 253.
[Skills]: Wild Bull Charge, Trample, Earth-Splitting Strike.
Another knight of leader level, accompanied by a mount of elite monster level.
One man and one ox, this combination can be said to be quite formidable.
If it were usual times, facing such a powerful enemy, everyone would indeed feel a chill in their hearts.
But compared to the Shadow Giant Dragon, which is also leader level, this Ockma not only has inferior attributes but also possesses skills that are not on the same level at all.
Everyone has even dealt with creatures like the Shadow Giant Dragon, so how could they fear a mere human knight now!
It was still Han Xing who initiated the attack, followed closely by Su Xiaoyang’s arrow.
Thud!
Thud!
The powerful equipment attributes brought unparalleled Attack Power,
directly penetrating the iron armor of the horned ox, deeply embedded into its flesh.
At this moment, Knight Captain Ockma raised the Holy Hammer high, and strands of Power of Thunder gathered in his hammer.
Coal Ball rushed over in an instant.
Swish!
Swish!
Void Spike burst forth.
One of the spikes shot straight toward the face of the Knight Captain.
The damage of Void Spike is extremely formidable,
Ockma clearly felt the terror of this spike and had no choice but to interrupt the skill’s release, choosing to block Coal Ball’s Attack.
At this moment, the horned ox below glared with red eyes and charged fiercely at the group, sparks almost flying from its hooves.
This was precisely the elite monster’s skill, Wild Bull Charge.
If they couldn’t block it, the formation would be scattered by the horned ox.
And at this moment, Shen Yun suddenly shouted, holding a Golden Shield in front of the Wild Horned Ox.
Bang!
After a solid impact, Shen Yun staggered back more than a dozen steps.
Without the Legendary Effect, Shen Yun’s Power was not as great as the horned ox, so naturally, he was knocked flying.
However, he successfully interrupted the horned ox’s charge.
At that moment, Zhang Lianmeng’s Magma Eruption was completed.
"Flames, unleash your Anger!"
A hot magma suddenly surged from the belly of the horned ox and then exploded violently.
Boom!
This attack almost toppled the Knight Leader on its back.
At this time, the Knight Leader was busy blocking Coal Ball’s attack, with no time for anything else.
Han Xing and Su Xiaoyang also began to continue their output, with each arrow seriously injuring the horned ox.
The Knight Leader, furious, shouted, "Damn it, you traitors of the Holy Light!
The God of Light will punish you!"
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong sneaked up behind him, then jumped high.
A sudden burst of killing intent followed by an Eagle Fall Slash.
With a swift motion, the Knight Leader had no time to react and was struck heavily from behind by Cheng Jianyong.
The Knight Leader cried out in pain and fell off the back of the horned ox.
"Haha, it seems your God of Light isn’t much use, is he?" Cheng Jianyong mocked arrogantly.
The fall of the knight was equivalent to losing half the combat strength.
Only Shen Yun was needed to hold off the elite-level horned ox.
As for Han Xing and the others, they began to bully the fallen enemy.
All kinds of Skills were fired one after another.
In the unwilling gaze of the Knight Leader, Han Xing shot an arrow that burst his head, triggering a system notification.
[Successfully killed Kingdom Knight Ockma (Two-Star Leader Creature), gaining 120,000 Experience Value,]
"Whoa, so much experience!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
Killing a Leader directly boosted everyone’s experience bar by a significant portion again.
As they took down this Leader Monster, they finally attracted the attention of the Royal Knight Order.
"Damn, they killed Ockma!"
"These traitors of the God of Light, send a squad to take them down!"
As the words fell, a commotion arose within the knight squad.
In the next moment.
A knight squad of more than thirty people charged towards Han Xing and his group, led by a Knight Leader.
Han Xing glanced at their Levels.

[Kingdom Knight Zalhab (Two-Star Elite Creature)]

chapters.title: Chapter 117 - 103: Soaring Level! (Part 2)
paragraphs: The Knight Leader sneered, "Overreaching fool!"
A war axe was raised high and then struck down fiercely onto Shen Yun’s shield!
Bang!
A loud explosion sounded, yet Shen Yun did not budge an inch!
The contempt on the Knight Leader’s face turned to surprise, and the other knights were momentarily stunned.
Shen Yun chuckled, "Grandsons, with that strength, you’re just scratching an itch for your grandpa?"
The knights, enraged, attacked Shen Yun in unison.
At this moment, Han Xing swiftly instructed, "Cheng Jianyong, Xiaoyang, go help Shen Yun, Lian’Er, join me to charge up a group magic attack."
Zhang Lianmeng immediately began summoning her one and only group magic skill after advancing as an Elemental Mage.
[Hurricane Cutting]: Release several hurricanes in a 5m*5m area in front, creatures within the attack range will receive magic damage equal to Spirit*1.5 per second, effect lasts for three seconds.
Whoosh—whoosh—
Hurricanes swept through, disrupting the knights’ formation.
Su Xiaoyang and Cheng Jianyong also started to attack, halting the knights’ advance.
At this point, Han Xing suddenly shot an arrow into the sky.
This skill was a group attack skill Han Xing learned after changing his class to Wild Ranger?

[Fallen Star Arrow Rain]: Draw upon the Power of Stars to inflict area damage on enemies in the area of Agility*0.2 meters in front, each meteor can deal 150% damage, each point of Agility summons one meteor.
Skill cooldown: 30 minutes.
The next moment, the Royal Knight Order all looked up, their eyes puzzled.
"Meteors?"
Indeed, hundreds of meteors appeared in the sky, instantly sparkling with starlight.
And these meteors were rushing straight toward them.
Among these meteors, the kingdom knights sensed a deadly sense of crisis!
However, it was already impossible to evade!
Rumble!
Han Xing’s current Agility was as high as 148 points, meaning he could summon 148 meteors, each dealing 150% of Attack Power damage.
In that instant, nearly every knight was hit by the meteors summoned by the Fallen Star Arrow Rain, causing severe damage.
Moreover, Zhang Lianmeng’s Hurricane Blade was also wreaking havoc.
The scene became incredibly chaotic.
When the explosion stopped, over a dozen knight corpses lay strewn about the ground.
And Han Xing’s notification panel was flooded with kill messages.
[Killed Kingdom Knight Merrick, gained 7500 Experience Value...]
[Killed Kingdom Knight Sog (Two-star Elite Level), gained 30000 Experience Value...]
[Killed Kingdom Knight Safire (Two-star Elite Level), gained 30000 Experience Value...]
With this wave, white light simultaneously rose from Han Xing, Zhang Lianmeng, and Su Xiaoyang.
Just after Han Xing had leveled up to 13, he once again soared to level 14!
"Damn! Damn! Brother Xing, what skill is this? So powerful!" Cheng Jianyong shouted.
Joy spread on everyone’s faces, they had never experienced such rocket-like leveling speed before.
The Fallen Star Arrow Rain, as a group attack skill, was incredibly satisfying for clearing the field!
Even Han Xing was astonished by this terrifying leveling speed.
However, although this skill was powerful, its cooldown time was relatively long.
A half-hour cooldown, which meant this skill could only be used during bursts.
At this moment, only one Knight Leader and a dozen injured Kingdom Knights remained on the field.
During the recent group attack, the Knight Leader’s mount was killed, so he had to fight on the ground like the other knights.
The pressure on everyone decreased drastically.
The Knight Leader gritted his teeth and said, "You damn traitors of the kingdom have already committed an unforgivable sin. The God of Light will punish you!"
"Attack!" Han Xing ignored the threat of the Knight Leader.
Maintaining the principle of taking advantage of the sick, claiming the life.
Han Xing decided to ride the wave of victory and wipe out this knight squad.
Everyone responded immediately, beginning to beat the dogs that have fallen into the water!
Skills were used one after another.
Counterattack Spike!
Eagle Fall Slash!
Lightning Chain!
Multi-Shot!
All kinds of skills targeted the Kingdom Knights.
Thud thud thud.
Kill messages began to flood the screen again.
After several rounds of attacks, only the last Knight Leader remained, barely holding on.
At this point, this Knight Leader was extremely battered.
He sensed he might fall here and said, "You... you guys, so many attacking me, what kind of hero does that make you?"
"If you have what it takes, duel me one-on-one, a showdown between knights!"
Han Xing glanced at him.
"Idiot."
Han Xing didn’t give a damn about his knightly spirit and started a righteous gang beating.
At this moment, Han Xing seized the opportunity and shot an arrow.
The heavily wounded Knight Leader’s reaction speed had massively decreased, and he watched helplessly as the arrow approached him, unable to react in time.
Thud!
The arrow pierced into his heart, headshot!
The Knight Leader’s body stiffened, then collapsed weakly.
The system prompt arrived.
[Successfully killed Kingdom Knight Captain Corey (Two-star Leader), gained 120000 Experience Value]
Han Xing and his team’s strength seemed to have surpassed the expectations of the Undead Knight Order and the Kingdom Knights.
The Kingdom Knights had dispatched an entire knight squad, yet not only did they fail to take them down, they were entirely wiped out.
Even for the kingdom, which has tens of thousands of elite knights, such a loss is no small matter.
Their actions finally angered the Royal Knight Order.
"You bunch of lowly bastards, daring to strike at the noble knights!"
A roar filled with rage resounded, echoing throughout the Knight Judgment Arena.
The moment they heard this voice, a dark shadow loomed over the hearts of Han Xing and the others.
At this moment, it felt as if they were being watched by a jungle’s king beast.
"Kevin, our fight isn’t over yet, you can’t go!" Lymes’ grim voice echoed.
"Get out of the way!" a roar came!
Bang!
After a loud boom, a figure leaped high, jumping out of the center of the battle, heading straight for Han Xing and his team.
At that moment, Han Xing and the others saw the source of the voice.
It was a burly figure, standing over 2.5 meters tall, a muscle-bound monster like a giant.
He only wore simple armor, with a mane-like wild hairstyle, exposing rugged muscles on the outside, holding a great sword wide like a door panel, over two meters in total length.
This appearance alone gave off an intense sense of oppression.
A window displaying this monster’s attributes appeared before everyone.
[Kingdom Knight Order, Captain Kevin (Two-star Lord Level)]
[Level]: lv15
[Attributes]: Strength 457, Agility 383, Spirit 396, Constitution 478.
Skills:
[Rage]: In combat, sacrifice 50% of Defense Value, increase Strength by 30%.
[Destruction]: When attacking, 30% chance to deal 200% damage.
[Anger]: Release rage within, causing a Strength*1.3 damage to all enemies within a five-meter radius,
[Power of Shattering]: Compress power inside the body and concentrate it in the hand, when detonated, it causes 500% explosive damage to the target.

[Power Domain (Lord Creatures Exclusive Domain Skill)]: When entering combat, create a Power Domain around oneself, suppressing creatures with a lower Strength Attribute than oneself, reducing their Strength Attribute by 50% and guaranteeing to knock enemies away on attack!
[Talent]: Beast King’s Body, C-level.

Talent description: Since childhood, Kevin possessed an extraordinary physique, born with great strength. At just three years old, he kicked the lion statue at the royal city gate, drawing the attention of the Knight King, later examined by the Kingdom’s high priest, unveiling the Beast King bloodline within Kevin. This bloodline grants a physique far surpassing ordinary humans, even a slight chance to break through as Legendary Creatures.
Upon seeing this knight panel, everyone fell silent.
Lords are stronger than Leaders, more formidable creatures.
It was the first time for everyone, including Han Xing, facing such a powerful creature head-on.
The Light Attribute panel, this Kevin even eclipsed that Legendary Creature, Shadow Giant Dragon.
That Lord’s exclusive skill, Power Domain, directly reduced everyone’s Strength Attribute by 50%.
This trait effectively rendered all three physical roles on the field useless.
This guy is truly terrifying to the extreme!
