chapters.title: Chapter 118 - 104: Su Xiaoyang’s Rage!
paragraphs: The first time facing a Lord-level monster brought immense pressure to everyone.
Han Xing’s face also turned very grim at this moment.
All of his bottom cards had been used during the confrontation with the Shadow Giant Dragon.
This included Coal Ball’s Void Frenzy and Han Xing’s own Legendary Skill, Broken Moon.
Now, they could be said to have no means left to restrain the Lord.
However, at this moment, that terrifying Knight Captain, the Lord-level monster, was already wielding a nearly two-meter-long broadsword, slashing toward everyone.
Shen Yun gritted his teeth and continued to rush forward, hoping to intercept the Lord’s attack.
However, the Knight Captain merely cast him a glance, and then the broadsword swung.
Whoosh!
The terrifying power carried a strong gust of wind.
Even before being hit, Shen Yun felt his body becoming unsteady.
The next moment, the door-width broadsword had already met Shen Yun’s Gold Shield.
Bang!
Shen Yun only felt an unimaginable force on the shield, sending him flying backward.
Shen Yun’s eyes were in a daze as he was mid-air, and he couldn’t help but think.
"Is this really a power that humans can possess?"
If a normal human’s power value is between 3~6, then now, this Knight Captain, with power exceeding four hundred, was equivalent to nearly a hundred times that of a normal human!
Upon landing, Shen Yun suddenly spat out a mouthful of blood.
He didn’t have time to heal his injuries and hurriedly shouted, "Brother Xing, run! This guy is too terrifying, we can’t beat him!"
Even when facing the Shadow Giant Dragon, Shen Yun had never said such words.
This showed how much of a psychological shadow the recent confrontation had cast on him.
Han Xing and the others also realized something was wrong.
"Retreat!" Han Xing shouted.
Hearing this, everyone immediately abandoned the thought of fighting.
However, the giant-like sturdy Knight Captain snorted, exuding a domineering aura over all beings.
"A bunch of insects, do you think you can run?"
The next moment, the giant’s figure vanished.
Cheng Jianyong had just run ten or so meters when he felt a shadow appear behind him.
"So fast..."
The group couldn’t imagine how this disproportionately hulking figure could possess such terrifying movement speed.
With an Agility Attribute as high as 380, the Knight Captain also crushed everyone in speed.
Bang!
The broadsword smacked down.
Cheng Jianyong was also swatted away with a single sword strike, thrown over ten meters away, unconscious.
Upon witnessing this scene, Han Xing’s eyes immediately turned red.
"Damn it!"
After dealing with Cheng Jianyong, the Knight Captain once more glanced at the remaining three.
This time, he set his sights on the nearest Su Xiaoyang.
Whoosh——
The Knight Captain’s figure disappeared.
Han Xing saw the giant figure appear behind Su Xiaoyang.
The Knight Captain’s cold eyes were filled with murderous intent, broadsword raised high, ready to slash down.
With Su Xiaoyang’s fragile frame, if she got hit, she might be directly killed in an instant!
This is not a game; if one dies, it’s true death.
Without time to think, Han Xing directly activated the ’Wild Instinct’ Skill.
His Agility already being at 148 points, with his movement speed skyrocketing fivefold, even this Knight Captain couldn’t catch up with him.
In this critical moment.
Han Xing fiercely tackled Su Xiaoyang to the ground.
Rumble!
The Knight Captain’s slashing missed, causing a violent explosion on the ground.
However, being a battle-hardened Royal Knight, his combat awareness couldn’t be like those senseless wild monsters.
After the broadsword missed, he realized the speed this human had just burst out with posed a bit of a threat to him.
Thus, he followed through with a horizontal sweep, fiercely striking Han Xing’s back.
Han Xing’s back felt like it was hit by a speeding truck.
He even heard the sound of his spine fracturing, the agony making cold sweat pour out profusely.
The next moment, both Han Xing and Su Xiaoyang were knocked away, rolling on the ground several times together.
At this point, Su Xiaoyang was still in a bewildered state, being held in Han Xing’s arms, her pretty face turned bright red.
However, before she could react, Han Xing suddenly turned pale, spitting out a mouthful of blood.
Su Xiaoyang was stunned, trembling as she supported Han Xing’s shoulder, asking, "Han... Han Xing, what’s wrong?"
However, Han Xing didn’t speak.
That recent strike left Han Xing so injured that he couldn’t even muster the strength to speak, his consciousness growing increasingly fuzzy.
She felt Han Xing’s aura gradually weakening.
When Han Xing lost consciousness, Su Xiaoyang was utterly shocked!
She looked incredulously at the man in her arms, mumbling, "Han... Han Xing!"
At this moment, Su Xiaoyang only felt her heart wrench sharply.
Confusion, fear, guilt, anger!
Su Xiaoyang felt a surge of rage rush to her head.
At this moment, she lifted her beautiful yet strangely eerie face, eyes turning completely blood red.
A savage, violent, bloodthirsty aura abruptly burst from Su Xiaoyang’s body.
"Heh... daring to harm my friend..."
"Disgusting bug... you made me angry!"
At this point, the Knight Captain, having knocked Han Xing away, was about to move against the last one, Zhang Lianmeng.
However, the next moment.
He saw a graceful shadow flicker before him.
A pair of bright red eyes flashed past.
At the moment their gazes met, the Knight Captain felt an intense madness, a gaze as cold as ice, locking onto him tightly.
The chill in that woman’s eyes was such that he felt goosebumps rise on his skin.
However, his rich combat experience allowed the Lord Knight to quickly regain his composure.
Instinctively, he swung his sword out.
Bang!
The greatsword capable of sending Shen Yun flying suddenly halted in mid-air.
He saw that the frail woman before him extended her delicate hand and clutched his broadsword.
Kevin only felt his weapon being pinched by a tremendous force, no matter how hard he tried, it did not move an inch.
"What is going on?"
The Knight Captain’s eyes showed a trace of bewilderment.
He couldn’t imagine being overpowered, especially by a frail woman.
Yet, this dreamy scene was unfolding for real.
At this moment, an eerie smile appeared on Su Xiaoyang’s absolutely beautiful face.
In a soft voice, she asked, "Do you know...what is the most delightful sound in the world?"
The Knight Captain was suddenly startled.
He snapped to attention, activating his Rage state!
"Stop pretending! Take my Power of Shattering!"
The Knight Lord shouted explosively, an invisible gas forming in his hand, its fearsome power brewing within.
With two consecutive Burst Skills, even Shen Yun, who had activated Unyielding Will, would be instantly killed if caught by this attack.
However, at that moment.
A pair of smooth, delicate human palms, like venomous snakes, climbed onto his arm.
The Knight Captain only felt a massive force arriving at his wrist.
Su Xiaoyang emitted a bizarre laugh once again.
"That would be...the sound of bones breaking one by one!
Crack!
With a crisp sound of bone breaking, Kevin was horrified to see his arm, as thick as a leg, forcibly twisted back in a strange angle, bending backwards.
"Roar!!"
The massive pain from the bone fracture caused this giant-like man to let out a heart-wrenching scream.
However, this was only the beginning.
After breaking his right hand, Su Xiaoyang continued with a mad grin.
"Damn!" The Knight Captain just wanted to resist.
The next moment, Su Xiaoyang’s delicate fingers somehow clamped onto his left wrist again.
Crack!
Another crisp sound of bone breaking resounded.
The Knight Captain looked at his arms twisted to bizarre angles, terror in his expression.
The excruciating pain made cold sweat drip down his forehead.
Su Xiaoyang’s actions did not stop.
In the next moment.
Su Xiaoyang viciously kicked him at the knee.
Crack! Crack!
Two consecutive bone-breaking sounds followed, crippling the Knight Captain’s legs.
Kevin collapsed to the ground, unable to hold back a wretched scream.
With his limbs crippled, the Knight Captain was like a declawed tiger, considerably reduced in threat.
"Damn it, who on earth are you!"
"How can a weak human have such terrifying strength?"
Yet, Su Xiaoyang did not answer him but instead said with a morbid smile, "Ah... this sound is truly intoxicating."
"No matter how precious the instrument in the world, it cannot make such wonderful music, don’t you think?"
The Knight Captain looked at Su Xiaoyang’s smile, a shiver running down his spine.
"You lunatic!"

Su Xiaoyang’s crimson eyes turned, seemingly thinking of something, she chuckled lightly, "You know, Lord Knight, the human body has 206 bones, at the rate of me breaking one per second, that’s about three and a half minutes, just the length of a song, hehe..."
The Knight Captain’s body trembled.
"Lord Knight, let’s play a game..."
The Knight Captain was no longer calm, threateningly said, "I don’t want to play any games with you, let me go, or you’ll face the pursuit of the Royal Knight Order, tens of thousands of knights!"
Upon hearing this, Su Xiaoyang chuckled lightly.
The next moment, she grabbed the Knight Captain’s hair with one hand, slamming his head to the ground with a fearful gaze.
Bang!
The Knight Captain’s face hit the ground with a loud thud.
The ground cracked like a spider web.
"Ah! Damn you!"
Su Xiaoyang ignored the Knight Captain’s cries and said to herself, "The game we’re about to play might be a bit painful, but you have to bear it, don’t scream too loudly."
The Knight Captain suddenly felt a foreboding sense.
Su Xiaoyang softly said, "This game, it’s called finger-breaking..."
Lanzhi gently lifted the Knight Captain’s sturdy finger.
Crack!
With a crisp sound of bone breaking, the Knight Captain was horrified to see his middle finger twisted at a strange angle, bending onto the back of his hand.
Connected to the heart by the fingers, the severe pain made him let out a beast-like wail.
This scream echoed across the entire square, sending chills down everyone’s spine.
All knights couldn’t help but turn their gaze to the area where Han Xing and others were.
In the next moment, they witnessed a scene they would never forget!

sentences.text: The first time facing a Lord-level monster brought immense pressure to everyone.
Han Xing’s face also turned very grim at this moment.
All of his bottom cards had been used during the confrontation with the Shadow Giant Dragon.
This included Coal Ball’s Void Frenzy and Han Xing’s own Legendary Skill, Broken Moon.
Now, they could be said to have no means left to restrain the Lord.
However, at this moment, that terrifying Knight Captain, the Lord-level monster, was already wielding a nearly two-meter-long broadsword, slashing toward everyone.
Shen Yun gritted his teeth and continued to rush forward, hoping to intercept the Lord’s attack.
However, the Knight Captain merely cast him a glance, and then the broadsword swung.
Whoosh!
The terrifying power carried a strong gust of wind.
Even before being hit, Shen Yun felt his body becoming unsteady.
The next moment, the door-width broadsword had already met Shen Yun’s Gold Shield.
Bang!
Shen Yun only felt an unimaginable force on the shield, sending him flying backward.
Shen Yun’s eyes were in a daze as he was mid-air, and he couldn’t help but think.
"Is this really a power that humans can possess?"
If a normal human’s power value is between 3~6, then now, this Knight Captain, with power exceeding four hundred, was equivalent to nearly a hundred times that of a normal human!
Upon landing, Shen Yun suddenly spat out a mouthful of blood.
He didn’t have time to heal his injuries and hurriedly shouted, "Brother Xing, run!
This guy is too terrifying, we can’t beat him!"
Even when facing the Shadow Giant Dragon, Shen Yun had never said such words.
This showed how much of a psychological shadow the recent confrontation had cast on him.
Han Xing and the others also realized something was wrong.
"Retreat!" Han Xing shouted.
Hearing this, everyone immediately abandoned the thought of fighting.
However, the giant-like sturdy Knight Captain snorted, exuding a domineering aura over all beings.
"A bunch of insects, do you think you can run?"
The next moment, the giant’s figure vanished.
Cheng Jianyong had just run ten or so meters when he felt a shadow appear behind him.
"So fast..."
The group couldn’t imagine how this disproportionately hulking figure could possess such terrifying movement speed.
With an Agility Attribute as high as 380, the Knight Captain also crushed everyone in speed.
Bang!
The broadsword smacked down.
Cheng Jianyong was also swatted away with a single sword strike, thrown over ten meters away, unconscious.
Upon witnessing this scene, Han Xing’s eyes immediately turned red.
"Damn it!"
After dealing with Cheng Jianyong, the Knight Captain once more glanced at the remaining three.
This time, he set his sights on the nearest Su Xiaoyang.
Whoosh——
The Knight Captain’s figure disappeared.
Han Xing saw the giant figure appear behind Su Xiaoyang.
The Knight Captain’s cold eyes were filled with murderous intent, broadsword raised high, ready to slash down.
With Su Xiaoyang’s fragile frame, if she got hit, she might be directly killed in an instant!
This is not a game; if one dies, it’s true death.
Without time to think, Han Xing directly activated the ’Wild Instinct’ Skill.
His Agility already being at 148 points, with his movement speed skyrocketing fivefold, even this Knight Captain couldn’t catch up with him.
In this critical moment.
Han Xing fiercely tackled Su Xiaoyang to the ground.
Rumble!
The Knight Captain’s slashing missed, causing a violent explosion on the ground.
However, being a battle-hardened Royal Knight, his combat awareness couldn’t be like those senseless wild monsters.
After the broadsword missed, he realized the speed this human had just burst out with posed a bit of a threat to him.
Thus, he followed through with a horizontal sweep, fiercely striking Han Xing’s back.
Han Xing’s back felt like it was hit by a speeding truck.
He even heard the sound of his spine fracturing, the agony making cold sweat pour out profusely.
The next moment, both Han Xing and Su Xiaoyang were knocked away, rolling on the ground several times together.
At this point, Su Xiaoyang was still in a bewildered state, being held in Han Xing’s arms, her pretty face turned bright red.
However, before she could react, Han Xing suddenly turned pale, spitting out a mouthful of blood.
Su Xiaoyang was stunned, trembling as she supported Han Xing’s shoulder, asking, "Han...
Han Xing, what’s wrong?"
However, Han Xing didn’t speak.
That recent strike left Han Xing so injured that he couldn’t even muster the strength to speak, his consciousness growing increasingly fuzzy.
She felt Han Xing’s aura gradually weakening.
When Han Xing lost consciousness, Su Xiaoyang was utterly shocked!
She looked incredulously at the man in her arms, mumbling, "Han...
Han Xing!"
At this moment, Su Xiaoyang only felt her heart wrench sharply.
Confusion, fear, guilt, anger!
Su Xiaoyang felt a surge of rage rush to her head.
At this moment, she lifted her beautiful yet strangely eerie face, eyes turning completely blood red.
A savage, violent, bloodthirsty aura abruptly burst from Su Xiaoyang’s body.
"Heh... daring to harm my friend..."
"Disgusting bug... you made me angry!"
At this point, the Knight Captain, having knocked Han Xing away, was about to move against the last one, Zhang Lianmeng.
However, the next moment.
He saw a graceful shadow flicker before him.
A pair of bright red eyes flashed past.
At the moment their gazes met, the Knight Captain felt an intense madness, a gaze as cold as ice, locking onto him tightly.
The chill in that woman’s eyes was such that he felt goosebumps rise on his skin.
However, his rich combat experience allowed the Lord Knight to quickly regain his composure.
Instinctively, he swung his sword out.
Bang!
The greatsword capable of sending Shen Yun flying suddenly halted in mid-air.
He saw that the frail woman before him extended her delicate hand and clutched his broadsword.

chapters.title: Chapter 119 - 105: Slaying the Lord
paragraphs: The Knight Captain who could single-handedly crush an army was now lying on the ground like a dead dog.
A frail-looking woman was standing on his back, viciously torturing the Knight Captain.
Crack! Crack! Crack!
One finger after another was broken, and Su Xiaoyang’s expression grew increasingly delightful.
A furious voice suddenly resonated from within the Royal Knight Order, "Damn it, save Kevin!"
However, at this moment, Lymes’ soul power suddenly surged, and a mournful green aura swept towards the Royal Knight Order.
Now, they could no longer support Kevin.
At this moment, Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong slowly rose from the ground.
They had just been attacked by a Lord Knight, causing them to fall into a brief unconsciousness.
Now that they regained consciousness, Cheng Jianyong quickly poured a bottle of Life Secret Elixir for himself, while Shen Yun guzzled a sip of the elixir.
Meanwhile, Zhang Lianmeng had already helped Han Xing up, crying like pear blossoms drenched in rain.
"Sob sob sob... Brother Xing, don’t scare me..."
"I finally found someone I can rely on, don’t leave Lian’Er..."
At this moment, Shen Yun hurried over, and upon seeing Han Xing’s condition, quickly cast a Holy Light Healing on him!
Shen Yun then said, "Sister Lian, don’t panic, Brother Xing is just unconscious."
Shen Yun’s Spiritual Power was high, and the healing technique worked wonders.
Moments later, Han Xing’s finger twitched.
Then, his consciousness gradually returned.
When Han Xing opened his eyes, Zhang Lianmeng was overwhelmed with joy and hugged him tightly.
Han Xing looked blankly at the scene before him and asked, "What... what’s going on now?"
The two did not answer, but instead pointed towards Su Xiaoyang’s area.
Seeing this scene, Han Xing’s pupils contracted suddenly.
At this moment, Su Xiaoyang had already broken all ten of the Knight Captain’s fingers.
She was now working on the Knight Captain’s shoulder bones.
Su Xiaoyang kicked with her foot.
Crack!
The clear sound of shattering, along with the Knight Captain’s weak wailing, sent a chill down Han Xing’s spine.
He pointed forward, his voice trembling, "This... this... is this Su Xiaoyang!?"
Shen Yun and Zhang Lianmeng were equally bewildered.
Next to them, Cheng Jianyong had long been dumbfounded.
He never would have thought that the frail Su Xiaoyang would have such a cruel side.
At this moment, Han Xing glanced at Su Xiaoyang’s status panel.
[Survivor]: Su Xiaoyang
[Profession]: Elf Shooter
[Level]: 13
[Attributes]: Power: ???, Agility 132, Spirit 104, Constitution: 114.
Han Xing noticed something was off with Su Xiaoyang’s current state.
Her Power Attribute had turned into question marks, meaning it exceeded their attributes too much to detect.
And at this moment, Su Xiaoyang seemed to have finished her little game, a satisfied smile appearing on her face.
The Knight Captain lying on the ground was in an extremely miserable state.
All ten of his fingers were broken, shoulder bones sunken, including his wrists and leg joints, twisted into grotesque positions.
This appearance would make anyone’s scalp tingle with just one glance.
At this moment, Su Xiaoyang slowly stood up, chuckling lightly, "Lord Knight, this was just the first round of the game.
"Next are the ribs, leg bones, and finally, your skull..."
"How about it, listening to your bones shattering one by one, isn’t it wonderful?"
However, the Knight Captain was already gasping for breath, unable to respond.
In the next moment, she lifted a beautiful leg, ready to stomp on the Knight Captain’s back.
Considering her state, if she had stomped down, several more bones would shatter.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun instinctively covered their eyes.
At that moment, Han Xing suddenly shouted, "Xiaoyang!"
Su Xiaoyang’s leg paused in mid-air.
Hearing Han Xing’s call, she turned her head, and upon seeing Han Xing stand up, the blood-red color in her pupils quickly vanished.
She exclaimed joyfully, "Brother Xing!"
"Great, you’re okay!"
Hearing Su Xiaoyang’s way of addressing him, Han Xing was a bit puzzled, but didn’t pay it much mind.
So he nodded, "Mm, I’m fine. Come here first."
Upon hearing this, Su Xiaoyang quickly ran over, no longer paying attention to the Knight Captain on the ground.
To avoid leaving him to recover, Han Xing decided to finish him off.
He drew several arrows and shot them, precisely hitting the Knight Captain’s head.
Thud thud!
Fine Iron Arrows penetrated into his skull, driving through to the abdominal cavity.
In the next moment, the already dying Knight Captain convulsed, then fell into a pool of blood.
A system notification appeared.
[Successfully killed Knight Captain Kevin (Two-star Lord-level Creature), gaining 480000 Experience Value]
[You are the first survivor in the server to kill a Lord-level Creature, receiving a first kill reward, Hunter’s Medal (Purple), Space Backpack Blueprint (Purple)]
Han Xing was taken aback for a moment; his original intention was just to finish off that Lord.
Unexpectedly, it seemed like he accidentally snatched a kill and even got the first-kill reward for the Lord?
At this moment, Han Xing’s eyes seemed peculiar.
No time to check the reward.
At this moment, Su Xiaoyang, full of joy, approached Han Xing. After confirming he was indeed fine, the redness in her eyes faded instantly.
The next moment, Su Xiaoyang’s body went limp, as if some force supporting her suddenly disappeared, and she collapsed.
Han Xing casually caught her, her soft body emanating a slight fragrance of a young girl as it fell into his arms.
However, Han Xing didn’t have any other thoughts. After confirming Su Xiaoyang had merely overexerted her physical strength, he breathed a sigh of relief.
Zhang Lianmeng, standing to the side, showed no change in expression, instead, looking on with some relief at this scene.
At this moment, Han Xing said, "Lian’Er, come over and support Xiaoyang."
"Okay, Brother Xing," Zhang Lianmeng responded joyfully, taking Su Xiaoyang from Han Xing’s arms.
Just then.
Over at the Royal Knight Order’s side, realizing Kevin’s death, they erupted into chaos again.
Suddenly, everyone heard an angry voice.
"Enough!"
This voice was very familiar; they knew who it belonged to.
The Knight King, Grotar.
"Lymes, you’re already dead. The dead should behave like the dead. Go back to your Netherworld."
Lymes, upon hearing this voice, felt hatred surge within him, causing his soul power to spike. In a voice almost chilling, he said, "Grotar, you vile creature, I will tear you to pieces!"
"Naive, do you think becoming undead gives you the qualifications to resist me? Lymes, have you forgotten what place this is?"
Lymes seemed to recall something, and in his deep pupils, his soul fire trembled.
At the same time, a strong Holy Light suddenly descended from the sky in the Judgment Arena, suppressing Lymes and the others.
This Holy Light seemed inherently effective against these undead creatures.
Under the Holy Light, the undead knights seemed as if they were in flames, each emitting painful wails.
In the instant of contact with the Holy Light, several undead knights had their soul bodies shattered, disappearing into the air.
"Damn it, you actually used the God of Light’s power!" Lymes shouted in anger.

Grotar still did not reveal himself, coldly snorting, "The God of Light is the deity of the Human Race’s beliefs. As the Leader of the Human Race, isn’t it natural for me to wield the God of Light’s power?"
During the brief conversation between the two, the Holy Light continued to burn.
Dozens more undead knights had their soul bodies shattered.
This meant the last traces of their existence in the world were also erased, disappearing forever.
As more and more companions disappeared.
Lymes desperately reached out a hand but could only barely maintain his soul body under the Holy Light.
The outcome of the battle seemed already determined.
Lymes said in a mixture of sorrow and anger, "God of Light, can’t you see, your followers are suffering due to a villain’s persecution, why are you helping him against us?"
However, Lymes’ plea received no response.
Gods do not concern themselves with undead, such lowly beings.
Lymes seemed to hear that man’s mocking laughter.
At this moment, he recalled the scene of his wife and daughter’s deaths, those despairing and hollow eyes, their bodies covered in scars, repeatedly burning in his nerves.
Ritana, Ali...
I can no longer avenge you...
Vaguely, Lymes heard a woman’s voice whispering in his ear.
"As long as you offer your soul, you can gain the power to destroy the world."
Soul... power to destroy the world...
Lymes felt his heart waver.
He knew that once he agreed, he would no longer have control over himself, turning into a mindless puppet.
After intense internal struggle, an overwhelming aura swept from Lymes’ body.
Just at this moment, all the projections within the square vanished.
All scenes paused.
Including the grand army of knights, and Lymes and others under the Holy Light, all disappeared.
It was as if a movie abruptly stopped without being fully played, leaving Han Xing and the others watching with perplexity.
The next moment, a system prompt appeared.
[Congratulations, you have successfully cleared the Two-Star Secret Realm ’Knight Judgment Arena’, this challenge completion rating is 100%.]
[You have received 700,000 experience rewards, item rewards: Strong Fragment*27, Rune Crystal*1030, Silver Treasure Chest*4, Golden Treasure Chest*1...]
A pile of rewards left everyone dumbfounded.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong said in confusion, "Huh? It’s over?"
"What about Lymes? Did he end up selling his soul or not?"
Everyone else also felt somewhat bewildered.
Han Xing shook his head and said, "I don’t know, since it’s already over, let’s not worry about it any further."
"That giant dragon said that the scenes here are just projections of past events no matter what, the outcome is already determined, and we can’t change anything."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded in realization.
Han Xing felt that this Two-Star Secret Realm they cleared was somewhat peculiar.
He wasn’t sure whether all Two-Star Secret Realms were like this, or if theirs was an exception.
With this thought, Han Xing shook his head, deciding not to dwell on it anymore.
After all, they still had other Secret Realms to challenge later, and they would know by then.
Just then, Su Xiaoyang seemed to regain consciousness as well.

In the instant of contact with the Holy Light, several undead knights had their soul bodies shattered, disappearing into the air.
"Damn it, you actually used the God of Light’s power!" Lymes shouted in anger.
Grotar still did not reveal himself, coldly snorting, "The God of Light is the deity of the Human Race’s beliefs.
As the Leader of the Human Race, isn’t it natural for me to wield the God of Light’s power?"
During the brief conversation between the two, the Holy Light continued to burn.
Dozens more undead knights had their soul bodies shattered.
This meant the last traces of their existence in the world were also erased, disappearing forever.
As more and more companions disappeared.
Lymes desperately reached out a hand but could only barely maintain his soul body under the Holy Light.
The outcome of the battle seemed already determined.
Lymes said in a mixture of sorrow and anger, "God of Light, can’t you see, your followers are suffering due to a villain’s persecution, why are you helping him against us?"
However, Lymes’ plea received no response.
Gods do not concern themselves with undead, such lowly beings.
Lymes seemed to hear that man’s mocking laughter.
At this moment, he recalled the scene of his wife and daughter’s deaths, those despairing and hollow eyes, their bodies covered in scars, repeatedly burning in his nerves.
Ritana, Ali...
I can no longer avenge you...
Vaguely, Lymes heard a woman’s voice whispering in his ear.
"As long as you offer your soul, you can gain the power to destroy the world."
Soul... power to destroy the world...
Lymes felt his heart waver.
He knew that once he agreed, he would no longer have control over himself, turning into a mindless puppet.
After intense internal struggle, an overwhelming aura swept from Lymes’ body.
Just at this moment, all the projections within the square vanished.
All scenes paused.
Including the grand army of knights, and Lymes and others under the Holy Light, all disappeared.
It was as if a movie abruptly stopped without being fully played, leaving Han Xing and the others watching with perplexity.
The next moment, a system prompt appeared.
[Congratulations, you have successfully cleared the Two-Star Secret Realm ’Knight Judgment Arena’, this challenge completion rating is 100%.]
[You have received 700,000 experience rewards, item rewards: Strong Fragment*27, Rune Crystal*1030, Silver Treasure Chest*4, Golden Treasure Chest*1...]
A pile of rewards left everyone dumbfounded.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong said in confusion, "Huh?
It’s over?"
"What about Lymes?
Did he end up selling his soul or not?"
Everyone else also felt somewhat bewildered.
Han Xing shook his head and said, "I don’t know, since it’s already over, let’s not worry about it any further."
"That giant dragon said that the scenes here are just projections of past events no matter what, the outcome is already determined, and we can’t change anything."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded in realization.
Han Xing felt that this Two-Star Secret Realm they cleared was somewhat peculiar.
He wasn’t sure whether all Two-Star Secret Realms were like this, or if theirs was an exception.
With this thought, Han Xing shook his head, deciding not to dwell on it anymore.
After all, they still had other Secret Realms to challenge later, and they would know by then.
Just then, Su Xiaoyang seemed to regain consciousness as well.

chapters.title: Chapter 120 - 106: Unboxing! Titan Battle Armor!
paragraphs: Han Xing noticed that Su Xiaoyang’s aura had become extremely weak, almost unable to stand.
It seemed to be the aftereffect of her previous state.
Zhang Lianmeng supported Su Xiaoyang until she came to her senses.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but ask, "Li... Little Sister Yang, what was that state you were in just now?"
Su Xiaoyang’s face flushed red, and she quickly defended herself, "No... It’s not like that, I’m not usually like this!"
"I’m not some kind of bone-crushing witch..."
Han Xing: "..."
Shen Yun: "..."
Su Xiaoyang, looking tense, said, "You, you guys don’t need to be afraid of me, I won’t do that to you."

Connecting the dots from Su Xiaoyang’s previous state, Cheng Jianyong wiped the cold sweat off his forehead and said, "No, no worries... we’re not afraid of you, I’m just curious about how you unleashed such a terrifying power?"
This question intrigued everyone indeed.
Mainly because the power Su Xiaoyang just unleashed far exceeded the strength of any current survivor, it was truly terrifying.
Su Xiaoyang heaved a sigh of relief after hearing this.
Then she explained, "Actually, I’m not quite sure either."
"When I first entered the game, I heard a notification saying that my fate matched this world, and I drew an S-level talent, War Witch."
"This talent only activates when I’m in life-threatening danger. Once activated, my power increases many-fold, but I don’t know the exact numbers..."
"And the cost is that after the battle ends, I’ll fall into a state of weakness for an entire day, unable to even hold my weapon."
Upon hearing this, the crowd wore expressions of confusion.
"S-level talent?"
Su Xiaoyang nodded, "Uh-huh, don’t you have one?"
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun both shook their heads.
But Han Xing seemed somewhat deep in thought.
Because when he entered the Sky Island World, he also drew a talent.
SSS-level talent: Divine-level Artisan.
It was precisely this talent that allowed him to consistently create top-grade equipment without failure, staying ahead of other survivors.
War Witch, huh? It certainly sounds formidable.
Han Xing said, "Alright, let’s not dwell on this right now. Xiaoyang is in a state of weakness, let’s hurry and open the chests and get out of here."
The group suddenly remembered this matter.
They turned their gaze.
In the empty square, five treasure chests were prominently placed.
"Wow, the rewards this time are really rich, a full five chests, including a golden treasure chest!"
As you know, from a silver treasure chest, you’re sure to get a piece of purple armor.
And in a golden treasure chest, there’s a high chance of obtaining golden equipment.
The group was also stunned by the rewards this time and eagerly walked over to the chests.
At this moment, Han Xing asked, "Who will open the first chest?"
Cheng Jianyong rubbed his hands, looking expectantly at Han Xing.
Shen Yun smiled and said, "Let Cheng Jianyong do it, this guy has always had good luck."
Han Xing nodded.
"Then I won’t be polite." Cheng Jianyong laughed heartily, then walked to the first silver treasure chest and opened it.
A flash of blue and purple light appeared.
The group craned their necks to look.
What emerged from the chest was quite ordinary, apart from some common materials, there was just a purple weapon.
[Obtained Mithril *17, Blood of the Strong *31, Advanced Profession Scroll for Mage *1, obtained Ice Crystal Sword (Purple) *1...]

[Ice Crystal Sword (Purple) lv15, Quality - Treasure, Attack Power 174~183, Power +20, Agility +20, Attached Effect - Critical Strike (Critical Strike Rate increased by 30%), Attached Effect - Breath of Extreme Cold (After an attack hits the target, slows the enemy, reducing Movement Speed by 10%)]
The group couldn’t help but reveal a hint of disappointment.
Cheng Jianyong was also surprised and said, "Damn, such bad luck this time?"
Usually, getting a piece of purple armor would be enough to excite them for a while.
But now, because Han Xing had given them a set of high-quality purple armor.
Not only was the quality excellent, but the attributes also crushed the equipment from the treasure chest.
So, this Ice Crystal Sword seemed a bit disappointing.
However, the slowing effect on the Ice Crystal Sword wasn’t bad.
Combined with Zhang Lianmeng’s Ice Spear, which had a 15% slowing effect, in total it could slow by 25%.
The group moved on to the next treasure chest.
Han Xing still allowed Cheng Jianyong to give it a try.
Cheng Jianyong rubbed his hands once more and opened the chest again.
A flash of white light.
[Obtained Mithril *13, Magic Crystal *342, Advanced Profession Scroll for Warrior *1, obtained Chaos Rune Blueprint (Middle) *1.]
[Chaos Rune Blueprint (Middle)]: Consumes Rune Crystal *200, Spirit Core *100, can create a rune that moderately increases one random attribute (Attribute increase range is 6~9).
Compared to the weak Chaos Rune on Han Xing’s blueprint panel now, this middle-level rune had a significant attribute boost.
A middle-level rune could roughly add 2 extra points in attributes compared to a lower-level rune.
Don’t underestimate these two points, as a survivor can equip runes on 7 pieces of equipment, the cumulative effect wouldn’t be negligible.
"Haha, this one’s not bad!" Cheng Jianyong said joyfully.
Then onto the third chest, the things that came out became quite ordinary again.
Besides some regular materials, there was a purple dagger, a weapon for the Stalker profession.
Nobody said much, but Cheng Jianyong felt guilty.
Arriving at the fourth silver chest, Cheng Jianyong suddenly said, "Um... I won’t open any more, my luck isn’t great today."
Han Xing nodded and said, "Shen Yun, why don’t you give it a try."
Shen Yun laughed and replied, "Alright!"
Click!
After the chest was opened, the items inside were also somewhat disappointing.

chapters.title: Chapter 121 - 106: Unboxing! Titan Battle Armor! (Part 2)
paragraphs: The purple armor inside is a magic staff.
However, this purple magic staff is Level 15, and purely in terms of damage, it’s slightly higher than the Level 11 magic staff Han Xing made for Zhang Lianmeng.
Now, only the last golden treasure chest remains unopened in the arena.
And this is also the main part of the rewards this time.
There’s a high probability of getting golden equipment from the golden treasure chest; Han Xing has already verified it.
Everyone is very excited inside.
"Who will open this last one?" Han Xing asked.
Everyone looked at each other.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun both shook their heads, "Our luck isn’t good today, better not open it; if it’s bad, the loss would be too great."
Han Xing nodded slightly.
Then Cheng Jianyong suddenly said, "Why not let my sis... let Sister Lian open it?"
Beside him, Zhang Lianmeng was initially surprised when Cheng Jianyong mentioned her.
In her heart, she indeed wanted to experience the fun of opening a golden treasure chest.
Han Xing noticed her eager expression and said, "Lian’Er, you go ahead."
Beside them, Su Xiaoyang’s expression changed slightly upon hearing Han Xing’s term for Zhang Lianmeng.
Zhang Lianmeng was about to agree, but she noticed that Su Xiaoyang’s expression was off and quickly reconsidered, then laughed, "No, let Little Sister Yang open it instead."
"This time, it’s thanks to Little Sister Yang that everyone was saved!"
After hearing this, everyone expressed no objections.
After all, Su Xiaoyang contributed greatly this time.
Singlehandedly killing a Lord, just saying that could scare people to death.
The initially downcast Su Xiaoyang heard Zhang Lianmeng’s suggestion and started shaking her hands, "No, no, no, I can’t do it..."
However, at that moment, Zhang Lianmeng tugged at her sleeve and brought Su Xiaoyang to the golden treasure chest without further ado.
"Little Sister Yang, Sister hasn’t had much luck..."
"Before this, Sister’s life wasn’t smooth, even after coming to this world."
"If I hadn’t met Brother Xing, I might have died at the hands of monsters and never met Little Sister Yang..."
Zhang Lianmeng’s words carried deeper meaning, and Su Xiaoyang was about to refuse further.
At this point, she heard Han Xing’s voice from behind, "It’s fine, you open it, Xiaoyang, we’ll have other opportunities to open treasure chests together in the future."
Upon hearing this, Su Xiaoyang nodded and looked gratefully at Zhang Lianmeng.
In her heart, her appreciation for this friendly and considerate big sister soared even higher.
Under the watchful eyes of everyone, Su Xiaoyang walked up to the golden treasure chest and opened it slowly.
The moment it was opened, a dazzling golden light appeared before everyone’s eyes.
"Wow, such a commotion..." Cheng Jianyong exclaimed aside.
Click!
As the chest opened, everyone immediately looked inside.
Inside lay a golden armor, beside which lay a ring emitting a brilliant golden light.
[Obtained Mithril*47, Permanent Gold Ingot*7, Vitality Ore*3, Kingdom’s Holy Ring (Gold), Titan Battle Armor (Gold)*1]
"Whoa! Two pieces of golden equipment from one chest?" Cheng Jianyong looked as if he’d seen a monster.
Shen Yun also sighed, "Today, I witnessed what a true Emperor of Luck is."
Zhang Lianmeng held Su Xiaoyang’s hand tightly, trembling with excitement.
"Little Sister Yang, you’re amazing!"
Han Xing also gave Su Xiaoyang a thumbs up.
Faced with everyone’s praise, Su Xiaoyang’s face turned red with embarrassment.
Her heart warmed, experiencing a sense of team recognition for the first time.
Meanwhile, Han Xing and the others saw the attributes of the two pieces of equipment.
[Titan Battle Armor (Gold) lv15, Quality - Legend, Defense 43~47, Power +30, Constitution +30.]
[Attached Effect - Titan’s Fury]: When attacked, there’s a 30% chance to increase Power by 20 points and Constitution by 20 points.
[Attached Effect - Force Discharge]: When receiving physical attacks, reduce damage caused by opponent’s Power by 20 points.

[Attached Effect - Titan’s Soul]: Legendary Effect. When activating skills, there’s a 50% chance to apply Titan’s Soul state, under which received physical and magic damage is reduced by 25%. After accumulating five instances of damage, the Titan’s Soul effect disappears, dealing true damage equal to 1X Power to the enemy.
Stunning attributes!
The first piece of equipment left everyone astounded.
Despite their excitement, they proceeded to check the second piece of golden equipment.

[Kingdom Ring (Gold) lv15, Quality - Treasure, Agility +50, Spirit +50, Attached Effect - Intermediate Magic Resistance (When receiving magic attacks, reduce the effect of magic damage by 20%), Attached Effect - Kingdom Authority (When attacking, there’s a 20% chance to deal an extra 20% true damage)]
Two pieces of golden equipment, one Legendary Quality, one Rare Quality.
The most precious, of course, is that Titan Battle Armor.
It doesn’t have specific armor categorization, meaning any profession can equip it.
However, its attributes lean more towards warriors and holy professions.
Shen Yun exclaimed, "This battle armor’s defense is insane; it’s almost catching up to this Shield of Immortality!"
Shield is the equipment in Sky Island Paradise with the highest defense.
But since his Shield of Immortality is Level 11 and the Titan Battle Armor is Level 15, in terms of strength, Titan Battle Armor actually surpasses the Shield of Immortality.
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing said, "This battle armor will go to Shen Yun, what do you think?"
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang both nodded, expressing no objections.
Cheng Jianyong shrugged indifferently.

Shen Yun hesitated for a moment, then quickly said, "Brother Xing, give it to Xiaoyongzi, this battle armor boosts Power significantly, enhancing his output capacity and his resilience. If I encounter a monster I can’t handle, Cheng Jianyong can help me withstand."
However, Han Xing explained, "Shen Yun, your analysis makes sense, but as you’ve seen in the previous battles, a tank is crucial to a team."
"During our fight against that Lord Knight, if you had this battle armor, you probably could’ve withstood that guy’s attacks, sparing us from such a dangerous situation."
"This team doesn’t lack output; what we lack is a person who can stand in the front!"
After hearing Han Xing’s analysis, Shen Yun paused for a moment, then nodded.
Cheng Jianyong also commented from the side, "No way! You want me to get beaten up with you? Not a chance!"
Seeing this, Shen Yun no longer refused and accepted the golden battle armor.
He now owned two pieces of golden equipment.
Upon reaching Level 15, Shen Yun’s defense would surge significantly again.
There’s still a piece of golden equipment left, the Kingdom Ring, although it’s Rare Quality and lacks legendary effects, its strength falls far behind.
Nonetheless, its attribute bonuses are remarkably strong.
Without hesitation, Han Xing took the Kingdom Ring himself.
Once he reaches Level 15, he can equip it, boosting his attributes further.
Everyone tacitly agreed.
At that moment, Shen Yun asked confusedly, "Why hasn’t the system sent us out now that the Secret Realm is over?"
They were immersed in the joy of opening the chest, only recalling this issue with Shen Yun’s mention.
"Right, how do we get out?"
Nonetheless, Han Xing seemed to recall something.
Han Xing remembered, during his clearing of the One-Star Secret Realm, he additionally triggered a hidden stage challenge.
In it, he coincidentally obtained the blueprint for manufacturing a Spiritual Puppet.
However, due to a lack of the Spiritual Core blueprint, he couldn’t mass-produce it yet.
Could this Knight Judgment Arena have a hidden stage too?
At that moment, a system notification appeared.
[Survivors, your remarkable performance has successfully gained recognition from Lymes’ consciousness, automatically triggering ’Knight Judgment Arena’ Phase Three, Destiny’s Choice.]
[This phase requires no combat but demands answering a question.]
[The system will reward corresponding items based on your choices.]

Could this Knight Judgment Arena have a hidden stage too?
At that moment, a system notification appeared.
[Survivors, your remarkable performance has successfully gained recognition from Lymes’ consciousness, automatically triggering ’Knight Judgment Arena’ Phase Three, Destiny’s Choice.]
[This phase requires no combat but demands answering a question.]
[The system will reward corresponding items based on your choices.]

chapters.title: Chapter 122 - 107: The First Orange Equipment in the Entire Server
paragraphs: [Third Phase Trial, the Choice of Destiny has been initiated.]
"Please answer the question: In the final scene, did Lymes offer his soul to the Desire Witch?"
"Please make your choice quickly..."
Upon hearing this prompt, everyone was stunned.
This third phase, unlike what Han Xing had triggered before, required an answer to a question.
Although, the system’s introduction said that no matter the choice, there would be a corresponding reward.
But if you chose wrong, would the reward be discounted?
Everyone was a bit worried.
Reflecting on the scene just now, everyone intuitively believed that Lymes would one hundred percent choose to offer his soul.
After all, being driven by the deep-seated hatred of having his entire family killed is not something one easily lets go of.
In a novel, someone like Lymes was the sure main character template.
Just as Han Xing was about to choose 1.
Shen Yun said at that moment: "Brother Xing, choose the second one."
Everyone simultaneously looked at Shen Yun, seemingly not understanding why he would make such a choice.
Han Xing asked doubtfully: "Are you sure?"
Shen Yun nodded.

Then, he began to explain: "Even in his most furious state, what Lymes thought of was only revenge against Grotar. If it were us, we wouldn’t be satisfied without wiping out the entire kingdom to quell our hatred."
"Reflecting on Lymes’ loyalty to his faith, I think, even in the end, he would not give up his personal consciousness and therefore would not be willing to offer his soul."
After hearing Shen Yun’s analysis, Han Xing nodded.
He chose option 2.
A system prompt appeared.
[You have made your choice and obtained a reward, Radiant Knight Professional Scroll*1]

[Radiant Knight Professional Scroll: Upon reaching Level 10, survivors can use this scroll to transfer to the hidden profession, Radiant Knight. Survivors’ all attributes increase by 200%, level limit increases to Level 20, and upon leveling up, constitution and spirit will gain double growth.]
[Automatically learn Radiant Knight exclusive skills: Power of Radiance, Blessing of Courage, Great Recovery Array]
Upon seeing the scroll’s profession introduction, everyone was stunned for a moment, then simultaneously looked at Shen Yun.
This additional reward turned out to be the Hidden Profession Scroll for a knight.
On the field, only Shen Yun was of the knight profession, so this Hidden Profession Scroll naturally went to him.
Cheng Jianyong said jealously on the side: "I’m envious, why is it that all the good stuff is what Xiaoyunzi can use, I also want to transfer to a hidden profession!"
Shen Yun glanced at him and said: "Didn’t you see the name of this Secret Realm? ’Knight Judgment Arena’, of course, the drops are all things knights can use."
Just then, a system prompt appeared.
[Secret Realm challenge has been completed, in 10 seconds, all survivors will be teleported out... ]
Han Xing glanced at the center of the plaza, he vaguely saw the human-like shadow observing everyone.
This Knight Judgment Arena should have other secrets, but the system did not give them extra time to explore, so Han Xing could only give up.
Just then, Han Xing noticed something seemed to be lying on the ground where they had just battled the Lord-level knight.
That object seemed to resemble a great sword.
Han Xing was momentarily dazed.

At that time, he was in a state of unconsciousness and didn’t see the scene of Su Xiaoyang fighting, nor did he know that after the knight lord’s weapon fell to the ground, there was never an opportunity to pick it up again.
But the strange thing is.
Before this, the knights they defeated, after dying, their bodies and equipment would vanish into white light.
Yet, the weapon of this Lord-level knight was still here.
With 5 seconds remaining on the countdown.
Whoosh!
A gust of wind rushed by.
Han Xing activated Wild Instinct and dashed over in an instant.
Under the bewildered gazes of everyone, Han Xing appeared in front of the giant broadsword and picked it up.
A system prompt appeared.
[Obtained Knight Captain, Kevin’s Sword.]
[Lion’s Giant Sword (Orange)]
Han Xing: "Whoa!!!"
Hearing the voice, everyone turned to look.
However, the next moment, the countdown had ended.
The scene flashed, and Han Xing and the others were teleported back to their domain.
After coming out, it was already late at night.
The nightly sky was dotted with stars.
In this Two-Star Secret Realm, they had spent more than two hours.
As soon as they emerged, Han Xing quickly scanned the surroundings.
Upon confirming their domain was intact and the defense shield had not been attacked, everyone simultaneously breathed a sigh of relief.
At this moment, Han Xing, in front of everyone, threw the giant broadsword from his backpack onto the ground.
Clang!
Upon seeing the somewhat familiar-looking weapon.
Everyone seemed to recall the image of that Lord Knight swinging the greatsword at them.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong hesitantly said, "Brother Xing, this thing, isn’t it the weapon of that Knight Lord?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, and what’s more, it’s an Orange Weapon!"
Receiving Han Xing’s confirmed response, everyone’s pupils shrank.
When they heard the words "Orange Weapon," they were even more stunned.
However, that was not the most shocking part to them.
Upon seeing the strong attributes on this weapon, they were already in an indescribably awed state.

[Lion’s Greatsword (Orange) lv15, Quality - Legend, Attack Power: 323~354, Power +50, Hit Rate +10%, Attached Effect - Breaking Army (during attack, ignores the opponent’s 50 defense points), Attached Effect - Lion Heart (at the start of battle, applies Lion Heart status, increasing Power by 12%), Attached Effect - King of the Beasts (Legendary Effect.)]

[King of the Beasts]: Legendary Effect, after activating King of the Beasts state, all enemies fall into a terrified state, defense decreases by 50 points, movement speed decreases by 20%, and all hits by the user are guaranteed to be critical strikes and have a knockback effect. (Effect cooldown time is 6 hours.)
"Hiss..."
After reading the attributes of this greatsword, everyone collectively drew a sharp breath.
"Whoa! Is this what Orange Equipment is? It’s truly terrifying!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in amazement.
Shen Yun was also shocked and said, "This weapon might be the first Orange Equipment in the whole region, right?"
At the current stage, even a piece of Golden Equipment is exceedingly rare, let alone higher-level Orange Equipment.
It’s understandable for Shen Yun to say this is the first Orange Equipment in the whole region.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong seemed to have thought of something.
He is of the Warrior profession, and only he on the field can equip this greatsword.
Thus, Cheng Jianyong put on an awkward smile and then asked with anticipation, "Brother Xing~ can you give me this Orange Greatsword?"
Han Xing immediately felt goosebumps rising on his back and said speechlessly, "Cheng Jianyong, for heaven’s sake, speak properly."
However, Cheng Jianyong still looked at him with that affectionate gaze.
Han Xing barely resisted the urge to shoot an arrow at him and casually tossed the broadsword over.
"Thank you, Brother Xing, from now on, I’ll listen to everything you say~"
"Sheesh!"
Just as Han Xing was about to kick him, Cheng Jianyong quickly caught the greatsword, and the fawning expression on his face disappeared, replaced by a look of excitement.
He held the Lion’s Greatsword in his arms, gently stroking it as if he were treating a lover.
"What a handsome weapon!"
"Tsk tsk, look at the patterns on this sword, the texture, it’s stunning!" Cheng Jianyong sincerely praised.
He held the weapon, unwilling to let go.
At this point, Han Xing said speechlessly, "Hurry up and level up, once you reach level 15, with the support of this greatsword, your damage might even surpass mine."
Cheng Jianyong responded with full agreement, filled with motivation.
Then, he hugged the greatsword again, sidled up to Shen Yun, and teased, "Xiaoyunzi, Brother Xing gave this to me, aren’t you jealous?"
Shen Yun rolled his eyes at him.
Of course, it’s impossible to say he isn’t jealous.
After all, that’s an Orange Weapon; once equipped, the Attack Power would increase by leaps and bounds!
However, Shen Yun also had his own gains. He chuckled and took out a scroll from his pocket.
"Xiaoyongzi, I also have good stuff, even more impressive than your Orange Weapon!"
"Radiant Knight Scroll, a hidden profession, Xiaoyongzi, aren’t you envious?"
Cheng Jianyong glanced at the scroll in his hand, then at the greatsword, and turned his head aside, saying, "Haha, I’m not envious at all!"
However, Han Xing was also very interested in the Radiant Knight profession, he walked over and said, "Shen Yun, let’s see the effects after you make the profession change."
Radiant Knight is far superior to the Priest profession, a 200% increase in all attributes alone is more than worth it.
Shen Yun nodded and said, "Brother Xing, then I’ll change professions, and don’t forget to take me along for leveling up later."
Han Xing laughed, "Don’t worry."
Shen Yun, in front of everyone, pressed down on the scroll.
The next moment, a sky full of white Holy Light appeared around the entire territory.
Everyone only felt a vast white in front of them, but being in the Holy Light, they felt a long-lost peace.
The next moment, all these rays of light converged into Shen Yun’s body.
But unlike Su Xiaoyang, those knights were also of the Human Race, so Shen Yun’s physique didn’t change.
When the light faded, Shen Yun looked at his personal panel, showing a look of joy.
Han Xing asked from the side, "How does it feel, what are the effects of those skills?"
Shen Yun smiled and directly posted the three skills into the chat window.

[Power of Radiance]: Passive Skill, increasing the effect of all Holy Profession skills by 20%, all attacks add Holy Light Punishment effect, and when switching to defensive mode, an extra layer of Holy Light is added to the shield, reducing damage received by 20%.

[Blessing of Courage]: Applies the Blessed State of Courage to a single teammate or self, increasing Attack Power by 20%, Movement Speed by 20%, Defense by 20%. (Effect lasts 200 seconds, cooldown time 100 seconds)
[Great Recovery Array]: Creates an array with a range (Spirit*0.2 meters) that has recovery effects, all friendly units within regain a large amount of Life Force per second.
"Wow, this is so strong?" Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but exclaim.
All three skills are immensely powerful.
Especially the Power of Radiance, as a passive skill, it can be considered a permanent boost.
An increase of 20% in all Holy Profession skills’ effects alone can be deemed a Divine Skill!
