chapters.title: Chapter 123 - 108: Hunter’s Medal (Purple)
paragraphs: A twenty percent skill effect enhancement allows Shen Yun to have a stronger healing effect when using healing skills, and the Holy Light Shield becomes more robust.
Together with a defensive stance, it can significantly reduce damage.
Plus, an effect of Holy Light Punishment makes it both offensive and defensive.
Compared to the other two professions in the Holy Profession: the Knight and the Priest.
The Knight leans towards defense and melee, able to withstand damage while providing some output.
The Priest, on the other hand, is more of a support-type profession, with two support skills and one healing skill.
But now, the Radiant Knight, as a hidden profession, combines the advantages of these two professions and exerts a stronger effect.
In other words, after Shen Yun’s profession change, his healing ability and monster resisting ability have been substantially enhanced.
Although his level dropped to level 10, his attributes not only didn’t decrease but were greatly improved.
This is because, generally, survivors using Advanced Profession Scroll receive a fixed 100% attribute enhancement.
However, hidden professions naturally have some differences.
Han Xing remembers that Su Xiaoyang’s Elf Shooter had a 150% attribute enhancement.
His Wild Ranger, and Shen Yun’s Radiant Knight both have a 200% attribute enhancement.
In terms of strength, Wild Ranger and Radiant Knight are indeed stronger than Elf Hunter.
Han Xing pondered, "It seems that within hidden professions, there are also differences in strength."
Shen Yun smiled proudly, feeling his basic attributes had increased significantly.
However, because his level dropped to level 10, many pieces of equipment couldn’t be worn, resulting in a slight deduction in his power.
But it’s okay, with Han Xing’s team’s strength, Shen Yun’s level will be boosted soon.
At this moment, Han Xing glanced again at the new blueprint in his blueprint tab.
It was the first kill reward for defeating a Lord Monster, a Hunter’s Medal (Purple) and a Space Backpack Blueprint (Purple).
Han Xing first checked the effect of the Hunter’s Medal.

[Hunter’s Medal (Purple)]: Special equipment, increasing all attributes by 5% when worn, providing an additional 5% damage to Lord-level creatures, can be upgraded by defeating Lord-level and above monsters.
[Medal Upgrade Progress]: 1/10.
Note: Only killing Lord Monsters not below own level provides upgrade progress, next stage of the medal, Elite Hunter (Gold).
"Hm? Special equipment?"
Han Xing was a bit surprised, initially thinking such purple accessories wouldn’t provide good attributes, but this Hunter’s Medal was quite powerful.
Just the 5% increase in all attributes could almost match the enhancement brought by a piece of equipment.
In addition, it can be upgraded by killing Lord Creatures, improving the medal.
This is quite like a piece of equipment that can grow, with endless potential!
"The upgrade progress is only 1, meaning I need to kill 9 more Lord Monsters to advance to the next stage?"
Han Xing couldn’t help but look forward to it.
After checking this medal’s attributes, Han Xing then examined the other blueprint reward.
[Space Backpack Blueprint (Purple)]: Can create a backpack with 500-800 slots storage space, comes with moderate attribute amplification effect.
[Materials Required]: Spirit Core *2000, Mithril *5, Strong Beast Hide *5, Ether *10000,
[Success Rate of Crafting: 20%, (Enhanced by Divine-level Craftsman Talent, crafting success rate is now at 100%)]
[Equipment Requirement]: LV20.
The attributes of the purple space backpack were expected; it has larger space and also offers more attribute enhancement.
Compared to the blue backpack’s maximum 200-slot space, the purple backpack has increased several-fold.
Though the materials needed for crafting have significantly increased, Han Xing was not the least bit worried.
Given his current material reserves, he is well-prepared; only the rare material Strong Beast Hide is scarce.
Han Xing cast a glimpse at his storage interface.
[Strong Beast Hide]: 1732 units.
There are two ways to obtain Strong Beast Hide, one is by dismantling Leader-level monster corpses, and the other is from Silver-level and above chests, rarely found.
Therefore, Han Xing hasn’t reserved much.
Han Xing pondered, "Only just over a thousand strong beast hides, so that means at most I can craft about 300 backpacks, if I want a large-scale trade, this number is entirely insufficient."
"It seems I need to keep an eye on the transaction channel for Rugged Beast Hide materials soon."
Since the recent large district merger extended from the original ten thousand to over ninety thousand people.
Some scarce materials are becoming more plentiful.
Once Han Xing stockpiles a batch of strong beast hides and waits for most survivors to reach level 20, it will be his time to make a move.
By then, any transaction will bring him considerable wealth.
Although Han Xing has the blueprint for a Golden Weapon, he could mass-produce golden longbows for sale.
Yet, people have selfish motives; now that golden equipment is extremely rare in the market, especially a golden weapon, can almost elevate a survivor’s power by 50%.
Everyone is now competing in the leveling rankings; Han Xing doesn’t want to create many competitors out of thin air.
Meanwhile, this purple space backpack blueprint has become Han Xing’s new money tree.
This journey to the Secret Realm yielded a lot of gains!
Everyone’s level increased by several levels, acquiring some new equipment, and overall strength was significantly boosted.
Just then, everyone suddenly heard a bubbling sound.
Following the sound source, everyone looked in its direction.
The sound was unexpectedly coming from Su Xiaoyang.
At this moment, she blushed deeply, seemingly quite embarrassed by the sound she made.
She explained, "Just, just now I used a lot of physical strength fighting that big guy, so I’m a bit hungry..."
After saying this, Su Xiaoyang lowered her head embarrassingly.
Everyone exchanged a smile and didn’t mind.

At this moment, Han Xing noticed the few leisurely strolling little pigs on Cheng Jianyong’s territory and suddenly said, "Cheng Jianyong, those little pigs on your land are quite plump, aren’t they?"

Cheng Jianyong’s face changed, and he forced a smile, "Brother Xing, where are they plump? These are just piglets, they haven’t grown up yet. Let’s wait until they’re fat enough and then slaughter them."
At this moment, Shen Yun decided to dismantle his words, "What are you talking about Cheng Jianyong? Piglet meat is the best, whether stir-fried or boiled, the meat is so tender it can’t be beat."
Shen Yun shifted gears, "Or is it that after taking Brother Xing’s Orange Weapon, you’re unwilling to contribute even a single pig?"
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong said gloomily, "These aren’t ordinary pigs... when they grow up, they can help me fight..."
Indeed, those pigs on Cheng Jianyong’s territory were not a breed from Blue Star.
They were a new species called Sunflower Fragrance Pigs, not only pristine in appearance but also possessing some combat ability.
Han Xing glanced over, these Sunflower Fragrance Pigs were all between levels 1~2, each with a basic skill, Spiritual Power Conversion.
[Spiritual Power Conversion]: Can slightly convert the spiritual energy contained in food into its own power, improving attributes.
This skill allowed these Sunflower Fragrance Pigs to exceed the basic attributes of ordinary monsters of the same level, giving them some combat strength.
It is said that usually, these pigs only eat food mixed with Spirit Core, quite precious indeed.

However, Shen Yun said speechlessly, "What’s the big deal about not being ordinary? There are plenty of extraordinary species in this world, yet we still end up killing them, skinning them, and eating their meat?"
Seeing that he couldn’t convince them, Cheng Jianyong could only somewhat compromise and say,
"Alright then, we’ll just eat one..."
Han Xing and Shen Yun exchanged a glance, then burst into laughter.
Then, Han Xing drew his bowstring, and the arrow shot out instantly.
The head of one little pig was pierced through, and it fell down without even a scream.
The other Sunflower Fragrance Pigs scattered in fear.
But Cheng Jianyong’s territory wasn’t that large, even if they wanted to run, there was nowhere to go.
"Haha, time to eat meat!"
Han Xing clapped his hands, then he and Shen Yun excitedly ran over and dragged the piglet back.
Cheng Jianyong looked at them gloomily.
"The pigs are so cute, why do you have to eat them..."
But, Han Xing and Shen Yun couldn’t care less about his gloom.
They quickly drained the blood and cleaned out the insides.
Han Xing took out two huge arrows and tied the piglet onto them.
One must admit, the Sunflower Fragrance Pig lived up to its name.
Even before it was over the fire, a faint fragrance was already wafting from the meat.
They could even imagine how rich the aroma would be once it was roasted, surely very enticing.
Shen Yun asked, "Brother Xing, are you planning to make a roasted suckling pig?"
"That’s right." Han Xing replied while placing Dark Fire Stones under the roasting rack.
As the number of Dark Fire Stones increased, the core temperature of the area rose, achieving an effect similar to charcoal grilling.
Under the heat of the Dark Fire Stones, the piglet’s skin gradually turned yellow.
The scent of meat began to spread.
Everyone was drawn to this peculiar fragrance, closing their eyes to savor it.
Cheng Jianyong was no longer gloomy, with saliva dripping as he eagerly watched the pig meat being turned over in Han Xing’s hand.
Shen Yun was helping on the side, occasionally brushing some oil and sprinkling seasoning.
Half an hour later.
The roasted suckling pig’s exterior was cooked to a golden yellow.
Under the expectant gazes of the crowd, Han Xing raised the pork and announced, "Time to eat!"
He first tore off two front legs, giving them to Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang.
The two girls exchanged a glance, then softly laughed and accepted them.
Then, Han Xing cut a few pieces of pork, stuck them on arrows, and handed them to Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong.
Han Xing also sliced a piece for himself and couldn’t wait to start tasting.
Taking a bite, the tender meat seemed to melt in his mouth.
"Wow, it’s amazing!" Han Xing gave a thumbs up.
Everyone, hearing this, began to devour heartily.
After a day of fighting, everyone was hungry.
Even the shy Su Xiaoyang and Zhang Lianmeng were holding pig trotters, gnawing on the pork without regard for their ladylike image.
"Delicious! Delicious!"
"This pork is so tasty, I’ve never eaten such a delicious pork before."
"Hey, Cheng Jianyong, save me a pig trotter, don’t eat them all!"
"Leave some for me too..."
On the territory, the sounds of people squabbling for food echoed from time to time.
Half an hour later, this roasted suckling pig had been devoured by the five of them.

sentences.text: A twenty percent skill effect enhancement allows Shen Yun to have a stronger healing effect when using healing skills, and the Holy Light Shield becomes more robust.
Together with a defensive stance, it can significantly reduce damage.
Plus, an effect of Holy Light Punishment makes it both offensive and defensive.
Compared to the other two professions in the Holy Profession: the Knight and the Priest.
The Knight leans towards defense and melee, able to withstand damage while providing some output.
The Priest, on the other hand, is more of a support-type profession, with two support skills and one healing skill.
But now, the Radiant Knight, as a hidden profession, combines the advantages of these two professions and exerts a stronger effect.
In other words, after Shen Yun’s profession change, his healing ability and monster resisting ability have been substantially enhanced.
Although his level dropped to level 10, his attributes not only didn’t decrease but were greatly improved.
This is because, generally, survivors using Advanced Profession Scroll receive a fixed 100% attribute enhancement.
However, hidden professions naturally have some differences.
Han Xing remembers that Su Xiaoyang’s Elf Shooter had a 150% attribute enhancement.
His Wild Ranger, and Shen Yun’s Radiant Knight both have a 200% attribute enhancement.
In terms of strength, Wild Ranger and Radiant Knight are indeed stronger than Elf Hunter.
Han Xing pondered, "It seems that within hidden professions, there are also differences in strength."
Shen Yun smiled proudly, feeling his basic attributes had increased significantly.
However, because his level dropped to level 10, many pieces of equipment couldn’t be worn, resulting in a slight deduction in his power.
But it’s okay, with Han Xing’s team’s strength, Shen Yun’s level will be boosted soon.
At this moment, Han Xing glanced again at the new blueprint in his blueprint tab.
It was the first kill reward for defeating a Lord Monster, a Hunter’s Medal (Purple) and a Space Backpack Blueprint (Purple).
Han Xing first checked the effect of the Hunter’s Medal.

[Hunter’s Medal (Purple)]: Special equipment, increasing all attributes by 5% when worn, providing an additional 5% damage to Lord-level creatures, can be upgraded by defeating Lord-level and above monsters.
[Medal Upgrade Progress]: 1/10.
Note: Only killing Lord Monsters not below own level provides upgrade progress, next stage of the medal, Elite Hunter (Gold).
"Hm?
Special equipment?"
Han Xing was a bit surprised, initially thinking such purple accessories wouldn’t provide good attributes, but this Hunter’s Medal was quite powerful.
Just the 5% increase in all attributes could almost match the enhancement brought by a piece of equipment.
In addition, it can be upgraded by killing Lord Creatures, improving the medal.
This is quite like a piece of equipment that can grow, with endless potential!
"The upgrade progress is only 1, meaning I need to kill 9 more Lord Monsters to advance to the next stage?"
Han Xing couldn’t help but look forward to it.
After checking this medal’s attributes, Han Xing then examined the other blueprint reward.
[Space Backpack Blueprint (Purple)]: Can create a backpack with 500-800 slots storage space, comes with moderate attribute amplification effect.
[Materials Required]: Spirit Core *2000, Mithril *5, Strong Beast Hide *5, Ether *10000,
[Success Rate of Crafting: 20%, (Enhanced by Divine-level Craftsman Talent, crafting success rate is now at 100%)]
[Equipment Requirement]: LV20.
The attributes of the purple space backpack were expected; it has larger space and also offers more attribute enhancement.
Compared to the blue backpack’s maximum 200-slot space, the purple backpack has increased several-fold.
Though the materials needed for crafting have significantly increased, Han Xing was not the least bit worried.
Given his current material reserves, he is well-prepared; only the rare material Strong Beast Hide is scarce.
Han Xing cast a glimpse at his storage interface.
[Strong Beast Hide]: 1732 units.
There are two ways to obtain Strong Beast Hide, one is by dismantling Leader-level monster corpses, and the other is from Silver-level and above chests, rarely found.
Therefore, Han Xing hasn’t reserved much.
Han Xing pondered, "Only just over a thousand strong beast hides, so that means at most I can craft about 300 backpacks, if I want a large-scale trade, this number is entirely insufficient."
"It seems I need to keep an eye on the transaction channel for Rugged Beast Hide materials soon."
Since the recent large district merger extended from the original ten thousand to over ninety thousand people.
Some scarce materials are becoming more plentiful.
Once Han Xing stockpiles a batch of strong beast hides and waits for most survivors to reach level 20, it will be his time to make a move.
By then, any transaction will bring him considerable wealth.
Although Han Xing has the blueprint for a Golden Weapon, he could mass-produce golden longbows for sale.
Yet, people have selfish motives; now that golden equipment is extremely rare in the market, especially a golden weapon, can almost elevate a survivor’s power by 50%.
Everyone is now competing in the leveling rankings; Han Xing doesn’t want to create many competitors out of thin air.
Meanwhile, this purple space backpack blueprint has become Han Xing’s new money tree.
This journey to the Secret Realm yielded a lot of gains!
Everyone’s level increased by several levels, acquiring some new equipment, and overall strength was significantly boosted.
Just then, everyone suddenly heard a bubbling sound.
Following the sound source, everyone looked in its direction.
The sound was unexpectedly coming from Su Xiaoyang.
At this moment, she blushed deeply, seemingly quite embarrassed by the sound she made.
She explained, "Just, just now I used a lot of physical strength fighting that big guy, so I’m a bit hungry..."
After saying this, Su Xiaoyang lowered her head embarrassingly.
Everyone exchanged a smile and didn’t mind.

At this moment, Han Xing noticed the few leisurely strolling little pigs on Cheng Jianyong’s territory and suddenly said, "Cheng Jianyong, those little pigs on your land are quite plump, aren’t they?"
Cheng Jianyong’s face changed, and he forced a smile, "Brother Xing, where are they plump?
These are just piglets, they haven’t grown up yet.
Let’s wait until they’re fat enough and then slaughter them."
At this moment, Shen Yun decided to dismantle his words, "What are you talking about Cheng Jianyong?
Piglet meat is the best, whether stir-fried or boiled, the meat is so tender it can’t be beat."
Shen Yun shifted gears, "Or is it that after taking Brother Xing’s Orange Weapon, you’re unwilling to contribute even a single pig?"
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong said gloomily, "These aren’t ordinary pigs... when they grow up, they can help me fight..."
Indeed, those pigs on Cheng Jianyong’s territory were not a breed from Blue Star.
They were a new species called Sunflower Fragrance Pigs, not only pristine in appearance but also possessing some combat ability.
Han Xing glanced over, these Sunflower Fragrance Pigs were all between levels 1~2, each with a basic skill, Spiritual Power Conversion.
[Spiritual Power Conversion]: Can slightly convert the spiritual energy contained in food into its own power, improving attributes.
This skill allowed these Sunflower Fragrance Pigs to exceed the basic attributes of ordinary monsters of the same level, giving them some combat strength.
It is said that usually, these pigs only eat food mixed with Spirit Core, quite precious indeed.
However, Shen Yun said speechlessly, "What’s the big deal about not being ordinary?
There are plenty of extraordinary species in this world, yet we still end up killing them, skinning them, and eating their meat?"
Seeing that he couldn’t convince them, Cheng Jianyong could only somewhat compromise and say,
"Alright then, we’ll just eat one..."
Han Xing and Shen Yun exchanged a glance, then burst into laughter.
Then, Han Xing drew his bowstring, and the arrow shot out instantly.
The head of one little pig was pierced through, and it fell down without even a scream.
The other Sunflower Fragrance Pigs scattered in fear.
But Cheng Jianyong’s territory wasn’t that large, even if they wanted to run, there was nowhere to go.
"Haha, time to eat meat!"
Han Xing clapped his hands, then he and Shen Yun excitedly ran over and dragged the piglet back.
Cheng Jianyong looked at them gloomily.
"The pigs are so cute, why do you have to eat them..."
But, Han Xing and Shen Yun couldn’t care less about his gloom.
They quickly drained the blood and cleaned out the insides.
Han Xing took out two huge arrows and tied the piglet onto them.
One must admit, the Sunflower Fragrance Pig lived up to its name.
Even before it was over the fire, a faint fragrance was already wafting from the meat.
They could even imagine how rich the aroma would be once it was roasted, surely very enticing.
Shen Yun asked, "Brother Xing, are you planning to make a roasted suckling pig?"
"That’s right." Han Xing replied while placing Dark Fire Stones under the roasting rack.
As the number of Dark Fire Stones increased, the core temperature of the area rose, achieving an effect similar to charcoal grilling.
Under the heat of the Dark Fire Stones, the piglet’s skin gradually turned yellow.
The scent of meat began to spread.
Everyone was drawn to this peculiar fragrance, closing their eyes to savor it.
Cheng Jianyong was no longer gloomy, with saliva dripping as he eagerly watched the pig meat being turned over in Han Xing’s hand.
Shen Yun was helping on the side, occasionally brushing some oil and sprinkling seasoning.
Half an hour later.
The roasted suckling pig’s exterior was cooked to a golden yellow.
Under the expectant gazes of the crowd, Han Xing raised the pork and announced, "Time to eat!"
He first tore off two front legs, giving them to Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang.
The two girls exchanged a glance, then softly laughed and accepted them.
Then, Han Xing cut a few pieces of pork, stuck them on arrows, and handed them to Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong.
Han Xing also sliced a piece for himself and couldn’t wait to start tasting.
Taking a bite, the tender meat seemed to melt in his mouth.
"Wow, it’s amazing!" Han Xing gave a thumbs up.
Everyone, hearing this, began to devour heartily.
After a day of fighting, everyone was hungry.
Even the shy Su Xiaoyang and Zhang Lianmeng were holding pig trotters, gnawing on the pork without regard for their ladylike image.
"Delicious!
Delicious!"
"This pork is so tasty, I’ve never eaten such a delicious pork before."
"Hey, Cheng Jianyong, save me a pig trotter, don’t eat them all!"
"Leave some for me too..."
On the territory, the sounds of people squabbling for food echoed from time to time.
Half an hour later, this roasted suckling pig had been devoured by the five of them.

chapters.title: Chapter 124 - 109: Hundred Servers Celebrity Ranking
paragraphs: After eating and drinking their fill, everyone relaxed in their chairs, enjoying the night view of Sky Island.
During this time, Zhang Lianmeng sat with Su Xiaoyang, seemingly having endless conversations, appearing quite inseparable.
Han Xing glanced at the two women and then moved a stool to sit to the side.
Feeling bored, he opened the forum, wanting to see what had transpired among the Survivors after the area merge.
Today was the first day after the area merge.
Several major events had occurred in the two large districts.
First, teams from various districts began incessantly recruiting, dominating the public chat channels and causing widespread anger.
After a whole day of mutual trolling, Boundaryless from District 101 intervened to stop the flaming.
As the leader of the largest team in District 101, Boundaryless is a legendary figure.
Not long after the Secret Realm Points leaderboard opened, he was the first to clear the Cloud Secret Realm, securing first place.
After a day of exploration, Boundaryless now has 5 points in the Cloud Secret Realm, maintaining first place.
This means he has cleared at least more than two Cloud Secret Realms, his strength being quite remarkable.
Boundaryless’s intervention had some deterrent effect.
Teams from various districts, with future collaboration in mind, ceased their spamming and recruitment activities.
Apart from this, several large-scale conflict incidents among Survivors broke out today.
Due to the recent district merger, the largest teams from each district thought they were the strongest, and none accepted the others.
Though everyone showed restraint, several significant conflict incidents among Survivors still occurred.
After reading today’s updates.
Cheng Jianyong, also browsing forum posts, suddenly said, "Brother Xing, Xiaoyunzi, look, someone on the forum is making some kind of Celebrity Leaderboard, and it seems quite popular."
"Celebrity Leaderboard? What’s that?"
Everyone was puzzled. After entering the forum, they found the highest trending post.
The post title was: "Freshly Baked, Overview of Celebrity Leaderboard from District 101~200!
Upon clicking, they discovered the poster was a Survivor named Dust Contract.

He stated inside: "With the initial area merge, let’s count the celebrities from each district: District 101’s Boundaryless, District 111’s Optimus Prime, District 199’s Alpha... Surely, many of you have heard of these people."
"Before this, they might have been the top experts of a district, double leaderboard champions, or leaders of a big team."
"Undeniably, these figures possess great strength and personal charisma; they are one in ten thousand."
"Coinciding with each district’s recruitment, I took a day to contact compatriots from each district and after extensive investigation, compiled the celebrity lists for each district."
"I found that no matter which district, there are always two or three dazzling figures!"
"Now, I’m making this list public for you to vote and select the most popular figure!"
Below the post.
Dust Contract began the list from District 101, placing two to three names in order, accompanied by voting options.
Starting from District 101’s Boundaryless, Nine Abyss, District 111’s Optimus Prime, Luo God, all the way to District 200’s Wind Divine Son, Hoeing at Noon.
Each district had two to five names listed.
Cheng Jianyong quickly scrolled down and found three names glaringly listed in District 107.
Star River, Black Shadow, Papaya Star Spirit.
These three indeed were frequently mentioned figures in District 107 prior to the merge.
Before this, there might have been a Whisperer.
But now, since Divine Whisper was forced to disband by Han Xing, the Whisperer was also eliminated by Black Eagle, thus becoming history.
After reviewing the leaderboard, Shen Yun nodded and said.
"This Dust Contract has some skills; he understands each district’s situation so well only a day after the merge."
Everyone nodded.
As they had already reached deep into the night, most Survivors had ended their day of battles; at this moment, the forum was at its peak of activity.
The post quickly shot to the highest heat position, attracting many viewers.
Seeing their district’s celebrities on the leaderboard, the Survivors felt quite pleased, with a sense of collective pride.
They started voting enthusiastically for people from their own district.
However, as previously mentioned, each district had one or two prominent figures with considerable popularity.
Calculating by an average of 9500 people per district, discounting those who haven’t seen the post, being able to gain 3000 votes at this stage is extremely high popularity.
Things went as expected.
When the votes for these three to four hundred people reached a critical point, those willing to vote had mostly cast their votes.
Currently, the popularity leader is District 101’s Boundaryless, with over four thousand votes.
He is not only the leader of ’Kunlun’ but also the current first in the Cloud Secret Realm Points leaderboard.
Below that post, Survivors from the Kunlun Team were chanting Boundaryless’s name.
"Leader of the Boundaryless is mighty!"
"Number one in popularity across all servers!"
Just as Survivors from the Kunlun Team were preparing to celebrate victory.
However, what they didn’t expect was.
A district, otherwise obscure, was steadily rising in vote count.
Everyone was puzzled.
And that district was precisely Han Xing and others’ District 107.
At this time, Star River was already nearing three thousand seven hundred votes and still climbing, about to surpass the popularity leader Boundaryless.
And alongside Star River, the other two from the same district, one being Black Eagle, the other Papaya Star Spirit.

chapters.title: Chapter 125 - 109: Hundred Servers Celebrity Ranking_2
paragraphs: The two of them only got three to five hundred votes, which sharply contrasted with the number of votes in other zones.
Everyone was puzzled and began leaving comments under the post.
"Who is this Star River? Has anyone heard of this person?"
"No idea, could it be the leader of the first group in zone 107?"
"Never heard of it, isn’t the first group in zone 107 the Dusk Mercenaries? The president is Black Eagle."
Everyone was completely baffled.
Meanwhile, Han Xing’s vote count kept rising.
From 3700, it officially surpassed 4000.
As the post’s popularity increased, more survivors clicked into the post.
Half an hour later, Han Xing overtook Boundless and became number one.
Not only were the survivors of zone 101 surprised, but those from other zones were equally bewildered.
"What’s going on? Why are the votes for this Star River still rising?"
"Yeah, what’s up with the people from zone 107? Why are they only voting for him?"
"It’s so strange..."
Another half hour later, Han Xing’s vote count reached 5000, claiming first place in an overwhelming manner!
Everyone was astonished.
Of course, this list is merely the result of voting among survivors and holds no actual significance.
However, the name Star River quickly caught the attention of major teams across various zones that very night.

After witnessing the lively scene, Cheng Jianyong laughed heartily and said, "Look at those people arguing so fiercely, I bet they never would have guessed that in the end, Brother Xing would take first place."
Zhang Lianmeng looked with admiration and said, "Yes, Brother Xing is an idol in the hearts of many people in zone 107!"
Through previous transactions, Han Xing had left a deep impression on the survivors of zone 107.
Moreover, his competitors, Black Shadow and Papaya Star Spirit, are more low-key individuals.
So most survivors from zone 107, upon seeing the voting list, immediately thought of Star River.
Thus, he deservedly claimed first place.
But Han Xing shook his head with a smile and said, "Taking first place is not necessarily a good thing."
Everyone looked toward him.
Han Xing explained, "After tonight, it’s likely that many people will remember my name, and in the eyes of those major teams, they might subconsciously regard me as a competitor."
"To learn about me, they’ll gather intelligence from the survivors of zone 107, and by then, some of my stuff might get exposed."
Han Xing possesses many special things and can even be said to be the wealthiest person in zone 107, which is a consensus.
Everyone nodded in sudden realization.
"I see, so whoever takes first place will face this situation. Isn’t Dust Contract afraid of offending people by posting this?
Han Xing shook his head, "He’s a smart guy, since he managed to compile this list in such a short time, he likely has a major team backing him up."

"And if Dust Contract can capitalize on this wave of popularity, it can provide a lot of help for his team in the future, at least, he has gained some influence in this channel of hundreds of thousands of people."
At this moment, Han Xing thought of another woman.
Tangxin Mumu.
She, like Dust Contract, possesses a vision that surpasses ordinary people.
In addition, Han Xing had promised her that he would accept an interview from her later.
But due to recent happenings, neither party had been able to get in touch.
Just then, Han Xing got up, clapped his hands, and said, "Alright, it’s getting late, everyone should go and rest."
Han Xing took out the Dark Fire Stone which was still releasing heat.
Everyone dispersed.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun returned to their territory.
Su Xiaoyang was invited warmly by Zhang Lianmeng and entered Han Xing’s castle with a flushed face.
Don’t misunderstand, it’s Zhang Lianmeng’s room.
The two girls shared a room.
Han Xing stayed outside the territory alone.
Because he had things to do.
Han Xing needed to prepare for the next transaction.
He was planning to mass-produce purple space backpacks.
The primary goal was to stockpile the material ’strong beast hide.’
He opened the trading channel and then filtered by keywords.
With a district of over 900,000 people, resources were abundantly rich.
Even something as precious as strong beast hide had over a thousand consignment posts.
Han Xing glanced over casually.
[Consignment Info]: Strong Beast Hide*5
[Required Items]: Spirit Core*10000, or one piece of purple equipment, or Mithril*10, or a large quantity of other materials.
[Consignor]: Non-spending Emperor of Luck.
Seller’s Note: Strong beast hide for sale, can be used to craft purple leather armor, if you have other materials, you can inquire with a price.
[Consignment Info]: Strong Beast Hide*7
[Required Items]: Spirit Core*14000, ...
Their asking prices were similar; one strong beast hide equaled approximately 2000 Spirit Cores.
By now, survivors had realized the importance of Spirit Cores, needed for many purposes.
Besides Spirit Cores, other materials like refined iron and rare earth also had their uses.
Especially when constructing territorial facilities, the numbers needed were enormous.
Han Xing now had over 20 million Spirit Cores, an astonishing number.
To save time, he didn’t bother negotiating with these people and bought them all with Spirit Cores.
The consignment function of the trading post was convenient.
Once you set the price, you don’t need to click to trade on each one.
As long as the other party gives the material you set for exchange, the trade can be automatically completed.
System prompts appeared continuously.
[Transaction successful, you gained Strong Beast Hide*5, you lost Spirit Core*1000...]
[Transaction successful, you gained Strong Beast Hide*7, you lost Mithril*142...]
[Transaction successful...]
Han Xing began large-scale shopping, and unless the prices seemed outrageous, he would buy up the consignment listings for strong beast hide outright.
Within minutes.
Of over a thousand consignment listings for strong beast hide in the trading channel, he bought up more than seven hundred of them.
Han Xing experienced being a big spender.
Over a million Spirit Cores were traded away in addition to other materials, resulting in him acquiring a total of 4732 strong beast hides.
Adding up his beast hide reserves, he could now craft over 1300 purple backpacks.
With these 1300 backpacks alone, Han Xing was confident he could reap returns in several folds, even dozens of folds alongside his costs!
The importance of purple backpacks was akin to a piece of golden equipment.
Currently, any piece of golden equipment in the trading channel has prices exceeding 400,000 Spirit Cores.
Moreover, even if you have that many Spirit Cores, you can’t buy it.
Because at this stage, possessors of golden equipment are powerhouses, and they wouldn’t trade for materials but would only exchange for equipment of the same level; it’s priced but unavailable.
Right as Han Xing continued shopping.
He suddenly noticed a shift in the trading channel’s strong beast hide prices.
From 2000 Spirit Cores per hide, it rose to 3000 per hide in a short span.
If one or two people increased the price, it would be understandable.
But now, it seemed that many all received the news simultaneously and raised prices together.
Han Xing sharply realized something was off.
"Someone is deliberately hiking the price of strong beast hide!" Han Xing’s expression turned stern.
He quickly figured out what was happening.
There’s no shortage of smart people in this world, especially some who are exceptionally sensitive to market price fluctuations.
Seeing a large number of strong beast hides quickly being traded, they might have seen profit potential and started manipulating market prices.
As for the method, it’s quite simple.
Do you see each consignment listing has the consignor’s ID? Just message them one by one.
Han Xing smirked.
Raising prices, huh?
Fine, I’ll just stop buying.
He had ways to make them offload their strong beast hides.
Coincidentally, Han Xing was planning a large-scale transaction soon.

After witnessing the lively scene, Cheng Jianyong laughed heartily and said, "Look at those people arguing so fiercely, I bet they never would have guessed that in the end, Brother Xing would take first place."
Zhang Lianmeng looked with admiration and said, "Yes, Brother Xing is an idol in the hearts of many people in zone 107!"
Through previous transactions, Han Xing had left a deep impression on the survivors of zone 107.
Moreover, his competitors, Black Shadow and Papaya Star Spirit, are more low-key individuals.
So most survivors from zone 107, upon seeing the voting list, immediately thought of Star River.
Thus, he deservedly claimed first place.
But Han Xing shook his head with a smile and said, "Taking first place is not necessarily a good thing."
Everyone looked toward him.
Han Xing explained, "After tonight, it’s likely that many people will remember my name, and in the eyes of those major teams, they might subconsciously regard me as a competitor."
"To learn about me, they’ll gather intelligence from the survivors of zone 107, and by then, some of my stuff might get exposed."
Han Xing possesses many special things and can even be said to be the wealthiest person in zone 107, which is a consensus.
Everyone nodded in sudden realization.
"I see, so whoever takes first place will face this situation.
Isn’t Dust Contract afraid of offending people by posting this?
Han Xing shook his head, "He’s a smart guy, since he managed to compile this list in such a short time, he likely has a major team backing him up."

"And if Dust Contract can capitalize on this wave of popularity, it can provide a lot of help for his team in the future, at least, he has gained some influence in this channel of hundreds of thousands of people."
At this moment, Han Xing thought of another woman.
Tangxin Mumu.
She, like Dust Contract, possesses a vision that surpasses ordinary people.
In addition, Han Xing had promised her that he would accept an interview from her later.
But due to recent happenings, neither party had been able to get in touch.
Just then, Han Xing got up, clapped his hands, and said, "Alright, it’s getting late, everyone should go and rest."
Han Xing took out the Dark Fire Stone which was still releasing heat.
Everyone dispersed.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun returned to their territory.
Su Xiaoyang was invited warmly by Zhang Lianmeng and entered Han Xing’s castle with a flushed face.
Don’t misunderstand, it’s Zhang Lianmeng’s room.
The two girls shared a room.
Han Xing stayed outside the territory alone.
Because he had things to do.
Han Xing needed to prepare for the next transaction.
He was planning to mass-produce purple space backpacks.
The primary goal was to stockpile the material ’strong beast hide.’
He opened the trading channel and then filtered by keywords.
With a district of over 900,000 people, resources were abundantly rich.
Even something as precious as strong beast hide had over a thousand consignment posts.
Han Xing glanced over casually.
[Consignment Info]: Strong Beast Hide*5
[Required Items]: Spirit Core*10000, or one piece of purple equipment, or Mithril*10, or a large quantity of other materials.
[Consignor]: Non-spending Emperor of Luck.
Seller’s Note: Strong beast hide for sale, can be used to craft purple leather armor, if you have other materials, you can inquire with a price.
[Consignment Info]: Strong Beast Hide*7
[Required Items]: Spirit Core*14000, ...
Their asking prices were similar; one strong beast hide equaled approximately 2000 Spirit Cores.
By now, survivors had realized the importance of Spirit Cores, needed for many purposes.
Besides Spirit Cores, other materials like refined iron and rare earth also had their uses.
Especially when constructing territorial facilities, the numbers needed were enormous.
Han Xing now had over 20 million Spirit Cores, an astonishing number.
To save time, he didn’t bother negotiating with these people and bought them all with Spirit Cores.
The consignment function of the trading post was convenient.
Once you set the price, you don’t need to click to trade on each one.
As long as the other party gives the material you set for exchange, the trade can be automatically completed.
System prompts appeared continuously.
[Transaction successful, you gained Strong Beast Hide*5, you lost Spirit Core*1000...]
[Transaction successful, you gained Strong Beast Hide*7, you lost Mithril*142...]
[Transaction successful...]
Han Xing began large-scale shopping, and unless the prices seemed outrageous, he would buy up the consignment listings for strong beast hide outright.
Within minutes.
Of over a thousand consignment listings for strong beast hide in the trading channel, he bought up more than seven hundred of them.
Han Xing experienced being a big spender.
Over a million Spirit Cores were traded away in addition to other materials, resulting in him acquiring a total of 4732 strong beast hides.
Adding up his beast hide reserves, he could now craft over 1300 purple backpacks.
With these 1300 backpacks alone, Han Xing was confident he could reap returns in several folds, even dozens of folds alongside his costs!
The importance of purple backpacks was akin to a piece of golden equipment.
Currently, any piece of golden equipment in the trading channel has prices exceeding 400,000 Spirit Cores.
Moreover, even if you have that many Spirit Cores, you can’t buy it.
Because at this stage, possessors of golden equipment are powerhouses, and they wouldn’t trade for materials but would only exchange for equipment of the same level; it’s priced but unavailable.
Right as Han Xing continued shopping.
He suddenly noticed a shift in the trading channel’s strong beast hide prices.
From 2000 Spirit Cores per hide, it rose to 3000 per hide in a short span.
If one or two people increased the price, it would be understandable.
But now, it seemed that many all received the news simultaneously and raised prices together.
Han Xing sharply realized something was off.
"Someone is deliberately hiking the price of strong beast hide!" Han Xing’s expression turned stern.
He quickly figured out what was happening.
There’s no shortage of smart people in this world, especially some who are exceptionally sensitive to market price fluctuations.
Seeing a large number of strong beast hides quickly being traded, they might have seen profit potential and started manipulating market prices.
As for the method, it’s quite simple.
Do you see each consignment listing has the consignor’s ID?
Just message them one by one.
Han Xing smirked.
Raising prices, huh?
Fine, I’ll just stop buying.
He had ways to make them offload their strong beast hides.
Coincidentally, Han Xing was planning a large-scale transaction soon.

chapters.title: Chapter 126 - 110: The Deal! Assets Doubled!
paragraphs: Han Xing is preparing for a large-scale trade soon.
He looked at his warehouse.
During his free time these days, he often kept the crafting interface open and mass-produced backpacks.
Now, he has over four thousand space backpacks, all of a blue grade.
Han Xing searched the market price for space backpacks.
After a system filter, over three thousand consignment listings popped up.
Such a large number of backpacks was expected.
Since each major region’s server first kill earns a backpack blueprint, the market circulation of space backpacks is quite significant.
However, even with blueprints, they do not have Han Xing’s unique advantage.
The SSS-level talent comes with a 100% success rate and usually crafts the highest quality.
On the market, those space backpacks not only have extremely low quality but also have much less space capacity than those made by Han Xing.
Yet even so, their prices are insanely high.
Even a backpack with just 100 slots dares to be priced at 20,000 Spirit Cores.
And a 150-slot backpack has its price escalated to 50,000 Spirit Cores.
"These guys really dare to price high," Han Xing complained.

Han Xing continued browsing consignment information and discovered that, surprisingly, some survivors from area 107 flipped the blue backpacks bought from Han Xing back on the trade channel, pricing them at 80,000!
Why is Han Xing so sure these backpacks were bought from him?
Because these backpacks were all treasures, with a space cap of 200 slots, and Han Xing had additionally added a Chaos Rune effect.
These survivors from area 107 previously only spent 20,000 Spirit Cores to exchange for a blue backpack from Han Xing.
Now, listing them on the trade channel, they could make three or four times the profit in one flip.
It is only now they realized.
How fair Han Xing’s set price was back then. Buying one was like earning money!
Many people regretted in their hearts for not buying more at that time, missing out on such a good opportunity to get rich!
Recently, some even private messaged Han Xing, hoping to purchase another batch of blue backpacks from him.
However, as Han Xing set his system to reject messages from strangers, he only opens it during trades.
So, they couldn’t contact him even if they wanted to.
After checking the market price for space backpacks, Han Xing had a general idea of the price.
Thus, Han Xing quietly listed a consignment.
[Consignment Item]: Space Backpack (Blue)
[Required Items]: Spirit Core*50000, Mithril*500, Permanent Gold Ingot*20, Strong Beast Hide*25, Refined Iron...
[Consignor]: Star River

Seller’s Note: Treasure Backpack, 200 slots, comes with a Chaos Rune, limited quantity, first come, first served. Those with building blueprints or other materials can contact me for a trade privately.
A treasure backpack priced at 50,000 Spirit Cores stirred up a frenzy among survivors at midnight.
First were those survivors from area 107; they recognized the name Star River, of course.
"Brothers, quickly check the trade channel, Star River God is selling blue space backpacks again!"
"Oh my, finally! I’ve been waiting for this day for so long! I missed the chance when Star River God was selling before, it hurt for a long time!"
"Charge in, grabbing one is like making a profit!"
Survivors from other regions also saw the news but did not know Han Xing’s past deeds, so they curiously asked.
"Who is Star River? What’s the deal with space backpacks?"
"I seem to have heard this name, there was just a popularity ranking post, with Star River at the top."
"Popularity first? Does that mean this Star River really is a legendary figure?"
With curiosity in their hearts, when they clicked on the trade channel, they were instantly shocked by the attributes of the space backpack!
"Wow... 200 slots of storage space, that’s powerful!
"But it requires 50,000 Spirit Cores, that’s a bit expensive, all my assets combined are only 40,000 spirit cores."
Someone immediately retorted, "Upstairs, do you even know what you are talking about?"
"This is a 200-slot backpack, see how much others are selling for? You can’t get one even for 80,000!"
"Indeed, if you can’t afford it, don’t buy it. 50,000 Spirit Cores, this is practically a giveaway!"
"Hurry and contact the group leader, a batch of treasure backpacks has appeared on the trade channel at a very cheap price!"
At that point, many people remembered something and quickly contacted the leaders within their teams.
When those team leaders saw the backpack’s attributes, they gasped in shock.
They immediately decided to mobilize all possible resources to secure the backpacks from Han Xing!
For a while, the midnight chat channel was engulfed in a purchasing frenzy.
"Hahaha, I got one!"
"I got one too, thanks to the 107 area brothers’ reminder, otherwise I might have missed this chance!"
"Thanks, Star River God!"
"No wonder Star River is so popular among people in area 107, if it were me, I’d like it too!"
Listening to everyone’s praise for Star River, an inexplicable sense of pride arose in the hearts of other area 107 survivors!
Many even voluntarily started advertising for Han Xing.
"That’s right, Star God is our pride in area 107."
"Star God’s products are guaranteed to be quality!"
The trade channel’s grand occasion lasted for more than half an hour.
When Han Xing’s batch of over four thousand space backpacks had all been traded away.
He once again reaped a massive amount of materials.
The reserve of Spirit Cores directly increased by over seventy million, and combined with his own reserves, it reached 98 million, just a little short of breaking 100 million.
The other various materials multiplied several times over!
Among them were high-end materials like Permanent Gold Ingots and Strong Beast Hides, and he acquired thousands through trading!
The only pity was that he didn’t get any impressive building blueprints.
However, Han Xing knew that while the temptation of the blue backpack was great, it couldn’t compare to building blueprints.
Even if they had some, people probably wouldn’t be willing to trade them.
After this event, the name Star River is likely to be etched into many people’s memories.
After collecting the massive materials into the Storage Box from the territory, Han Xing prepared to return to his room to rest.
As he passed by Zhang Lianmeng’s room, he faintly heard the giggles of two girls.
Han Xing even heard Su Xiaoyang exclaim.
Saying something like, "Oh my, so big, so white," and other such misleading remarks.
He hurriedly ran upstairs.
The next day...
As Han Xing just opened his eyes.
The system notification appeared again.

[Cloud Secret Realm update is complete. To speed up the passage time for survivors, the secret realm process has been simplified. Now, except for special secret realms, there will be no more cut-scenes. Additionally, the generation probability of the Cloud Secret Realm has been increased.]
A moment later, Han Xing and the others gathered on the lawn of the territory.
Shen Yun said, "Brother Xing, with this update, the system has increased the generation probability of the Cloud Secret Realm. Doesn’t it feel like the system is urging us to level up faster?"
Han Xing nodded, "It does feel that way. It might be related to the impending Blood Tide; it seems this disaster is quite severe..."
After hearing this, everyone’s faces showed a serious expression.

To avoid discouraging the crowd, Han Xing continued, "However, it did take too long just to pass through a secret realm once before. Not counting the travel time, it took at least one or two hours. This change is pretty good.
"With our strength, challenging the leaderboard will also become much easier."
Shen Yun nodded.
At this moment, everyone glanced at the leaderboard again.
The first place, Boundless, already had 6 points.
The second tier also had 5 points.
To be in the top hundred of the leaderboard, at least 4 points were needed.
Now, all five of them had 2 points each, ranked beyond the top thousand.
At this moment, Han Xing encouraged everyone’s spirits.
"Alright, today we also need to continue leveling up and then challenge the leaderboard."
"Let’s strive to reach level 20 quickly and complete the Second Transformation!"
"Okay!"
Everyone felt invigorated.
At this moment, their several Sky Islands had already overlapped with Han Xing’s, requiring only Han Xing alone to control them.
Within just a few minutes of proceeding.
A cloud over three thousand square meters appeared in front of them.
Though they had encountered many such large clouds before, most survivors didn’t have the strength to deal with the monsters inside.
Even Han Xing didn’t dare to challenge the monsters inside when he had just broken through to level 10; just approaching one felt like facing a strong sense of danger.
But now, after some time of development.
Both their equipment and attributes had improved significantly.
Approaching such a vast Sky Island now, the sense of danger greatly diminished.
At this point, a system prompt appeared.
[A peculiar bamboo grove grows inside, occupied by a group of cold-blooded animals. Do you want to enter?]
Han Xing clicked to confirm.
The cloud dissipated, revealing a vast expanse of greenery before their eyes.
Everyone saw that on this large Sky Island, rows upon rows of healthy green bamboo were flourishing, and as the wind blew, the forest echoed with the faint sounds of insects and birds.
Han Xing and the others also saw the attributes of these bamboo plants before them.
[Jade Core Bamboo]: A special plant. Every so often, a bamboo core with special effects will grow in the middle of the Jade Core Bamboo.
Note: The bamboo core is consumable and can permanently increase a survivor’s Spirit Attribute by 5 points. Each survivor can consume it up to three times.
"This Sky Island is quite interesting." Shen Yun first commented.
Everyone nodded.
"It really is interesting. This bamboo core is a good item; it can increase Spirit, making it practically a divine artifact for Mages and the Holy Profession," Cheng Jianyong admired.
The functionality of the Jade Core Bamboo is indeed pretty good.
If it can be mass-planted, it would equate to a renewable resource.
Items that can increase attributes like this, if placed in the trading channel, would surely cause a frenzy, and it is considered a unique resource in this world.
The Sky Island, which spanned over three thousand square meters, was equivalent to the size of a school playground.

Inside, there were at least thousands of fully matured Jade Core Bamboo, in addition to nearly ten thousand still growing or in their juvenile stage bamboo plants, with a high plant coverage rate in the forest.
However, they also heard the system prompt.
Apart from the Jade Core Bamboo, there was also a group of monsters residing inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 127 - 111: The First Resource Sky Island
paragraphs: The system said there were monsters inside. If it were an ordinary Sky Island, Han Xing would have swept through with siege crossbow arrows by now.
A range of five kilometers would be enough to comprehensively cover and strike.
However, doing so would destroy the bamboo forest’s ecology.
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing decided to lead everyone in and slowly clear out the monsters inside.
Shortly after stepping into the bamboo forest, a few soft-bodied creatures suddenly dangled down from above, attacking Han Xing at lightning speed.
"Watch out!" Shen Yun hurriedly warned from behind.
Feeling the wind from behind, Han Xing quickly rolled on the spot.
He discovered that a green venomous snake, only as thick as a thumb, had appeared where he originally stood.
[Green Shadow Snake (Two-Star Ordinary Creatures)]
[Level]: lv15
[Skills]: Intermediate Neurotoxin, Rapid Assault.
There are monsters!
Han Xing was instantly on alert.
The reason why he hadn’t noticed them earlier while passing by.
Was because these creatures’ skin was too similar in color to Jade Core Bamboo, making them hard to detect without a close look.
Moreover, there was more than just one.
After the first snake’s sneak attack failed, at least dozens of Green Shadow Snakes dangled down from above.
"Prepare for battle!"
Han Xing was the first to draw his bow and arrow, and the Wind Chasing Arrow was released.
The arrow precisely hit the head of the Green Shadow Snake on the ground.
Poof!
Headshot.
The arrow pierced through the Green Shadow Snake’s head, pinning it to the ground. It twisted frantically, and after struggling for a few seconds, it ceased to live.
"Hiss! Hiss hiss!"
In the air, the snake swarm attacked the group.
At this moment, Shen Yun raised the Holy Hammer high and shouted, "Submit to the Holy Light!"
Bam!
The hammer, covered with a layer of holy light, struck the ground, erupting into a brilliant flash!
The snake swarm suddenly suffered from the scorching holy light, the intense light robbing them of their vision.

[Power of Radiance]: Passive Skill, all skill effects of the Radiant Knight are increased by 20%, all attacks add a Holy Light Punishment effect, during defensive state, an additional layer of holy light effect is added to the shield, reducing received damage by 20%.
This skill added a layer of Holy Light Punishment to Shen Yun’s ordinary attacks.
Previously, everyone did not understand what this meant.
But now, they realized that the so-called Holy Light Punishment effect was indeed formidable.
It directly turned Shen Yun’s attacks into area attacks, and even added a blinding effect, truly terrifying.
Everyone looked at Shen Yun in surprise as he displayed a slight smug smile at the corner of his mouth.
Cheng Jianyong opened his mouth to complain, "Showing off!"
After speaking, he raised his great sword and cut a Silver Shadow Snake in half with a single strike.
Shen Yun ignored his taunt, swinging the hammer continuously.
Bang! Bang bang!
With each hammer strike, the group felt waves of white light flash before their eyes, even interfering with their combat.
Cheng Jianyong seemed a bit overwhelmed at this moment and said, "Damn it, stop smashing, our brothers are almost blinded by you!"
Shen Yun was about to retort, but he saw that Han Xing and Zhang Lianmeng were also closing their eyes.
At this moment, Shen Yun realized that the holy light effect accompanying his attacks was indeed a bit too dazzling.
He scratched his head and said awkwardly, "You guys go ahead, you guys go ahead, hehe, I’ll just support you."
After speaking, he cast a Blessing of Courage on Zhang Lianmeng.
Zhang Lianmeng felt a strong power surge from within her body.
Then, she unleashed a group magic spell.
"Lightning Chain!
Crackle... Crackle, crackle!
The magic staff released a massive amount of lightning power, pouring towards the Green Shadow Snake swarm.
The next moment, dozens of Green Shadow Snakes stiffened simultaneously, then convulsed violently.
When the effect of the lightning chain dissipated.
On the ground, only charred corpses of Green Shadow Snakes remained.
Zhang Lianmeng slightly opened her mouth in surprise and said, "What... a powerful amplification effect!"
Her magic damage was already high, and with Shen Yun’s blessing, her attack power soared by another 20%.
In one wave, she even completed a clearing effect.
Everyone was amazed by the effect of the Blessing of Courage.
Cheng Jianyong quickly said, "Damn, Xiaoyunzi, give me a blessing too, so I can rush in and slaughter them crazily!"
Shen Yun gave him a sidelong glance, "The cooldown isn’t over yet."
"Alright," Cheng Jianyong replied disappointedly.
After Zhang Lianmeng’s clearing wave.
The threat from the Green Shadow Snake swarm was mostly eliminated.
Then, Han Xing and Su Xiaoyang transformed into machine gun shooters, madly firing arrows to clear out the remaining Green Shadow Snakes.
With Han Xing’s Madness Skill increasing his hit rate by 100%, it could be said that as long as he didn’t intentionally shoot astray, he could basically hit the enemy.
With each shot, he could precisely hit either the Green Shadow Snake’s head or its vitals.
As for Su Xiaoyang, although her hit rate wasn’t as high as Han Xing’s, her attack speed was much faster than his.
Pow pow pow!
In no time, the ground was littered with Green Shadow Snake corpses in all directions.
The silhouette of Coal Ball flickered, constantly performing finishing moves.
Two minutes, the group of Green Shadow Snakes declared completely wiped out.
System notifications started flooding the screen at this time
[Killed Green Shadow Snake (Two-Star Creatures), gained 4500 Experience Value.]
[Killed Green Shadow Snake (Two-Star Creatures), gained...]
One Green Shadow Snake gave 4500 experience points, totaling 73, which is nearly 330,000 experience points.
At this moment, a white light rose from Shen Yun’s body.
Yesterday he reset his profession and dropped back to Level 10, now after this wave of monster farming, he’s directly leveled up to Level 11.
Shen Yun immediately put back on those pieces of equipment with level requirements, greatly boosting his attributes again.
Then, Shen Yun exclaimed, "Team play is great, if it were usually just Cheng Jianyong and me, we’d probably get mobbed to death by this group of Green Ring Snakes with just one encounter."
"Even if we could beat them, it would take a long time."
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, now that the system has adjusted, even monsters inside the Sky Island give a lot of experience, everyone’s leveling up speed will be improved."
Shen Yun asked, "Brother Xing, how much more do you need to reach Level 15?"
Han Xing looked at his experience bar and replied, "Almost there, currently at 63%."
330,000 experience points directly gave him a 21% increase in experience, calculating it this way, from Level 14 to Level 15, requires nearly 1.57 million experience points.
"Not much more, should be able to reach Level 15 today."
Everyone nodded, once Han Xing reaches Level 15, he can equip the Kingdom Ring, by then his strength will be boosted again.
At this moment, everyone suddenly heard a scream from behind.
"Aooo!!!"
They turned around and saw Cheng Jianyong, who was cleaning up the battlefield.
Shen Yun glared over, "Cheng Jianyong, what are you screaming for?"
At this point, Cheng Jianyong was speaking in terror, "Damn it! I got bitten!"
Everyone quickly raised their weapons, however, they didn’t find any trace of the Green Shadow Snake.
Then, Cheng Jianyong turned around, with a Green Shadow Snake over a meter long hanging from his butt.
Han Xing: "..."
Shen Yun: "..."
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang both turned their faces away, a bit embarrassed to look.
This scene immediately amused everyone.
"Hahaha, idiot!" Shen Yun didn’t hold back in mocking.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed excitedly, "Come on, stop laughing, quickly help me get this poisonous snake off my butt!"
Han Xing, upon hearing, directly shot an arrow, effortlessly piercing through the seven inches of the Green Ring Snake.
Phtang!
The corpse of the Green Shadow Snake fell off Cheng Jianyong’s butt.
However, even after the crisis was averted, Cheng Jianyong’s complexion didn’t improve.
Not only that, his entire skin was rapidly turning blue and purple,
Cheng Jianyong said tremblingly, "Oh no, I think I’m poisoned by the snake, Xiaoyunzi, quickly suck it out for me!"
Shen Yun gave him a blank look, "Suck your sister, wait for death!"
"Damn it, are you a real brother?" Cheng Jianyong was utterly incredulous.
Of course, everyone knew Shen Yun was joking.
With that, Shen Yun directly cast a ’Purification Technique’ on Cheng Jianyong.
The gentle Power of Holy Light entered his body, and Cheng Jianyong immediately felt the snake venom within him dissolve instantly like snow under a scorching sun.
Within seconds, Cheng Jianyong’s complexion returned to normal.
He let out a long sigh and laughed, "Not bad, Xiaoyunzi, after changing profession to Radiant Knight, even the Purification Technique is so awesome."
The passive skill of the Radiant Knight is to enhance the effects of all skills by 20%, including the Purification Technique.
After the battle ended.
Han Xing looked at the corpses strewn across the ground.
He remembered that on the Green Shadow Snake’s panel, there was an Intermediate Divine-level Poison Skill.
"Intermediate... should be more potent than Basic Neurotoxin."
Venom like this can be applied to arrows, carrying a strong poison effect.
Han Xing had tried it before, the effect was remarkable.
Cheng Jianyong personally testified this properly, Level 15 Green Shadow Snake venom could cause severe damage to these Two-Star Professionals.
And the speed of venom corroding the nerves is extremely fast, if not for Shen Yun’s timely Purification Technique, within half a minute, Cheng Jianyong might be fully corroded by the poison.
Thinking of this, Han Xing immediately decided to collect all the venom sacs from these Green Ring Snakes.
[Do you want to dismantle Green Ring Snake corpse*74...]
"Yes."
[Dismantling successful, obtained Two-star Beast Hide*74, obtained Snake meat*203, obtained Green Shadow Snake Venom Sac*74, obtained Snake Gall...]
Han Xing felt pleased, 74 venom gallbladders, each can enchant 300 or so arrows with poisonous effect, enough for him to use for a long time.
After clearing this wave of monsters, the team continued deeper into the bamboo forest.
The Sky Island is over three thousand square meters, not too big or too small.
After walking for a minute or two, the team finally reached the center of the bamboo forest.
But after this, they didn’t encounter any more monsters.
At this moment, a system notification arrived.
[You have successfully explored this Sky Island, the Sky Island Territory is currently unclaimed, you can choose to merge it into your territory or abandon it.]
The five of them looked at each other.
Han Xing asked, "Who wants this territory?"
Everyone glanced at each other and shook their heads.
Han Xing did not stand on ceremony, directly said, "Alright, then I’ll merge it."
The Jade Core Bamboo resources on this Sky Island territory are quite good.

[Successfully merged Sky Island Territory, you obtained Sky Island Fragment*3746, obtained Territory Resources Jade Core Bamboo (Mature Period)*3451, Jade Core Bamboo (Seedling Period)*10142, Green Ring Snake Eggs*123, Spring Water*412...]

chapters.title: Chapter 128 - 112: Crushing Victory and Clues to Witch Root Grass!
paragraphs: A large pile of resources was merged into Han Xing’s territory.
At this moment, a bamboo forest appeared on the outskirts of Han Xing’s Sky Island.
In the territory panel, there was an introduction to the attributes of Jade Core Bamboo and its specific quantity.
Han Xing could even see which Jade Core Bamboos had matured and could have their green cores picked, and which were still in the growth stage, requiring a few more days to mature.
Of course, these Jade Core Bamboos could also be forced to mature with bone meal.
However, Han Xing couldn’t be bothered to manage them and planned to grant Zhang Lianmeng access to take care of them later.
He directly picked a dozen or so green bamboo cores from the territory and distributed three to each person.
This thing could increase the survivor’s spirit attribute by 5 points; three would total 15 points, which is quite effective.
In front of everyone, Han Xing directly swallowed the bamboo core in one gulp.
This thing felt a bit cool in his hand and, once in his mouth, it felt like jelly, with a hint of sweetness and plenty of moisture.
At this point, a system prompt appeared.
[Successfully consumed Jade Bamboo Core *1, Spirit Attribute +5...]
After digesting the harvest from this bamboo forest Sky Island, everyone moved forward again.
Not far off, a large cloud, spanning one or two thousand square meters, appeared in front of them.
Upon entering, they unexpectedly found that it was a field of herbs.
Inside, a plant called Black Soul Grass was growing.
[Black Soul Grass]: One of the raw materials for a certain secret elixir recipe, can be consumed directly with a slight healing effect on psychic damage.
"Psychic damage? Is it a type of magic damage?" Cheng Jianyong asked.
Zhang Lianmeng explained at this time, "It should be, I remember that another profession branch of the Mage, the Illusionist, has a skill called Mental Shock."
After listening to Zhang Lianmeng’s explanation, everyone finally understood.
This Black Soul Grass material was considered one of the rarer secret elixir raw materials, and if they obtained the recipe in the future, it could be gathered and produced in batches.
However, there was also a monster guarding this herbal field.
A Deep Blue Demon Bear, level 15, elite level.
Its entire body was covered with deep blue fur, with a body about seven to eight meters long, giving off a strong sense of oppression.
Especially when this monster stood up, it reached an astonishing height of ten meters, truly a behemoth.
"Roar!"
The Azure Demon Bear roared, carrying terrifying power, and pounced toward the group.
This time, however, there was no need for anyone to take action.
Han Xing directly controlled the crossbow arrow launcher platform and, from a distance of one or two kilometers, fired five giant crossbow arrows at once.
Thud thud thud!
Two missed.
The other three giant crossbow arrows, with terrifying attack power, directly hit the massive body of the Azure Demon Bear.
The tough bear hide of the Azure Demon Bear was instantly pierced, with giant arrows deeply embedded in its abdomen.
Two blue columns of blood spurted out.
Suffering a sudden heavy blow, the Azure Demon Bear’s eyes turned blank, then instantly turned completely red.
It roared and charged madly toward Han Xing and his group.
The life force of a Two-Star Elite Monster was still quite strong; despite such severe injuries, it remained active.
If it were a typical level 15 survivor squad, they would likely be in disarray by now, then wiped out by the Azure Demon Bear in retaliation.
However, Han Xing’s firepower was even more formidable.
As the Azure Demon Bear charged over, a second wave of crossbow arrows was fired simultaneously.
This time, it was a volley of ten arrows.
The Azure Demon Bear couldn’t dodge in time, and five or six more giant crossbow arrows struck its body, halting its charge.
This was a truly devastating blow.
The Azure Demon Bear’s massive size became its weakness.
Under everyone’s astonished gaze, the Azure Demon Bear fell down.
This behemoth, capable of annihilating an entire survivor squad, couldn’t even touch the hem of their garments before being directly overwhelmed by Han Xing’s firepower.
This is the powerful attack of a siege crossbow.
However, strangely, despite killing the Azure Demon Bear, the system did not prompt anything.
Shen Yun seemed to notice this as well and asked, "Brother Xing, doesn’t using territory buildings to kill monsters give experience points?"
Han Xing thought for a moment and nodded, "It seems that way."
Everyone was taken aback.
But after thinking about it, it made sense.

This might be a restriction from the system to prevent survivors like Han Xing from mass-building territory structures and slaughtering other Sky Island monsters, which would allow their leveling speed to greatly exceed other survivors.
There was a hint of regret among the group.
The plan to quickly level up using siege crossbows was shattered.
At this time, Han Xing comforted them, "But it doesn’t matter; although there’s no experience reward, there are item rewards."
"Look, isn’t the body of that elite monster still there?"
Everyone’s eyes lit up.
Han Xing went up to the Azure Demon Bear and disassembled it.
[Successfully dismantled Azure Demon Bear carcass (Two-Star Elite Creature), obtained Thick Bear Meat *473, acquired Quality Leather *3, gained Damaged Leather *8, obtained Bear Paw...]
Because so many giant crossbow arrows were embedded in the Azure Demon Bear, it damaged the integrity of its leather.
After dealing with the territory monster, this Sky Island was in an unclaimed state and could either be merged or abandoned.
Han Xing clicked merge.
[Successfully merged, your territory has expanded, and you have gained territory resources: Fertile Land *2741, Black Soul Grass *1723, and Witch Root Grass *106...]
A large pile of territory resources was acquired.
Han Xing noticed one specific material mentioned in the system prompt.
Witch Root Grass.
