chapters.title: Chapter 129 - 112: Crushing Victory and the Clue to Witch Root Grass!
paragraphs: He remembered that one of the materials needed to create the Blood Curse Antidote Formula was Witch Root Grass.
Han Xing quickly walked to the herb field, with a faintly cool medicinal fragrance entering his nostrils.
Across the entire herb field, most of it was covered with a dark purple herb.
Occasionally, a puff of black smoke would emit from the leaves, these should be Black Soul Grass.

And in the middle of the Black Soul Grass, there were sporadically one or two dark red herbs growing, their leaves resembling the Sanqi Grass on Blue Star, except they faintly had blood vessel-like veins.
Han Xing squatted down and murmured softly, "Is this Witch Root Grass?"
A prompt appeared before him.

[Witch Root Grass]: A special herb, developed as a new species by the seventeenth generation Witch Race Saintess with her life after the decline of the Witch Race, behind it lies a tear-jerking tragic story.
Han Xing was delighted in his heart, he didn’t care about the Witch Race Saintess’s tragic story, but joyfully said, "Witch Root Grass, Divine Aurora, Cursed Blood."
"Great, now two of the three materials are here, just missing the last Divine Aurora!"
Han Xing was exhilarated.
The Blood Tide crisis was approaching, and he was eager to possess self-preservation power.
After merging this territory, everyone continued to explore the nearby large clouds.
However, what they encountered next were cloud islands over a thousand square meters.
Han Xing found that these large Sky Islands, more or less, always contained some territorial resources.
Such as Refined Iron Ore Veins, Rare Earth Ore Veins, Moonlight Grass Fields, Tiger Bone Grass Fields, etc.
Among these, there was no shortage of small amounts of Secret Silver Ore Veins, and sometimes one or two Permanent Gold Ore Veins could be seen.
Han Xing thought at this moment: "It seems that these large Sky Islands have a lot of resources inside."

"That is to say, as long as the survivors reach around level 15, they will have the strength to challenge the Sky Islands of this level, and by then, the speed at which everyone acquires resources will also increase significantly."
"Then various territorial buildings can be constructed, greatly enhancing survival capabilities."

However, even though most of the survivor army has completed direct advancement, it still takes a long time to reach level 15, and gathering materials to build territorial buildings will take at least another twenty days.
Han Xing was at least half a month ahead of them in progress.
And he wasn’t worried about others surpassing him.
The resources Han Xing held in his hands had already reached a terrifying number.
Next, as long as he steadily improved and then captured new leaderboard rewards.
He would be able to mass-produce stronger buildings like catapults.
By then, Han Xing would be truly invincible among players.
Thinking of these things, Han Xing’s Sky Island continued to move forward.
After advancing for more than ten minutes.
At this moment, Shen Yun suddenly narrowed his eyes, exclaiming, "Brother Xing, look ahead."
Han Xing looked in the direction of the voice and saw that, about one or two kilometers ahead, there were two uneven-sized clouds.
Both of these clouds had vortex symbols on them.
"Whoa, Cloud Secret Realms, two of them!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
At this moment, everyone also saw these two Secret Realms.
Han Xing nodded at this, saying, "Indeed, after the system update, the probability of encountering Cloud Secret Realms has increased significantly."
He led everyone to the side of the Secret Realm and saw the information above it.
[One-Star Secret Realm: Wanderer Altar, entry level 10~15, number of entrants: 1~2 people.]
[Two-Star Secret Realm, Cursed Village, entry level 10~15, number of entrants: 1~5 people.]
Two Secret Realms, one one-star, one two-star.

After pondering for a moment, Han Xing said, "The one-star Secret Realm allows only two people to enter, the difficulty is not too high, Shen Yun just re-classed, I’ll take him in first to catch up in level."
"Once we come out, we’ll go challenge the two-star Secret Realm together, what do you think?"
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang both indicated they had no objections.
Cheng Jianyong also didn’t mind and casually said, "Brother Xing, you decide."
Han Xing nodded, and then led Shen Yun towards the vortex of the one-star Secret Realm, and a system prompt appeared.
"Do you want to enter the One-Star Secret Realm: Wanderer Altar?"
"Yes."
The next moment, the figures of the two vanished.
After a brief darkness, their vision restored.
In front of them appeared a pitch-black altar, not large, only a few hundred square meters.
Both he and Shen Yun seemed to appear at the center of the altar.
There were no barriers around, but the sky here appeared extraordinarily dim.
A howling cold wind blew, occasionally bringing a chilling aura.
And right in the middle of this strange altar.
Was a group of people dressed in black robes.
At this moment, they were all kneeling on the ground.
The blue-black robes dragged on the ground, covered in dust.
As if they had been kneeling here for countless years.
A year, two years, perhaps even longer.
The attributes of these monsters appeared before Han Xing.
[Wanderer (Two-Star Creatures)]
[Level]: lv15
[Attributes]: Power 221, agility 213 (-50), Spirit 278, Constitution 244.
[Skills]: Dark Fireball, Soul Whisper.
[Wandering Priest (Two-Star Elite Creatures)]
[Level]: lv15
[Attributes]: Power 245, agility 233 (-50), Spirit 312, Constitution 266.
[Skills]: Dark Fireball, Soul Whisper, Mind Shock...
System prompt appeared,
[One-Star Secret Realm, Wanderer Altar challenge task has been activated, defeat the Secret Realm boss: Wandering Priest, and you can clear this Secret Realm.]
Hearing this prompt, both felt somewhat surprised.
"So we just have to take down this elite monster to clear it? This process is indeed much simplified." Han Xing thought.
Compared to his first clear of the Lost Palace, which not only had a first and second stage but also a hidden stage.
Now, just going in and defeating this group of monsters allows for a direct clear, greatly saving time.
However, although the process is simplified, it lacks the fun of exploration.
Han Xing remembered that in that One-Star Secret Realm, he not only found the Dwarf Race’s fine brew but also discovered the blueprint for making Spiritual Puppets.
However, as the system prompt said, once the leaderboard ends, the Cloud Secret Realm will revert to its original process.
At that time, whenever encountering a Secret Realm, it can be explored slowly.
The urgent task now is to level up quickly and secure the leaderboard rewards.
As soon as the prompt disappeared, the grayish figures of the wanderers all lifted their empty eye sockets simultaneously to look at Han Xing and the others.
Then, this group of wanderers slowly stood up from the ground.
But it seemed that because they knelt for too long, their bones had ossified.
As they stood up, a series of cracking bone sounds echoed in the two people’s ears.
At this moment, Shen Yun suddenly said without any reason, "It’s good we didn’t let Su Xiaoyang come in. If she heard this sound, she might transform into that form again..."
Han Xing heard and his mouth twitched twice.
Mainly because Su Xiaoyang’s performance at that time left such a deep impression.
They never would have thought that the seemingly fair-skinned girl, who blushed when talking to people, would turn terrifying when she went mad.
It was truly chilling!
Just then, in the middle of the wanderers, the black-robed priest emitted a hoarse voice.
"Humans... capture them and make them one of us!"
The remaining wanderers, hearing this, immediately rushed towards Han Xing and the others.
The two exchanged a glance, and Shen Yun tossed a ’Blessing of Courage’ to Han Xing.
He then raised his shield and charged into the horde of monsters fiercely.
With top-grade equipment, plus having changed to the powerful Radiant Knight, Shen Yun’s defense was astounding.
He withstood the attacks of more than a dozen wanderers without flinching.
Bang! Bang bang!
Dark fireballs hit Shen Yun’s shield without making him retreat half a step.
Just then, the elite wanderer uttered a series of strange syllables.
"Siri Hasen..."
The next moment, Shen Yun felt a burst of intense pain in his brain, his consciousness went briefly blank.
"Damn, a mental attack?"
And just then.
Coal Ball leaped into the monster horde, abruptly releasing Void Spike.
Thud thud thud!
At least three or four wanderers were pierced through by the Void Spike in Coal Ball’s strike.
These wanderers gazed dazedly at their wounds and, before their consciousness faded, spoke a few eerie lines in hoarse voices.
"Oh Goddess... I atone to you..."
"Take my soul away..."
After finishing their lines, these wanderers fell to the ground.
At this moment, Han Xing directly shot an arrow towards the sky.
Fallen Star Arrow Rain!
The next moment, meteors began to fall from the sky.
Bam! Bam bam!
Screams echoed continuously...
When the meteor shower’s explosions ceased, dozens of wanderers were cleared out in a single wave!

chapters.title: Chapter 130 - 113: Curse of the Evil God
paragraphs: For a One-Star Secret Realm with levels around 10~15, it poses no threat to them.
Dozens of Wanderers were cleared by Han Xing with this wave of Fallen Star Arrow Rain!
System notification appears.
[Killed Fallen Wanderer (Two-Star Ordinary Creatures), gained Experience Value 4600...]
[Killed Fallen Wanderer (Two-Star Elite Creatures), gained Experience Value 33200...]
[Killed...]
After a series of kill notifications, they gained a total of 220,000 experience.
At this moment, a white light rose from Shen Yun’s body once more.
In one morning, he leveled up twice, this leveling speed is quite fast indeed.
Han Xing also glanced at his own experience bar, 87%, needing just over 200,000 experience points to reach Level 15.
Then, the second system notification appeared.

[You have successfully cleared the One-Star Secret Realm: Wanderer Altar, Cloud Secret Realm Points +1, gained Experience Value reward 138,000, gained item rewards, Strong Fragment*6, Rune Crystal*420, Silver Treasure Chest*1...]
Another reward of over 100,000 experience, which is quite good.
Besides, in a One-Star Secret Realm, a Silver Treasure Chest is guaranteed, making the overall gains quite impressive.
Han Xing didn’t hesitate and opened the treasure chest directly.
Inside were still some regular materials, along with an ordinary piece of Purple Armor.
Han Xing tossed it into his backpack right away.
Then, they were transported out.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang were still whispering to each other.
But Cheng Jianyong was covered in dirt, as if he had just rolled around in a field.
Seeing Han Xing and the others emerge, the three of them were a bit stunned.
"Whoa, that quick?" Cheng Jianyong said, his face full of disbelief.
Seeing his expression, Shen Yun said proudly, "Of course, with my equipment, standing among the monsters doesn’t even let them scratch me!"
Cheng Jianyong scoffed, "Pfft, keep bragging, without Brother Xing’s attack power, you wouldn’t be able to clear the One-Star Secret Realm even within half an hour."
Shen Yun shrugged, not denying it.
At this point, Han Xing looked at the nearby cloud, which also displayed relevant information.
[Two-Star Cloud Secret Realm: Plague Village, Secret Realm Level: 10~15, Maximum Entry: 1~5 people.]
"Alright, get ready everyone, we’re going into this Two-Star Secret Realm."
The group responded by checking their backpack supplies.
After confirming nothing was missing.
Han Xing began maneuvering the Sky Island Territory towards the Two-Star Secret Realm.
System notification appeared.
[Enter Two-Star Secret Realm: Plague Village?]
"Yes."
The five of them ventured into the vortex together.
The scene flickered.
Han Xing and the others found themselves in a dark street.
Before them stood rows of abandoned mud houses, topped with bricks and tiles, akin to villages on Blue Star in the eighties or nineties.
However, these houses seemed uninhabited for a long time, with thick dust covering the roofs.
The entire village appeared to have been ravaged by fire, with black soot covering the ground and the mud house walls scorched black.
At this moment, Coal Ball suddenly moved in front of the group, sniffing the air several times.
"Sniff... sniff..."
The group watched it curiously.
Zhang Lianmeng then remarked, "Brother Xing, have you noticed? Coal Ball seems to have grown a bit?"
Han Xing also realized Coal Ball’s changes after hearing this.
After half a month’s feeding, this Little Wolf Cub, initially the size of a palm, rapidly grew to almost a meter in size.
This little creature’s appetite has become increasingly astonishing recently.
From previously eating only thirty to forty Spirit Cores a day, now no less than two hundred Spirit Cores will suffice.
With the increase in Coal Ball’s food intake, the growth speed of its Potential Value has also been enhanced.
Currently, it has a Potential Value of 2832 points.
Han Xing couldn’t help thinking, "If only we could find one or two more Legendary Creatures, Coal Ball’s Potential Value could soar even higher."
Of course, Han Xing was just thinking.
Encountering that Shadow Giant Dragon in the Secret Realm yesterday was purely luck.
According to the strength classification told by the Wild Ranger Spirit to Han Xing.
The level of Legendary Creatures is at least 50 and above.
However, due to the special nature of the Secret Realm, that Shadow Giant Dragon’s level was suppressed to be so low.
If outside, any Legendary Creature could easily obliterate the group with just a breath.
Coal Ball continued to lead the way ahead.
The group began to delve deeper into the village.
Strangely, it seemed as though the village was dead, with not a trace of human presence, eerily silent.
As they went further in, a faint odd smell started to pervade the air.
Shen Yun, walking in front, suddenly turned back and asked, "Have you smelled something?"
The group nodded.
The air was filled with a strange odor, reminiscent of a mix between potions and rotting corpses.
There was also a faint scent of blood amidst it.
Coal Ball had sensed this early on with its sharp sense of smell, hence its previous reaction.
At this moment, everyone’s expression suddenly changed.
They all received a system notification.
[You have been infected by the Evil God’s aura, afflicted with 1 layer of Curse of the Evil God, each layer of curse reduces Survivor’s All Attributes by 10%.]
[From now, each minute increases 1 layer of Curse of the Evil God, when stacking reaches 10 layers, the Survivor will undergo a terrible mutation, equivalent to death.]
[Please find the source of the plague as soon as possible, clearing the Secret Realm will automatically remove this state...]
"Damn it, did you guys get the notification? The system says I’ve been hit with a curse of the evil god and I’m about to mutate!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
Everyone exchanged glances, and all of their faces looked a bit grim.
It seemed that everyone had received the same notification.
In this system message, Han Xing noticed two key points.
Evil god’s aura and mutation!
He remembered that when he previously acquired the Blood Curse Antidote Formula, the system also mentioned that creatures infected by the curse of the evil god would undergo terrifying mutations.
It was hard not to connect these events together.
Because, in the near future, a Blood Curse was about to erupt.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong, his face pale, said: "Damn it, the Blood Curse increases by 1 layer every minute and reduces attributes by 10%. That means we have at most 9 minutes to fight?"
Han Xing murmured, "It might not even be 9 minutes. The longer we drag on, the lower our attributes get, and our combat power will be greatly reduced."
"If the boss at the end has a bit more strength..."
With this reminder, everyone realized the seriousness, their faces changing rapidly.
Time was tight, but fortunately, among them was a partner with a strong sense of smell.
Coal Ball.
"The source of the plague should be where the scent is coming from!"
Han Xing looked at the Void Ghost Wolf on the ground and said, "It’s up to you, Coal Ball."
After he finished speaking.
Coal Ball understood Han Xing’s meaning, sprang into action, and everyone followed closely behind it.
With a few maneuvers, Coal Ball led them through several streets.
This place was unremarkable, with a few dilapidated houses around.
At this moment, Coal Ball suddenly darted into an inconspicuous run-down house.
Crash!
The decayed wooden door was directly smashed open by the strong physique of the Void Ghost Wolf.
"What’s inside?"
Maintaining a cautious attitude, everyone filed in.
Inside the house, there were some old pieces of furniture covered in thick layers of black dust.
This was just an ordinary small house.
Moreover, here, that strange smell seemed to have weakened a lot.
If an average survivor team passed by here, they wouldn’t notice anything unusual.
However, Coal Ball led them straight to the bedroom area.
Inside, there was something familiar to those from the north, a heated kang.
The kang was covered with several layers of already blackened quilts.
"Is there something here?" Shen Yun asked in confusion.
At that moment, everyone suddenly felt a weakening of their power.
A minute had passed, and their All Attributes had decreased by a notch.
"Damn!" Everyone’s face fell.
But Han Xing noticed.
Coal Ball’s attributes didn’t seem to be affected.
Han Xing glanced at Coal Ball’s panel, surprised.
Because not only hadn’t its attributes diminished, there were no negative states like the curse of the evil god in its status bar.
He didn’t know if it was due to the bloodline of the Void Ghost Wolf or if pets aren’t affected by the evil god curse.
But for them, this was undoubtedly good news.
At this moment, Coal Ball was circling the room, sniffing continuously.
The next moment, its deep eyes suddenly lit up.
Coal Ball leapt high, striking the kang with its claw.
Smack!
The blackened kang cracked in the middle.
Everyone saw that under the kang was a jar exuding blood water.
At that moment, a stench mixed with a bloody smell shot up.
The group heard a baby’s cry, followed by a child’s sobbing scream.
The eerie yet piercing cries continuously drilled into their minds, like blades scraping glass.
The system notification appeared.
[Survivors, you have successfully found the source of the curse. Break the jar and kill the creature inside that is already infected by the evil god’s aura to clear the Secret Realm.]
Everyone’s faces turned pale.
Shen Yun, however, didn’t react much. The creature’s voice seemed to have no effect on him, and he asked, "Brother Xing, should we break the jar now?"
Han Xing also felt a slight headache, shook his head, and said, "Break it. Let’s finish it off before our attributes drop too much."
Shen Yun nodded and then swung the Big Hammer in his hand, smashing it forcefully.
Crash!
The blood-red jar showed a web of cracks at this moment.
The next moment.
A dozen blood-red tentacles stretched out from the jar’s cracks.
Sticky, slimy.
Splash!
"Mom... you finally let me out... heeheehee!"
A voice, gloomy yet carrying a weird laugh, echoed.
When the creature inside revealed its full form, everyone couldn’t help but break out in goosebumps.
This was a monster whose appearance alone made one feel physically unwell.

The level of Legendary Creatures is at least 50 and above.
However, due to the special nature of the Secret Realm, that Shadow Giant Dragon’s level was suppressed to be so low.
If outside, any Legendary Creature could easily obliterate the group with just a breath.
Coal Ball continued to lead the way ahead.
The group began to delve deeper into the village.
Strangely, it seemed as though the village was dead, with not a trace of human presence, eerily silent.
As they went further in, a faint odd smell started to pervade the air.
Shen Yun, walking in front, suddenly turned back and asked, "Have you smelled something?"
The group nodded.
The air was filled with a strange odor, reminiscent of a mix between potions and rotting corpses.
There was also a faint scent of blood amidst it.
Coal Ball had sensed this early on with its sharp sense of smell, hence its previous reaction.
At this moment, everyone’s expression suddenly changed.
They all received a system notification.
[You have been infected by the Evil God’s aura, afflicted with 1 layer of Curse of the Evil God, each layer of curse reduces Survivor’s All Attributes by 10%.]
[From now, each minute increases 1 layer of Curse of the Evil God, when stacking reaches 10 layers, the Survivor will undergo a terrible mutation, equivalent to death.]
[Please find the source of the plague as soon as possible, clearing the Secret Realm will automatically remove this state...]
"Damn it, did you guys get the notification?
The system says I’ve been hit with a curse of the evil god and I’m about to mutate!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
Everyone exchanged glances, and all of their faces looked a bit grim.
It seemed that everyone had received the same notification.
In this system message, Han Xing noticed two key points.
Evil god’s aura and mutation!
He remembered that when he previously acquired the Blood Curse Antidote Formula, the system also mentioned that creatures infected by the curse of the evil god would undergo terrifying mutations.
It was hard not to connect these events together.
Because, in the near future, a Blood Curse was about to erupt.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong, his face pale, said: "Damn it, the Blood Curse increases by 1 layer every minute and reduces attributes by 10%.
That means we have at most 9 minutes to fight?"
Han Xing murmured, "It might not even be 9 minutes.
The longer we drag on, the lower our attributes get, and our combat power will be greatly reduced."
"If the boss at the end has a bit more strength..."
With this reminder, everyone realized the seriousness, their faces changing rapidly.
Time was tight, but fortunately, among them was a partner with a strong sense of smell.
Coal Ball.
"The source of the plague should be where the scent is coming from!"
Han Xing looked at the Void Ghost Wolf on the ground and said, "It’s up to you, Coal Ball."
After he finished speaking.
Coal Ball understood Han Xing’s meaning, sprang into action, and everyone followed closely behind it.
With a few maneuvers, Coal Ball led them through several streets.
This place was unremarkable, with a few dilapidated houses around.
At this moment, Coal Ball suddenly darted into an inconspicuous run-down house.
Crash!
The decayed wooden door was directly smashed open by the strong physique of the Void Ghost Wolf.
"What’s inside?"
Maintaining a cautious attitude, everyone filed in.
Inside the house, there were some old pieces of furniture covered in thick layers of black dust.
This was just an ordinary small house.
Moreover, here, that strange smell seemed to have weakened a lot.
If an average survivor team passed by here, they wouldn’t notice anything unusual.
However, Coal Ball led them straight to the bedroom area.
Inside, there was something familiar to those from the north, a heated kang.
The kang was covered with several layers of already blackened quilts.
"Is there something here?" Shen Yun asked in confusion.
At that moment, everyone suddenly felt a weakening of their power.
A minute had passed, and their All Attributes had decreased by a notch.
"Damn!" Everyone’s face fell.
But Han Xing noticed.
Coal Ball’s attributes didn’t seem to be affected.
Han Xing glanced at Coal Ball’s panel, surprised.
Because not only hadn’t its attributes diminished, there were no negative states like the curse of the evil god in its status bar.
He didn’t know if it was due to the bloodline of the Void Ghost Wolf or if pets aren’t affected by the evil god curse.
But for them, this was undoubtedly good news.
At this moment, Coal Ball was circling the room, sniffing continuously.
The next moment, its deep eyes suddenly lit up.
Coal Ball leapt high, striking the kang with its claw.
Smack!
The blackened kang cracked in the middle.
Everyone saw that under the kang was a jar exuding blood water.
At that moment, a stench mixed with a bloody smell shot up.
The group heard a baby’s cry, followed by a child’s sobbing scream.
The eerie yet piercing cries continuously drilled into their minds, like blades scraping glass.
The system notification appeared.
[Survivors, you have successfully found the source of the curse.
Break the jar and kill the creature inside that is already infected by the evil god’s aura to clear the Secret Realm.]
Everyone’s faces turned pale.
Shen Yun, however, didn’t react much.
The creature’s voice seemed to have no effect on him, and he asked, "Brother Xing, should we break the jar now?"
Han Xing also felt a slight headache, shook his head, and said, "Break it.
Let’s finish it off before our attributes drop too much."
Shen Yun nodded and then swung the Big Hammer in his hand, smashing it forcefully.
Crash!
The blood-red jar showed a web of cracks at this moment.
The next moment.
A dozen blood-red tentacles stretched out from the jar’s cracks.
Sticky, slimy.
Splash!
"Mom... you finally let me out... heeheehee!"
A voice, gloomy yet carrying a weird laugh, echoed.
When the creature inside revealed its full form, everyone couldn’t help but break out in goosebumps.
This was a monster whose appearance alone made one feel physically unwell.

chapters.title: Chapter 131 - 114: Peculiar Little Creature
paragraphs: At the moment they saw this monster, the two girls in the team felt a wave of pale complexion.
Because this guy was really too disgusting.
It was a monster with a dozen blood-red tentacles on its body, its true form resembling a baby’s corpse soaked in blood water.
Fat, swollen, bizarre.
The monster’s attributes appeared in front of everyone.
[Evil God Infected Body (Two-star Leader Level)]
[Level]: lv15
[Attributes]: Power 254, Agility 213, Spirit 302, Constitution 205.
[Skills]
Demon Sound: The Evil God Infected Body periodically uses sound to inflict severe psychic damage to surrounding creatures.
Evil Breath: The Evil God Infected Body spits out a mucus glob that causes continuous corrosion and poisoning effects, accelerating the outbreak time of the Curse of the Evil God on the target hit.
Twisted Brain: The Evil God Infected Body unleashes the power of resentment in its heart, distorting the senses and awareness of surrounding creatures, leaving enemies in long-term mental control.
Power of the Evil God: The Evil God Infected Body increases all attributes by 30%, and creatures killed by the Power of the Evil God will also transform into new Evil God Infected Bodies.
Upon seeing the attributes of this monster, everyone realized it was a rare spiritual series monster.
"What the hell is this, looking so gross?" Cheng Jianyong cursed angrily.
Han Xing then said, "Who cares what it looks like, let’s take it down!"
Even though the monster looked terrifying, its attributes weren’t beyond everyone’s expectations.
Relatively speaking, they all felt that the difficulty of this Two-Star Secret Realm was a bit too low.
Just a level 15 leader monster, it was no problem at all for the group.
Shen Yun directly cast a Blessing of Courage on Han Xing, then raised his shield and charged forward, suppressing the Evil God Infected Body amidst the ruins.
Just as it waved its dozen large intestine-like tentacles, preparing to attack.
Han Xing shot an arrow, directly hitting the body of the Evil God Infected Body.
Poof!
The arrow hit, and it really felt like stabbing into a decaying corpse.
Blood water spurted up.
"Ah!"
The Evil God Infected Body screamed in pain, its attack interrupted.
"Mom... someone’s bullying Chenchen, wuwuwu..."
"Wuwuwuwuwu..."
Sharp cries pierced into the minds of everyone.
At this point, everyone covered their ears, striving to resist that eerie sound, as if suffering a heavy blow to their minds.
Among them, only Shen Yun and Zhang Lianmeng were in a slightly better state.
Because both of them were spiritual series professions, possessing extremely high spirit attributes.
At this moment, Shen Yun lifted his Holy Hammer and first cast a Purification Technique on Han Xing.
Han Xing immediately felt the intense pain in his mind disappear.
The next moment, he unleashed various burst skills.
The Evil God Infected Body cried out repeatedly as it was struck once more...
In an instant, the group recovered, launching attacks at the infected body from all angles.
The Evil God Infected Body continuously wailed, uttering all sorts of eerie lines.
"Wuwuwu... why isn’t mom helping Chenchen..."
"Stop hitting me, stop hitting me, wuwu... I’ll tell you all my secrets..."
"Dad was eaten by me, brother was thrown into the well by me, and the big fire in the village was also set by me..."
"Chenchen was wrong, Chenchen won’t dare anymore..."
The creature’s lines left everyone feeling a bit creepy.
"Damn it, hurry and take it down, this little thing is way too damn scary..." Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but complain.
Hearing his remark, everyone sped up their attack rhythm.
After repeated severe strikes, the Evil God Infected Body’s dozen tentacles began to flail.
This leader monster went into a rage.
In an instant, the neighboring houses collapsed one by one.
Bang bang bang bang!
The infected body kept swinging its tentacles.
However, Shen Yun stood firm under the rampant attacks, unmoving.
Seeing this, the group began to unleash attacks without concern from behind.
After a wave of concentrated fire.
This leader monster was continuously forced to retreat by the gang’s attacks.
On the field.
Han Xing, Zhang Lianmeng, Su Xiaoyang.
All three were professions excelling in violent output.
Against a leader monster of the same level, Han Xing and Coal Ball could handle it with ease.
And his teammates were undeniably powerful.
By this point in the fight, there was no longer any suspense.
Unless, they encountered terrifying lord creatures such as the Knight Captain.
Otherwise, dealing with such a leader monster was very easy.
After a session of concentrated fire, this leader monster was finally slain by everyone.
The system prompt was delivered.
[You have successfully slain the Evil God Infected Body (Two-Star Leader Creature), gaining Experience Value 174121...]
A white light rose from Han Xing’s body.
The massive experience points also leveled him up to Level 15.
At the same time, the negative states on everyone’s bodies were lifted.
"Finally got rid of this guy." Cheng Jianyong breathed a sigh of relief.
Shen Yun, however, said in confusion from the side, "Why does it feel like the difficulty of this secret realm isn’t that high?"
Hearing him mention it, everyone else also felt the same way.
The final boss of the Two-star Secret Realm was just a Level 15 leader monster, which didn’t really put much pressure on them.
Aside from the monster’s disgusting appearance and strange attack methods, everything else wasn’t much of a problem.
Compared to the Two-star Secret Realm they cleared before, the Knight Judgment Arena, it wasn’t even in the same league.
However, what they didn’t know was that their team’s strength was top level even among the 900,000-strong population in the merged two major regions!
That’s why they felt the difficulty wasn’t high.
If another team were to attempt this,
just the unavoidable negative state would greatly increase their mental pressure, forcing the survivors to swiftly tackle the secret realm.
Moreover, if they wasted too much time finding the boss’s true form, breaking the vessel would still lead to a significant decline in their attributes.
By that time, they’d face this horrific monster again.
Less capable teams would likely have already been wiped out by then.
But Han Xing and his team managed to save a lot of search time thanks to Coal Ball’s keen sense of smell.
Otherwise, they would’ve been delayed for quite some time too.
After Han Xing leveled up to 15, his attributes improved significantly once more.
Furthermore, he could finally equip another piece of golden equipment, the Kingdom Ring.
Even though it didn’t have any legendary effects, its attribute bonuses far exceeded those of the ring Han Xing was currently wearing.
After swapping out the Violet Jade Ring and equipping the Kingdom Ring, Han Xing’s attributes received a noticeable boost again.
Everyone noticed a ring on Han Xing’s middle finger, exuding an air of majesty.
At that moment, a system notification chimed in.

[Successfully cleared the Two-star Secret Realm: Plague Village, gained 2 Cloud Secret Realm Points, experience reward: 367,151, item rewards: Strong Fragment*17, Rune Crystal*480, Silver Treasure Chest*3.]
"Huh? Why are there only three Silver Treasure Chests?" Cheng Jianyong asked.
Everyone else was a bit surprised, too.
You know, when they cleared the Two-star Secret Realm, Knight Judgment Arena, they got 1 Golden Treasure Chest plus 4 Silver Treasure Chests.
Besides that, they also got a Hidden Profession Scroll and an Orange Greatsword.
Despite both being Two-star levels, the rewards from Plague Village seemed rather meager.
Han Xing thought for a moment and contemplated, "These rewards were expected, given that this Two-star Secret Realm is far less difficult compared to the Knight Judgment Arena we tackled last time."
"Last time, we at least fought dozens of elite monsters, three leaders, and an additional lord."
"Here, there’s only one leader monster, so it’s unlikely to give us the same rewards as before."
After hearing this, everyone showed a look of realization.
You should know that the Golden Treasure Chests have a high chance of containing one to two pieces of golden equipment.
If clearing this level of Two-star Secret Realm always rewarded Golden Treasure Chests,
golden equipment would likely become too common.
The group nodded in agreement, and although there was no Golden Treasure Chest reward, the secret realm gave enough experience to compensate for the loss.
At this point, it was still Su Xiaoyang who opened the chests.
The first two chests were quite ordinary, containing two pieces of Level 15 purple armor and some materials.
But the last chest surprised everyone a bit.
[Intermediate Life Secret Medicine Formula]: Can treat severe injuries in Two-Star Creatures and minor injuries in Three-Star Creatures.
[Required materials for making]: 500ml of Spiritual Spring Water, Spirit Core*100, Moonlight Grass*5, Spirit Blood Grass*1.
Seeing this formula, everyone was astonished.
They previously felt that the healing effect of Basic Life Secret Elixirs was already falling behind, and now they had their hands on an Intermediate Life Secret Medicine Formula.
Although Shen Yun provides healing techniques during combat, having a few bottles of Intermediate Life Secret Elixirs in the bag also offers extra safety assurance.
Most importantly, this item can also be sold on the trade channel.
Currently, the market price for Basic Life Secret Elixirs is 500 Spirit Cores per bottle, whereas the price for Intermediate Life Secret Elixirs has already reached over 3,000.
The high price is not mainly due to the raw materials needed.
The main issue is the low success rate.
At a 20% success rate, it means one successful bottle out of five attempts, and if luck isn’t great, selling at 3,000 Spirit Cores may not even cover the cost.
So, the market finds this price relatively acceptable.
Of course, this excludes Han Xing, as he has a 100% success rate.
With this formula, he can start stockpiling materials for the Life Secret Medicine Formula.
Then, after completing this level-up, he can sell these items in large quantities to prepare for the next batch of territory buildings.
"Little Sister Yang! You are so lucky!" Zhang Lianmeng exclaimed excitedly from the side.
Cheng Jianyong also happily said, "I hereby announce that, starting today, I will pass my title of Emperor of Luck to you."
Su Xiaoyang was once again embarrassed by everyone’s compliments.
After opening the chests, the system prompt appeared.
[Secret Realm rewards have been settled, and in ten seconds, all survivors will be teleported back to the territory.]
At this moment, Han Xing glanced at a dried-up well not far away, where black air seemed to be emerging faintly.
Recalling the lines from the Evil God mutant, this well likely had issues too.
It might even be a hidden phase of the secret realm.
However, time was running out, so Han Xing decided to forgo continued exploration.
After the ten-second countdown,
the screen flashed, and everyone was back in the territory.

chapters.title: Chapter 132 - 115: Everyone Races to the Leaderboard, Rankings Soar!
paragraphs: After coming out of the Two-star Secret Realm, Han Xing glanced at the leaderboard.
The ranking of their group of five all entered the top ten thousand.
Today is the second day of the Points Leaderboard opening, the gaps between everyone are not large.
Practically every point gained can surpass thousands or even tens of thousands of people.
If they maintain this pace, getting into the top hundred shouldn’t be difficult.
At this moment, Han Xing said, "It’s confirmed that the difficulty of One-Star and Two-Star Secret Realms has decreased significantly."
"With our strength, clearing those Secret Realms under level 15 is relatively simple."
"Let’s push hard these days, and strive for everyone to get into the top ten together!"
Upon hearing this, everyone’s eyes lit up.
Han Xing saying he would lead everyone into the top ten was not just an empty promise, but he indeed had this capability.

Their group’s equipment could be considered top-tier among the Survivors, plus the team has three Hidden Professions and a powerful Coal Ball, focusing on speed could further accelerate the clearance speed.
It’s important to know that in the top ten rewards, there are four types of building blueprints, as well as a Lord Contract and numerous Spirit Cores.
Getting any ranking would be enough to significantly boost everyone’s strength.
Next, Han Xing started leading his team into leaderboard rushing mode.
However, he didn’t only target the Cloud Secret Realm; if he encountered those large-area Sky Islands on the way, he would explore them too.
These Sky Islands contain abundant resources, and the rewards are not bad.
[Successfully merged with an ownerless Sky Island, your territory has expanded, gaining territory resources: Rich Refined Iron Ore*1, Oak Wood*762, Bird Egg...]
[Successfully cleared Two-star Secret Realm, Succubus Town, Cloud Secret Realm Points +2, gained Experience Value...]
[Successfully merged with an ownerless Sky Island...]
After a full day of exploration, the time came to sunset.
Everyone started to rest temporarily and then tallied up the day’s gains.
Today, the five of them cleared three Two-star Secret Realms and eight One-star Secret Realms.
Of these, 5 One-star Secret Realms were explored by Han Xing and Shen Yun, while the other 3 were explored by Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang.
With the massive accumulation of experience, everyone’s levels were soaring rapidly.
Han Xing reached level 16, Zhang Lianmeng and Cheng Jianyong reached level 15, while Su Xiaoyang and Shen Yun were a bit slower, one at level 14, the other at level 13.
In just one day, this leveling speed is simply incredible.
However, their leveling speed will slow down from here on.
Because after reaching level 15, the experience needed will double, and even clearing a Two-star Secret Realm won’t increase it by much.
The majority of Secret Realms generating now are level 10~15.
There’s a small chance of generating level 15~20 Cloud Secret Realms, where the monsters will be even tougher.
Currently, Han Xing and his team haven’t encountered such a level of Secret Realm yet.
But presumably, for level 20 Secret Realms, the experience and item rewards should be more abundant.
At the same time, Han Xing’s territory area expanded from over sixty thousand square meters to over ninety thousand square meters.
Additionally, they harvested a large batch of territory resources, including several patches of forest, ponds, and veins...
Now, his territory has all sorts of terrains.
Walking a little distance, one can see a green bamboo forest, and after a few more steps, there’s a bright red maple forest growing beside a herb field, water pools...
All these territory resources need time for organization and absorption.
Apart from Han Xing, the territory areas of Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun also broke through to over twenty thousand square meters, along with Su Xiaoyang.
Now, the merging of the four people’s territories can directly spread out into a large platform exceeding 150,000 square meters.
Growing a bit more, they could even build a neighborhood.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong, just coming out of the Secret Realm, laughed loudly, "Hahaha, I’ve finally reached level 15!"
Others seemed to realize something.
Cheng Jianyong reaching level 15 meant he could equip that Orange Weapon, the Lion King’s Greatsword.
As expected, Cheng Jianyong was strutting around the territory holding that door-like Giant Sword with an imposing air.
On the side, Shen Yun said speechlessly, "Look at you showing off, wait till I’m level 15, then I’ll equip that Titan Battle Armor, two pieces of Golden Equipment, still stronger than you!"
However, Cheng Jianyong was unconvinced and said, "Oh really? Want to try it out?"
Shen Yun was just about to decline.
But then Han Xing interjected.
"I remember, the Lion King’s Greatsword’s legendary effect includes a 100% knockback effect, while the Shield of Immortality includes an effect of not being knocked back by any attack."
"These two attributes seem a bit contradictory, don’t they?"
Everyone also seemed to recall this matter.
One attribute knocks back 100%, the other doesn’t get knocked back 100%, what would happen when these conflicting attributes clash?
Cheng Jianyong suddenly chuckled, "Xiaoyunzi, how about we try it out, we’ll both activate the effects and see if I can knock you back."
Shen Yun gave him a sidelong glance, thought for a moment, and then nodded.
He was also quite interested in this.
At this moment, Han Xing walked a dozen meters away, leaving space for the two to battle.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang stood behind him, with beautiful eyes full of curiosity about the upcoming battle.
At this time, both contestants took their places.
Cheng Jianyong, holding the Orange Greatsword, chuckled, "Xiaoyunzi, I’m coming~"
Shen Yun cast a Blessing of Courage on himself, then added a Holy Light Shield, took a deep breath, and said, "Bring it on!"
Seeing him ready for battle, Cheng Jianyong charged forward in an instant.

The ranking of their group of five all entered the top ten thousand.
Today is the second day of the Points Leaderboard opening, the gaps between everyone are not large.
Practically every point gained can surpass thousands or even tens of thousands of people.
If they maintain this pace, getting into the top hundred shouldn’t be difficult.
At this moment, Han Xing said, "It’s confirmed that the difficulty of One-Star and Two-Star Secret Realms has decreased significantly."
"With our strength, clearing those Secret Realms under level 15 is relatively simple."
"Let’s push hard these days, and strive for everyone to get into the top ten together!"
Upon hearing this, everyone’s eyes lit up.
Han Xing saying he would lead everyone into the top ten was not just an empty promise, but he indeed had this capability.

Their group’s equipment could be considered top-tier among the Survivors, plus the team has three Hidden Professions and a powerful Coal Ball, focusing on speed could further accelerate the clearance speed.
It’s important to know that in the top ten rewards, there are four types of building blueprints, as well as a Lord Contract and numerous Spirit Cores.
Getting any ranking would be enough to significantly boost everyone’s strength.
Next, Han Xing started leading his team into leaderboard rushing mode.
However, he didn’t only target the Cloud Secret Realm; if he encountered those large-area Sky Islands on the way, he would explore them too.
These Sky Islands contain abundant resources, and the rewards are not bad.
[Successfully merged with an ownerless Sky Island, your territory has expanded, gaining territory resources: Rich Refined Iron Ore*1, Oak Wood*762, Bird Egg...]
[Successfully cleared Two-star Secret Realm, Succubus Town, Cloud Secret Realm Points +2, gained Experience Value...]
[Successfully merged with an ownerless Sky Island...]
After a full day of exploration, the time came to sunset.
Everyone started to rest temporarily and then tallied up the day’s gains.
Today, the five of them cleared three Two-star Secret Realms and eight One-star Secret Realms.
Of these, 5 One-star Secret Realms were explored by Han Xing and Shen Yun, while the other 3 were explored by Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang.
With the massive accumulation of experience, everyone’s levels were soaring rapidly.
Han Xing reached level 16, Zhang Lianmeng and Cheng Jianyong reached level 15, while Su Xiaoyang and Shen Yun were a bit slower, one at level 14, the other at level 13.
In just one day, this leveling speed is simply incredible.
However, their leveling speed will slow down from here on.
Because after reaching level 15, the experience needed will double, and even clearing a Two-star Secret Realm won’t increase it by much.
The majority of Secret Realms generating now are level 10~15.
There’s a small chance of generating level 15~20 Cloud Secret Realms, where the monsters will be even tougher.
Currently, Han Xing and his team haven’t encountered such a level of Secret Realm yet.
But presumably, for level 20 Secret Realms, the experience and item rewards should be more abundant.
At the same time, Han Xing’s territory area expanded from over sixty thousand square meters to over ninety thousand square meters.
Additionally, they harvested a large batch of territory resources, including several patches of forest, ponds, and veins...
Now, his territory has all sorts of terrains.
Walking a little distance, one can see a green bamboo forest, and after a few more steps, there’s a bright red maple forest growing beside a herb field, water pools...
All these territory resources need time for organization and absorption.
Apart from Han Xing, the territory areas of Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun also broke through to over twenty thousand square meters, along with Su Xiaoyang.
Now, the merging of the four people’s territories can directly spread out into a large platform exceeding 150,000 square meters.
Growing a bit more, they could even build a neighborhood.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong, just coming out of the Secret Realm, laughed loudly, "Hahaha, I’ve finally reached level 15!"
Others seemed to realize something.

chapters.title: Chapter 133 - 115: Everyone Competes for the Rankings, Positions Soar! (Part 2)
paragraphs: King of the Beasts!
Immortal Will!
Two legendary effects are activated simultaneously.
Cheng Jianyong swung the great sword, accompanied by a massive gust of wind, and fiercely struck forward.
Clang!
The sound of metal clashing rang out.
A dark yellow halo emanated from the giant sword.
The Shield of Immortality also shimmered with a faint halo.
However, after one second.
The halo on the Shield of Immortality dimmed.
In the next moment, Shen Yun, along with his shield, was sent flying tens of meters away.
Bang!
After Shen Yun landed, his face turned pale.
He quickly cast a Holy Light Healing on himself.
Cheng Jianyong, looking at the great sword in his hand with surprise, exclaimed, "Wow! Hahaha, it seems like my weapon is a bit more powerful?"
Shen Yun, still somewhat in disbelief, said, "Damn, wasn’t it supposed to be a hundred percent resistant to being knocked back?"

At this time, Han Xing walked over, "I just realized that when both of your legendary effects were activated, there was a unique glow. This glow should be the Power of Rules that the Shadow Giant Dragon talked about earlier."
"And when two conflicting powers clash, the higher level of power takes precedence."
"That’s why Cheng Jianyong was able to send Shen Yun flying."
Everyone showed a look of realization.
In their hearts, they were also curious about this so-called Power of Rules.
Cheng Jianyong, holding the Divine Artifact, couldn’t wait to find a monster to test it on.
Han Xing was happy to oblige.
Next, he led everyone to continue exploring the secret realm.
[Two-Star Secret Realm: Kobold Tribe, Required Level: 10~15, Number of Entries: 1~5 people.]
In a flash.
Before them appeared a camp of tents.
There were at least over three hundred kobolds ranging from level 10 to 15, including a dozen elite monsters and one leader.
Upon seeing Han Xing and his group, all the kobolds raised their weapons and charged.
In the face of a terrifying number of monsters, the group did not flinch.
Cheng Jianyong shouted, "Xiaoyunzi, give me a shield, and a blessing! I’m going all-out!"
Shen Yun reacted quickly.
As Cheng Jianyong charged, he first cast a Holy Light Shield on him, then added a Blessing of Courage.
Cheng Jianyong felt his power surge.
He then wielded the Lion King’s Greatsword and began swinging it wildly.
Whoosh—
Whoosh—
Each swing of Cheng Jianyong’s sword carried terrifying power.
The kobold minions at the front were almost swept away in droves, like cutting wheat, as a dozen kobold heads fell to the ground.
Splat, splat, splat!
Blood spurted.
Yet Cheng Jianyong grew more excited as he fought.
Relying on his strong equipment, he charged into the group of monsters, killing indiscriminately!
For a moment, dismembered limbs flew everywhere, causing the two girls in the team to turn pale.
Cheng Jianyong didn’t seem to notice, excitedly shouting, "Hahaha! This is awesome! So satisfying!"
Hearing his easily misunderstood comments, everyone else was speechless.
Behind them, Han Xing was constantly targeting the elite monsters and the leader monster.
One monster after another fell.
A few minutes later.
The chaotic battlefield calmed down.
A system prompt appeared.
[Successfully cleared the Two-Star Secret Realm, Kobold Tribe. Gained 431,542 experience points and received item rewards: 42 Strong Fragments...]
This was their fastest clear of a two-star secret realm ever.
With all members having top-grade equipment and immense power, they easily crushed the Two-Star Secret Realm.
After leaving the Kobold Tribe, they headed to the next secret realm.
Along the way, when other survivors saw their formidable presence, they usually left tactfully.
Those who weren’t wise were met with a few giant crossbow bolts from Han Xing and quickly fled like startled rabbits.
So, they didn’t encounter many survivors along the way.
Meanwhile.
The names of the five of them quickly shot into the top hundred from ranking outside the top ten thousand in a short time!
This kind of terrifying climb was unprecedented.
In a district with over 900,000 people, there were plenty of hidden talents.
Before this, those who could break into the top ten, no, even those who could enter the top hundred, were prominent figures in each district, at least a team leader of a large group.
They not only viewed the ranking as a symbol of honor but also used it as a promotional tool.
Whenever someone from a team entered the top hundred, they would ride the wave of this popularity to promote themselves in public channels and recruit other survivors.
The current ranking was closely watched.
As early as in the morning, when the five of them made it into the top five hundred, they attracted a lot of attention.
Especially Han Xing, who, after the previous famous list and backpack trading event, had already gained quite a reputation among the survivors.
When they saw the names Star River, Qing Meng (Zhang Lianmeng’s virtual name), Yun Tianming, Lone Brave, Clever Little Sheep—
As if a rising new power was rapidly climbing the ranks, it sparked intense discussion.
"Look, Star God moved up three more places, about to break into the top hundred!"
"And Yun Tianming, Lone Brave, their ranks are also rising rapidly!"
"Oh my gosh, it’s understandable for Star God, but how did the others achieve such speed?"
At that moment, survivors from the original 107 district came to explain.
"You guys might not know, but that Yun Tianming and Lone Brave are friends of Star God. In the last two ranking events, Star God helped his friends dominate the top three or top ten."
"Gasp... so terrifying?
"Wow, being a friend of Star God comes with such perks, so envious!"
"I want to be Star God’s friend too, I’m good at everything!"
"Excuse me, does Star God need any more teammates? I’m a 1.75-meter-tall, 108-pound girl and can dance all kinds of dances..."
"I want to join too, I’m eighteen this year~"
For a while, a group of people wanting to befriend Han Xing appeared in the chat channel.
Amidst everyone’s discussions.
An hour passed, and Han Xing’s group of five had already entered the top hundred.
Another two hours went by, and it was now deep into the night.
In the incredulous eyes of tens of thousands of survivors, all five names broke into the top ten.
Among them, Han Xing, with 17 points, directly ranked second.
The current first was still a survivor named Boundless, with 19 points, not far from Han Xing.
In third place was Cybertron team leader, Optimus Prime, with 16 points.
Behind them, Su Xiaoyang and Zhang Lianmeng occupied the 4th, 5th, 6th, and 7th places.
And Han Xing indeed achieved his stated goal, which was to have everyone enter the top ten!
At this time.
On a massive Sky Island spanning tens of thousands of square meters, a silver-haired man with deep eyes just walked out of a secret realm.
The quality of the equipment on him was extremely high, with purple mixed with a couple of pieces of golden equipment, even comparable to Han Xing.
In addition, his silver hair and inhuman pupils indicated he most likely also switched to some hidden profession.
This man was the leader of the largest group in district 101, Boundless.
Before this, Boundless was also the dual-ranked first-place strongman of district 101, and he unlocked a powerful profession with the Hidden Profession Scroll from the first ranking event.
Vampire Warrior.
This profession has two formidable talent skills.
First is the attack that comes with a blood-sucking effect.
The second is never feeling fatigued.
Especially with the second talent, allowing him to fight non-stop for twenty-four hours, coupled with the strength of his equipment.
For the past two days, Boundless has been consistently holding the first place on the leaderboard.
At this time, as soon as Boundless came out, he received a report from his subordinates.
On the Cloud Secret Realm points leaderboard, Star River’s name had appeared below his and their gap wasn’t large.
Boundless’s brow suddenly twitched.
"Star River... is it him again?"
In the past two days, Star River’s name had frequently appeared in everyone’s sights.
Although he knew this person was not simple.
He didn’t expect Star River to rise so quickly.
Boundless glanced at a beautiful woman beside him and asked softly, "Last night, I asked you to investigate Star River’s information, how did it go?"

chapters.title: Chapter 134 - 116: Sleepless Night for Three
paragraphs: Boundless looked at a beautiful woman beside him and asked, "Last night, I asked you to investigate information about Star River. How did that go?"
The beautiful woman gently replied, "I’ve investigated. We offered some benefits and inquired with the survivors of Area 107 about Star River’s information, and they honestly divulged everything."
"From their words, we learned about Star River’s development process."

"This person possesses remarkable abilities. Through unknown means, he acquired a large quantity of Spiritual Spring Water early on, which he used to consolidate a substantial amount of resources. Later, he mass-sold items like the Life Secret Elixir and Space Backpack."
"Based on our deductions, the resources in his possession likely have reached a terrifying amount, even more than you, the group leader..."
After listening to the analysis, Boundless nodded.
When he heard that Han Xing had a massive amount of resources, Boundless wasn’t surprised.
Because he clearly understood the terrifying speed at which top entities in a large district could acquire resources.
"Got it. Pass on this information to Optimus Prime, Shenxiu and the others to see if they are interested."
"I’m busy with leaderboard rankings lately, so I won’t be dealing with these matters for now."
The beautiful woman gave him a glance quietly and then nodded, saying, "Understood."
During the night on the territory.
Han Xing and the four others finished their day of battles and began to enjoy some leisure time.
Zhang Lianmeng was still in the outdoor kitchen by the grass, handling ingredients, with Su Xiaoyang helping her by the side.
Though Han Xing’s castle has a dedicated kitchen area.
Zhang Lianmeng preferred cooking outside, saying that the air was better there, and she could always pick some fruits and vegetables from her garden nearby.

After a few days of growth, Zhang Lianmeng’s garden was thriving, and its area rapidly expanding, planted with various fruits and vegetables, most of which are common species from Blue Star, such as chili peppers, Chinese cabbage, etc.
Now, except for not being able to use their phones, they could say their lives were practically the same as on Blue Star.
When a good meal was ready, Han Xing once again took out a small bottle of Black Vine Wine from the Storage Box.
Everyone poured a cup, and the territory was filled with the aroma of wine.
Coal Ball caught a whiff of the fragrance and dashed over from the castle balcony.
Then it lay beside Han Xing, pawing at him continuously.
Han Xing laughed heartily and also took out a small bowl to pour some for Coal Ball.
Coal Ball happily licked it.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong raised his wine bowl, "Dear brothers and sisters, it’s been a hard few days, to everyone!"
Shen Yun gave him a speechless glance and said, "Cheng Jianyong, just eat, why make it so sentimental?"
Cheng Jianyong laughed heartily, "Xiaoyunzi, you don’t understand, I’m just happy."
"In this unfamiliar world, it’s a rare thing to have a trustworthy group of companions."
Shen Yun paused for a moment upon hearing this.
"Didn’t expect you to occasionally come up with something sensible."
Cheng Jianyong grinned proudly.
Seeing this, everyone raised their glasses and drank heartily.
After a few rounds of drinking, everyone entered a slightly tipsy state.
Cheng Jianyong, with a flushed face, said, "By the way, have you noticed that after our attributes increased, our physical condition seems to have become stronger?"
"This Black Vine Wine, I used to get knocked out after one cup, but now I’ve had three and still feel quite fine."
Upon hearing Cheng Jianyong, it seemed to dawn on everyone else too.
Han Xing nodded, "That’s true. In fact, compared to when we first entered this world, our attributes have at least increased dozens of times over."
"With our current physical conditions, if we were back on Blue Star, each of us would be a superman-level existence. One punch could probably demolish an entire floor."
Han Xing’s current Strength Attribute is 203, compared to the meager 3 points when he first entered the game; he’s improved dozens of times over.
Cheng Jianyong said excitedly, "Haha, do you think if we continue to grow, we might all turn into Superman or Hulk kind of beings?"

Shen Yun scoffed, "I don’t want to become a muscle monster. I want to be an Apocalypse Knight in the future, raise my hand and unleash a Holy Light Attack, and a single blow to shatter the continent!"
Cheng Jianyong glanced at him, "You, an Apocalypse Knight?
"What? Not convinced? Want to have a match?"
Amid Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun’s routine bickering, the night wore on.
Everyone gradually dispersed.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun returned to their Lord’s Cottages.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang continued back to Han Xing’s castle.
Han Xing also returned to his room to make some preparations.
He sat on the balcony and entered the trading channel.
Then he began to input various material information.
First, it was the three materials for making the Blood Curse Antidote.
Witch Root Grass, Cursed Blood, and Divine Aurora.
After entering the first one, Witch Root Grass, more than 300 trade messages appeared.
It seems these survivors, like Han Xing, also discovered Witch Root Grass on some resource Sky Islands, so the reserves were quite sufficient.
Han Xing calculated that there were about 30,000 Witch Root Grass in total on the trading channel.
He noted the price; roughly 200 Spirit Cores could trade for one Witch Root Grass.
Without hesitation, Han Xing spent over 6 million Spirit Cores and swept them all up.
The massive trade on the trading channel concerning Witch Root Grass caught the attention of some folks.
But their attention was pointless because Han Xing had already cleared them all out.
Then, Han Xing continued to input the second material, Cursed Blood.
The trading channel had over 100 entries, totaling more than 2000 drops of Cursed Blood.
Before this, Han Xing had already determined that Cursed Blood only dropped from creatures tainted by Evil God breath.
The hundred or so consignment posts for Cursed Blood indicated that many survivors have encountered such creatures.
Han Xing furrowed his brows. He also spent over 200,000 Spirit Cores to clear out the Cursed Blood.
Then came the third material, Divine Aurora.
After Han Xing inputted the information, he discovered that the consignment information was zero.
"None?"
Han Xing was somewhat surprised and also had a bad premonition.
This represented two possibilities.
Either the material Divine Aurora is too advanced and extremely difficult to acquire.
Or, quite simply, Divine Aurora is not a material that can be obtained through conventional means.
Either possibility was not good news for Han Xing.
Since there was none, he had no choice but to give up.
Next, Han Xing continued to browse the transaction channel for goods.
Strong Beast Hide, Permanent Gold Ingot, Spirit Blood Grass, and so on...
Throughout the night, he spent over ten million Spirit Cores, and these materials were quickly accounted for.
At the same time, Han Xing glanced at the production information for the purple backpack.
[Space Backpack Blueprint (Purple)]: Can produce a backpack with 500 to 800 storage slots, with moderate attribute enhancement effects.
[Materials required for production]: Spirit Core*2000, Mithril*10, Strong Beast Hide*5, Ether*10000,
Now, he already had about ten thousand pieces of Strong Beast Hide.
He could produce over two thousand backpacks in one go.
Making a purple backpack requires 20 seconds per piece.
Han Xing clicked on "produce all" directly, which would take about 12 hours.
Anyway, he could do other things while the production interface was running.
After finishing this, Han Xing prepared to go to bed.
Han Xing comfortably lay back on the bed.
At this moment, he suddenly noticed some movement at the door.
Han Xing focused his gaze.
A beautiful woman, looking a bit guilty as if sneaking, came upstairs from below.
This beauty was Zhang Lianmeng.
To avoid making any noise, she was barefoot, her petite jade feet appeared white and blush-tinted at this moment.
Zhang Lianmeng quietly opened Han Xing’s room door and breathed a sigh of relief.
Han Xing asked with some confusion: "What’s wrong, Lian’Er?"
Zhang Lianmeng shyly glanced at Han Xing and softly said: "No, nothing, just missed you..."
By now, how could Han Xing not understand the meaning behind her words?
Zhang Lianmeng, at this age, was in the prime of her desires.
Aside from the first few times at the beginning, later, as the two became familiar, it was almost always Zhang Lianmeng who took the initiative.
In front of Han Xing, Zhang Lianmeng gently removed her clothing.
Before long, a smooth and alluring body was presented before Han Xing.
The night’s air was a bit chilly; Zhang Lianmeng seemed a bit cold, hugging herself, holding up the grandeur in front of her chest.
This scene made Han Xing’s breath quicken as well.
In the next moment, Han Xing pulled her onto the bed.
"Ah!" Zhang Lianmeng exclaimed softly.
Soon, the room was filled with low, suppressed breathing sounds.
The second floor of the tower, which was Zhang Lianmeng’s room.
Su Xiaoyang, who was in a sleeping state, woke up not long after Zhang Lianmeng left.
At first, she didn’t know what Zhang Lianmeng had sneaked out to do.
Suddenly, hearing bursts of strange noises from upstairs, she realized what was happening above.
Feeling a peculiar mix of emotions, Su Xiaoyang’s face became increasingly warmer.
She buried her head in the pillow, but the strange sounds upstairs kept seeping into her ears.
Su Xiaoyang felt a surge of restlessness in her heart, her slender jade legs tightly clamped together, as she kept tossing and turning on the bed.
That night, none of the three slept.
The next day...
Before dawn.
Zhang Lianmeng got up from Han Xing’s bed and returned to Su Xiaoyang’s nest.
Han Xing got up from the bedroom bed and stretched on the balcony.
From afar, he saw Su Xiaoyang and Zhang Lianmeng walking out together.
However, Su Xiaoyang’s eyes looked somewhat weary, while Zhang Lianmeng’s face had a rosy, satisfied look.
Han Xing’s eyes showed a complicated expression.
Upon seeing Han Xing, Zhang Lianmeng waved and greeted him.
Today is the third day of the Cloud Secret Realm update.
There are seven days left until the leaderboard ends.
Han Xing calculated the days.
The end of the leaderboard would be exactly one month since they entered Sky Island Paradise.
That means by then, the second batch of humans from Blue Star will be completely deployed into this world.
Blue Star will become a thing of the past.
Everyone, including Han Xing, will no longer be able to return to that familiar homeland.

sentences.text: Boundless looked at a beautiful woman beside him and asked, "Last night, I asked you to investigate information about Star River.
How did that go?"
The beautiful woman gently replied, "I’ve investigated.
We offered some benefits and inquired with the survivors of Area 107 about Star River’s information, and they honestly divulged everything."
"From their words, we learned about Star River’s development process."
"This person possesses remarkable abilities.
Through unknown means, he acquired a large quantity of Spiritual Spring Water early on, which he used to consolidate a substantial amount of resources.
Later, he mass-sold items like the Life Secret Elixir and Space Backpack."
"Based on our deductions, the resources in his possession likely have reached a terrifying amount, even more than you, the group leader..."
After listening to the analysis, Boundless nodded.
When he heard that Han Xing had a massive amount of resources, Boundless wasn’t surprised.
Because he clearly understood the terrifying speed at which top entities in a large district could acquire resources.
"Got it.
Pass on this information to Optimus Prime, Shenxiu and the others to see if they are interested."
"I’m busy with leaderboard rankings lately, so I won’t be dealing with these matters for now."
The beautiful woman gave him a glance quietly and then nodded, saying, "Understood."
During the night on the territory.
Han Xing and the four others finished their day of battles and began to enjoy some leisure time.
Zhang Lianmeng was still in the outdoor kitchen by the grass, handling ingredients, with Su Xiaoyang helping her by the side.
Though Han Xing’s castle has a dedicated kitchen area.
Zhang Lianmeng preferred cooking outside, saying that the air was better there, and she could always pick some fruits and vegetables from her garden nearby.

After a few days of growth, Zhang Lianmeng’s garden was thriving, and its area rapidly expanding, planted with various fruits and vegetables, most of which are common species from Blue Star, such as chili peppers, Chinese cabbage, etc.
Now, except for not being able to use their phones, they could say their lives were practically the same as on Blue Star.
When a good meal was ready, Han Xing once again took out a small bottle of Black Vine Wine from the Storage Box.
Everyone poured a cup, and the territory was filled with the aroma of wine.
Coal Ball caught a whiff of the fragrance and dashed over from the castle balcony.
Then it lay beside Han Xing, pawing at him continuously.
Han Xing laughed heartily and also took out a small bowl to pour some for Coal Ball.
Coal Ball happily licked it.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong raised his wine bowl, "Dear brothers and sisters, it’s been a hard few days, to everyone!"
Shen Yun gave him a speechless glance and said, "Cheng Jianyong, just eat, why make it so sentimental?"
Cheng Jianyong laughed heartily, "Xiaoyunzi, you don’t understand, I’m just happy."
"In this unfamiliar world, it’s a rare thing to have a trustworthy group of companions."
Shen Yun paused for a moment upon hearing this.
"Didn’t expect you to occasionally come up with something sensible."
Cheng Jianyong grinned proudly.
Seeing this, everyone raised their glasses and drank heartily.
After a few rounds of drinking, everyone entered a slightly tipsy state.
Cheng Jianyong, with a flushed face, said, "By the way, have you noticed that after our attributes increased, our physical condition seems to have become stronger?"
"This Black Vine Wine, I used to get knocked out after one cup, but now I’ve had three and still feel quite fine."
Upon hearing Cheng Jianyong, it seemed to dawn on everyone else too.
Han Xing nodded, "That’s true.
In fact, compared to when we first entered this world, our attributes have at least increased dozens of times over."
"With our current physical conditions, if we were back on Blue Star, each of us would be a superman-level existence.
One punch could probably demolish an entire floor."
Han Xing’s current Strength Attribute is 203, compared to the meager 3 points when he first entered the game; he’s improved dozens of times over.
Cheng Jianyong said excitedly, "Haha, do you think if we continue to grow, we might all turn into Superman or Hulk kind of beings?"
Shen Yun scoffed, "I don’t want to become a muscle monster.
I want to be an Apocalypse Knight in the future, raise my hand and unleash a Holy Light Attack, and a single blow to shatter the continent!"
Cheng Jianyong glanced at him, "You, an Apocalypse Knight?
"What?
Not convinced?
Want to have a match?"
Amid Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun’s routine bickering, the night wore on.
Everyone gradually dispersed.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun returned to their Lord’s Cottages.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang continued back to Han Xing’s castle.
Han Xing also returned to his room to make some preparations.
He sat on the balcony and entered the trading channel.
Then he began to input various material information.
First, it was the three materials for making the Blood Curse Antidote.
Witch Root Grass, Cursed Blood, and Divine Aurora.
After entering the first one, Witch Root Grass, more than 300 trade messages appeared.
It seems these survivors, like Han Xing, also discovered Witch Root Grass on some resource Sky Islands, so the reserves were quite sufficient.
Han Xing calculated that there were about 30,000 Witch Root Grass in total on the trading channel.
He noted the price; roughly 200 Spirit Cores could trade for one Witch Root Grass.
Without hesitation, Han Xing spent over 6 million Spirit Cores and swept them all up.
The massive trade on the trading channel concerning Witch Root Grass caught the attention of some folks.
But their attention was pointless because Han Xing had already cleared them all out.
Then, Han Xing continued to input the second material, Cursed Blood.
The trading channel had over 100 entries, totaling more than 2000 drops of Cursed Blood.
Before this, Han Xing had already determined that Cursed Blood only dropped from creatures tainted by Evil God breath.
The hundred or so consignment posts for Cursed Blood indicated that many survivors have encountered such creatures.
Han Xing furrowed his brows.
He also spent over 200,000 Spirit Cores to clear out the Cursed Blood.
