chapters.title: Chapter 135 - 117: Meteorite Crater!
paragraphs: The Blue Star is about to become history.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly thought.
In this world, the Sky Island fragments are seemingly endless.
Is there a possibility that, one day in the future, by collecting these fragments, one can form a colossal Sky Island Territory,
replicating an ecological planet like Blue Star seems unlikely.
However, building a modern city seems very hopeful.
By then, Han Xing himself will be the mayor, and the city will not only have his friends, but other survivors, dwarves, elves, orcs and the like from this world’s natives.
With hopes for the future.
After everyone had breakfast, they began to continue exploring this world.
The massive Sky Island advances at a steady pace, and at this moment, Han Xing suddenly stops in his tracks.
Because in front of them, there appears an extremely large Sky Island.
Roughly estimated, this Sky Island has at least five thousand square meters.
At this time, a system prompt comes in.
[Inside, there is a huge mountain peak, which formed a colossal crater after being struck by a meteorite. It seems to hide unknown dangers within. Enter?]
Crater?
Everyone is a bit puzzled, but Han Xing didn’t feel a strong sense of crisis on this Sky Island.
So, Han Xing directly confirmed.
After the clouds dispersed.
A small mountain was revealed inside.
Yes, just a small mountain.
This Sky Island is not simply a single layer.
It is divided into dozens of layers.
Like an inverted funnel, it hangs in the air.
Before even getting close, waves of warmth are felt coming towards them.
"Seriously, is this the crater? Why does it look like a natural hot spring?" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed first.
Everyone noticed this point as well.
At the center of the valley, there is a large pool emitting steam, and the lake water is very pure.
Roughly estimated, the pool has a diameter of over two hundred meters, and estimating from the depth of this floating Sky Island, it’s at least more than thirty meters deep.
"Speaking of which, why is this water hot? Is it really a hot spring?" Shen Yun asked.

Han Xing glanced at the construction of this Sky Island, revealing a hint of red soil below, and said in a low voice, "It should be because beneath the lake there is an astonishing amount of Dark Fire Stone Ore Vein."
"The Dark Fire Stone Ore Vein is continuously emitting heat, raising the temperature of this pool."
Everyone understood.
Cheng Jianyong looked inside and asked, "Speaking of which, what about the monsters inside this Sky Island?"
The system prompt mentioned that there are unknown dangers inside, indicating that there must be monsters inside.
At this moment, the bald mountain top shows no sign of any monsters.
Everyone looked around.
If there are monsters, they can only be hiding in the water.
But among everyone present, although they all can swim, it would be troublesome if they encountered danger in the water.
Su Xiaoyang then said, "How about me going to check it out?"
"You? You want to jump in the water?" Han Xing asked.
Seeing Han Xing look at herself, Su Xiaoyang, blushing from recalling the noises she heard last night, said softly, "No... not really, because I have a flying skill..."
Han Xing realized, indeed, he forgot that Su Xiaoyang’s Elf Shooter profession has a Low Altitude Flight skill.
It provides two minutes of flight time, and the speed doubles while in flight.
At Su Xiaoyang’s current speed, two minutes is enough for her to circle the lake surface twice.
Although he noticed something off with Su Xiaoyang’s state, he didn’t think much of it.

Han Xing nodded, "That’s fine, then you just fly over the lake and scout around. If you encounter danger, come back immediately. At worst, I can just sweep it with the siege crossbow arrows, we don’t lack that experience."
Su Xiaoyang nodded lightly.
In the next moment, she activated the Elf Shooter’s Low Altitude Flight skill.
Her entire being not only sped up drastically, but also gained the ability to fly.
Clad in a set of purple leather armor, Su Xiaoyang, once airborne, truly looked like an elf gracefully dancing.
However, after she circled the lake once, there were still no signs of any monsters.
After returning, Su Xiaoyang’s face was slightly red due to being exposed to the steamy water vapor.
"I didn’t see any trace of monsters, either it’s hiding at the bottom or there’s no monster inside," Su Xiaoyang said.
Han Xing wondered, "No monster?"
Logically, if it were a resource-rich Sky Island without monsters, the system would directly indicate that it’s an unclaimed Sky Island, and survivors could directly merge it.
But up to now, they haven’t received the relevant prompt.
This indicates that there must be monsters hidden inside.
Han Xing estimated the size of this Sky Island, over a hundred meters in height, and water depth seems to be around forty to fifty meters.
With this depth, it’s unclear whether the siege crossbow arrow launcher’s attack power can reach the bottom.
Thinking of this, Han Xing shook his head and said, "No matter, since the monster doesn’t want to come out, I’ll directly use the crossbow arrow launcher platform to force it out!"
Everyone else nodded in agreement.
Han Xing prepared to launch the siege crossbow arrow.
For safety, he moved the Sky Island back a bit, about a thousand meters.
For large Sky Islands like this, the safety distance is a thousand meters.
Beyond that, it resumes being covered by clouds.
After pulling away, under Han Xing’s control.
The two hundred siege crossbow arrow launcher devices on the territory all realigned in this moment.
Creaaaak! Creaaaak!
The sound of mechanical axles turning.
Then, with a wave of Han Xing’s hand.
Pop! Pop! Pop!
Over two hundred siege crossbow arrows fired simultaneously.
A rain of arrows fell from the sky.
One giant crossbow arrow after another plunged into the water like cannonballs.
Splash! Splash! Splash!
Waves began to ripple across the surface of the lake.
However, after a moment of turbulence, the waters returned to calm.
The crowd grew even more puzzled, even doubting whether there were any monsters inside at all.
However, Han Xing observed what seemed to be a hint of red under the clear water surface.
So he continued to operate the siege crossbow arrows, firing them into the water.
Thud! Thud! Thud!
Arrow after arrow penetrated the lake floor.
One round, two rounds, three rounds.
Close to eight hundred crossbow arrows were fired, yet the monster beneath still did not emerge.
Han Xing, in frustration, exclaimed, "Damn it, it can really hold on!"
He still couldn’t believe it.
What he could confirm was that after his siege crossbow arrows entered the water, although weakened by water resistance, they did manage to injure the creature.
Yet, this monster seemed quite capable of endurance.
Still refusing to come out.
He continued shooting.
Finally, after the fourth round of concentrated fire, the surface of the lake suddenly erupted in a massive commotion.
The next moment, a sharp tip slowly emerged from the water.
The tip was dark red, with faint lines of flame visible on it.
Then, a creature with a body over thirty meters long, covered in wrinkled fish scales, resembling a mix between a crocodile and a giant python, appeared.
The skin on its back was as thick as a palm, covered in wrinkles, exuding an aura of formidable defense just by its appearance!
"Damn, finally showed up," Han Xing couldn’t help but say.
In front of everyone, the attributes of this monster appeared.
[Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao (Two-star Leader-level Creature)]
[Level]: lv18
[Attributes]: Power 373, Agility 302, Spirit 354, Constitution 405.
Skills:
[Intermediate Thick Hide]: The Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao has a thick layer of skin, reducing magic damage received by 20% and physical damage by 30%.
[Magma Spray]: The Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao sprays a mass of magma with powerful attack power, causing area damage and a continuous burning effect on enemies.
[Water Breath]: After being damaged, the Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao can dive into the water to quickly regenerate its life force.
[Death Tornado]: The Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao spins at an astonishing speed to form a death tornado, dealing continuous damage to surrounding enemies.
This level 18 leader creature possessed overwhelmingly strong attributes.
Han Xing’s attacks had thoroughly enraged it.
At this moment, the Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao, eyeing everyone with its eyes as large as copper bells, charged forward.
Its sudden raid speed far exceeded the crowd’s expectations.
Boom!
The water surface erupted as if a cannonball had been dropped.
Its immense power sent shivers through everyone’s hearts.
Level 15 to 16 also represents a significant hurdle.
Monsters above level 16 would have much-enhanced attributes.
Against this level 18 leader monster, given their strength, a direct confrontation might be barely manageable.
But Han Xing didn’t want to take unnecessary risks.
So he directly operated the siege crossbow arrows for concentrated fire.
The next moment, countless giant crossbow arrows rained down on the wide back of the Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao.
Thud! Thud! Thud!
Curiously, these crossbow arrows, carrying tremendous impact, only penetrated about ten centimeters before being deflected by the thick skin of the Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao.
The ’Intermediate Thick Hide’ skill of the Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao included a 30% reduction in physical damage.
Its formidable defense left everyone on the scene astounded.
Even so, Han Xing’s siege crossbow arrows were not to be underestimated.
Over two hundred shot in unison, and despite most being deflected, a dozen or so managed to penetrate the Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao’s defenses, deeply embedding in its flesh.
The Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao, hurt on its back, was knocked back into the water.
A dozen or so blood holes as thick as bowls were continuously seeping blood.
It was completely enraged by Han Xing!
The next moment, it opened its massive jaw filled with sharp teeth, and Han Xing saw a bright red fireball brewing in its throat.
It was the Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao’s second skill, Magma Spray!
The siege crossbow arrows entered a 10-second reloading interval, and it was too late to interrupt.
However, by this time, everyone had retreated into Han Xing’s territory.
The eruption of magma suddenly burst forth, but a Spiritual Shield unexpectedly shone with green light, blocking it outside.
Pop!
Sparks flew like a cannonball exploding in mid-air.
Inside the territory, no one was harmed.
Han Xing glanced at the Spirit Core Shield’s defense value, over 70 points remaining.
This meant that the Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao’s attack had reduced the shield’s defense value by nearly 170 points.
If it attacked again, the shield would burst!
"Wow, this is so fierce?" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
Han Xing quickly operated the giant crossbow arrows to launch a second wave of attacks.
Whir! Whir! Whir!
Another over two hundred giant crossbow arrows fell.
This time, the damage caused by the giant crossbow arrows was even more terrifying!

Close to eight hundred crossbow arrows were fired, yet the monster beneath still did not emerge.
Han Xing, in frustration, exclaimed, "Damn it, it can really hold on!"
He still couldn’t believe it.
What he could confirm was that after his siege crossbow arrows entered the water, although weakened by water resistance, they did manage to injure the creature.
Yet, this monster seemed quite capable of endurance.
Still refusing to come out.
He continued shooting.
Finally, after the fourth round of concentrated fire, the surface of the lake suddenly erupted in a massive commotion.
The next moment, a sharp tip slowly emerged from the water.
The tip was dark red, with faint lines of flame visible on it.
Then, a creature with a body over thirty meters long, covered in wrinkled fish scales, resembling a mix between a crocodile and a giant python, appeared.
The skin on its back was as thick as a palm, covered in wrinkles, exuding an aura of formidable defense just by its appearance!
"Damn, finally showed up," Han Xing couldn’t help but say.
In front of everyone, the attributes of this monster appeared.
[Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao (Two-star Leader-level Creature)]
[Level]: lv18
[Attributes]: Power 373, Agility 302, Spirit 354, Constitution 405.
Skills:
[Intermediate Thick Hide]: The Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao has a thick layer of skin, reducing magic damage received by 20% and physical damage by 30%.
[Magma Spray]: The Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao sprays a mass of magma with powerful attack power, causing area damage and a continuous burning effect on enemies.
[Water Breath]: After being damaged, the Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao can dive into the water to quickly regenerate its life force.
[Death Tornado]: The Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao spins at an astonishing speed to form a death tornado, dealing continuous damage to surrounding enemies.
This level 18 leader creature possessed overwhelmingly strong attributes.
Han Xing’s attacks had thoroughly enraged it.
At this moment, the Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao, eyeing everyone with its eyes as large as copper bells, charged forward.
Its sudden raid speed far exceeded the crowd’s expectations.
Boom!
The water surface erupted as if a cannonball had been dropped.
Its immense power sent shivers through everyone’s hearts.
Level 15 to 16 also represents a significant hurdle.
Monsters above level 16 would have much-enhanced attributes.
Against this level 18 leader monster, given their strength, a direct confrontation might be barely manageable.
But Han Xing didn’t want to take unnecessary risks.
So he directly operated the siege crossbow arrows for concentrated fire.
The next moment, countless giant crossbow arrows rained down on the wide back of the Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao.
Thud!
Thud!
Thud!
Curiously, these crossbow arrows, carrying tremendous impact, only penetrated about ten centimeters before being deflected by the thick skin of the Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao.
The ’Intermediate Thick Hide’ skill of the Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao included a 30% reduction in physical damage.
Its formidable defense left everyone on the scene astounded.
Even so, Han Xing’s siege crossbow arrows were not to be underestimated.
Over two hundred shot in unison, and despite most being deflected, a dozen or so managed to penetrate the Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao’s defenses, deeply embedding in its flesh.
The Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao, hurt on its back, was knocked back into the water.
A dozen or so blood holes as thick as bowls were continuously seeping blood.
It was completely enraged by Han Xing!
The next moment, it opened its massive jaw filled with sharp teeth, and Han Xing saw a bright red fireball brewing in its throat.
It was the Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao’s second skill, Magma Spray!
The siege crossbow arrows entered a 10-second reloading interval, and it was too late to interrupt.
However, by this time, everyone had retreated into Han Xing’s territory.
The eruption of magma suddenly burst forth, but a Spiritual Shield unexpectedly shone with green light, blocking it outside.
Pop!
Sparks flew like a cannonball exploding in mid-air.
Inside the territory, no one was harmed.
Han Xing glanced at the Spirit Core Shield’s defense value, over 70 points remaining.
This meant that the Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao’s attack had reduced the shield’s defense value by nearly 170 points.
If it attacked again, the shield would burst!
"Wow, this is so fierce?" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
Han Xing quickly operated the giant crossbow arrows to launch a second wave of attacks.
Whir!
Whir!
Whir!
Another over two hundred giant crossbow arrows fell.
This time, the damage caused by the giant crossbow arrows was even more terrifying!

chapters.title: Chapter 136 - 118: Meteorite Armor, Earth Bursting Celestial Star
paragraphs: More than 200 crossbow arrows were fired in a volley!
Nearly a quarter of the crossbow arrows directly inflicted damage on this colossal creature.
At this moment, its broad back was filled with giant crossbow arrows as thick as fists, like a massive porcupine.
The Lava Crocodile Turtle struggled painfully on the water’s surface, gradually staining the large pool with its blood.
The siege crossbow arrows have a 10-second charge time.
In the time it took for the Lava Crocodile Turtle to struggle, over 4 seconds had already passed.
By now, the Lava Crocodile Turtle was severely injured, realizing it was not a match for that bunch of giants.
It took its last breath, cast a resentful glance at the people in the distance on the territory, and prepared to dive into the water.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly said, "This guy wants to get into the water!"
"Shen Yun, give me a blessing!"
Shen Yun quickly reacted and hurriedly cast a Blessing of Courage on Han Xing.
Han Xing felt a surge of immense power from within.
The next moment, he directly unleashed his legendary skill, Broken Moon.
On the surface of the water, a giant moon appeared out of nowhere.
This huge monster was like it was embedded in the moon’s reflection.
Without Han Xing needing to remind them, all the ranged units began their most powerful output.
Pow! Pow! Pow!
After a round of concentrated fire.
The Level 18 leader monster was left gasping for breath under the group’s attacks.
At this moment, the massive moon began to crack.
The next instant, it shattered explosively!
The legendary skill ’Broken Moon’ causes 1200% damage once the control state is lifted.
In addition to Shen Yun’s Blessing of Courage applied to Han Xing, the damage of this strike reached an unimaginable level!
Crack!
Everyone heard a shattering sound like glass breaking, and the Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao was blown to pieces.
Soon after, it stopped moving.
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
[Successfully killed Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao, Level 18 Leader Creature, gained Experience Value 541222...]
Over 500,000 experience points, matching the strength of the Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao.
After the prompt ended, the boiling water surface returned to calm.
On the water surface, the massive 40-meter-long body of the Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao floated in the center.
The blood dyed the lake surface red.
"Let’s go, collect this leader monster’s body," Han Xing said.
Everyone’s eyes lit up.
Such a massive creature often yields something good after its body is dismembered.
But now, the corpse of the Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao was floating in the center of the pool, requiring everyone to jump into the water to get close.
At this time, Han Xing thought of another way to move.
He directly summoned several core territories.
They were left behind by those unfortunate ones they had defeated earlier.
These initial core territories could be used as moving platforms.
Everyone was amazed, each stepping onto a small platform and floating to the center of the pool.
At this point, Han Xing approached the monster and began disassembling it.
[Decomposition successful, obtained Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao Thick Hide*284, obtained Magma Horn*1, obtained Magma Heart*1, obtained Blood of the Strong*2451, obtained Jiao Meat...]
Han Xing reviewed the material descriptions.
[Molten Rock Crocodile Jiao Thick Hide]: Thick hide from a powerful creature, possessing extremely high defense, can be used to make Golden Equipment.
[Magma Horn]: Special material, when placed in the territory, increases the damage of all fire attribute creatures by 10%.
[Magma Heart]: Core of magma creatures, when placed in a fire element-rich area, it has a chance of nurturing new magma creatures.
All three materials were extremely precious.
At this point, Su Xiaoyang said softly, "Han... Brother Han Xing, can you give me that Magma Heart?"
Hearing Su Xiaoyang address him, Han Xing was momentarily stunned.
However, from what he learned about Su Xiaoyang’s territory, that Pale Demon Plant could grow stronger by consuming various hearts.
According to Su Xiaoyang, when she first encountered this Pale Demon Plant, it was only a Level 5 elite monster.
After Su Xiaoyang’s continuous feeding, the Pale Demon Plant had advanced to Level 13 and had become a leader-level creature.
If they continued feeding it, there was a chance it could become a lord creature in the future!
A moment later, Han Xing held a fiery red heart and handed it directly to her.
Su Xiaoyang delightedly accepted it.
After obtaining a large quantity of materials, Han Xing also merged this Sky Island together.
In no time, a vast amount of resources were added to his collection.
[Obtained Giant Territory: Meteorite Celestial Pool, obtained Territory Resources: Dark Fire Stone Ore Vein*1, Red Earth*12412, Lapis Lazuli*4711... obtained Golden Treasure Chest*1...]
"Wow! There’s a Golden Treasure Chest!" Han Xing exclaimed, surprised by the last prompt.
Everyone was instantly intrigued, asking, "Where’s the Golden Treasure Chest?"
Previously, when searching for the leader monster, they had confirmed there was nothing on the lake surface.
If there was a chest, it would only be at the bottom of the lake.
"Probably under the lake, let me check."
With that, Han Xing dove straight into the lake.
Those at the water’s surface looked at each other.
As he dived deeper, Han Xing felt the pressure underwater increasing.
He continued to dive to nearly thirty fathoms deep, where visibility was very low.
The surrounding water temperature was also rising.
However, Han Xing faintly saw a red glow emanating from the lakebed.
A moment later.
He finally reached the bottom.
As he suspected.
Indeed, there was a Dark Fire Stone Ore Vein below, emitting continuous high temperatures, which even Han Xing found hard to withstand.
He quickly searched the lakebed for the Golden Treasure Chest’s location.
The lakebed was a strange dark red color, and visibility was still manageable.

chapters.title: Chapter 137 - 118: Meteorite Armor, Earth Bursting Celestial Star
paragraphs: Not long after moving forward, Han Xing finally saw a glimmer of golden light.
Before him, at the bottom of the water, there clearly lay a Golden Treasure Chest.
At this moment, Han Xing noticed that his oxygen level had already depleted by 70%, making it imperative to surface quickly.
He hurried over to open it.
[Successfully opened the Golden Treasure Chest, obtaining Permanent Gold Ingot *13, Vitality Ore *7, Mithril *144, Meteorite Battle Armor (Gold) *1.]
"Damn, golden armor!"
In the water, Han Xing couldn’t help but exclaim with excitement in his heart.
With a thrilled heart, Han Xing collected everything from the chest into his backpack and quickly surfaced.
Seeing Han Xing emerge with an expression of joy, everyone knew he had made quite a haul.
Cheng Jianyong pulled Han Xing up with one hand and asked, "Brother Xing, did you get something good?"
Han Xing nodded and directly posted the attributes of the equipment.

[Meteorite Battle Armor (Gold) lv18, Quality - Legend, Defense 57~64, Power +35, Constitution +30, Hit Rate -10%, Attached Effect - Mountains (immune to dizziness), Attached Effect - Scorching Flame (20% chance when attacking to add Explosive Flame effect, causing 150% explosive damage to enemies), Attached Effect - Earth Bursting Celestial Star (Legendary Effect)]

[Earth Bursting Celestial Star]: Legendary Effect, 15% chance to summon a meteor from space when attacking, dealing Attack Power *288% wide-range damage to enemies and causing them to be stunned for 3 seconds. (This effect has a cooldown time of 600 seconds.)
"Damn! This top is truly badass!"
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Nearly triple range damage and three seconds of group stunning effect, terrifying!"
Compared to the Titan Battle Armor obtained last time at the Knight Judgment Arena, this Meteorite Battle Armor was superior due to its higher level and better attributes.
Due to its adaptable attributes, everyone present could actually equip it.
Yet, at the current stage, even Han Xing, the highest-level character, was just level 16, unable to meet the equipment requirement.
He had to put it in his backpack for future use.
Meanwhile, Han Xing noticed something else in the treasure chest.
[Vitality Ore]: A precious exotic metal, with a seemingly liquid surface.
Han Xing recalled that the ancient weapon, the Gold Melting Cannon, obtained by felling that strange bird, seemed to require Vitality Ore for repairs.
He glanced at the Gold Melting Cannon in his backpack, covered in cracks.
It was down to its last two points of durability.
He had plenty of Permanent Gold Ingot now, but Vitality Ore was scarce, having only found three during the last Golden Treasure Chest opening.
This time, however, he directly obtained 7 Vitality Ore.
Getting closer to repairing the Gold Melting Cannon.
Han Xing thought, "Now, everyone should have explored plenty of Sky Islands over a thousand square meters and gathered a lot of High-Level Materials within them."
"But I wonder if there’s any Vitality Ore among them."
"If there is, I need to trade for it, even at a cost."
Han Xing immediately made up his mind, maneuvering the Sky Island while accessing the trading channel.
Then, he typed in the keywords ’Vitality Ore.’
Tens of thousands of trade listings were filtered through, leaving less than thirty.
Though few, it made Han Xing’s eyes light up.
"There really are some!"
The benefits of the merged district became evident at this moment.
While Vitality Ore is considered rather advanced, the sheer number of Survivors meant that a low probability would still result in its appearance!
Each of these over thirty listings had between two to eight Vitality Ore.
Yet they were unaware of the Vitality Ore’s use.
Because the system merely annotated that it is a precious metal without specifying its exact purpose.
However, since the system acknowledged its preciousness, these people naturally knew of its above-standard value.
Many set their prices between thirty to forty thousand Spirit Cores for a single Vitality Ore, which nearly rivaled the price of a Blue Backpack.
Nonetheless, Han Xing found it acceptable.
Considering how limited the source of Vitality Ore is—only a slim chance of obtaining it from a Golden Treasure Chest.
In the current phase, even a Silver Treasure Chest is valuable; Han Xing himself had opened fewer than five Golden Treasure Chests, with only two yielding Vitality Ore.
Han Xing initially wanted to buy them up outright, but some seemed unsure of the Vitality Ore’s value and instead opted for price negotiation through private chat.
So, Han Xing started private messaging each seller.
He first messaged someone named Squirrel, straightforwardly stating, "20,000 Spirit Cores for one Vitality Ore."
The response was quick.
Squirrel: "Damn, second on the leaderboard, Star River?"
By now, Han Xing was well-known, nearly ubiquitous in Zone 2.
Currently, he sits in second place on the leaderboard, and given recent discussions in the chat channel, ignoring him is impossible.
Han Xing replied, "It’s me, are you selling the Vitality Ore?"
Squirrel seemed excited and promptly responded, "Selling, of course!"
"Just, are you sure you want to trade 20,000 Spirit Cores for one Vitality Ore? I actually have 5 pieces here."
He seemed to think Han Xing’s offer was too high.
Initially, Squirrel only intended to trade these Vitality Ore for other materials, like Mithril, and consider it profitable.
But now, Han Xing’s offering of 20,000 Spirit Cores per piece was extraordinary.
By current market standards, 20,000 Spirit Cores could exchange for a blue-quality piece of equipment.
100,000 could even get two supreme blue backpacks.
Han Xing replied, "Yes, if you agree, let’s trade now."
Squirrel contemplated briefly, then said, "Star God, can I use these 5 Vitality Ore to exchange for two Blue Backpacks with you?"
Han Xing was taken aback.
His request was indeed within a reasonable range.
Since Han Xing’s set price for a Blue Backpack was 50,000 Spirit Cores each.
Han Xing agreed, and the person named Squirrel quickly initiated the trade.
[Trade successful, you’ve obtained Vitality Ore *5, and lost Spirit Core Space Backpack (Blue) *2.]
Looking at the 13 Vitality Ore in his backpack, a smile appeared on Han Xing’s lips.
He continued sending private messages one by one.
However, trading directly was sometimes cumbersome since there was no anonymity feature in the trading channel, and every message he sent elicited awe.
Some amicable survivors readily agreed to trade with Han Xing.
While others saw his fame as a chance to extort a bit.
In such cases, Han Xing simply disconnected from the chat.
Moving on to the next potential seller.
After about ten minutes, those people often lost patience and proactively contacted Han Xing for a private chat.
But some remained stubborn, refusing to back down.
Han Xing eventually gave up negotiating with them.
Finally, after half an hour,
Han Xing managed to trade for 46 Vitality Ore, combining with his own reserves, amounting to 53 pieces altogether—more than enough to repair the Gold Melting Cannon.
At this moment, Han Xing took out the massive, cracked cannon from his backpack.
As soon as everyone saw the peculiar cannon design, they gathered around for a look.
However, Zhang Lianmeng slightly trembled, seemingly recalling some unpleasant memory.
Cheng Jianyong asked first, "Brother Xing, what is that?"
"Gold Melting Cannon, I’ll let you witness its power in a bit," Han Xing replied.
Then, a system prompt appeared.
"Would you like to repair the special equipment, ’Gold Melting Cannon’?"
"Repair requires materials: Permanent Gold Ingot *48, Vitality Ore *48, Spirit Core *4800, Rare Earth *48000, and upon successful repair, the durability will be restored to full."
Han Xing clicked yes immediately.
In the next moment, the materials in his backpack vanished, and a golden light shimmered on the barrel of the Gold Melting Cannon.
A few seconds later.
The system prompt appeared.
[Special equipment, Gold Melting Cannon, successfully repaired. Current Durability: 50/50.]

However, Zhang Lianmeng slightly trembled, seemingly recalling some unpleasant memory.
Cheng Jianyong asked first, "Brother Xing, what is that?"
"Gold Melting Cannon, I’ll let you witness its power in a bit," Han Xing replied.
Then, a system prompt appeared.
"Would you like to repair the special equipment, ’Gold Melting Cannon’?"
"Repair requires materials: Permanent Gold Ingot *48, Vitality Ore *48, Spirit Core *4800, Rare Earth *48000, and upon successful repair, the durability will be restored to full."
Han Xing clicked yes immediately.
In the next moment, the materials in his backpack vanished, and a golden light shimmered on the barrel of the Gold Melting Cannon.
A few seconds later.
The system prompt appeared.
[Special equipment, Gold Melting Cannon, successfully repaired.
Current Durability: 50/50.]

chapters.title: Chapter 138 - 119: Goblin Nest
paragraphs: [The special equipment, Molten Gold Cannon, has been successfully repaired. Current durability is: 50/50.]
As the system prompt appeared, the surface cracks on the gigantic cannon in Han Xing’s hand also gradually vanished.
On it, various golden secret patterns reappeared again.
The barrel, over two meters in length and more than forty centimeters in diameter, just looking at it, gives a strong sense of deterrence!
At this moment, Han Xing glanced again at the attributes of the Molten Gold Cannon.

[Molten Gold Cannon lv10 (Golden Special Equipment), Quality - Treasure, Attack Power 436~472, Attached Effect - Blast (When the shell contacts an object, it inflicts 150% impact damage, then detonates the shell, causing 80% blast damage to all objects within twenty meters), Attached Effect - Burning Embers (Units attacked by the Molten Gold Cannon will be added with a layer of burning embers state, continuously burning life.)]
[Remaining Durability]: 50/50 (Each attack consumes 1 durability. When durability reaches zero, this equipment will become scrapped and cannot be repaired.)
Although it’s only level 10 equipment, the attack power of over four hundred is comparable to Han Xing’s current attack strength.
What’s different is that the Molten Gold Cannon inflicts area damage, and that blast effect is equivalent to a group attack, making it a powerful tool for monster slaying!
Han Xing couldn’t help but think: "This thing doesn’t belong to the territory buildings."
"Using it to kill monsters should also provide experience points, right?"
Thinking of this, he couldn’t wait to test the power of the Molten Gold Cannon.
The Sky Island hadn’t progressed for long.
In front of everyone appeared a Two-Star Secret Realm.
[Two-Star Secret Realm: Goblin Nest, Secret Realm Level: 10~15, Accessible by: 1~5 people.]
After the teleportation ended, the sky in front of everyone turned dark, and they found themselves in a deep cave.
The visibility in the cave is very low, and the ground seems very damp.
The group hadn’t progressed far.
Suddenly, two green figures appeared ahead.
Each held a torch in one hand and a short sword in the other.
[Goblin Scout (One-Star Ordinary Creature), lv15]
Just a level 15 ordinary monster, it’s simply negligible for the group.
At this moment, one of the Goblin Scouts seemed to notice them.
The goblin exclaimed, "There are humans here! Quickly call the brothers over."
Hearing the shout, the other short goblin also spotted the group.
However, it seemed to notice Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang behind Han Xing.
That short goblin immediately exclaimed, "There are women! Beautiful human females and elves!"
The nearby Goblin Scout also noticed the two enchanting figures, eyes turning red filled with lustful gaze.
"Wahaha! These two dames are really charming, kill the male ones, and drag the females into the cave to give birth!"
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang’s faces immediately turned pale.
However, the moment it shouted this, Han Xing had already taken action.
Thunk!
An arrow shot out, piercing through the Goblin Scout’s head, creating a bloody hole from front to back.
Headshot!
The other short goblin seemed to realize something was wrong and was about to escape.
However, Han Xing’s arrow was faster.
In the next moment, this goblin met the same fate.
However, the noise of their battle seemed to have disturbed the creatures inside.
Moments later.
Dozens of goblins, wielding various weapons, rushed out of the cave with strange cries.
"There are enemies!"
"Everyone, come here! Kill them all!"
Han Xing saw that there were also two or three tall goblin giants among them, they should be elite-level creatures.
They also noticed Han Xing and the others.
However, at this moment, all goblin eyes were focused on Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang.
These two women, practically dazzling beauties, each with their unique charms, posed an irresistible attraction to males.
Including goblins, who are by nature not picky and are always in a state of heat.
This group of green-skinned creatures watched the two women intently, eyes red and even drooling white at the mouth.
Han Xing’s eyes showed a hint of disgust.
He raised the Molten Gold Cannon.
Then pressed the red button on the barrel.
Tremendous power started to gather.
The goblins seemed still immersed in Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang’s beauty, not coming back to their senses.
In the next moment.
Han Xing said, "A bunch of disgusting creatures, accept the baptism of gunpowder!"
A head-sized fireball whistled out, landing among the goblin horde.
Without waiting for them to react, a dull explosion rang out.
Boom!
In the narrow cave space, the explosion power of the Molten Gold Cannon was maximized.
These dozens of goblins were simultaneously affected by the blast damage from the Molten Gold Cannon.
When the dust settled.
The system’s prompts were already scrolling madly for everyone.
[Killed Goblin Supervisor (Two-Star Elite Creature), gained 9300 experience points...]
[Killed Goblin Soldier (Two-Star Elite Creature), gained 10200 experience points...]
[Killed...]
After a long string of kill notifications, the group gained a massive amount of experience points.
At this time, a beam of white light rose from Shen Yun’s body.
He leveled up to level 14.
The marks from the explosion were still evident on the scene.
Those dozens of goblins were directly annihilated by a single blast.
Everyone swallowed, gaining a clear recognition of the power of the Molten Gold Cannon in Han Xing’s hand once again.
"This cannon’s damage is truly terrifying..."
Cheng Jianyong sighed, "With it in hand, it feels like there’s nothing left for us to do!"
Shen Yun, standing beside him, nodded continuously, deeply agreeing with him.
After dealing with this wave of monsters, the group continued to delve deeper into the Goblin Nest.
As expected, the goblins were a filthy bunch, and their living environment was extremely unpleasant.
Dark, damp, and the occasional foul stench almost made everyone want to throw up.
At this moment, their only desire was to quickly reach the depths of the cave, eliminate the monsters inside, and clear the Secret Realm.
As they ventured deeper into the cave, they finally encountered the Goblin Leader in its depths.
A fat, green-skinned monster over three meters tall.
[Goblin Giant (Two-Star Leader Creature), Level: lv15]
This Goblin Giant was extremely bloated, and nearby, there were prisons one after another.
Han Xing and the others saw many female creatures of various races inside.
Fox Girl, Elf, Slime, Dwarf...
They didn’t even spare the Kobolds.
Even though they knew this Secret Realm was just a projection of the past, everyone still felt a chill run down their spine.
Without waiting for the Giant to stand up, Han Xing directly fired a shot at it.
Boom!
A small mushroom cloud rose up.
The Goblin Giant was blasted and rolled over a dozen times.
"Roar!"
The Goblin Giant, in pain, picked up a huge spike-covered wolf fang club where it stood and roared in anger.
"Humans! I’m going to eat you all!"
It immediately went into a berserk state.
However, Han Xing had no intention of engaging it in combat.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Three consecutive cannon shots!
Heatwaves swept over in waves.
At this time, a system notification came.
[Goblin Giant (Two-Star Leader Level) eliminated, gained Experience Value 134122...]
[Successfully cleared the Two-Star Secret Realm, Goblin Nest, Cloud Secret Realm Points +2, gained Experience Value reward: 271512, obtained item reward Strong Fragment *19...]
At this moment, everyone was holding their weapons, feeling somewhat bewildered.
Because this was the fastest they had ever cleared a Secret Realm, taking less than six minutes in total, practically bulldozing their way through.
Three cannon shots directly killed a Leader Level monster.
The group didn’t even have a chance to act.
Han Xing was also shocked by the powerful destructive force of the Molten Gold Cannon.
With this cannon, he could essentially use large-scale group attack magic without cooldown.
If it weren’t for the durability limitation, he could even use the Molten Gold Cannon to level up himself!
No, perhaps he could!
Because the main materials for repairing the Molten Gold Cannon’s durability are Permanent Gold Ingot and Vitality Ore.
And he still had a reserve of over four thousand Permanent Gold Ingots.
The main lacking material was the Vitality Ore!
Han Xing saw in the trading channel that there were at least a hundred Vitality Ores available.
If he could buy them all, it would equate to restoring two rounds of the Molten Gold Cannon’s durability.
And they had only fired less than four shots to clear a Two-Star Secret Realm!
In other words, these Vitality Ores could help Han Xing accelerate the Secret Realm clearing time significantly!
Han Xing suddenly raised his head!
He suddenly realized, this could be the key to overtaking the first place in Boundless, and surpassing the other 90,000 survivors in the 2nd district!
After leaving the Goblin Nest, the group rushed towards the next area non-stop.
While on the move, Han Xing also began to frantically purchase materials like the Vitality Ore.
Currently, there weren’t many Vitality Ores available in the market.
Due to his last trade, the price of Vitality Ores had been slightly increased, with the current market price equivalent to 30,000 Spirit Cores per piece.
Han Xing didn’t care about the expense.
Under his financial onslaught, most Vitality Ores in the trading market had now been acquired by Han Xing.
A total of 1.7 million Spirit Cores were spent to acquire 52 pieces of Vitality Ore.
Nearly two million Spirit Cores might sound astronomical to others.
But for Han Xing, it was like a drop in the bucket.
He considered this trade very worthwhile.
Although with the strength of Han Xing’s team, they could clear a Two-Star Secret Realm within twenty minutes even following normal procedures.
But under the firepower of the Molten Gold Cannon, this speed could be doubled or more.
It’s essentially paying money to speed up time.
But it’s worth it!
With this much reserve of Vitality Ores, Han Xing could also use the Molten Gold Cannon more recklessly, bombarding like mad.
The group’s clearing speed kept increasing.
That day, the leaderboard witnessed a bizarre change again.
When Han Xing came out of the Goblin Nest, his Secret Realm Points had just reached 17, and the first place in Boundless had reached 23.
He always maintained a few points’ gap with Han Xing.
But starting in the afternoon.
Han Xing’s point increment speed increased nearly several folds!
In the blink of an eye, it rapidly shot up from 17 points to 20.
When Boundless reached 25 points, Han Xing had already hit 24 points, just one point away from overtaking him.
Many eyes were fixated on the leaderboard at this moment!

chapters.title: Chapter 139 - 120: Boundless in Shock!
paragraphs: The survivors of Region 2 have been fixated on the leaderboard, watching the changes in everyone’s rankings.
"Wow, Star River is catching up so quickly. Could he actually overtake Boundless?"
"I don’t think so... Boundless has been holding the first place for two days now. Everyone assumes that first place belongs to him."
Just then, Han Xing’s points jumped again, going from 24 to 25, directly tying with Boundless!
"Look, Star River’s points increased again!"
"Oh my gosh, I remember he was just at 24 points a few minutes ago. Did he clear another secret realm in such a short time?"
"That’s so fast! Even Boundless couldn’t manage that speed, right?"
The survivors were not mistaken.
At this moment, Boundless had just come out of a secret realm and heard the news that Han Xing had tied with him in points, and the calm expression on his face vanished.
Before this, Boundless never thought anyone could take his first place.
The traits bestowed by the Vampire Warrior allowed him to battle continuously for twenty-four hours without feeling fatigue.
To him, first place was already in his pocket!
Perhaps there were a few competitors, but they were only Optimus Prime, Luo God, and the like.
Among them, Star River wasn’t even a name he considered.
Even half a day ago, when he saw Han Xing’s rank rising swiftly, he still didn’t pay him any mind.
However, at this moment, Boundless had to acknowledge this formidable opponent.
Beside him, a shapely and beautiful mature woman softly said, "Young Master Wu, do you need me to arrange people to locate Star River and his team?"
Nearby, a few of Boundless’ teammates changed their expressions; they understood the meaning behind the woman’s words.
Previously, those large teams had inquired about Star River’s background and discovered that he hadn’t established any strong team.
In other words, Star River had no powerful backing.
And for someone with weak support, no matter how strong, they are easier to deal with.
However, Boundless waved his hand, indicating it wasn’t necessary.
His blazing eyes showed a bloodthirsty glint, and his face was full of intense war intent.
"Isn’t this great?"
"To have someone as my opponent and to pressure me, letting me know there are always people better."
Boundless glanced at the woman beside him and then said, "Go, get Nine Heavens and the others, then go to the trading channel to buy a large batch of attribute-enhancing potions."
The woman nodded with a smile upon hearing this.
Because she knew, her leader was taking things seriously.
Under Boundless’ call, the largest team of District 101, no, now the largest team in District 2, gathered a few of the top elites by him.
Boundless took a deep breath and said, "From now on, don’t do anything else, just stay in my territory, then form two shifts to accompany me in breaking through the Cloud Secret Realm."
"Black Cat, Shengzi, you fight with me during the day, Li Qingfeng, Wang Han, you replace them at night."
The eight people listened and their expressions turned serious.
Boundless looked at them and asked, "What’s wrong, is there a problem?"
At this moment, the survivor known as Black Cat asked, "Leader, we have no problem, we’re just worried about you. Can you really handle it?"
They deciphered Boundless’ plan, which was to explore the Cloud Secret Realm non-stop in two shifts for 24 hours.
Everyone couldn’t help but admire Boundless’ determination.
At this time, Boundless licked his lips and said, "With pressure comes motivation, right?"
"Star River, you gave me quite a bit of pressure."
"Just not sure, in my all-out state, can you keep up with my pace?"
However, before he could act, he suddenly saw on the leaderboard that Han Xing’s points had already surpassed 27, officially taking the first place!
Not only that.
Shen Yun, Cheng Jianyong, Zhang Lianmeng, Su Xiaoyang, their territory points were also rapidly increasing.
Now, Optimus Prime had been pushed down to sixth place.
The changes on the leaderboard quickly sparked discussions among the survivors.
Boundless’ smile froze on his face.
He was just held up for ten minutes, and Star River had directly surpassed him.
Everyone looked at Boundless in confusion, asking, "Uh, leader, should we continue with the tactic?"
Boundless’ mouth twitched, and he waved his hand, "Keep fighting!"
At that moment, on another Sky Island Territory, Optimus Prime also said with a gloomy face, "Just who exactly is this Star River?"
"First, he sold off a large batch of space backpacks, now he surpassed Boundless to take first place."
"Not only that, he managed to bring all his teammates into the top ten on the leaderboard."
"At this rate, won’t he end up taking all top five spots?"
Many people thought of this possibility.
Aside from Optimus Prime, other potential top-three contenders felt a pressing sense of pressure.
Han Xing, unaware of the talk about him, was quickly exploring the secret realm with his team.
He discovered a pattern.
One-star secret realms typically have monsters that gather together.
The strongest among them is just an Elite Monster.
This provided Han Xing with a great environment for output.
Each time Han Xing entered, he launched an attack without waiting for system prompts.
A single cannon shot, and a large number fell.
Sometimes even elite monsters with a fragile constitution would be blasted to death by this cannon.
Even if they weren’t blasted to death, they would be almost in a severely injured state by this time.
With a few skills from him and Coal Ball, they could directly take them down.
From entering the One-Star Secret Realm, to finishing the battle, to collecting the treasure chest, the whole process took less than a minute.
Sometimes, before Shen Yun could even see what the scene inside was, Han Xing would have already dealt with the monster.
Shen Yun stood stupefied on the side, not knowing what to do.
The process of clearing the Two-Star Secret Realm was a bit more troublesome.
But the battle time was also compressed by Han Xing to within 10 minutes.
Excluding the travel time, Han Xing’s points would change almost every half hour.
Meanwhile, over on the Boundless side, even though he had given it his all.
As time went on, the gap between him and Han Xing only grew larger.
This gap was almost despair-inducing.
Not only that, he not only couldn’t catch up with Han Xing, but now even Su Xiaoyang and Shen Yun’s points were gradually leaving Boundless behind.
By late at night.
Han Xing’s Cloud Secret Realm points reached 45, already surpassing Boundless by 10 points.
A 10-point gap, at Boundless’s usual speed, would take almost half a day.
And Shen Yun, Cheng Jianyong, and the others also smoothly occupied ranks 2, 3, 4, and 5 on the leaderboard.
Now, the five of them directly monopolized the top five ranks on the leaderboard.
The chat channel completely exploded!
The whole day, the discussions about Han Xing and the others hadn’t stopped.
Their terrifying speed of acceleration was truly beyond imagination, leaving many in despair.
But what they didn’t know was, it was all due to the money Han Xing had thrown in to achieve this speed.
The price of the Vitality Ore was extremely high, not even less than three thousand Spirit Core per piece, plus the Permanent Gold Ingot, each shot consumed nearly 50,000 Spirit Core.
Today, Han Xing fired about forty shells, which translates to nearly over two million Spirit Core blown away.
Though the consumption was big, the effects were also very remarkable.
That was all their levels and points were skyrocketing simultaneously.
On the side, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun were almost going crazy with excitement.
When had they ever experienced such a way of upgrading,
"Is this what firepower coverage means? As soon as a cannon strikes, every monster, no matter the form, is taken away!"
Shen Yun also nodded excitedly, "So fierce! It’s like leveling up while lying down!"
In just one day, Shen Yuncheng went from level 13 to level 15 and smoothly equipped the Titan Battle Armor, greatly increasing his defense.
And Han Xing also directly leveled up to 17, while the other three reached level 16.
At this rate, it’s only a matter of a few days for the entire team to reach level 20 and complete the Second Transformation!
Just thinking of this, even the two girls were extremely excited.
At this moment, Han Xing calmed the excited crowd, saying: "Calm down, it’s getting late, let’s call it a day for today and continue leveling up tomorrow."
The group looked up at the sky, and before they knew it, it was already deep into the night.
They were so excited that they had forgotten about the passage of time.
Then, everyone returned to their own territories.
The whole day, the chat channel had been abuzz with discussions about Han Xing and the others.
Only until Han Xing went to rest and the leaderboard points stopped rising did the excitement gradually subside.
At this point, Boundless saw that the Star River’s points had finally stopped growing, and his heart, which had been hanging on a thread, finally let out a sigh of relief.
A glimmer of hope rekindled in his eyes, "Looks like you haven’t transcended humanity, and still need to rest."
"Whereas I have replaced my vampire bloodline and can stay awake and fight for twenty-four hours, but you can’t."
"Star River, human power is ultimately limited!"
"And this will be my chance to surpass you!"
The next day...
As soon as the sky brightened.
Everyone noticed the changes on the leaderboard.
After a night’s struggle, Boundless successfully broke through 40 points in the Secret Realm points, overtaking Cheng Jianyong, grabbing third place.
Meanwhile, the seventh-ranked Optimus Prime and Luo God also started to advance, narrowing the gap.
In the morning, the five of Han Xing gathered on the territory.
Shen Yun also passed this news on to Han Xing.
However, Han Xing didn’t care at all.
He carried the Gold Melting Cannon nonchalantly, "No worries, with this thing, they can’t possibly surpass me, and they’ll only keep lagging behind us."
Han Xing glanced at the durability of the Gold Melting Cannon.
[Remaining Durability]: 9/50.
Yesterday, it consumed forty-one durability points of the Gold Melting Cannon.
Equivalent to the consumption of two million Spirit Core.
Of course, the effect was also very impressive.
Not only did it bring a large amount of experience value and Secret Realm points, but also many materials.
Thus, Han Xing directly consumed 40 Vitality Ores to restore the Gold Melting Cannon’s durability.
However, after this round, his reserve of Vitality Ores was only down to 57, which could barely support his consumption for another day.

sentences.text: The survivors of Region 2 have been fixated on the leaderboard, watching the changes in everyone’s rankings.
"Wow, Star River is catching up so quickly.
Could he actually overtake Boundless?"
"I don’t think so...
Boundless has been holding the first place for two days now.
Everyone assumes that first place belongs to him."
Just then, Han Xing’s points jumped again, going from 24 to 25, directly tying with Boundless!
"Look, Star River’s points increased again!"
"Oh my gosh, I remember he was just at 24 points a few minutes ago.
Did he clear another secret realm in such a short time?"
"That’s so fast!
Even Boundless couldn’t manage that speed, right?"
The survivors were not mistaken.
At this moment, Boundless had just come out of a secret realm and heard the news that Han Xing had tied with him in points, and the calm expression on his face vanished.
Before this, Boundless never thought anyone could take his first place.
The traits bestowed by the Vampire Warrior allowed him to battle continuously for twenty-four hours without feeling fatigue.
To him, first place was already in his pocket!
Perhaps there were a few competitors, but they were only Optimus Prime, Luo God, and the like.
Among them, Star River wasn’t even a name he considered.
Even half a day ago, when he saw Han Xing’s rank rising swiftly, he still didn’t pay him any mind.
However, at this moment, Boundless had to acknowledge this formidable opponent.
Beside him, a shapely and beautiful mature woman softly said, "Young Master Wu, do you need me to arrange people to locate Star River and his team?"
Nearby, a few of Boundless’ teammates changed their expressions; they understood the meaning behind the woman’s words.
Previously, those large teams had inquired about Star River’s background and discovered that he hadn’t established any strong team.
In other words, Star River had no powerful backing.
And for someone with weak support, no matter how strong, they are easier to deal with.
However, Boundless waved his hand, indicating it wasn’t necessary.
His blazing eyes showed a bloodthirsty glint, and his face was full of intense war intent.
"Isn’t this great?"
"To have someone as my opponent and to pressure me, letting me know there are always people better."
Boundless glanced at the woman beside him and then said, "Go, get Nine Heavens and the others, then go to the trading channel to buy a large batch of attribute-enhancing potions."
The woman nodded with a smile upon hearing this.
Because she knew, her leader was taking things seriously.
Under Boundless’ call, the largest team of District 101, no, now the largest team in District 2, gathered a few of the top elites by him.
Boundless took a deep breath and said, "From now on, don’t do anything else, just stay in my territory, then form two shifts to accompany me in breaking through the Cloud Secret Realm."
"Black Cat, Shengzi, you fight with me during the day, Li Qingfeng, Wang Han, you replace them at night."
The eight people listened and their expressions turned serious.
Boundless looked at them and asked, "What’s wrong, is there a problem?"
At this moment, the survivor known as Black Cat asked, "Leader, we have no problem, we’re just worried about you.
Can you really handle it?"
They deciphered Boundless’ plan, which was to explore the Cloud Secret Realm non-stop in two shifts for 24 hours.
Everyone couldn’t help but admire Boundless’ determination.
At this time, Boundless licked his lips and said, "With pressure comes motivation, right?"
"Star River, you gave me quite a bit of pressure."
"Just not sure, in my all-out state, can you keep up with my pace?"
However, before he could act, he suddenly saw on the leaderboard that Han Xing’s points had already surpassed 27, officially taking the first place!
Not only that.
Shen Yun, Cheng Jianyong, Zhang Lianmeng, Su Xiaoyang, their territory points were also rapidly increasing.
Now, Optimus Prime had been pushed down to sixth place.
The changes on the leaderboard quickly sparked discussions among the survivors.
Boundless’ smile froze on his face.
He was just held up for ten minutes, and Star River had directly surpassed him.
Everyone looked at Boundless in confusion, asking, "Uh, leader, should we continue with the tactic?"
Boundless’ mouth twitched, and he waved his hand, "Keep fighting!"
At that moment, on another Sky Island Territory, Optimus Prime also said with a gloomy face, "Just who exactly is this Star River?"
"First, he sold off a large batch of space backpacks, now he surpassed Boundless to take first place."
"Not only that, he managed to bring all his teammates into the top ten on the leaderboard."
"At this rate, won’t he end up taking all top five spots?"
Many people thought of this possibility.
Aside from Optimus Prime, other potential top-three contenders felt a pressing sense of pressure.
Han Xing, unaware of the talk about him, was quickly exploring the secret realm with his team.
He discovered a pattern.
One-star secret realms typically have monsters that gather together.
The strongest among them is just an Elite Monster.
This provided Han Xing with a great environment for output.
Each time Han Xing entered, he launched an attack without waiting for system prompts.
A single cannon shot, and a large number fell.
Sometimes even elite monsters with a fragile constitution would be blasted to death by this cannon.
Even if they weren’t blasted to death, they would be almost in a severely injured state by this time.
With a few skills from him and Coal Ball, they could directly take them down.
From entering the One-Star Secret Realm, to finishing the battle, to collecting the treasure chest, the whole process took less than a minute.
Sometimes, before Shen Yun could even see what the scene inside was, Han Xing would have already dealt with the monster.
Shen Yun stood stupefied on the side, not knowing what to do.
The process of clearing the Two-Star Secret Realm was a bit more troublesome.
But the battle time was also compressed by Han Xing to within 10 minutes.
Excluding the travel time, Han Xing’s points would change almost every half hour.
Meanwhile, over on the Boundless side, even though he had given it his all.
As time went on, the gap between him and Han Xing only grew larger.
This gap was almost despair-inducing.
Not only that, he not only couldn’t catch up with Han Xing, but now even Su Xiaoyang and Shen Yun’s points were gradually leaving Boundless behind.
By late at night.
Han Xing’s Cloud Secret Realm points reached 45, already surpassing Boundless by 10 points.
A 10-point gap, at Boundless’s usual speed, would take almost half a day.
And Shen Yun, Cheng Jianyong, and the others also smoothly occupied ranks 2, 3, 4, and 5 on the leaderboard.
Now, the five of them directly monopolized the top five ranks on the leaderboard.
The chat channel completely exploded!
The whole day, the discussions about Han Xing and the others hadn’t stopped.
Their terrifying speed of acceleration was truly beyond imagination, leaving many in despair.
But what they didn’t know was, it was all due to the money Han Xing had thrown in to achieve this speed.
The price of the Vitality Ore was extremely high, not even less than three thousand Spirit Core per piece, plus the Permanent Gold Ingot, each shot consumed nearly 50,000 Spirit Core.
Today, Han Xing fired about forty shells, which translates to nearly over two million Spirit Core blown away.
Though the consumption was big, the effects were also very remarkable.
That was all their levels and points were skyrocketing simultaneously.
On the side, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun were almost going crazy with excitement.
When had they ever experienced such a way of upgrading,
"Is this what firepower coverage means?
As soon as a cannon strikes, every monster, no matter the form, is taken away!"
Shen Yun also nodded excitedly, "So fierce!
It’s like leveling up while lying down!"
In just one day, Shen Yuncheng went from level 13 to level 15 and smoothly equipped the Titan Battle Armor, greatly increasing his defense.
And Han Xing also directly leveled up to 17, while the other three reached level 16.
At this rate, it’s only a matter of a few days for the entire team to reach level 20 and complete the Second Transformation!
Just thinking of this, even the two girls were extremely excited.
At this moment, Han Xing calmed the excited crowd, saying: "Calm down, it’s getting late, let’s call it a day for today and continue leveling up tomorrow."
The group looked up at the sky, and before they knew it, it was already deep into the night.
They were so excited that they had forgotten about the passage of time.
Then, everyone returned to their own territories.
The whole day, the chat channel had been abuzz with discussions about Han Xing and the others.
Only until Han Xing went to rest and the leaderboard points stopped rising did the excitement gradually subside.
At this point, Boundless saw that the Star River’s points had finally stopped growing, and his heart, which had been hanging on a thread, finally let out a sigh of relief.
A glimmer of hope rekindled in his eyes, "Looks like you haven’t transcended humanity, and still need to rest."

"Star River, human power is ultimately limited!"

Meanwhile, the seventh-ranked Optimus Prime and Luo God also started to advance, narrowing the gap.

Shen Yun also passed this news on to Han Xing.
However, Han Xing didn’t care at all.
He carried the Gold Melting Cannon nonchalantly, "No worries, with this thing, they can’t possibly surpass me, and they’ll only keep lagging behind us."
Han Xing glanced at the durability of the Gold Melting Cannon.
[Remaining Durability]: 9/50.
Yesterday, it consumed forty-one durability points of the Gold Melting Cannon.
Equivalent to the consumption of two million Spirit Core.
Of course, the effect was also very impressive.
Not only did it bring a large amount of experience value and Secret Realm points, but also many materials.
Thus, Han Xing directly consumed 40 Vitality Ores to restore the Gold Melting Cannon’s durability.
However, after this round, his reserve of Vitality Ores was only down to 57, which could barely support his consumption for another day.

chapters.title: Chapter 140 - 121: Cooperation with Black Eagle
paragraphs: Han Xing knew that to maintain this speed, he must get more Vitality Ore.
But because he was too conspicuous now, every move he made was watched by many.
Even his private chats with some people yesterday about acquiring Vitality Ore had already leaked to certain interested parties.
He found that today in the trading market, the quantity of Vitality Ore had noticeably decreased, and the price had increased significantly.
Han Xing’s heart sank, he knew that someone had already noticed his large-scale purchase of Vitality Ore.
However, since Han Xing was not only massively acquiring Vitality Ore but also consistently purchasing other materials, including Witch Root Grass, Cursed Blood, Permanent Gold Ingot, etc.
They were unclear about Han Xing’s purpose for buying Vitality Ore.
So, the current Vitality Ore market, besides a slight increase in price, had not changed much.
However, if Han Xing continued to purchase Vitality Ore today, it would attract more attention.
Currently, two methods were in front of Han Xing.
One is to openly purchase Vitality Ore, offering prices unimaginable to those survivors, to buy the Vitality Ore from their hands.
But in that case, he would certainly suffer a united sniper attack by several big teams, the cost then might be too high.
The second method is to let others purchase while they haven’t discovered the importance of Vitality Ore to him, even if the price is a bit higher.
This method is a bit more secure.
But who to turn to, this choice of person, is somewhat head-scratching.
Because Han Xing didn’t have many friends.
Letting Cheng Jianyong and the others purchase was not very realistic either, because now everyone knew that Lone Brave and Yun Tianming were his teammates.
Other people, Han Xing couldn’t trust.
Han Xing flipped through his friend list.
Apart from Su Xiaoyang and the others, he had two more friends.
One was named Tang Mu, and the other was Hill Eagle.
Hill Eagle was Black Eagle’s real name.
That Tangxin Mumu, ever since their last interaction, hadn’t contacted him once, it seemed that she too was busy leveling up because of the district merger.
As for Black Eagle...
Han Xing wasn’t sure if he could rely on him.
But judging from this person’s previous style, he acted decisively and should keep his promises.
Thinking of this, Han Xing opened the private chat interface with Black Eagle.
He didn’t beat around the bush, directly saying: "I want you to help purchase a batch of materials, in return, I can make you 10 purple Space Backpacks for free."
After a moment of waiting, Black Eagle immediately sent a message.
"You’ve already obtained the blueprint for the purple backpack?"
"That’s right, you can check the attributes yourself."
Han Xing posted the attributes of the purple backpack.
Black Eagle: "..."
Opposite side fell silent for a moment, then replied: "Okay, what materials do you need."
"Vitality Ore, as much as possible, as for the price, as long as it’s within fifty thousand Spirit Cores, you can get it."
Hearing Han Xing’s bold bidding, even the worldly-wise Black Eagle couldn’t help feeling a trace of shock.
Yet what followed, Han Xing’s actions stunned the usually unfazed Black Eagle.
He directly initiated a trade request with Black Eagle.
In the trade window, Han Xing first put up ten million Spirit Cores, then added five hundred thousand Mithril blocks, and two hundred blue backpacks.
Seeing so many materials, Black Eagle was completely dumbfounded.
He knew Han Xing was very wealthy.
From the previous trades, everyone speculated that he had gathered resources beyond ordinary people’s imagination.
But Black Eagle didn’t expect him to be wealthy to this extent.
Directly offering tens of millions of Spirit Cores, even if combining the entire fortunes of the Twilight Mercenary Corps, it would barely reach that number.
The material reserves in Han Xing’s hands far exceeded everyone’s recognition.
Because in their understanding, once Han Xing acquired materials, he would surely continue producing blue backpacks for sale.
But the making of this equipment had success rates, and the odds weren’t high.
Once failed, those materials would disappear.
But what they didn’t know was that Han Xing’s crafting never failed.
This talent of his indirectly boosted his earnings severalfold or even dozens of times!
Black Eagle looked at the trading bar in disbelief, asked: "Are you certain, to exchange so much for Vitality Ore?"
Han Xing nodded: "These resources should be enough. If the other party needs other materials, contact me again, be sure to help me purchase a large amount of Vitality Ore."
Black Eagle took a deep breath, suddenly asked: "Star River, we’ve only dealt once, aren’t you afraid I’d run off with these things?"
Han Xing chuckled: "Run? Where do you think you can escape to?"
"The world is only so big."
"Moreover, even if you do take these things and run, do you think I can’t deal with you?"
"Have you forgotten how Divine Whisper was wiped out?"
When Han Xing mentioned the already obliterated Divine Whisper, Black Eagle seemed to recall something, suddenly shuddering.
This guy, indeed, once used a bounty task to force Divine Whisper into disbandment.
Given Han Xing’s financial power, if he were to issue the same bounty against the Twilight Mercenaries...
Even Black Eagle didn’t think they could last till the end.
Because this wasn’t the previous Zone 107 with just over nine thousand people.
Now, there were as many as more than ninety hundred thousand in a large zone.
As long as Han Xing was willing to offer the right price, he could certainly move many people to action.
