chapters.title: Chapter 141 - 121: Cooperation with Black Eagle_2
paragraphs: Even if only a portion of them are willing to take action, that’s still a considerable number.
No matter how capable Black Eagle is, facing tens of thousands of greedy eyes, he wouldn’t dare claim he can pull through the crisis.
As for raiding Han Xing’s territory and implementing a decapitation strategy directly?
That’s out of the question.
He knew better than anyone how extraordinarily well-defended Han Xing’s territory was.
The blueprint for the siege crossbow arrow launcher platform was even given to him by Black Eagle.
Thinking of this, Black Eagle replied, "Got it, I’ll give orders for this matter. If there’s any surplus material, I’ll return it to you."
After hanging up the private chat window.
A weight was lifted from Han Xing’s heart.
With Black Eagle helping him collect Vitality Ores, Han Xing finally solved his worry about materials.
So, he began using the Gold Melting Cannon more unscrupulously.
Boom! Boom boom!
Monsters were blasted into pieces by the Gold Melting Cannon.
The ranking that stayed stagnant for a few hours once again started rising at a terrifying speed.
In less than an hour, the five of them surpassed Boundless and Optimus Prime, once again taking the top five spots.
And as time passed, the gap widened.
By dusk.
Han Xing’s personal points had surpassed 80, with Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang at least having 70 points.
And now, the most aggressive pursuer, Boundless, had barely broken 60 points!
By midnight.
Han Xing’s personal points had past 100.
Han Xing’s level officially reached level 18, and others also reached level 17.
Only 2 levels away from reaching level 20 and completing the Third Transformation.
While Boundless’ personal points had just surpassed 70.
The huge gap left the entire District 2 feeling deeply hopeless.
On Boundless’ territory.
The silver-haired man looked furious, vampire fangs exposed.
"Dammit!"
"Can anyone tell me how these guys do it so fast? How on earth did they manage it?"
It was the first time for the elite members of the Kunlun Team to see Boundless lose composure like this.
Everyone was too scared to say anything.
At this moment, the faces of the leaders of several other large guilds were also quite ugly.
Earlier, they had confidently proclaimed they’d take the top three spots.
But now, five monsters unexpectedly topped the rankings, taking all top five spots.
As a result, many couldn’t even guarantee they’d make it to the top ten.
Looking at the rankings, some people began to have different thoughts.
That night, many major team’s leaders had emergency meetings.
The next day.
Today is the fifth day of the Cloud Secret Realm points board activation.
Just as Han Xing woke up, he received a private message from Black Eagle.
"Yesterday, I collected 137 Vitality Ores, expended 5.45 million Spirit Cores. These materials are getting scarcer on the trading market, so I had my people buy in batches to avoid attention."
Seeing this number, Han Xing was pleasantly surprised.
As for the Spirit Cores spent, he didn’t care at all.
Sure enough, Black Eagle was indeed capable; he managed to collect over a hundred Vitality Ores in just a single day, enough to last him about three days.
According to Han Xing’s estimate, in three more days, he could reach level 20 and complete the Second Transformation.
By then, he could learn two new skills, and with the surge in strength, he’d be able to quickly farm monsters even without the Gold Melting Cannon.
Han Xing replied, "No rush, just keep collecting slowly; send me the collected Vitality Ores."
Black Eagle immediately sent a trade request to Han Xing.
[Trade successful, you received Vitality Ore*137.]
With this material reserve, he could use the Gold Melting Cannon more freely.
Of course, the consumption was also terrifying.
In a day, he burned through at least several million Spirit Cores.
But Han Xing didn’t care.
When Spirit Cores are gone, he has ways to earn them back.
The urgent task is to convert these resources into personal strength.
Han Xing and his team began leveling up at rocket speed.
By the end of day five.
Han Xing’s personal points reached 400, and his teammates’ points also reached 360.
At that time, Boundless, the fastest, had just broken 250, and the gap kept widening.
By the end of day six.
Han Xing’s personal points officially exceeded 500, almost doubling Boundless, who was in sixth place.
The entire District 2, over 900,000 people, had already become completely numb these days.
"Oh my god... Star God is still sprinting; he’s already doubled Boundless in sixth place and is still sprinting!"
"What is his limit?"
Under such a massive gap.
It can be said that for the next two days, even if Han Xing did nothing, he could still sweep the top five and secure the rewards.
But Han Xing did not choose to stop.
Because during the points board duration, whether dealing with Sky Island Monsters or Secret Realm Monsters, he could gain more experience.
Taking advantage of this time, he intended to crazily boost his level and completely outpace the contestants.
This time, Black Eagle also found a way to acquire over a hundred more Vitality Ore, enough to support three days of consumption.
The seventh day, eighth day...
With two days left until the Cloud Secret Realm points board ends.
Han Xing’s personal points had already exceeded 800, while his four teammates each at least had 780 points.
As for the sixth-placed Boundless, any hope was basically gone.
Because he had just reached 400 points, and at their current daily increase of 30~50 points, catching up with Han Xing was impossible even when the leaderboard ends.
By the end of day eight.
Han Xing temporarily paused.
Because in the afternoon, Han Xing reached level 20.
Farming monsters no longer yielded any experience bonus.
Now, he needed to complete the advancement task to become a Second Transformation Professional.
And the Second Transformation quest in Sky Island Paradise was not complicated.
It required killing a leader monster of the same level alone to obtain an Expert Badge.
For Han Xing, this was relatively easy.
After leveling up, he could finally wear the level 18 Golden Equipment, the Meteorite Armor.
Currently, Han Xing possessed three pieces of Golden Equipment on his body.
Although the levels of these Golden Equipments weren’t high, their quality was not low, and their attributes were very strong.
Since Han Xing’s level was far ahead of other survivors, even browsing the trading channel didn’t result in finding much level 20 equipment.
Han Xing had to continue wearing this set of equipment for now.
In the vast sky, white clouds were floating.
At this moment, a gigantic Sky Island exceeding 100,000 square meters in area and over a hundred meters thick was hovering in the air.
This was Han Xing’s territory now.
After several days of exploration, while challenging the Secret Realm, Han Xing also conquered nearby Sky Islands.
Unlike the earlier clouds, these Sky Islands were no longer just thin layers.
They were complete landforms with features like small islands, full mountains, and woodlands...
After merging all these Sky Islands into his territory, Han Xing’s domain continued to grow larger.
Now, just his Sky Island itself occupied a massive area.
He took some time to perform a simple layout.
At the center of the territory, a European-style castle stood majestically.
Opposite the castle was a one-meter-deep clear river, with schools of fish swimming in it.
On the other side of the river, there were patches of fertile land hosting an array of Blue Star plants.
Over time, Han Xing expanded his kingdom by fusing over 500 siege crossbow arrow launcher platforms.
These weren’t the thin layers like before, resulting in a more complete ecological system.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong clicked his tongue in admiration, "Impressive! Your space isn’t nearly finished; we still need to build the Smelting Workshop, the Barracks, and the Tavern."
The whole team nodded in agreement.
However, Han Xing laughed, "It’s still early, the space is far from enough. I have to set up more territorial buildings. Smelting workshops, barracks, taverns, all need to be built."
"Once we secure the leaderboard rewards, we should focus on building more catapults and the Moonlight Spring."
"Then slowly expand the scale, build the army, and when the territory’s security is ensured, I can truly build my own city!"
Everyone listened to Han Xing’s vision for the future and couldn’t help but nod in agreement, their faces filled with anticipation.

sentences.text: Even if only a portion of them are willing to take action, that’s still a considerable number.
No matter how capable Black Eagle is, facing tens of thousands of greedy eyes, he wouldn’t dare claim he can pull through the crisis.
As for raiding Han Xing’s territory and implementing a decapitation strategy directly?
That’s out of the question.
He knew better than anyone how extraordinarily well-defended Han Xing’s territory was.
The blueprint for the siege crossbow arrow launcher platform was even given to him by Black Eagle.
Thinking of this, Black Eagle replied, "Got it, I’ll give orders for this matter.
If there’s any surplus material, I’ll return it to you."
After hanging up the private chat window.
A weight was lifted from Han Xing’s heart.
With Black Eagle helping him collect Vitality Ores, Han Xing finally solved his worry about materials.
So, he began using the Gold Melting Cannon more unscrupulously.
Boom!
Boom boom!
Monsters were blasted into pieces by the Gold Melting Cannon.
The ranking that stayed stagnant for a few hours once again started rising at a terrifying speed.
In less than an hour, the five of them surpassed Boundless and Optimus Prime, once again taking the top five spots.
And as time passed, the gap widened.
By dusk.
Han Xing’s personal points had surpassed 80, with Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang at least having 70 points.
And now, the most aggressive pursuer, Boundless, had barely broken 60 points!
By midnight.
Han Xing’s personal points had past 100.
Han Xing’s level officially reached level 18, and others also reached level 17.
Only 2 levels away from reaching level 20 and completing the Third Transformation.
While Boundless’ personal points had just surpassed 70.
The huge gap left the entire District 2 feeling deeply hopeless.
On Boundless’ territory.
The silver-haired man looked furious, vampire fangs exposed.
"Dammit!"
"Can anyone tell me how these guys do it so fast?
How on earth did they manage it?"
It was the first time for the elite members of the Kunlun Team to see Boundless lose composure like this.
Everyone was too scared to say anything.
At this moment, the faces of the leaders of several other large guilds were also quite ugly.
Earlier, they had confidently proclaimed they’d take the top three spots.
But now, five monsters unexpectedly topped the rankings, taking all top five spots.
As a result, many couldn’t even guarantee they’d make it to the top ten.
Looking at the rankings, some people began to have different thoughts.
That night, many major team’s leaders had emergency meetings.
The next day.
Today is the fifth day of the Cloud Secret Realm points board activation.
Just as Han Xing woke up, he received a private message from Black Eagle.
"Yesterday, I collected 137 Vitality Ores, expended 5.45 million Spirit Cores.
These materials are getting scarcer on the trading market, so I had my people buy in batches to avoid attention."
Seeing this number, Han Xing was pleasantly surprised.
As for the Spirit Cores spent, he didn’t care at all.
Sure enough, Black Eagle was indeed capable; he managed to collect over a hundred Vitality Ores in just a single day, enough to last him about three days.
According to Han Xing’s estimate, in three more days, he could reach level 20 and complete the Second Transformation.
By then, he could learn two new skills, and with the surge in strength, he’d be able to quickly farm monsters even without the Gold Melting Cannon.
Han Xing replied, "No rush, just keep collecting slowly; send me the collected Vitality Ores."
Black Eagle immediately sent a trade request to Han Xing.
[Trade successful, you received Vitality Ore*137.]
With this material reserve, he could use the Gold Melting Cannon more freely.
Of course, the consumption was also terrifying.
In a day, he burned through at least several million Spirit Cores.
But Han Xing didn’t care.
When Spirit Cores are gone, he has ways to earn them back.
The urgent task is to convert these resources into personal strength.
Han Xing and his team began leveling up at rocket speed.
By the end of day five.
Han Xing’s personal points reached 400, and his teammates’ points also reached 360.
At that time, Boundless, the fastest, had just broken 250, and the gap kept widening.
By the end of day six.
Han Xing’s personal points officially exceeded 500, almost doubling Boundless, who was in sixth place.
The entire District 2, over 900,000 people, had already become completely numb these days.
"Oh my god...
Star God is still sprinting; he’s already doubled Boundless in sixth place and is still sprinting!"
"What is his limit?"
Under such a massive gap.
It can be said that for the next two days, even if Han Xing did nothing, he could still sweep the top five and secure the rewards.
But Han Xing did not choose to stop.
Because during the points board duration, whether dealing with Sky Island Monsters or Secret Realm Monsters, he could gain more experience.
Taking advantage of this time, he intended to crazily boost his level and completely outpace the contestants.
This time, Black Eagle also found a way to acquire over a hundred more Vitality Ore, enough to support three days of consumption.
The seventh day, eighth day...
With two days left until the Cloud Secret Realm points board ends.
Han Xing’s personal points had already exceeded 800, while his four teammates each at least had 780 points.
As for the sixth-placed Boundless, any hope was basically gone.
Because he had just reached 400 points, and at their current daily increase of 30~50 points, catching up with Han Xing was impossible even when the leaderboard ends.
By the end of day eight.
Han Xing temporarily paused.
Because in the afternoon, Han Xing reached level 20.
Farming monsters no longer yielded any experience bonus.
Now, he needed to complete the advancement task to become a Second Transformation Professional.
And the Second Transformation quest in Sky Island Paradise was not complicated.
It required killing a leader monster of the same level alone to obtain an Expert Badge.
For Han Xing, this was relatively easy.
After leveling up, he could finally wear the level 18 Golden Equipment, the Meteorite Armor.
Currently, Han Xing possessed three pieces of Golden Equipment on his body.
Although the levels of these Golden Equipments weren’t high, their quality was not low, and their attributes were very strong.
Since Han Xing’s level was far ahead of other survivors, even browsing the trading channel didn’t result in finding much level 20 equipment.
Han Xing had to continue wearing this set of equipment for now.
In the vast sky, white clouds were floating.
At this moment, a gigantic Sky Island exceeding 100,000 square meters in area and over a hundred meters thick was hovering in the air.
This was Han Xing’s territory now.
After several days of exploration, while challenging the Secret Realm, Han Xing also conquered nearby Sky Islands.
Unlike the earlier clouds, these Sky Islands were no longer just thin layers.
They were complete landforms with features like small islands, full mountains, and woodlands...
After merging all these Sky Islands into his territory, Han Xing’s domain continued to grow larger.
Now, just his Sky Island itself occupied a massive area.
He took some time to perform a simple layout.
At the center of the territory, a European-style castle stood majestically.
Opposite the castle was a one-meter-deep clear river, with schools of fish swimming in it.
On the other side of the river, there were patches of fertile land hosting an array of Blue Star plants.
Over time, Han Xing expanded his kingdom by fusing over 500 siege crossbow arrow launcher platforms.
These weren’t the thin layers like before, resulting in a more complete ecological system.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong clicked his tongue in admiration, "Impressive!
Your space isn’t nearly finished; we still need to build the Smelting Workshop, the Barracks, and the Tavern."
The whole team nodded in agreement.
However, Han Xing laughed, "It’s still early, the space is far from enough.
I have to set up more territorial buildings.
Smelting workshops, barracks, taverns, all need to be built."
"Once we secure the leaderboard rewards, we should focus on building more catapults and the Moonlight Spring."
"Then slowly expand the scale, build the army, and when the territory’s security is ensured, I can truly build my own city!"
Everyone listened to Han Xing’s vision for the future and couldn’t help but nod in agreement, their faces filled with anticipation.

chapters.title: Chapter 142 - 122: Sky City
paragraphs: After Han Xing prepared to establish the Wolf Cavalry Camp and the Minotaur Camp, he planned to enter a troop-building mode.

At this moment, Cheng Jianyong eagerly asked, "Brother Xing, if you form an army in the future, could you spare me a brigade? I’ve long wanted to experience the feeling of leading troops to conquer the lands!"
Shen Yun glanced at him disdainfully and said, "You want to lead troops? Have you ever been on a battlefield?"
"So what if I haven’t!"
Cheng Jianyong said excitedly, "This isn’t modern warfare, it’s all about magic and swordplay."
"When the time comes, watch me take the enemy’s head amidst the chaos!"
Shen Yun was utterly speechless.
At this time, Han Xing smiled and said, "It’s still early to build an army; for now, let’s focus on completing the Second Transformation advancement quest."
Only then did everyone remember this; Han Xing had already reached Level 20, and advancement was imminent.
At this point, Shen Yun commented, "This advancement quest is quite challenging; it actually requires handling a Leader Monster alone."
"I suspect that besides Brother Xing, none of us can confidently say we can easily pass this quest."
Since Han Xing had Coal Ball, a violent pet for assistance, he could easily deal with Leader Monsters of the same level.
Hearing this, Cheng Jianyong was surprised and said, "What? Your advancement quests require soloing a Leader Monster? I only need to solo an Elite Monster!"
Everyone was taken aback.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng softly said from the side, "I also just need to solo an Elite Monster."
Su Xiaoyang timidly said, "Mine is a Leader Monster..."
Everyone felt a bit puzzled.
Typically, when ordinary Survivors reach Level 18, the system automatically issues two quests.
One is an advancement quest, and the other is a challenge quest.
[Advancement Quest]: Break through the Level Limit to complete Profession advancement.
[Quest Condition 1]: Survivor reaches Level 20.
[Advancement Condition 2]: Obtain 1 Expert Emblem.
The Expert Emblem is a non-tradable quest item that can only be obtained through challenge quests.
The ’Advancement Quest’ requirements are the same for everyone.
However, the challenge quest varies somewhat.
[Challenge Quest]: Survivors must complete a test of their abilities.
Successfully defeating a same-level Leader or higher-grade monster grants the item reward: 1 Expert Emblem.
Han Xing, Shen Yun, and Su Xiaoyang’s quests require them to defeat Level 20 Leader Monsters.
Whereas Cheng Jianyong and Zhang Lianmeng only need to defeat Level 20 Elite Monsters.
Everyone seemed to realize something, connecting it to their respective professions, and suddenly they understood.
Cheng Jianyong’s eyes showed a look of realization, "So that’s it, for ordinary professions like ours, simply challenging a same-level Elite Monster can complete the quest."
"This is also a system mechanism to take care of ordinary players like us."
"Whereas those who have transferred to hidden professions, due to the advantages of their professions, have relatively more difficult advancement quests."
Upon understanding this, everyone felt at ease.
This mechanism is rather humane.
Otherwise, at this stage, besides top-tier players like Han Xing, even ordinary players would need to struggle to handle an Elite Monster, let alone a powerful Leader Monster.
Han Xing shook his head and said, "It’s okay, although Leader Monsters are powerful, based on your skills, as long as you choose the right target, you can still defeat them."
"Even though you don’t have pets, you can still take advantage of your profession specialties to find Leader Monsters with weaknesses and adopt targeted strategies."
Su Xiaoyang and Shen Yun’s eyes lit up; they understood Han Xing’s meaning.
What are targeted strategies?
For instance, Su Xiaoyang’s profession, Elf Shooter, has flight capabilities. In this case, they can find a Level 20 Leader with short reach and kite it to death.
Shen Yun’s profession also has distinctive features.
The Radiant Knight deals an additional 150% damage when dealing with Dark Creatures, such as Ghosts and the Undead.
With these thoughts, everyone’s gaze at Han Xing became tinged with admiration.
Now, they just need to find suitable battle targets.
As for Level 20 Leader Monsters, they are also easy to find.
For instance, clouds with an area over ten thousand square meters are highly likely to have a Level 20 Leader inside.
Of course, they might also encounter even stronger enemies.
However, for extremely dangerous Sky Islands like these, the system will provide corresponding warnings.
The massive Sky Island continued moving forward.
After Han Xing reached Level 20, the Sky Island’s movement speed increased significantly again.
It reached a movement speed of 77 meters per second, which translates to a speed of 277 kilometers per hour.
But due to the growing size of the Sky Island, it seemed relatively slow.
Before long, a vast cloud appeared ahead of everyone.
Rough estimates put its area at over twenty thousand square meters, the largest cloud Han Xing and company could currently challenge.
If it were any larger, it would likely harbor Three-star Monsters.
After the two massive Sky Islands drew near, a system prompt appeared.
[This was once a territory of the Human Race Empire, a prosperous small city, its former splendor vanished after the wash of time...]
"A small city? Does that mean there’s a city inside?"
Hearing this prompt, everyone was also surprised.
This was the first time they encountered architecture from the world’s original inhabitants outside of a Secret Realm.
Moreover, the system did not clearly state whether there are any monsters inside.
Han Xing clicked confirm with a face full of confusion.
After the clouds dispersed, a floating island suddenly appeared ahead.
Everyone looked on with curiosity.
Just as the system indicated, on the island was a relatively intact human town.
The first thing that caught the eye was a blue stone wall about two meters high, encircling the entire island.
However, it seemed that due to the ravages of war, the wall had many cracks and several collapsed gaps.
Passing through the wall, inside were rows of medieval-style buildings.
Blue bricks and red walls, each building was carved with some ornate decorations, all of which displayed the city’s former prosperity.
But now, the bustling scene was gone, leaving only a wreckage.
Houses collapsed, ground sunk, leaving only scattered wood and stone blocks.
"My God! Could this be the Sky City from the movies?" Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help exclaiming.
Han Xing wondered, "A human town... does this mean that the Human Race in this world once developed well here?"
Everyone was also very puzzled.
In their impression, the place where survivors descended was always a shatter of broken Sky Islands, without any sign of civilization.
In the last Knight Judgment Arena, although everyone knew there was a Human Race in this world, they had never encountered them.

Most importantly, from the information Han Xing received, the place where the Blue Star people arrived was called the Land of the Abandoned Gods, a place other intelligent creatures were unwilling to set foot in.
But why, only the Human Race prospered here?
Unable to think of an answer, Han Xing shook his head and said, "I’ll go in and explore a bit to see if I can find anything."
With that, he maneuvered his territory closer to the city in the sky, ready to land.
Then, at that moment.
The ground beneath everyone’s feet trembled, and they found it hard to stand steadily.
Rumble!
A violent quaking sensation came, as if they had collided with an air wall.
Han Xing looked carefully, and in front of him appeared a transparent defense shield.
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
[You have approached the territory of the Human Race Empire, Lamino City. If you have not obtained permission from the City Lord, your intrusion will be regarded as a forceful invasion.]
Hearing this, Han Xing was a little surprised.
Lamino City, that should be the name of this Suspended City.
But he didn’t expect that this seemingly ancient small city actually had something like a defense shield.
"There’s even a defense shield here. Does that mean there might be other structures like pyramids inside?"
Han Xing also heard the words City Lord, which indicated that there might be living people inside.
However, after observing for a while, he didn’t see any signs of life coming out from the town.
Everyone was also expressing great confusion.
Then, Han Xing tried attacking the defense shield.
An arrow shot out, creating ripples on the transparent shield.
A prompt appeared in front of him.
[Intermediate Spiritual Defense Shield: Remaining defense value, 1180/1200.]
Han Xing’s arrow only knocked off 20 points of defense value, but that was because he just attacked casually without using full force.
"What a thick shield!" Han Xing exclaimed in surprise.
The intermediate defense shield had 1000 more defense points than the basic defense shield.
At this time, the system prompt appeared again.

[Please note, your actions have already displeased the creatures within Lamino City. If you continue these attack actions, the creatures inside Lamino City will regard you as a hostile entity and retaliate.]
"Retaliate?"
Han Xing was shocked inwardly.
He quickly instructed everyone to step back.
However, after waiting for half a minute, there was still no movement inside.
At this time, Han Xing realized something was amiss with the system prompt.
This prompt seemed not to be from the system, but from the creatures inside.
It sounded like a threat and warning, but Han Xing detected a sense of insecurity from it.
"Is this guy inside trying to scare me off?"
A strange expression suddenly appeared on Han Xing’s face.
"If I’m not allowed in, I insist on entering!"
With that, Han Xing directly operated the crossbow arrow launcher platform for a volley.
Thwack thwack thwack!
The siege crossbow arrow launcher platform caused significant damage, with very noticeable effects.
After a round of volleys, the shield with over 1000 defense points broke instantly.
Yet, even with the shield shattered, the town remained eerily quiet, with no creatures coming out.
After waiting for a moment, Han Xing murmured softly.
"It seems, the folks inside don’t want to come out."
The system’s prompt confirmed that there were definitely living creatures inside.
Shen Yun worriedly said from the side, "Brother Xing, the entities inside seem not too welcoming to us. Should we still go in?"

chapters.title: Chapter 143 - 123: Knight and Welcoming Gift
paragraphs: "Brother Xing, it seems like whatever is inside doesn’t really welcome us. Do we still want to go in?" Shen Yun asked.
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, of course we do. This is the first city of the Human Race we’ve encountered, we definitely have to explore it."
"However, I’ll go in alone first."
"Because I can see that there aren’t many living beings inside. If it’s just a leader, I can also take the opportunity to complete the job-changing task."
"If I encounter any danger, I’ll call you guys."
Everyone nodded after listening.
Then, Han Xing piloted the Sky Island to the edge of this Suspended City.
Once the two large Sky Islands connected, Han Xing jumped directly onto the city wall.
Everyone watched Han Xing anxiously.
Han Xing waved and said, "I’m going down."
With that, he jumped directly onto the city’s street.
As soon as he landed, Han Xing prepared for combat.
A system alert appeared.
[You have entered Lamino City. The owner here was once a figure of noble status in the Human Race Empire. Your actions have already displeased them. Please leave their territory quickly.]
Han Xing ignored the warning and continued to explore this small city.
This was his first time seeing a human city in this world, and his heart was filled with curiosity.
Han Xing randomly approached a house, and the system indicated that the door was closed and couldn’t be entered.
"Won’t let me in?"
Han Xing stroked his chin, looked at the door with a defense value of 50, drew the bowstring, and shot two arrows quickly.
Swish! Swish!
The door’s defense value instantly dropped to zero.
Han Xing put away his longbow, clapped his hands, and said, "Isn’t this doable?"
Bang!
Han Xing kicked the door open and walked in.
Inside, it appeared to be an ordinary family residence, with two floors, like a small western-style villa, with an exterior design full of artistic flair.
The entrance was a hall, with a bedroom on each side.
Inside the hall was a wooden staircase that seemed to connect to the villa’s second floor.
After rummaging around, Han Xing couldn’t find anything valuable and left, uninspired.
After kicking down several doors, Han Xing lost interest.
Then, Han Xing continued to wander the streets, stopping when he saw an interesting building.
Along the way, he saw many buildings like taverns, shops, and trading posts.
More importantly, Han Xing discovered a special building among them, a smelting workshop.
Han Xing’s eyes lit up, "A smelting workshop? Does this mean I can exploit the mines on my territory?"
Though it was just a small city, the facilities were quite complete.
As Han Xing gradually approached the city center, two tall buildings appeared before him.

There’s a massive castle taking up four to five thousand square meters sitting in the city’s center, and beside it, there’s a pyramid occupying more than 200 square meters and nearly forty meters high.
"This should be the city’s main building, similar to my Basic Castle. The one next to it should be an Intermediate Spiritual Shield Pyramid."
Han Xing approached the massive castle, intending to continue his exploration.
Then, a system alert appeared again.
[Lamino City Lord’s Mansion]: Intermediate territory building.
[State]: Closed
[Remaining Defense Value]: 10,000
"Looks like the guy inside really doesn’t want me to enter, even closed the City Lord’s Mansion doors." Han Xing was quite speechless.
"With a defense value of 10,000, if I have to grind it down myself, who knows how long it’d take."
With that thought, Han Xing opened the territory interface and started remotely controlling the siege crossbow arrow launcher platform.
The next moment, more than 700 attacking crossbow towers began adjusting their angles.
Crunch! Crunch!
Even from hundreds of meters away, Han Xing could hear the hair-raising sound of the siege crossbow arrow launcher platform.
Han Xing was confident that with the power of the siege crossbow arrows, a round of focused fire would surely blow up even an intermediate city lord’s mansion like this.
However, just as more than 700 crossbow arrows were about to fire, the city lord’s mansion’s gate slowly opened by itself.
Han Xing immediately stepped back, tightened his grip on the longbow, and prepared for combat.
Once the gate opened, Han Xing saw a humanoid creature in silver armor, with a sword at its waist, walking out.
From inside, came a voice that was both ancient and helpless.
"Why... must you disturb my peace?"
At this moment, Han Xing got a clear look at the creature’s appearance.
Its attire was much like the knights Han Xing had seen in the Knight Judgment Arena.
However, this knight appeared very old, lacking the grace of the knights of old.
Han Xing asked confusedly, "Um, old man?"
The elderly knight was momentarily taken aback upon seeing Han Xing.
"Are you... of the Human Race?"
Han Xing looked at himself, then nodded, "Do I not look like it?"
The shock in the elderly knight’s eyes gradually dissipated, then he shook his head, "No, it’s just that I haven’t seen a human in hundreds of years, so I’m a bit surprised."
He looked curiously at Han Xing.
This was also the first time Han Xing had encountered a monster that could communicate.
The two exchanged glances for a moment.
At this time, the elderly knight’s attitude seemed to have softened considerably, and he said, "Would you like to come in and sit for a while?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment and accepted his invitation.
Under the guidance of the elderly knight, the two walked together down the corridor.
Inside the castle, the decor was extremely luxurious, surrounded by various ornaments, including some abstract-style paintings, with different patterns carved on each stone pillar.
After passing through the corridor, they arrived at an opulent guest hall.
The hall was furnished with many tables.
The two sat facing each other.
At this moment, the other party spoke first, "My name is Lamino, as you can see, I am the City Lord of this small town."
Upon hearing the introduction, Han Xing gave him a peculiar look.
The elderly knight, seeing Han Xing’s expression, asked puzzledly, "What’s the matter, is there anything wrong?"
Han Xing shook his head, saying, "Nothing, please continue."
Lamino nodded, "Young man, how did you find this place?"
His meaning was probably to ask how Han Xing had found the Sky Island.
Han Xing was momentarily taken aback, "I just wandered around nearby for a few rounds, then found this place."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s response, the elderly knight seemed a bit stunned, then laughed and shook his head.
"Alright, no need to force yourself if you don’t want to say.
"Young man, since you’ve found this place, it’s fate that brings us together. As we’re both Human Race, how about I give you a welcome gift?"
Upon hearing that there was a gift to be received, Han Xing’s eyes instantly brightened, and he hastily nodded, "Yes, yes!"
The other party, seeing Han Xing’s unabashed attitude, also laughed.
Then, right in front of Han Xing, the elderly knight took out a scroll from his pocket.
[Knight Rune Blueprint]: Moderately increases Defense and Magic Resistance.
Seeing the information on it, Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
It’s yet another Rune Blueprint, and it’s a rare double attribute blueprint that increases both Physical and Magical Defense!
Just as the name of this blueprint suggests, the crafted rune is very suitable for the knight profession, known for being a tank.
Of course, other professions can also use it. After enchanting all equipment, Defense will greatly increase.
The elderly knight handed the Rune Blueprint to Han Xing.
Han Xing received it, his face full of joy.
At this moment, the other party inadvertently caught sight of the ’Kingdom Ring’ in Han Xing’s hand. His pupils instantly shrank, and he couldn’t help but tremble slightly.
But he quickly concealed this emotion.
Han Xing seemed not to have noticed. Gleefully, he stored the Rune Blueprint in his backpack, a smile appearing on his face.
The elderly knight exhaled softly and asked, "Young man, I would like to ask you a few questions. I wonder if you’re willing to answer."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing quickly responded, "Of course, go ahead and ask."
After all, having accepted such a precious blueprint right off the bat, answering a few questions seemed a small matter.
The elderly knight asked, "I want to know what’s been happening outside recently, any news about the Knight King?"
Han Xing shook his head, "Knight King? No, nothing."
The elderly knight looked somewhat surprised, paused, then continued, "Do you know of Knight King Grotar?"
"Yes, I do." Han Xing replied truthfully.
The elderly knight breathed a sigh of relief, murmuring softly, "That’s good, it seems I haven’t fallen out of step with the times..."
Then the elderly knight sighed, "Young man, what’s the state of the wars outside?"
Han Xing looked puzzled, "Which particular war do you refer to?"

The elderly knight paused for a moment, then replied, "The war between the Human Kingdom and the Undead Knight Order. Back then, Lymes initiated the Undead Calamity, summoning back the souls of many who had passed away, launching their attack on the Human Empire."
"Back then, it was a grave disaster for the entire Land of the Abandoned Gods..."
Han Xing’s eyes showed a contemplative expression.
It seems the scenes seen at the Knight Judgment Arena were already fragments from hundreds of years ago.
When Lymes did not get suppressed by the God of Light’s divine power, but instead escaped from the Judgment Arena, subsequently unleashing an Undead Calamity on the entire Human Kingdom.
As for what happened later, it’s all unknown.

Han Xing said, "The wars initiated by the Undead Knight Order were many years ago. I am unaware of the details, only that now, throughout the Land of the Abandoned Gods, no other Human Race is visible."
"No other Human Race visible?" The elderly knight was greatly shocked upon hearing this.

"How is it possible... Back then, the Human Kingdom’s domain covered the entirety of the Land of the Abandoned Gods, encompassing more than seventy thousand cities of varying sizes, with the population once reaching ten billion!"
"Could it be that the war back then was lost?"
The elderly knight furrowed his brow.
Meanwhile, Han Xing caught a key piece of information from his words.
That key information was how the Human Race had once flourished tremendously in the Land of the Abandoned Gods, with a population surpassing even that of Blue Star.
Yet strangely, upon entering this world, Han Xing encountered no other humans, except for this old knight.
The elderly knight asked again, "Then, where did you come from?"

chapters.title: Chapter 144 - 124: Let Me Show You My Da Bao!
paragraphs: "Then where did you come from?" the elderly knight asked Han Xing.
After speaking, he glanced overhead, seemingly noticing the vast territory above Han Xing’s land.
Han Xing shrugged, saying, "I don’t know either, I just suddenly came over."
"Suddenly came over?" The elderly knight was baffled by Han Xing’s words.
He wanted to continue speaking but was interrupted by Han Xing.
"Alright, you’ve asked so many questions, it’s my turn now, right?"
The elderly knight was stunned for a moment, showing slight displeasure, but he quickly suppressed it.
He nodded and said, "Go ahead."
Han Xing didn’t hold back and directly asked, "Why is this place called the Land of the Abandoned Gods?"
This was the question Han Xing most wanted to know.
The elderly knight replied, "As the name suggests, this is a place abandoned by the gods, because here, the power of the gods cannot cover and the divine power cannot be exerted."
"Moreover, this place has a natural repulsion against all intelligent creatures; the stronger the existence, the greater the repulsion."
"Also, if you stay in the Land of the Abandoned Gods for too long, your power will rapidly drain, including that of the gods."
Han Xing nodded, continuing to ask, "Then why can the Human Race survive and develop here for a long time?"
The elderly knight shook his head, "I don’t know, or rather, there are very few people in this world who understand the reason."
"But the powerful beings all know that the Land of the Abandoned Gods absolutely holds a big secret, so much so that it can weaken the power of the gods, which even a Holy Artifact cannot do!"
"There are also secrets hidden in the Human Race."
"Once, due to the pursuit of the secrets of the Land of the Abandoned Gods, many powerful beings from the outside once launched large-scale persecutions against the Human Race."
"But later, because the God of Light issued a divine decree, these persecution actions came to a halt."
After hearing his explanation, Han Xing had some initial understanding of this world.
The Land of the Abandoned Gods is a secluded area of this world.
Outside, there are more vast territories where powerful races like Elves, Dwarves, and Giants live.
Then, Han Xing continued to ask, "Speaking of which, why are you here?"
This question seemed to leave his counterpart silent for a long time.
A moment later, he sighed, "Back then, Lymes’ undead army swept across the entire Land of the Abandoned Gods, and this Lamina Town I stood in was inevitably engulfed in the flames of war."
"I led the Knight Guard under my command to bravely resist."
"But the undead army was too strong, and their combat methods were extremely strange, making it impossible for the Knight Guard to withstand."
"After they broke through the town, they began to massacre civilians, turning them into members of the undead army."
"I thought I would die in that war, but unexpectedly, through a stroke of luck, I managed to escape with my life."
"When I came to my senses, I found that this once-prosperous small town only had me left."
"Then I started repairing and mending this abandoned city alone, the death of my loved ones hit me hard, and it forever trapped me here..."
The elderly knight’s eyes revealed intense sadness.
At this moment, the elderly knight continued, "I’ve been here for hundreds of years, feeling very lonely... If possible, can you bring your friends over to chat with me?"
Han Xing stared at him, and a moment later, solemnly said,
"You’re lying!"
The elderly knight’s expression changed as he looked at Han Xing, "Young man, what are you saying? What am I lying about?"
Han Xing said, "Old man, don’t try to fool me anymore, you’re not the master of this place at all!"
Hearing this, the elderly knight was profoundly shocked.

But he still forced himself to suppress the panic in his eyes, saying, "Nonsense! I’ve lived here since I was a child, and when the Old City Lord passed away, His Majesty the Knight King personally handed me the City Lord’s Order, how could I not be the master here?"
Han Xing sneered at that, "Alright, stop pretending."
"I not only know you’re lying, I also know your real name isn’t Lamino, but Longte, right?"
The elderly knight was instantly astounded.
He pointed at Han Xing, trembling, "You... you knew all along!?
A smile appeared at the corner of Han Xing’s mouth.
Even when the other party was making his introduction, Han Xing already had his suspicions in his heart.
Because at that time, the elderly knight said his name was Lamino and that he was the City Lord.
But he certainly didn’t expect that Han Xing and others were beings equipped with a system.
He could directly see the attributes of these monsters.
[Kingdom Knight Longte, (Two-Star Leader Creature)]
[Level]: lv20
[Attributes]: Power 403, agility 392, Spirit 354, Constitution 455.
[Skills]: Blade Chaos Dance, Divine Eagle Eye, Holy Light Barrier, Divine Punishment.
At this point, Longte also knew his disguise had been uncovered.
The panic in his eyes disappeared, and instead, he put on a calm face and said, "I was planning on letting you bring all your companions over, so I could take you down all in one go."
"Since you, young man, saw through it, I’ll catch you first and then deal with them slowly!"
After saying that, the unmasked Longte waved his hand!
The next moment, the main gate of the City Lord’s Mansion suddenly closed.
Including the doors to the reception hall, which also shut tight!
Boom!
At the same time, all lights in the hall dimmed, and the surroundings plunged into darkness.
In the darkness, Han Xing faintly heard Longte’s chilling laughter.
"Young man, let me introduce you to some new friends, and maybe soon, you’ll become one of them too..."

chapters.title: Chapter 145 - 124: Let Me Show You My Da Bao! (Part 2)
paragraphs: Longte finished speaking.
In the pitch-black environment, clusters of ghostly green fires suddenly rose.
In the next moment, those ghost fires transformed into humanoid phantoms.
"So cold... so cold!"
"Stop hitting me, sob sob..."
"Finally, I can come out... hehe!"
[Resentful Spirit: (Two-star special creature, Elite Level)]
[Level]: lv20
[Attributes]: Power 243, Agility 252, Spirit 294, Constitution 234.
[Skills]: Soul Body, Wailing of the Vengeful Spirits, Possession.
The air echoed with the whispers of these vengeful spirits.
In total, there were eight vengeful spirits, plus a leader-level monster; this lineup was quite formidable.
Even a well-equipped team of survivors might be annihilated if surrounded suddenly.
Fortunately, the monsters in this City Lord’s Mansion were not at Level 21.

Because Level 21 creatures are equivalent to having completed the Second Transformation, their attributes are multiplicatively enhanced, and even the most common Level 21 small monsters can crush Level 20 elite monsters in attributes.
However, when Han Xing saw these monsters, he had a bizarre expression on his face.
"Say, you, a knight who believes in the God of Light, actually keep company with such evil creatures."
"You old guy, are you secretly a traitor to the Holy Light?" Han Xing taunted without hesitation.
On the other side, Longte’s expression remained unchanged upon hearing this as he let out an old laugh, "Haha... God of Light..."
"For so many years, the God of Light has never answered my calls, no matter how many times I confess, he remains unmoved!"
"In my loneliest moments, only these vengeful spirits kept me company."
"They are all my masterpieces!"
At this point, Longte’s expression became increasingly twisted.
"After that war, I locked all the surviving residents of this city away and tortured them by various means."
"I wanted to create perfect vengeful spirits using the method a certain woman taught me."
"However, they couldn’t endure my torture, and many civilians perished as their wills crumbled."
"Just when I thought I was going to fail, I discovered a few promising subjects among them."
"I treated them like treasures, using all methods to destroy their flesh bodies and torment their souls!
"Until finally, I created these few vengeful spirits that could be called perfect..."
"Do you feel it? Their resentment is so intense... and soon you will become one of them, accompanying me here, day in and day out, for hundreds of years..."
Listening to this, Han Xing shuddered with disgust.
"You perverse old thing!"
Han Xing swiftly entered combat mode.
Even when trapped amidst so many monsters, he did not feel panic.
In the next moment, the vengeful spirits rushed towards Han Xing.
Han Xing quickly took a few steps back
and then fired an arrow.
The arrow passed through the bodies of the vengeful spirits as if striking air, causing no damage.
These humanoid vengeful spirits seemed immune to Han Xing’s attack.
On the other side, Longte laughed gloatingly, "Boy, your attack can’t harm them; just surrender obediently and let me refine you into the perfect vengeful spirit..."
Han Xing glanced at him, "Can’t harm them? How about this?"
Longte looked at Han Xing’s actions in confusion.
"Let me show you my big treasure!"
Han Xing slowly reached into his backpack and pulled out a huge golden object.
The thing was nearly two meters long and about sixty centimeters thick.
It was indeed a big treasure in every sense!
In the next moment, Han Xing aimed the forty-centimeter cannon muzzle at the front.
Button pressed!
In Longte’s bewildered gaze, a head-sized fireball illuminated the dark hall and then exploded.
Boom!
In this confined space, the damage from the Molten Gold Cannon was maximized.
These vengeful spirits were inherently creatures of the cold attribute, and at the instant they made contact with the searing firelight,
all the vengeful spirits let out piercing howls of pain.
"So painful... so painful..."
The entire City Lord’s Mansion seemed to shake violently at this moment.
After the tumult subsided.
At least three or four of the undead had their soul bodies directly blown apart by this shot, with system notifications appearing consecutively.
[Successfully killed Resentful Spirit (Two-Star Elite Creature), gained 56000 experience points...]
[Successfully killed Resentful Spirit...]
On the side, Longte seemed utterly stunned by this shot.
As a Level 20 leader monster, this shot only caused him minor damage.
But the shock of such an up-close and personal explosion left a deep, indelible impression on his heart.
At this moment, Longte seemed to come to his senses and cursed angrily, "Damn it!"
With that, Longte raised his great sword, and pure Holy Light gathered at its tip.
However, before he could launch an attack.
Han Xing fired a second shot.
Boom!
The City Lord’s Mansion trembled violently, with the solid walls of the hall being blasted open under the terrifying force.
Dazzling sunlight streamed into the darkness.

The fire attribute damage from the Molten Gold Cannon provided extra bonus damage to these undead creatures, and with two shots, more than half of the vengeful spirits summoned by Longte were already dead.
In the spots where those vengeful spirits perished, there appeared to be patches of white crystal powder.
Seizing the upper hand, Han Xing relentlessly pressed the Molten Gold Cannon’s firing button.
Boom boom boom!
After three consecutive earth-shattering explosions.
All eight Level 20 elite vengeful spirits were annihilated.
On the scene, only Longte remained alone.
Longte seemed incredulous, "How is that possible... these vengeful spirits were painstakingly created by me, that woman said ordinary attacks couldn’t harm them?"

In the next moment, those ghost fires transformed into humanoid phantoms.
"So cold... so cold!"
"Stop hitting me, sob sob..."
"Finally, I can come out... hehe!"

The air echoed with the whispers of these vengeful spirits.
In total, there were eight vengeful spirits, plus a leader-level monster; this lineup was quite formidable.
Even a well-equipped team of survivors might be annihilated if surrounded suddenly.
Fortunately, the monsters in this City Lord’s Mansion were not at Level 21.

Because Level 21 creatures are equivalent to having completed the Second Transformation, their attributes are multiplicatively enhanced, and even the most common Level 21 small monsters can crush Level 20 elite monsters in attributes.
However, when Han Xing saw these monsters, he had a bizarre expression on his face.
"Say, you, a knight who believes in the God of Light, actually keep company with such evil creatures."
"You old guy, are you secretly a traitor to the Holy Light?" Han Xing taunted without hesitation.

God of Light..."

chapters.title: Chapter 146 - 124: Let Me Show You My Da Bao! (Part 3)
paragraphs: "Damn it, what kind of weapon is that!"
Han Xing didn’t respond to him, instead, he lifted the cannon and fired directly.
"Old thing, you’re dropping gold coins!"
BOOM!
The Gold Melting Cannon’s shell made close contact with Longte, causing a terrifying explosion damage.
At this moment, a strong light suddenly appeared on Longte’s body.
The force of the explosion collided with the Holy Light Shield on Longte’s body.
CRACK!
This shot directly shattered Longte’s shield.
Yet, Longte’s body itself wasn’t much harmed.
After all, the Gold Melting Cannon is Level 10 equipment, while Longte is a Level 20 Leader Monster, a big level gap.
Moreover, Han Xing also noticed that the quality of the Knight’s Heavy Armor on Longte was quite outstanding.
Longte glared sullenly, angrily saying, "Kid, you’re dead!"
Han Xing ignored his threat.
Instead, he glanced upwards.
In the air, the silhouette of the Void Ghost Wolf hung on the crystal chandelier, as Han Xing had previously instructed it to stay put.
At this moment, after receiving Han Xing’s command.
Coal Ball charged forward instantly.
After a few days of growth, the Void Ghost Wolf now truly carried the aura of the King of the Jungle.
With a body length of about two meters, it was definitely a giant beast.
In mid-air, Coal Ball executed the Burst Skill, Counterattack Spike.
Ten spikes laden with Void breath erupted abruptly.
Puff, puff, puff!
Longte couldn’t dodge in time and was hit by the Void Ghost Wolf’s spikes, emitting a burst of black mist, and his defense was greatly weakened.
Then, Han Xing pressed the button twice in quick succession!
Bang! Bang!
These two shots directly shattered the opponent’s armor, sending Longte flying backward.
The defense reduction effect of Coal Ball was quite significant.
At that moment, Han Xing put away the cannon and began frantically pulling the bowstring to shoot.
At this time, Longte’s body was charred black from the explosion, and after landing, he coughed up a mouthful of fresh blood.
He viciously looked at Han Xing, his eyes filled with a venomous look.
The next moment, Longte raised the great sword in his hand high, and it seemed as if a peculiar beam of light traversed space and descended instantly from the sky.
"Oh Divine Light...punish these sinful people!"
"Hmm? The old thing is trying to go big?"
Han Xing realized something was wrong.
Then, he decisively drew an arrow, and a bright moon gathered beside Longte.
Legendary Skills, Broken Moon!
The next moment, Longte was sealed within the moon.
Then, Han Xing immediately used the second Burst Skill.
Fallen Star Arrow Rain!
On this day, the City Lord’s Mansion, silent for hundreds of years, suddenly encountered a meteor shower.
Only, each of these meteors carried a dangerous aura.
Like meteorites falling from outside the heavens, causing terrifying impacts.
RUMBLE!
Meteors continuously fell, then erupted with explosive damage!
When the control time of the Shattered Moon Skill ended, that bright moon shattered, followed by 1200% burst damage!
This set of control followed by burst left the Leader Longte heavily injured by Han Xing.
A Level 20 Leader Monster was no longer challenging for Han Xing.
Of course, this was largely due to the strong control effect of the Legendary Skills, Broken Moon.
Five seconds was enough for him to deal tons of damage.
At this time, Knight Longte was lying on the ground, on his last breath, watching as a swift figure slowly walked toward him.
He seemed to be overwhelmed by Han Xing’s attack, the expression of resentment disappeared, and his cloudy eyes showed a hint of fear.
Han Xing slowly squatted down, asking, "Alright, now tell me your true identity."
Knight Longte seemed to have been scared out of his wits by Han Xing, shivering on the ground!
He responded in terror, "I’ll talk! I’ll talk!"

chapters.title: Chapter 147 - 125: Annexation!
paragraphs: Han Xing pressed Longte for his true identity, and the other confessed everything in one go.
"I’m not Lamino! I’m a soldier under Lamino!"
"That day, Lymes’ undead army attacked, and City Lord Ramino went out with the guards to meet them, but I was too scared, so I hid in the basement of the City Lord’s Mansion."
"Later, I don’t know what happened, I only know that after that battle, Lord Ramino never came back, and there were only some old, weak women and children left in the city..."
After hearing this, Han Xing roughly understood the whole story and mocked, "Turns out, you’re a deserter!"
However, upon hearing this, Longte beneath him became instantly agitated.
"I’m not a deserter! I’m not a deserter!"
"Lymes and his forces were too strong, if I didn’t hide, everyone would have died under their undead iron heels!"
Han Xing disdainfully replied, "Is that so? Then why did you target those civilians after the war?"
Han Xing had heard this guy talk about how he tortured those civilians before refining those eight Resentful Spirits.
This question was too sharp, making Longte shiver all over while lying on the ground.
"I... I don’t know..."
He looked at Han Xing, seeming reluctant to answer the question.
However, Han Xing had no patience to engage in a mental work with this old knight.
An arrow shot out, directly piercing through Longte’s palm!
"Ah!!" The acute pain made Longte emit a sharp, hoarse scream.
Han Xing remained unmoved and said, "Think carefully before answering, if you say ’I don’t know’ again, the next arrow won’t be aimed at your hand?"
Faced with Han Xing’s death threat, the already timid Longte was even more terrified, shivering on the ground.
Han Xing pulled back the arrow, urging, "Hurry up!"
The Longte on the ground seemed to be engaged in an intense inner struggle.
Longte slowly began to speak, "I met someone, a woman, she taught me..."
However, before this sentence was finished, Longte’s body stopped trembling.
Longte suddenly lifted his head.
Han Xing noticed his pupils turning a deathly white.
Then, Longte gave Han Xing an eerie smile.
"What the hell?" Han Xing found the old knight’s smile somewhat baffling.
In the next moment, Han Xing saw the image of a woman on Longte’s aged face.
Before Han Xing could react, Longte suddenly charged at him.
Han Xing had remained vigilant, and as Longte charged at him, an arrow pierced into his forehead.
Puff!
A spray of blood appeared.
Knight Longte’s head got penetrated, and he collapsed limply onto the ground.
[Successfully killed Kingdom Knight Longte, Two-star Leader Level, gained 720,000 Experience Value.]
[Challenge task has been completed, obtained reward, Expert Badge*1.]
Hearing the system’s prompt, Han Xing’s expression was still grim, as if a layer of mist had settled over his heart.
"That woman’s appearance looks a bit familiar..."
Han Xing recalled the final scene, the woman’s face that appeared before Longte died seemed to have been seen somewhere.
But as the features were too blurry, Han Xing couldn’t be sure,
"As I get to know this world more, things are becoming more complicated..."
Han Xing sighed; he clearly felt that the Land of the Abandoned Gods hid too many secrets.
"However, that challenge task is complete.
Although there were some twists and turns, the result was decent.
Han Xing touched the cold badge in his hand.
With this, he could advance into a Second Transformation Professional anytime.
At that time, his strength would surge again.
However, Han Xing didn’t change profession immediately.
Instead, he looked at the token beneath Longte and the golden greatsword beside him.
"Huh? Did some equipment really drop?"
Han Xing was quite surprised and hurried over.
After picking up the items off the ground, a system prompt appeared.
[Obtained City Lord’s Order*1, obtained Dawn Sword (Gold)*1]
"City Lord’s Order? What’s this?"
Han Xing looked at the attributes of the two items in his hand.
[City Lord’s Order]: Special item, when the survivor’s territory meets the conditions, the City Lord’s Order can be used to build a main city of your own.
"Build my own main city?"
Han Xing gazed at the stone token in his hand, eyes full of wonder.
"Does main city mean my own city?"
"But, it requires meeting certain conditions. What are these conditions?"
Han Xing was full of confusion.
Undoubtedly, this City Lord’s Order was an extremely valuable item.
But currently, Han Xing hadn’t met the requirements, so he continued to check the other item.
[Dawn Sword (Gold) lv20, Quality - Legend, Attack Power: 304~324, Strength +50, Constitution +50.]
[Attached Effect]: Light of Judgment (Deals 50% extra damage to undead creatures).
[Attached Effect]: Jade Radiance (When activating support skills, there’s a 100% chance to convert 100 Power into Spirit).

[Attached Effect]: Light of Dawn (Legendary Effect, summons a beam of dawn, merging into the weapon. Upon burst, it deals 500% light attribute damage to the enemy and forces blindness for five seconds.)
"Light of Dawn?"
Han Xing looked at the last effect of this weapon and recalled Knight Longte’s last attack launched in the hall, seemingly exhibiting this effect.
However, he didn’t even get to use the skill before Han Xing interrupted him.
"Legendary Quality, and also level 20 equipment, the attributes of this Dawn Sword are really impressive," Han Xing said joyfully.
"Although, strictly speaking, its attributes aren’t as good as Cheng Jianyong’s level 15 Orange Greatsword, it can still be taken to the trading house for swapping with other equivalent equipment."
One should know, with the current scarcity of golden equipment blueprints, even Han Xing cannot acquire golden equipment in bulk.
After dealing with the equipment dropped by Longte,
Han Xing went back to the hall where the battle just occurred.
Han Xing vaguely remembered that when he blasted those undead to death, some things were left on the ground.
Han Xing walked over.
Sure enough, he saw a cluster of glowing crystal powder.
After picking it up, a system prompt appeared.
[Obtain Resentful Spirit Crystal *8.]
[Resentful Spirit Crystal]: A product of black magic.
The soul crystal left by tormented souls after death, filled with their resentment towards this world.
By using certain evil rituals and a mediator, powerful resentful spirits can be summoned again.
"Black magic? Isn’t this guy a knight? How did he come into contact with such things?"
Han Xing’s eyes flashed with thought.
Could it be related to the woman Longte mentioned?
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
[You have defeated the owner of this territory. This Sky Island is now unowned. You can choose to merge or abandon it.]
Looking at the prompt before him, he shook his head and said, "Forget it, how he came into contact doesn’t matter. Let’s merge this city first."
Han Xing stood up, then looked at the vast Sky Island before him.
In his eyes, there appeared a look of anticipation.
Because this is the largest Sky Island he has ever merged.
It even has a complete small city on it.
Among them are many special buildings he has never seen before, such as an Intermediate Spiritual Pyramid, a Smelting Workshop, a tavern, and more...
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.

[Successfully merged the unowned Sky Island. Your territory area has expanded and gained territory buildings: Intermediate City Lord’s Mansion *1 (damaged, needs repairs), Intermediate Shield Pyramid *1, Smelting Workshop *1 (damaged, needs repairs), Tavern *1 (damaged, needs repairs), Refining Workshop *1, Ordinary Residential Houses *103 (some damaged, need repairs) ...]
[Territory Resources Acquired: Palace Brew *742, Food *12314, Mithril *4131, obtained...]
A string of system prompts appeared, ranging from various grain seeds to residential houses, taverns, smelting workshops, and city lord’s mansions.
Han Xing was stunned.
Because the harvest inside this Sky Island seemed a bit beyond his expectations.
These already built structures, after the merger, also became his personal property.
Although they are all ordinary buildings, most of which require consuming materials for refurbishment,
there are several special buildings among them that he doesn’t have, such as an Intermediate City Lord’s Mansion, a Smelting Workshop, an Intermediate Shield Pyramid, and so on.
In other words, he is now effectively the new owner of this city.
At this moment, Han Xing’s joy was almost uncontainable as he laughed heartily, "Longte, your city is quite good, but now it’s mine!"
Han Xing quickly opened the territory interface to review the buildings he just acquired.
[City Lord’s Mansion]: Intermediate Building.
[Defense Value]: 10000

[Building Effect]: Increases all defensive buildings’ defense value by 30%, increases all attacking buildings’ attack power by 20%, boosts all allied units’ All Attributes by 15%, and increases the Sky Island territory’s travel speed by 20%.
[Additional Effect]: Accelerates territory building construction time by 20%.
[State]: 5% building area damaged, needs repairs, repair materials required, Stone Block *74512, Refined Iron *4212, Mithril *412, Rare Earth *15541...
Compared to a Basic Castle, the City Lord’s Mansion is an intermediate building that offers stronger enhancement effects and has a total defense value of 10000 points.
Then there is the Intermediate Shield Pyramid, its function is similar to the Junior Shield Pyramid.
However, it can cover a larger area, and its shield’s defense value is higher.
Then there’s a special building which is the Smelting Workshop.
[Smelting Workshop]: Territorial Building
[Building Effect]: Can refine and process ores transported to the Smelting Workshop.
[State]: Damaged (some functions cannot be used.)
"Finally got a Smelting Workshop!" Han Xing exclaimed with joy.
Having a Smelting Workshop means Han Xing can exploit the rich mineral veins within his territory, such as Refined Iron Ore, Constant Gold Ore, and Purple Gold Ore, among others.
After processing, they can be turned into refined iron blocks and permanent gold ingots, which can be directly used to craft equipment!
Although Han Xing currently obtains materials from the trading house, which fully meets his daily needs,
it’s a pity not to mine the mountains at his doorstep.
Thinking of this, Han Xing immediately clicked repair.
[Would you like to consume materials: Stone Block *4151, Wood *723, Refined Iron *182, Mithril *30, to repair the ’Smelting Workshop’?]
