[Obtained City Lord’s Order*1, obtained Dawn Sword (Gold)*1]
"City Lord’s Order?
What’s this?"
Han Xing looked at the attributes of the two items in his hand.
[City Lord’s Order]: Special item, when the survivor’s territory meets the conditions, the City Lord’s Order can be used to build a main city of your own.
"Build my own main city?"
Han Xing gazed at the stone token in his hand, eyes full of wonder.
"Does main city mean my own city?"
"But, it requires meeting certain conditions.
What are these conditions?"
Han Xing was full of confusion.
Undoubtedly, this City Lord’s Order was an extremely valuable item.
But currently, Han Xing hadn’t met the requirements, so he continued to check the other item.
[Dawn Sword (Gold) lv20, Quality - Legend, Attack Power: 304~324, Strength +50, Constitution +50.]
[Attached Effect]: Light of Judgment (Deals 50% extra damage to undead creatures).
[Attached Effect]: Jade Radiance (When activating support skills, there’s a 100% chance to convert 100 Power into Spirit).
[Attached Effect]: Light of Dawn (Legendary Effect, summons a beam of dawn, merging into the weapon.
Upon burst, it deals 500% light attribute damage to the enemy and forces blindness for five seconds.)
"Light of Dawn?"
Han Xing looked at the last effect of this weapon and recalled Knight Longte’s last attack launched in the hall, seemingly exhibiting this effect.
However, he didn’t even get to use the skill before Han Xing interrupted him.
"Legendary Quality, and also level 20 equipment, the attributes of this Dawn Sword are really impressive," Han Xing said joyfully.
"Although, strictly speaking, its attributes aren’t as good as Cheng Jianyong’s level 15 Orange Greatsword, it can still be taken to the trading house for swapping with other equivalent equipment."
One should know, with the current scarcity of golden equipment blueprints, even Han Xing cannot acquire golden equipment in bulk.
After dealing with the equipment dropped by Longte,
Han Xing went back to the hall where the battle just occurred.
Han Xing vaguely remembered that when he blasted those undead to death, some things were left on the ground.
Han Xing walked over.
Sure enough, he saw a cluster of glowing crystal powder.
After picking it up, a system prompt appeared.
[Obtain Resentful Spirit Crystal *8.]
[Resentful Spirit Crystal]: A product of black magic.
The soul crystal left by tormented souls after death, filled with their resentment towards this world.
By using certain evil rituals and a mediator, powerful resentful spirits can be summoned again.
"Black magic?
Isn’t this guy a knight?
How did he come into contact with such things?"
Han Xing’s eyes flashed with thought.
Could it be related to the woman Longte mentioned?
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
[You have defeated the owner of this territory.
This Sky Island is now unowned.
You can choose to merge or abandon it.]
Looking at the prompt before him, he shook his head and said, "Forget it, how he came into contact doesn’t matter.
Let’s merge this city first."
Han Xing stood up, then looked at the vast Sky Island before him.
In his eyes, there appeared a look of anticipation.
Because this is the largest Sky Island he has ever merged.
It even has a complete small city on it.
Among them are many special buildings he has never seen before, such as an Intermediate Spiritual Pyramid, a Smelting Workshop, a tavern, and more...
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
[Successfully merged the unowned Sky Island.

Your territory area has expanded and gained territory buildings: Intermediate City Lord’s Mansion *1 (damaged, needs repairs), Intermediate Shield Pyramid *1, Smelting Workshop *1 (damaged, needs repairs), Tavern *1 (damaged, needs repairs), Refining Workshop *1, Ordinary Residential Houses *103 (some damaged, need repairs) ...]
[Territory Resources Acquired: Palace Brew *742, Food *12314, Mithril *4131, obtained...]
A string of system prompts appeared, ranging from various grain seeds to residential houses, taverns, smelting workshops, and city lord’s mansions.
Han Xing was stunned.
Because the harvest inside this Sky Island seemed a bit beyond his expectations.
These already built structures, after the merger, also became his personal property.
Although they are all ordinary buildings, most of which require consuming materials for refurbishment,
there are several special buildings among them that he doesn’t have, such as an Intermediate City Lord’s Mansion, a Smelting Workshop, an Intermediate Shield Pyramid, and so on.
In other words, he is now effectively the new owner of this city.
At this moment, Han Xing’s joy was almost uncontainable as he laughed heartily, "Longte, your city is quite good, but now it’s mine!"
Han Xing quickly opened the territory interface to review the buildings he just acquired.
[City Lord’s Mansion]: Intermediate Building.
[Defense Value]: 10000

[Building Effect]: Increases all defensive buildings’ defense value by 30%, increases all attacking buildings’ attack power by 20%, boosts all allied units’ All Attributes by 15%, and increases the Sky Island territory’s travel speed by 20%.
[Additional Effect]: Accelerates territory building construction time by 20%.
[State]: 5% building area damaged, needs repairs, repair materials required, Stone Block *74512, Refined Iron *4212, Mithril *412, Rare Earth *15541...
Compared to a Basic Castle, the City Lord’s Mansion is an intermediate building that offers stronger enhancement effects and has a total defense value of 10000 points.
Then there is the Intermediate Shield Pyramid, its function is similar to the Junior Shield Pyramid.
However, it can cover a larger area, and its shield’s defense value is higher.
Then there’s a special building which is the Smelting Workshop.
[Smelting Workshop]: Territorial Building
[Building Effect]: Can refine and process ores transported to the Smelting Workshop.
[State]: Damaged (some functions cannot be used.)
"Finally got a Smelting Workshop!" Han Xing exclaimed with joy.
Having a Smelting Workshop means Han Xing can exploit the rich mineral veins within his territory, such as Refined Iron Ore, Constant Gold Ore, and Purple Gold Ore, among others.
After processing, they can be turned into refined iron blocks and permanent gold ingots, which can be directly used to craft equipment!
Although Han Xing currently obtains materials from the trading house, which fully meets his daily needs,
it’s a pity not to mine the mountains at his doorstep.
Thinking of this, Han Xing immediately clicked repair.
[Would you like to consume materials: Stone Block *4151, Wood *723, Refined Iron *182, Mithril *30, to repair the ’Smelting Workshop’?]

chapters.title: Chapter 148 - 126: City Building! Lord Contract Function Unlocked!
paragraphs: [Do you want to consume materials: Stone Block*4151, Wood*723, Refined Iron*182, Mithril*30, to repair the ’Smelting Workshop’.]
"Yes." Han Xing directly clicked to confirm.
The next moment, Han Xing saw a black mist appear on a two-story building at the edge of the small city.
The system was already conducting repair work.
Meanwhile, Han Xing consumed some materials to repair the City Lord’s Mansion as well.
Soon, a system prompt came through.
[City Lord’s Mansion repair successful, Smelting Workshop repair successful. Now, you can view related building information on the territory interface.]
Han Xing clicked to view.
[Smelting Workshop]: Territorial Building.
[Defense Value]: 100
[Building Effect]: After transporting ores to the Smelting Workshop, they can be refined and processed.
This thing requires a person to specially transport ores to the Smelting Workshop for work.
But Han Xing currently doesn’t have the manpower.
Anyway, he doesn’t lack materials now, so he decided to think about it later.
In the future, if he finds a kind of resource Sky Island full of mineral veins, Han Xing will consider hiring a batch of people specifically for mining,
At this time, Han Xing discovered another interesting building among them.
[Refining Workshop]: By developing workshop technology levels, it can increase the success rate of crafting equipment or shorten the time needed to craft equipment.

[Technology 1, Entry-Level Artisan]: Consumes Spirit Core*20000, Refined Iron*5000, Mithril*100 to upgrade ’Entry-Level Artisan’ technology level. Each level up increases crafting success rate by 1%, with a maximum level of 20.

[Technology 2, Basic Pipeline]: Consumes Spirit Core*10000, Refined Iron*2000, Mithril*50 to upgrade ’Pipeline Operation’ technology level. Each level up shortens equipment crafting time by 1%, with a maximum level of 50.
"Wow, aren’t these two technologies a bit too powerful?" Han Xing was amazed.
The first technology, for other survivors, is almost a divine attribute.
Although it consumes a lot of materials, it can increase the success rate when crafting equipment. Fully maxed out, it can even increase the success rate by 20%.
But Han Xing himself already has a 100% success rate and doesn’t need this at all.
What caught his eye was the second attribute of the Refining Workshop, which shortens the time to craft equipment.
For Han Xing, this is truly a divine attribute!
When survivors craft equipment, although each piece only takes a few seconds to tens of seconds, this time is not long.
But Han Xing is different, he crafts thousands at a time in batches, and the time required is often dozens of hours.
Now, he’s almost posting production interface overnight, producing one or two thousand backpacks a day.
Even so, the production efficiency is still unsatisfactory.
Because the trading market now has a huge demand for backpacks.
If this technology is maxed out, it will effectively double Han Xing’s money-making speed!
He immediately couldn’t wait to open the Refining Workshop interface and see the two research branches on it.
He directly clicked on the second technology, ’Basic Pipeline.’
[Do you want to consume materials: Spirit Core*10000, Refined Iron*2000, Mithril*50 to upgrade ’Basic Pipeline’ technology level.]
"Yes."
Han Xing began to click crazily.
After reaching level 10, the materials required to upgrade the technology started to increase by 50%.
But Han Xing didn’t care and continued to click furiously.
At level 20, the materials required increased by another 50%, and the technology name changed to ’Intermediate Pipeline.’
Han Xing pondered, calculating that reaching level 50 would just consume one million Spirit Cores, plus 200,000 Refined Iron and 50,000 pieces of Mithril.
If it were other survivors, collecting these materials step by step, it wouldn’t be known how long it would take just to max out the technology.
He directly maxed out the technology level.
Now, the technology interface of the Refining Workshop had become:
[Entry-Level Artisan lv1]: Increases crafting success rate by 1% when crafting equipment.
[Advanced Pipeline Max]: Shortens crafting time by 50% when crafting equipment.
Han Xing felt extremely excited!
This way, the number of backpacks he can make each day has increased significantly.
At this moment.
A message came through the team chat interface, it was from Cheng Jianyong.
Cheng Jianyong: "Brother Xing, what’s the situation over there? I heard a few explosions earlier, but now it’s quiet. Do you need us to come over?"
Han Xing replied: "It’s over, you can come over now."
Upon hearing this, everyone came down from Han Xing’s territory and walked into the small city.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong and the others were looking around the streets with strong curiosity in their eyes.
They touched the walls from time to time and looked at the buildings by the road.
"So beautiful... it really is a city!" Zhang Lianmeng exclaimed as she walked.
Seeing them approach, Han Xing also stepped forward and said, "This is hardly a city. At most, it’s just a small town."
However, Zhang Lianmeng looked at Han Xing with a face full of admiration.
Because she had heard Han Xing mention his dream of building a city before.
She didn’t expect that in just a few days, he was already close to realizing it.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong also praised: "So many houses, the scale of this town is quite large."
"And these little houses are really beautiful, just like those two-story villas in Europe, with terraces. They’re way better than the pigeonhole I bought in Xinyang City."
Han Xing casually said, "If you like these houses, feel free to pick a few for yourself."
Cheng Jianyong’s eyes lit up with delight, "Really?"
Han Xing nodded; for this type of ordinary residential building, there are over a hundred in the whole town, and he hasn’t found any use for them yet, so leaving them idle is no problem.
Cheng Jianyong quickly thanked him.
At this moment, Shen Yun also excitedly said, "Brother Xing, can I choose a few as well?"
Han Xing nodded, "Sure."
Shen Yun started looking around excitedly.
He immediately took a liking to several houses closest to the City Lord’s Mansion and excitedly said, "I want this one, this one, and this one!"
With each point of Shen Yun’s finger, he had already chosen five or six houses.

Before Han Xing could speak, Cheng Jianyong, looking puzzled, asked, "Xiaoyunzi, why do you want so many houses? Are you planning to move your whole family to live in Brother Xing’s territory? Aren’t you embarrassed?"
Shen Yun replied disdainfully, "You just don’t understand; I’m interested in the future value of these houses."
"Future value?" Everyone looked at Shen Yun.
Shen Yun explained, "Yeah, with Brother Xing’s strength, the speed of territorial expansion will definitely increase!"
"Next, as Brother Xing’s territory expands, eventually, he will surely be able to build a city."
"Once we Blue Star people establish ourselves in this world and no longer need to fight frequently, that’s when business will rise."
"And because of Brother Xing’s strength, the safety of this city will be guaranteed, which will definitely attract a large number of people to settle here."
"I’ve already thought this through for Brother Xing. Those who settle must sign various contracts, and they must pay Brother Xing a large amount of rent each year."
"By then, this street of Brother Xing’s will be the city center, and it will literally be as valuable as gold!
"Let me tell you, in the future, just relying on these storefronts will be enough for the Shen family to live comfortably for generations."
After Shen Yun finished analyzing, everyone looked at him in disbelief.
It seemed unexpected that he could think this far ahead.
He even considered future human matters.
However, what Shen Yun said wasn’t unreasonable.
Among the current survivors, if not the strongest, the one progressing the fastest is definitely Han Xing.
Once a city is truly built in the future, Han Xing may choose to open it to other Human Race members as a large, stationary commercial city to funnel resources to Han Xing.
Meanwhile, Han Xing could control other territory cores to continue collecting Sky Island fragments from this world.
This is also a viable method of development.
Seeing the surprised expressions of everyone, Shen Yun was filled with pride.
But at this moment, Cheng Jianyong struck a blow, "A few generations? You haven’t even found a girlfriend and you’re thinking this far ahead?"
"Damn! Cheng Jianyong, will you die if you don’t bring that up?" Shen Yun deflated immediately.
After hitting Shen Yun, Cheng Jianyong seemed very pleased.
He seemed to have thought of something and suddenly asked.
"Brother Xing, by the way, should we give this town a name?"
"Name it?"
"Yeah, this is the first city of our Blue Star humans in this world. It’s a shame if it doesn’t have a name."
Everyone also expressed their agreement.
After a moment of thought, Han Xing said, "Then let’s call it Xingyu City."
"Xingyu City..."
Everyone repeated the name aloud,
And just then, a system notification appeared.
[Do you want to use City Lord’s Order*1 to name this city?]
[After naming, you will become the new City Lord, and the Lord Contract Function will be enabled.]
Han Xing was taken aback.
Unexpectedly, the City Lord’s Order dropped from killing that old knight had this effect.
A new City Lord?
So, does this mean I’m now eligible to establish a city?
Han Xing directly clicked ’Yes.’
[Naming successful, the first city among survivors has appeared, world influence +47, Legendary Points +10, extra reward: Thunder Tower Construction Plan*1.]
Before Han Xing could recover from his daze.
A system announcement interrupted everyone’s thoughts.
System Announcement: "Attention all survivors, the first settlement among survivors has appeared. The Territorial Contract Function is now active."

[Territorial Contract Function]: After the Lord initiates a contract with another survivor, the signer will be deemed to have relinquished the rights to their own territory, merging with the other party’s territory. The signer can reside in the other party’s territory to develop together, with the contract lasting for 3 years.
Note 1: The signer may not attack the Lord or engage in actions detrimental to the Lord’s interests.
Note 2: 10%-50% of the subsequent gains obtained by the signer must be handed over to the Lord. (Specific value to be determined by both parties.)
Note 3: The Lord cannot force the signer to carry out tasks but can expel them.
This announcement left all survivors dumbfounded.
The chat channel instantly exploded into heated discussions.

chapters.title: Chapter 149 - 127: Xingyu City!
paragraphs: At this moment, Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion, "What does this territory contract function mean? Isn’t this just a deed of enslavement? This seems too unfair to the signatories. I wonder, would anyone even sign it?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment, nodded, and said, "There will be. That unfairness you mentioned is based on equal strength. But what if it’s for someone new to this world?"
"Note that in a few days, the second batch of humans is going to be dropped here..."
This reminder made the crowd suddenly recall this fact.
In a few days, their relatives will arrive in this world.
Except for Han Xing, who is special, everyone present has their fair share of relatives.
When they first enter this world, feeling weak and alone, they can only seek shelter from their kin.
Those like Cheng Jianyong who have already gained a foothold here can offer some level of protection to their relatives.
But what if their relatives are all gone?
Entering this world without any support.
Then they can only start afresh like Han Xing and others.
For those who inherently lack combat ability, finding a stranger to sign the contract, although it temporarily costs them freedom,
They can still continue living, gain experience, and have time to develop.
Meanwhile, their safety can still be ensured.
Furthermore, the second clause notes that the lord can’t issue mandatory orders to other survivors, which means lords are prevented from using survivors as cannon fodder.
However, by doing so, the signatory will have to work for the other party.
Shen Yun spoke up, "Brother Xing is right. Losing freedom is still better than losing one’s life."
"But this way, territories owned by the strong will definitely be welcomed by many, since they have ready defense facilities, which are very reassuring."
After Shen Yun spoke, everyone suddenly looked at Han Xing.
In terms of safety, it’s unlikely any survivor’s territory can compare to Han Xing’s Sky Island.
After all, he spent nearly an ocean of materials to build over 700 siege crossbow arrow launcher platforms on it.
Moreover, this time, he directly annexed a city, leading to the emergence of various intermediate buildings.
One could say that, should Han Xing wish to, even slightly revealing some information,
could attract a multitude of Blue Star People to his territory to sign a contract with him.
Han Xing shook his head and said, "Don’t look at me, I’m not ready to recruit other survivors yet, as it would be tough to manage many people at once."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded unanimously.
After some discussion, Han Xing decided to restructure his current territory.
Xingyu City, newly named, has just merged.
At present, the city is situated at the very edge of his territory.
The core of Han Xing’s territory remains that Basic Castle.
Han Xing has lived in this castle for quite a while and is quite used to it.
However, compared to the Basic Castle’s 1000 Defense Value, the City Lord’s Mansion boasts a massive 10,000 Defense Value, nearly tenfold.
Staying within the City Lord’s Mansion significantly increases security.
Therefore, Han Xing intends to move his Xingyu City to the center of his territory.
Thinking this, Han Xing got straight to work.
Then, he began his manipulations of the territory.
Under Han Xing’s control, block by block of land began to change locations.
The ground shook violently.
Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and others had retreated back into their own territories, watching Han Xing’s operation.
Once a territory reaches a certain scale, its restructuring becomes awfully dramatic.
He moved mountains and carved up forests.
Rumble~
It felt like the world was being opened anew, with mountains and rivers rearranging.
Though this wasn’t their first time witnessing such a scene,
this god-like act of creation still deeply amazed them.
After a busy session, Han Xing’s territory underwent an earth-shattering transformation.
In front of the crowd appeared a massive mountain range with an area of over hundreds of thousands of square meters.
The first thing to catch one’s eyes was the bustling town atop the mountain.
This town was quite sizable, covering more than twenty thousand square meters, with a unique architectural style.
Around the town was a blue stone brick wall about two meters high, upon which four people could walk abreast.
From a distance, it looked like a giant beast crouching atop the mountain, leaving a strong impression.
Han Xing had also relocated over five hundred siege crossbow arrows to the walls, placing them every few meters.
Even if the territory gets breached, there would still be one last defense line.
The place atop the wall provides the best view.
The edges of the town are covered by small groves, each hiding siege crossbow arrows.
The layout is much like before.
Looking down is a wide grassland, like a flat plain.
On the plain stand a group of hulking Puppet Giants, among them Han Xing’s Spiritual Puppets, as well as the Golden Armor and Silver Armor Puppets of others.
A small river gently flows down from the mountain top, merging into the steaming lake on the plain.
In astonishment, everyone gazed at this magical style floating island and couldn’t help but exclaim.
"So beautiful..."
"How cool!"
Han Xing clapped his hands and said, "Alright, from now on, this Xingyu City will be our new base."
Compared to before, Han Xing’s territory looked like a large plain.
Now, the territory has undergone an earth-shattering change.

sentences.text: At this moment, Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion, "What does this territory contract function mean?
Isn’t this just a deed of enslavement?
This seems too unfair to the signatories.
I wonder, would anyone even sign it?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment, nodded, and said, "There will be.
That unfairness you mentioned is based on equal strength.
But what if it’s for someone new to this world?"
"Note that in a few days, the second batch of humans is going to be dropped here..."
This reminder made the crowd suddenly recall this fact.
In a few days, their relatives will arrive in this world.
Except for Han Xing, who is special, everyone present has their fair share of relatives.
When they first enter this world, feeling weak and alone, they can only seek shelter from their kin.
Those like Cheng Jianyong who have already gained a foothold here can offer some level of protection to their relatives.
But what if their relatives are all gone?
Entering this world without any support.
Then they can only start afresh like Han Xing and others.
For those who inherently lack combat ability, finding a stranger to sign the contract, although it temporarily costs them freedom,
They can still continue living, gain experience, and have time to develop.
Meanwhile, their safety can still be ensured.
Furthermore, the second clause notes that the lord can’t issue mandatory orders to other survivors, which means lords are prevented from using survivors as cannon fodder.
However, by doing so, the signatory will have to work for the other party.
Shen Yun spoke up, "Brother Xing is right.
Losing freedom is still better than losing one’s life."
"But this way, territories owned by the strong will definitely be welcomed by many, since they have ready defense facilities, which are very reassuring."
After Shen Yun spoke, everyone suddenly looked at Han Xing.
In terms of safety, it’s unlikely any survivor’s territory can compare to Han Xing’s Sky Island.
After all, he spent nearly an ocean of materials to build over 700 siege crossbow arrow launcher platforms on it.
Moreover, this time, he directly annexed a city, leading to the emergence of various intermediate buildings.
One could say that, should Han Xing wish to, even slightly revealing some information,
could attract a multitude of Blue Star People to his territory to sign a contract with him.
Han Xing shook his head and said, "Don’t look at me, I’m not ready to recruit other survivors yet, as it would be tough to manage many people at once."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded unanimously.
After some discussion, Han Xing decided to restructure his current territory.
Xingyu City, newly named, has just merged.
At present, the city is situated at the very edge of his territory.
The core of Han Xing’s territory remains that Basic Castle.
Han Xing has lived in this castle for quite a while and is quite used to it.
However, compared to the Basic Castle’s 1000 Defense Value, the City Lord’s Mansion boasts a massive 10,000 Defense Value, nearly tenfold.
Staying within the City Lord’s Mansion significantly increases security.
Therefore, Han Xing intends to move his Xingyu City to the center of his territory.
Thinking this, Han Xing got straight to work.
Then, he began his manipulations of the territory.
Under Han Xing’s control, block by block of land began to change locations.
The ground shook violently.
Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and others had retreated back into their own territories, watching Han Xing’s operation.
Once a territory reaches a certain scale, its restructuring becomes awfully dramatic.
He moved mountains and carved up forests.
Rumble~
It felt like the world was being opened anew, with mountains and rivers rearranging.
Though this wasn’t their first time witnessing such a scene,
this god-like act of creation still deeply amazed them.

chapters.title: Chapter 150 - 127: Xingyu City!
paragraphs: If placed on Blue Star, it would be at least a 5A-level scenic spot.
Everyone, fueled by strong curiosity, began to wander around this town.
Then, Han Xing walked up to the city wall and started admiring his increasingly vast territory.
At this moment, he stood as if on a mountaintop, with all the facilities in clear view below.
Han Xing nodded in satisfaction and said, "Great, with this layout, it’s easy to defend and hard to attack."
"Once the leaderboard rewards are settled, we can start mass-producing the Flamethrower Catapults, enhancing firepower."
"Then place the Wolf Cavalry Camp and Minotaur Camp below and start massing troops, that plain will be where the army is stationed in the future."
"Now, just waiting for the leaderboard rewards to be settled."
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly remembered something, his brain whirred to action, and he quickly said, "Hmm? Wait! Didn’t the system just reward me with a blueprint?"
Han Xing quickly opened his backpack to check.
[Lightning Tower Construction Plan]: A territory-type defensive building.
[Building Effect]: Deals 2000 thunder attribute damage to enemies in front of 20*10000 meters, targets hit will also suffer a 2-second paralysis effect, charge time 20 seconds.
"Hiss! What a powerful defense tower!"

The damage of this Lightning Tower is truly terrifying, 2000 thunder attribute damage, almost three times that of a Siege Crossbow Arrow Launcher Platform, even a Three-star creature might get electrocuted instantly.
The most crucial thing is that the Lightning Tower deals area damage.
If several are built, it can form an almost overwhelming firepower coverage network.
Han Xing could even imagine the horror of hundreds or even thousands of Lightning Towers erupting simultaneously, the roaring thunder like an apocalyptic scene.
The scene must be very breathtaking!
Han Xing even wanted to build hundreds of Lightning Towers right on the spot. He impatiently checked the construction requirements.
[Materials for Building the Thunder Tower]: Refined Iron*300000, Mithril*50000, Permanent Gold Ingot*500, Magic Crystal*200000, Rare Earth*500000, Thunder Stone*1000.
"Oh my, the materials needed are too much..."
Han Xing was dumbfounded; the amount of materials required to build a Lightning Tower was unimaginably vast.
Just those 500 Permanent Gold Ingots are enough to deplete any team’s foundation.
Even with Han Xing’s current material reserves, he could barely build forty to fifty Lightning Towers.
But that is just an ideal situation. In fact, he couldn’t even build one right now.
Because he didn’t have the last material, Thunder Stone.
Han Xing could only hope the trade channel had this material.
He hurriedly opened the trade channel to search for Thunder Stone.
After filtering, there were still over seven hundred consignments remaining.
Han Xing sighed in relief.
As long as Thunder Stone is a tradeable material, he doesn’t need to worry.
Han Xing casually clicked one to see the information displayed on the material.
[Thunder Stone]: A peculiar ore containing intense Thunder Elemental Power, can be used to make thunder-attribute weapons, or certain special buildings.
Han Xing checked the price of Thunder Stone in the market.
Due to its clear use, its price is almost fixed.
The market price is 3000 Spirit Cores per piece.
"So cheap!"
Seeing the price above, Han Xing excitedly rubbed his hands together.
The current trade channel’s seven hundred or so consignments had a total of over 10,000 Thunder Stones!
If Han Xing bought them all, it would be enough to construct a dozen Lightning Towers!
Before the other guys watching the market could react, Han Xing began to frantically snap up this material called ’Thunder Stone.’
[Trade Successful, you obtained Thunder Stone*23, you lost Spirit Cores 69000...]
[Trade Successful, you obtained Thunder Stone*17...]
One trading message after another came in, Han Xing’s Spirit Core reserves rapidly declined. In just one minute, he had traded nearly 20 million Spirit Cores!
But Han Xing did not feel distressed because it was all worth it!
A few minutes later, the entire trade market’s Thunder Stones were all swept away by him.
And Han Xing, looking at the 11451 Thunder Stones in his backpack, began to grin widely.

At this moment, Shen Yun who was patrolling inside the city inadvertently saw Han Xing with a grin that reached the back of his ears and had a puzzled expression, not knowing what he saw that made him so happy.
Of course, Han Xing was happy because today was undoubtedly a day of great harvest.
With his current material reserves, he’s capable of building 11 Lightning Towers at once!
These are powerful buildings capable of instant-killing Three-star monsters.
Not only is their attack range wide, but the damage is also high.
Ordinary survivors, when they build one, can declare their invincibility!
And Han Xing directly builds 11 Lightning Towers!
At this moment, Han Xing could boldly say that even if he encounters a Lord-level monster of Three-star, he would dare to face it head-on.

And if it were a weaker Lord monster, like the Knight Captain they encountered at the Knight Judgment Arena, while suppressed by the berserk firepower of the Lightning Towers, they would drink bitter under concentrated fire by Han Xing!
"Hahaha! Hahahahaha!"
Han Xing laughed excitedly.
Nothing is more exciting than an improvement in strength. In any world, safety is the primary need.
In Xingyu City, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang heard Han Xing’s laughter and curiously looked in the direction of the city wall.
Han Xing did not explain but started pacing back and forth on the city wall.
He needed to find the construction location for the Lightning Towers.
Although, with the 20,000 meters range of the Lightning Tower, it could cover the entire territory no matter where it was built.
But Han Xing still decided to build it at a high place.
On the outskirts of the city wall, Han Xing cleared out a 10m*10m area and then clicked to build.
[Do you want to consume materials: Refined Iron*300000, Mithril*50000, Permanent Gold Ingot*500, Magic Crystal*200000, Rare Earth*500000, Thunder Stone*1000 to build Lightning Tower*1?]
"Yes."
A large amount of material from the backpack disappeared, and a system prompt appeared.
[Under Construction: City Lord’s Mansion acceleration effect active, estimated time remaining, 18 hours and 34 minutes...]
The Lightning Tower is a large building, and according to the blueprint ratio, it occupies at least a hundred square meters, and once fully constructed, it is estimated to be over 50 meters high.
Han Xing started to build a Lightning Tower every few dozen meters.
Until he circled around the vicinity of Xingyu City.
All eleven Lightning Towers entered the construction phase.
Once tomorrow comes, these eleven Lightning Towers can be completely finished!
Han Xing suppressed his excitement and began to organize the construction of the Lightning Towers.
Even though, with a shooting range of 20 meters from the Thunder Tower, their attacks could cover the entire territory no matter where they were built.
Han Xing cleared a plot of 10 meters * 10 meters on the exterior of the city wall, then clicked to build another one.
[Do you want to consume materials: Refined Iron*300000, Mithril*50000, Permanent Gold Ingot*500, Magic Crystal*200000, Rare Earth*500000, Thunder Stone*1000, and build Lightning Tower*1?]
"Yes."
A massive energy flow appeared, bathing every part of the Sky Island Territory in this majestic power.
The ground began to tremble faintly.
This thunderous masterpiece will soon come to life.
Meanwhile, Han Xing opened his backpack to inspect his newly acquired Blueprints and saw the Expert Emblem lying quietly inside, a quest item.
Just with this thing, he could directly complete the Second Transformation quest.
In that instant, when Han Xing clicked confirm.
The vast Sky Island Territory roared with power, as an ancient and sacred force gathered around him.
Even Cheng Jianyong and others who were wandering around the city couldn’t help but look towards Han Xing with awe.
Meanwhile.
In a remote corner of the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
The Wild Ranger Spirit was engaged in a fierce battle with a twisted entity.
"I told you, no matter how many times you kill me, I can come back to life!" the twisted entity spoke furiously.
At this moment, the body of the Wild Ranger Spirit was scarred with bloodstains, even the mane of the silver-white wolf beside it was stained red with blood.
But both their eyes were still filled with surging War Intent.
The Wild Ranger said, "There’s no such thing as an unkillable creature; even powerful Divine Spirits, even those reputed to be immortal beasts, have their day of downfall."
"And you shall inevitably share the same fate."
"I can see that every time you resurrect, you consume the Power of a Blood Pool, and those Blood Pools are your source of Power."
The twisted Black Shadow was not in a panic but smirked coldly, "So what if you’ve figured it out?"
"Even if you keep destroying my Blood Pools, you can’t save those humans."
"What do you think I have been doing lurking in the Land of the Abandoned Gods for so long? Your strength won’t last against me, Hunter!"
